### 1. [Visual Scaffolding: Toward Native Multimodal Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25247v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25247

**作者：** Run Shao、Zhaoyang Zhang、Ziyu Li、Linrui Xu、Ji Qi、Xiu Su、Yichao Cao、Chao Tao、Haifeng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25247v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25247v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「视觉脚手架」机制，让 MLLM 在推理任意步骤自主发起检索，由轻量检索器选出原生视觉特征并直接并入演化的 CoT 中间状态供后续步骤复用，同时构建 NMR-Bench（Burden Counting、Path Tracing）在受控视觉需求下评测，并在小规模参数增量下报告了准确率。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 VLM 推理期的视觉证据获取与中间状态复用：自主检索动作可类比 LOOK 决策，视觉特征进入推理链并保留给后续步骤，内容替换干预还检验了所选视觉内容对准确率与后续选择的因果作用，可供核查视觉旁路、贡献分配与停止决策问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Scaffolding: Toward Native Multimodal Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** The success of chain-of-thought (CoT) in complex reasoning can be attributed to a textual scaffolding effect: explicit intermediate results can be examined, reused, and composed to support subsequent reasoning, much as scaffolding supports a building under construction. However, mainstream multimodal LLMs lack an equivalent scaffold for visual distinctions that are difficult to express in concise verbal descriptions. We therefore ask: Can native visual representations become first-class citizens alongside language, providing a visual scaffold for reasoning? We define native multimodal reasoning as reasoning in which native visual representations and language jointly carry reusable intermediate states. As a concrete implementation, the visual scaffolding mechanism we proposed lets the MLLM autonomously initiate a retrieval action at any reasoning step. A lightweight retriever selects native visual features, which are then incorporated directly into the evolving CoT and remain available to subsequent steps. To evaluate this mechanism under controlled visual demands, we introduce NMR-Bench, comprising Burden Counting and Path Tracing. With 88M added parameters (approximately 2%) on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking, our model achieves 66.43% and 72.50% accuracy, respectively, surpassing the evaluated GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro baselines. Controlled interventions show that changing selected visual content affects task accuracy and can redirect subsequent visual selection even when intervening text is held fixed. These findings show that native visual states can function as intermediate reasoning material and point toward reusable scaffolds for additional modalities.

</details>

### 2. [A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25470v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25470

**作者：** Shashwat Singh、He He、Tal Linzen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25470v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25470v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 VQA 式视觉对齐能否让语言模型的文本表示本身获得视觉结构（「强多模态」），用配对的文本／图像形状计数任务比较纯文本与视觉对齐模型，并结合内部表示探测与把上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏进文本嵌入的对齐目标加以验证。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系 LVR 关心的「视觉细节是否保留在内部状态并被使用」：负结果提示 VQA 对齐未带来跨模态迁移，而视觉嵌入蒸馏提供可供核查的表示对齐线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

</details>

### 3. [SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23864v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23864

**作者：** Mushir Akhtar、M. Tanveer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23864v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23864v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画自适应 VLM 集成中「边际 conformal 覆盖有效、各计算路由条件覆盖却严重不足」的失效，提出冻结路由后按早退与升级分组做 Mondrian 校准的 SAGE-CP，并在 10 个基准、4 个冻结 VLM 上比较路由覆盖、预测集大小与调用、延迟、能耗。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联 VLM 推理中的动态计算与停止／升级决策：其路由条件覆盖缺口与分组校准思路，可供核查 early-exit 类停止策略的可靠性评价及覆盖—成本权衡。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles

**abstract/A1：** Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 2 figures, 12 tables

</details>

### 4. [Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23890v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23890

**作者：** Cai Ke、Xinghao Chen、Yuanchen Bei、Yuni Lai、Keyu Chen、Ruizhi Qiao、Siyu An、Junnan Dong、Ruifeng Xu、Xing Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23890v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23890v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LMMR：将文本隐状态与视觉 patch 特征映射到共享的稀疏自编码器概念空间，以稀疏激活作为语义地址动态构建轮级多模态记忆图，图编码器聚合跨模态与时序依赖并以连续残差注入生成骨干，同时保留原始视觉 token，在 Mem-Gallery 与 MemEye 上评测。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 latent 状态的表示与使用：概念空间和记忆图给出 latent 的构造与更新方式，连续残差注入可供核查 latent 内容是否真被答案使用，保留原生视觉 token 对应细节保留问题；其记忆组织与推理期视觉证据筛选、停止决策的边界待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Long-term personalized agents are required to reason over distributed history across modalities and evolving dialogue states. While existing flat cross-modal methods compress visual evidence prematurely and struggle with temporally stale observations, they neglect the necessity to unify multimodal and cross-session evidence. Crucially, raw multimodal memories are inherently entangled and heterogeneous, making fine-grained visual grounding and cross-modal reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present latent multimodal memory reasoning, i.e., LMMR, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term multimodal memory organization into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of converting images to text and relying on static retrieval, LMMR maps both textual hidden states and visual patch features into a shared Sparse Autoencoder concept space, establishing sparse activations as common semantic addresses to dynamically construct a turn-level multimodal memory graph. (ii) A graph encoder then aggregates cross-modal and temporal dependencies across the task-specific latent subgraph, injecting the graph readout as a continuous residual rollout into the generation backbone while retaining native visual tokens to preserve fine-grained details. Extensive experiments on nine Mem-Gallery tasks and twelve MemEye settings demonstrate that LMMR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing complex multimodal dependencies while enabling faithful and grounded responses.

</details>

### 5. [Same Space or Not: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence Through Cross-View Contradictions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23959v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23959

**作者：** Huizi Cao、Guanyu Xu、Zhixuan Liang、Ming Yin、Jiuxiang Gu、Manling Li、Mengdi Wang、Shilong Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23959v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23959v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SSoN 基准，每题给出三个同一场景的视角和一个被 3D 编辑的视角，要求模型在无参考视角的情况下找出不一致视角并解释矛盾，评测 VLM 的跨视角空间一致性，并尝试 prompt、相机信息、3D 重建与微调等干预。

**相关性简评：** 属于 VLM 多模态推理的诊断与失败分析：直接考察模型能否在内部维持跨视角一致的场景表示并筛选有效视觉证据，其 rationale 加答案监督的提升可供核查训练监督对推理贡献的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Space or Not: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence Through Cross-View Contradictions

**abstract/A1：** Spatial intelligence, the capacity to represent and reason about physical space, underlies embodied perception and real-world visual understanding. Existing benchmarks probe it through spatial relations, perspective-taking, and mental modeling. What remains underexamined is whether a model can maintain a coherent scene representation across views, since pairwise comparison alone cannot reveal which view departs from the truth. We thus introduce Same Space or Not (SSoN), a benchmark of cross-view contradiction resolution comprising 1,000 questions from seven indoor scene sources and six categories of controlled 3D edits. Each question presents three views of an unchanged scene and one view of an edited variant. Models must identify the inconsistent view and explain the contradiction without a designated trusted reference or a marked target. Our pipeline iteratively translates human review into generation constraints. Automated checks and exhaustive human validation screen out both trivial visual shortcuts and questions lacking sufficient evidence for a unique answer. Humans achieve 83.3% accuracy, compared with 39.7% for the strongest vision-language models (VLMs), falling to 34.9% when a valid visual explanation is also required. We investigate prompting, camera information, and 3D reconstruction as interventions. On a 100-question intervention set with a 24% baseline, prompting and 3D reconstruction remain below 50% answer accuracy, except when ground-truth camera information is supplied, which reaches 61% answer accuracy but only 48% True solve accuracy. On a held-out 201-question test set, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 21.89% accuracy, 33.33% after answer-only fine-tuning, and 41.79% after fine-tuning on both rationales and answers. These results identify cross-view contradiction resolution as a substantial weakness of current VLMs that can be partly addressed by targeted supervision.

</details>

### 6. [Learning When to Trust and Reobserve Sparse-Frame VideoQA from Temporal Sampling Perturbations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23969v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23969

**作者：** Shujia Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23969v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究稀疏帧 VideoQA 中仅采样时间戳变化就导致答案翻转的问题，提出 PhaseGuard+：在受控时间偏移上探测冻结 VLM，用轻量模型分别预测相位投票答案的可靠性，以及某个「补救动作」（加密帧或换更强模型）的逐样本正确性增益，并按后者只路由预期受益的样本。

**相关性简评：** 把「答案是否可信」与「再观察是否有价值」拆成两个分数，直接对应 LVR 关注的 LOOK/STOP 决策与证据获取的成本收益权衡；可供核查其可靠性预测是否优于 token 置信度、以及动作价值估计能否迁移为 latent 状态下的停止与再观察准则。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning When to Trust and Reobserve Sparse-Frame VideoQA from Temporal Sampling Perturbations

**abstract/A1：** Sparse-frame video-language models can change their answers when only the sampling timestamps shift. Raw agreement exposes this problem, but it need not rank errors better than token confidence or identify which additional observation will repair an answer. We argue that answer risk and action value must be estimated separately. PhaseGuard+ probes a frozen VLM at controlled temporal offsets, predicts the reliability of the phase-vote answer, and predicts the example-wise correctness gain of a specific rescue action. The second score routes only examples expected to benefit from denser frames or a stronger VLM. Both predictors use lightweight models trained on public data; the VLMs remain frozen. We use 256 Perception Test videos for method development and evaluate on a disjoint 256-video test set comprising 554 Physics questions. For Qwen3-VL-8B, reliability AUROC rises from 68.0% with token softmax to 74.8% (+6.8 pp, 95% CI \[2.6, 10.7\] pp). Routing 30% of questions to Qwen3-VL-32B reaches 67.87% accuracy, compared with 63.66% for budget-matched random routing (+4.21 percentage points, CI \[1.89, 6.40\]). All four tested rescue pairs significantly outperform random routing. Temporal sensitivity becomes actionable when the system learns both whether an answer is unreliable and whether an available action is likely to fix it.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical Understanding for Decision-Making (PhysUnderstand), Poster

</details>

### 7. [How Much Can We Prune? Exploring the Performance Limits of Visual Token Pruning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23974v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23974

**作者：** Janghoon Cho、Shubhankar Borse、Reza Pourreza、Juntae Lee、Jihwan Bang、Munawar Hayat、Fatih Porikli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23974v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23974v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文探究视觉 token 剪枝的性能上限：把通用图像理解的剪枝建模为固定预算下选取一个共享视觉 token 子集，用前沿 VLM 生成的辅助 QA 集近似其效用，在被评估模型冻结下优化 teacher-forced 答案概率，并提出基于 QA 小批量的贪心方法 QA-MBG 构造嵌套子集，在九个基准上比较其与现有剪枝基线的差距。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及视觉证据筛选与预算—收益关系：其离线搜索得到的嵌套子集轨迹和 token 边际增益估计，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK 保留多少视觉证据、剪枝是否为推理收益的主要瓶颈，以及现有剪枝方法离「上限」还有多远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Can We Prune? Exploring the Performance Limits of Visual Token Pruning

**abstract/A1：** Visual token pruning is increasingly used to reduce the memory and inference costs of vision-language models. Existing work has largely focused on designing method-specific selectors and demonstrating incremental improvements over prior methods at selected token budgets. It remains unclear whether the resulting performance reflects an inherent limit of visual token pruning or the limitations of current token-selection algorithms. We take a complementary perspective and ask: \\emph{how well can visual token pruning perform when offline search cost is not the primary constraint?} We formulate pruning for general image understanding as selecting, under a fixed budget, one shared visual-token subset that supports a broad distribution of questions about an image. We approximate this utility with a finite auxiliary QA set generated by a frontier VLM and optimize a teacher-forced answer-probability objective with the evaluated model frozen. Motivated by the conceptual monotonicity and diminishing returns of adding visual evidence, we construct nested subsets greedily and introduce \\emph{QA mini-batch greedy} (QA-MBG), which estimates token marginal gains from randomly sampled QA components at each step. Empirically, QA-MBG is both cheaper and more effective than full greedy. With one frontier-VLM call and approximately $0.5$ H100 GPU-hours per image, it produces a nested subset trajectory covering keep ratios up to $0.3$. Across Qwen3-VL-4B and Gemma~4 E4B on $900$ images from nine benchmarks, we find significant headroom over evaluated pruning baselines on held-out QA and image-grounded long-form generation, while the searched subsets substantially narrow the gap to full-token inference.

</details>

### 8. [RL Teaches VLMs Where to Attend but Not How to Perceive](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23983v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23983

**作者：** Ziqian Zhang、Junjie Liao、Zhining Zhang、Wentao Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23983v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23983v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在四个智能体环境中考察多轮 RL 带来的任务成功率提升是否伴随环境相关的视觉问答改善，并用表示探针与注意力分析追查机制。结果显示视觉编码器探针准确率基本不变，而 LLM 层探针提升、对视觉 token 的注意力增强；一个不更新参数、不加梯度的固定注意力偏置干预可部分恢复未训练模型的 VQA 增益，据此认为 RL 主要改善视觉信息的利用而非感知本身。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系「答案是否真正使用视觉内容」、视觉旁路与注意力结构问题，为「latent 状态是否保留并调用视觉证据」提供诊断证据，并给出可供核查的免训练注意力干预线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RL Teaches VLMs Where to Attend but Not How to Perceive

**abstract/A1：** Although reinforcement learning (RL) effectively trains Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents, the mechanisms behind these capability gains are poorly understood. Across four diverse agent environments, we investigate whether the task-success gains from multi-turn RL are accompanied by improved grounded visual question answering about the environment. To assess this, we design environment-specific grounded VQA tasks that reveal improvements in grounded visual understanding. Representational probing shows that vision-encoder probe accuracy remains relatively stable, while LLM-layer probe accuracy improves. Attention analysis further reveals that LLM layers pay more attention to visual tokens during RL training. To test whether increased attention to visual tokens contributes to VQA gains, we introduce a lightweight plug-and-play intervention using a fixed attention bias. Without updating model parameters or computing gradients, this intervention partially restores VQA gains on the untrained model. These results reveal better utilization of visual information as a key mechanism behind the gains from RL.

</details>

### 9. [What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23987v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23987

**作者：** Tengju Ru、Weitong Lian、Zecong Tang、Zhiheng Liu、Lingyi Meng、Haoran Li、Kaixuan Wang、Bohao Li、Xihui Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23987v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23987v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文系统分析统一多模态模型生成侧表示对细粒度视觉理解的价值，发现其更敏感于细粒度语义变化、能捕捉理解侧遗漏的任务相关变化且依赖正确空间组织，并据此提出后训练框架 GAFU，将生成侧视觉表示压缩为紧凑 G token 供理解通路按任务检索。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉细节与任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态、以及 latent 表示如何被下游使用，其「生成侧表示含理解侧缺失信息、依赖空间组织」的发现可供核查 LVR 中视觉信息保留与证据检索的前提。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models

**abstract/A1：** Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. However, existing generation-assisted understanding methods mainly rely on generative supervision or explicit generation and have not systematically explored direct use of native generation-side representations. To address this gap, we systematically analyze what generation-side representations offer for fine-grained understanding, finding that they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic changes, capture task-relevant changes missed by understanding-side representations, and depend on correct spatial organization for this advantage. Guided by these findings, we design GAFU, a post-training framework that unlocks native generation-side information for fine-grained understanding. It compresses generation-side visual representations into compact \\(G\\) tokens that preserve fine-grained visual details, enabling task-conditioned retrieval by the understanding pathway. Experiments show that GAFU consistently outperforms SFT baselines trained on the same data across diverse visual understanding tasks and UMM architectures, with maximum relative improvements of 20.00\\%, 17.94\\%, and 8.62\\% on VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, and VSR-Bench, respectively. Overall, GAFU converts complementary information from the generation pathway into gains in fine-grained visual understanding, providing an effective path toward synergy between generation and understanding in UMMs.

</details>

### 10. [ProV-Mem: Proactive Memory for Streaming Video Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23998v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23998

**作者：** Bingbing Wang、Jing Li、Han Gao、Yishi Lin、Ruifeng Xu、Peng He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23998v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23998v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练、基于冻结 VLM 的主动记忆框架 ProV-Mem，将流式视频问答的「何时查询、说什么、是否输出」拆为三层轻量记忆，并给出阶段式近似界与折价冗余和过长回答的 CAUC 指标。

**相关性简评：** 与停止决策及证据保留问题相关：时间触发与情景记忆决定何时查询、是否输出，CAUC 折价冗余与过长回答，可供核查 STOP 的成本-收益权衡；但未涉及 latent 状态或内部表示，与 LVR 表示层的联系有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProV-Mem: Proactive Memory for Streaming Video Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Proactive streaming video question answering requires a model to continuously monitor an incoming stream and autonomously decide when to speak, what to say, and whether to emit a response. Existing streaming systems face a fundamental difficulty: retaining long visual histories is costly, whereas discarding them can lead to missed events and repeated responses. We propose \\textbf{ProV-Mem}, a training-free proactive memory framework built around a frozen VLM backbone. ProV-Mem decomposes the proactive decision into three lightweight memory tiers: a temporal-trigger memory controls when to query the backbone and recovers from prolonged silence, an instructional memory guides what to say through a fixed prompting prior for concise and visually grounded generation, and an episodic memory determines whether to emit by filtering near-duplicate responses. Under an idealized conditional-sufficiency assumption, we derive a stagewise approximation bound relating the decomposed process to a full-state joint policy. We further introduce Cost-Aware Area Under the Curve (\\textbf{CAUC}), which extends PAUC by explicitly discounting redundant, overly frequent, and unnecessarily long emissions. Experiments on the four scenarios of ProactiveVideoQA show that ProV-Mem achieves the best CAUC across all scenarios and the best PAUC on WEB, EGO, and TV, while maintaining low per-response inference latency.

</details>

### 11. [Do 3D Large Language Models Really Use 3D Evidence?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24447v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24447

**作者：** Yifei Zhao、Fanyu Zhao、Han Zhang、Yixuan Lin、Yuyang Hou、Bin Wu、Ruike Cao、Li Xiao、Yinsheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24447v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24447v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 UNICORNS 基准，用指代歧义、场景证据不足、错误预设等四类证据条件，检验 3D-LLM 的回答是否真正基于 3D 证据，并给出义务感知后训练方法 HORN 来提升证据约束下的正确率。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」与视觉旁路问题：其「不支持场景断言即失败」的判定和多类证据条件下的行为要求，可供核查 LVR 中的证据筛选、证据不足时的停止/拒答决策，以及 HORN 的义务奖励能否迁移到 latent 推理监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do 3D Large Language Models Really Use 3D Evidence?

**abstract/A1：** Recent 3D Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) have shown strong performance on scene question answering with extensive post-training. Yet, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate how 3D-LLMs respond to referential ambiguity, insufficient scene evidence, or false presuppositions, obscuring whether their responses are grounded in 3D evidence. In this work, we introduce UNICORNS, a benchmark for evaluating the reliability of 3D-LLM responses across four evidence conditions. UNICORNS contains 11,387 questions across 557 ScanNet scans, covering eight challenge categories alongside answerable controls. A response passes only if it satisfies the required response behavior and contains no scene claim unsupported by the available evidence. Evaluation of six open-sourced 3D-LLMs reveals a pronounced performance gap: even the strongest zero-shot model achieves 61.22% accuracy on answerable controls, but only 40.94% across the eight challenge categories. To address this gap, we further propose HORN, an obligation-aware post-training method combining group-relative task rewards, leaf-conditioned obligation rewards, and supervised control replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HORN reaches $75.1 \\pm 1.0\\%$ across the challenge categories and $77.2 \\pm 0.8\\%$ overall, outperforming all baselines without degrading answerable-control accuracy. Our findings enable a systematic evaluation and improvement of evidence-grounded 3D reasoning for 3D-LLMs (code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/unicorns-6B38/).

</details>

### 12. [Investigating Length Bias and Robustness in LVLMs for Multiple-Choice Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24500v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24500

**作者：** Md. Atabuzzaman、Hani Alomari、Chris Thomas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24500v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24500v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 LVLM 在多选题问答中的长度偏置：用细粒度视觉领域的受控基准量化「偏好更长选项」的现象，通过逐层机制分析定位其来源，并做模糊图像与弃答实验，最后评估多种推理期缓解策略。

**相关性简评：** 逐层分析指出后层压制视觉证据、转而依赖语言侧长度先验，直接触及「答案是否真正使用视觉信息」与视觉旁路问题，弃答测试也关联停止决策；其内部状态诊断方式与缓解策略的有效性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Investigating Length Bias and Robustness in LVLMs for Multiple-Choice Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong performance on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), yet their reliability under biased conditions remains underexplored. We investigate length bias, the systematic preference for longer answer options, through controlled benchmarks spanning fine-grained visual domains. LVLMs consistently favor longer options even when visually inconsistent, with accuracy dropping 2--38\\% when correct answers are shorter and increasing 1--70\\% when longer. This bias persists across model scales. Through layer-wise mechanistic analysis, we reveal that length bias emerges from late-layer suppression of visual evidence in favor of language-side length priors. Blurry-image experiments show that bias intensifies when visual evidence weakens, while abstention tests reveal that LVLMs struggle to refuse incorrect predictions. We propose and evaluate multiple inference-time mitigation strategies; while these provide partial improvements, none achieves deployable bias mitigation without relying on oracle information unavailable at inference time. These results underscore that inference-time interventions are insufficient, pointing to the need for architectural solutions and bias-aware training.

**comment/C1：** EMNLP 2026 main conference

</details>

### 13. [VisConf: Quality-Aware Consensus for Best-of-N in Vision-Language Model Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24526v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24526

**作者：** Muhammad Usman、Muhammad Qasim Ayub、Usman Ahad、Muhammad Tahir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24526v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24526v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 VLM 的 Best-of-N 推理，提出 VisConf 评分：将 rollout 的视觉参与度（视觉注意力）与候选校准的 Self-Certainty 相乘组合，并用免调参的 Rank-Weighted Consensus 把问内排名转成答案级投票权重。

**相关性简评：** 作者把「视觉注意力强度」当作轨迹质量的互补信号，可用于核查 VLM 推理中答案是否真正使用视觉证据、何时出现视觉旁路；其候选筛选与加权聚合也可供 LVR 证据获取和验证环节参考，但结论仍限于 BoN 选择场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VisConf: Quality-Aware Consensus for Best-of-N in Vision-Language Model Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Best-of-N methods improve text-only LLM reasoning by sampling multiple trajectories before selecting an answer. For Vision-Language Models (VLMs), answer frequency and model confidence alone can be insufficient, as sampled generations also vary in their engagement with the visual input. We find that distributional confidence and visual attention are complementary indicators of rollout quality. Each is limited on its own, while trajectories that show strong signals in both are more likely to be correct. Motivated by this, we introduce VisConf, a rollout-quality score that multiplicatively combines visual engagement with candidate-calibrated Self-Certainty, penalizing rollouts that are weak in either signal. We incorporate Rank-Weighted Consensus (RWC), a tuning-free aggregation rule that converts within-question VisConf ranks into answer-level vote weights. Across three VLMs on MathVista, MMMU-Pro, and MMStar, VisConf with RWC consistently outperforms strong BoN baselines. Our analysis shows particularly large gains when correct trajectories are present but underrepresented in the candidate pool.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: VLM4RWD. 20 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VisConf-VLM-BoN/

</details>

### 14. [From Views to Worlds: Active Exploration over 3D Worlds for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24676v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24676

**作者：** Qijian Tian、Jiayu Ying、Ke Fan、Lizhuang Ma、Xin Tan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24676v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24676v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 V2W 框架：从多视角图像重建含几何、相机位姿与语言语义的显式 3D 世界，并通过视觉与语言接口让 VLM 多轮交互、迭代获取空间证据进行空间推理；可免训练接入现有 VLM，也可用强化学习优化探索策略。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 VLM 推理中的证据获取与多轮决策，可供核查其探索策略与停止条件是否等价于 LOOK/THINK/STOP 的信息增益与成本权衡，以及该多轮监督能否为 latent 工作区训练提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Views to Worlds: Active Exploration over 3D Worlds for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual understanding tasks, yet the passive view-centric perception paradigm limits their capacity for 3D spatial reasoning. Such reasoning often requires actively acquiring spatial evidence beyond the currently visible views, such as camera poses and cross-view spatial relationships, to infer 3D relationships that are not explicitly represented in 2D images. However, existing methods either lack active exploration or merely provide additional views during inference, without explicitly acquiring such spatial evidence beyond 2D images. In this paper, we propose View-to-World (V2W), an active exploration framework that enables VLMs to actively explore 3D worlds and lifts VLMs from passive view-centric perception to active world-centric spatial reasoning. Given a spatial reasoning task with multi-view images, V2W first reconstructs an explicit 3D world with geometry, camera poses, and language-grounded semantics, and exposes it to VLMs through visual and linguistic interfaces. Through multi-turn interaction with these interfaces, VLMs iteratively acquire spatial evidence from the constructed 3D world, enabling active world-centric spatial reasoning. V2W can be integrated with existing VLMs in a training-free manner and can be further enhanced by optimizing the exploration policy via reinforcement learning. Experiments on spatial mental modeling benchmarks demonstrate that V2W substantially improves VLM baselines in the training-free setting and achieves state-of-the-art performance with the learned exploration policy, highlighting the importance of active exploration for spatial intelligence. Project page: \\url{https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w}.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026; Project Page: https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w

</details>

### 15. [Visual Sufficiency Landscapes: Understanding Query-Conditioned Reliability in Visual Token Pruning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24968v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24968

**作者：** Zhenghan Li、Kexin Sun、Wei Zheng、Peng Hu、Xiao Wei、Anbo Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24968v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24968v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「视觉充分性景观」，在固定层与预算下用均匀采样的视觉 token 子集，统计能同时保持密集模型答案、参考答案似然与输出分布的子集比例，并在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL2-8B、LLaVA-v1.5-7B 上考察该比例随输入与 query 的变化，以及它对剪枝失败预测的增益。

**相关性简评：** 该度量刻画视觉 token 子集保持模型行为的充裕程度，与视觉细节保留、信息坍缩及视觉证据筛选的主线问题直接相关；其「同一图像不同 query 产生不同景观」的发现可供核查 LVR 中 query 条件化的视觉信息需求与剪枝可靠性评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Sufficiency Landscapes: Understanding Query-Conditioned Reliability in Visual Token Pruning

**abstract/A1：** Different visual token pruning strategies retain different subsets while maintaining similar task performance. This motivates a combinatorial question: how many visual subsets can preserve model behavior, and how does their abundance depend on the query? We introduce visual sufficiency landscapes to characterize this abundance. At a fixed layer and budget, visual sufficiency probability is the fraction of uniformly sampled subsets that jointly preserve the dense model's answer, reference-answer likelihood, and output distribution. Independent sampling replicates separate input variation from estimation noise. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5-7B, differences between inputs on GQA and TextVQA exceed replication error, and different questions about the same GQA image produce distinct landscapes. Sufficiency probability also improves failure prediction for full pruning methods. On LLaVA, adding this probability increases AUC by 0.1151 for FastV, 0.0683 for VisionZip, and 0.1401 for SparseVLM, while reducing log loss and Brier score. Several architecture-adapted configurations on the other two models reproduce these gains. Under controlled selection rules, predictors trained on the original images reduce log loss on new images by 9.0%, 13.0%, and 14.1%, respectively. These results establish successful-subset abundance as a measurable dimension of local prunability and connect it to the identification of high-risk pruning conditions.

</details>

### 16. [ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25005v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25005

**作者：** Guangzong Si、Dong Wang、Yifan Yu、Miao Liu、Panwang Pan、Wentao Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25005v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25005v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文通过逐层注意力分析发现 MLLM 中的「Visual Backtracking」现象：中层会重新取用早期看似不重要的视觉 token，据此提出 ReTrace，用可休眠 token 状态把非枢轴 token 移出昂贵计算、在回溯窗口内恢复、待信息被吸收后再剪枝，在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3 上大幅降低 FLOPs 与 KV cache。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接涉及视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、以及剪枝「暂停计算」与「删除信息」耦合导致的信息坍缩问题，其分层注意力诊断与视觉证据筛选、动态计算成本的研究兴趣相关，可供核查其对 latent 状态保留与长度泛化的启示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encode images into dense visual token sequences, creating substantial attention and KV-cache overhead. Existing visual token compression methods reduce this cost by pruning low-saliency tokens in shallow layers, but this practice couples temporary computational deactivation with irreversible information deletion. We show that this coupling breaks an intrinsic inference pattern in MLLMs. Through layer-wise attention analysis, we identify \\textbf{Visual Backtracking}: visual pivots remain spatially stable, yet in middle layers they actively retrieve context from tokens that appeared unimportant earlier. Thus, early low-saliency tokens can be inactive for computation while still being useful for later reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we propose \\textbf{ReTrace}, a backtracking-aware compression framework that introduces a dormant token state. ReTrace caches non-pivot tokens outside expensive layer-wise computation, restores them during the backtracking window, and prunes only after their information has been absorbed. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 demonstrate nearly 90\\% reductions in FLOPs and KV cache, a 2.83$\\times$ prefilling speedup, and strong performance retention across complex vision-language benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026, forthcoming

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PLANE: Plug-and-Play Fine-Grained Visual Experts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly suffer from hallucinations, which appear as fabricating non-existent objects or outputting incorrect attributes and spatial relationships in images. Previous works empirically indicate that CLIP-style vision encoders tend to focus on primary objects while ignoring image details, which is one of the causes of hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose plug-and-play fine-grained visual experts (PLANE) comprising two components: LoRA visual experts operating on CLIP for multi-aspect image encoding, and an instruction-aware gate network for adaptive image feature fusion. During training, we construct a fine-grained image-caption pairs dataset, where images are described from three aspects: objects, attributes, and relations between objects. Image-caption pairs from different aspects are used to train the three fine-grained LoRA experts respectively. Aiming at comprehensively evaluate our method's capabilities, we manually annotate a fine-grained hallucination evaluation benchmark for LVLMs which is GPT4-independent during evaluation phase (GIFT). We conduct experiments both on popular hallucination evaluation benchmarks and GIFT. The results show that our method effectively reduces hallucinations across models of different types and sizes while introducing minimal inference latency. Compared to advanced baselines, our model also demonstrates superior performance.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by EMNLP2026 Findings

</details>

### 18. [Persistent Representational Misalignment Induces Vision-Language Model Failures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25252v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25252

**作者：** Yonatan Gideoni、Yoav Gelberg、Tim G. J. Rudner、Yarin Gal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25252v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25252v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文探究 VLM 在人类简单任务上失败的成因，论证现有视觉与语言表示线性不可对齐，该错位来自数据本身而不随规模或对齐复杂度消失，并能预测性地诱发泛化失败、与既有失败模式相关。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及 LVR 关注的视觉信息是否保留在内部状态：表示错位与线性不可对齐可作为视觉旁路、信息坍缩的诊断线索，其「规模无法解决对齐」的结论与假设缩放即可保住视觉细节的 latent 推理研究构成对立，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Persistent Representational Misalignment Induces Vision-Language Model Failures

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) fail at some tasks that are simple for humans---but why? We hypothesize that many such failures stem from VLMs' difficulties translating between vision and language representations, a misalignment the Platonic Representation Hypothesis predicts should disappear with scale. This paper is composed of two parts: in the first, we show that existing vision and language representations are linearly unalignable. This misalignment is an inherent property of the data and hence expected to persist regardless of either scale or the alignment's complexity. In the second, we demonstrate how this misalignment both leads to a predictably induced generalization failure and correlates with existing failure modes, where more representationally aligned VLM backbones accordingly exhibit fewer failures. Overall, these results imply representations will not become aligned simply given sufficient scale, providing evidence against a strong version of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis.

</details>

### 19. [SENRI: Understanding the Space-Event Nexus in Real-Life Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25309v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25309

**作者：** Kehan Lan、Kaining Ying、Henghui Ding、Kaipeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25309v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25309v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SENRI 任务与 SENRI-Bench：在约 25.3 小时的长时第一视角连续视频上，用 500 道人工标注多选题评测「事件→空间」与「空间→事件」两个方向的检索，并对比直接感知、证据搜寻与持久记忆三类长视频理解范式，另提出 SENRI-Agent，用目标引导视觉核查（TGVC）为并行验证器派发局部检查任务并汇入工作记忆。

**相关性简评：** 与「获取证据」「视觉证据筛选」及记忆/状态如何支撑推理直接相关，其现有记忆方法失败模式与 TGVC 的收益成本可供核查；但不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成机制，主要落在评价与证据获取层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SENRI: Understanding the Space-Event Nexus in Real-Life Videos

**abstract/A1：** Human memories are organized in a way that connects events with their corresponding spatial contexts. An AI assistant should also be able to memorize and recall the nexus of events and spaces. Thus we introduce SENRI, a task that studies this space--event connection in long, continuous real-life egocentric video. It contains six task types in two directions: Event$\\rightarrow$Space, which recovers spatial knowledge from event cues, and Space$\\rightarrow$Event, which retrieves events from regions and trajectories. To evaluate this, we build SENRI-Bench, containing 500 manually annotated multiple-choice questions over 10 uninterrupted self-recorded videos with around 25.3 hours of content. Also, we evaluate three typical long video understanding paradigms: direct perception, evidence seeking, and persistent memory. The task remains challenging across all three paradigms, highlighting substantial room for improvement. Then we show two representative failure modes of existing memory methods and address these evidence gaps with SENRI-Agent, a controller that uses Target-Guided Visual Check (TGVC) to propose local visual check tasks for parallel verifiers and integrate the reports into a working memory to help with reasoning. Built upon existing memory systems, SENRI-Agent improves the performance of existing baselines without modifying their stored memories. We hope SENRI will provide valuable insights into how real-life egocentric understanding should be evaluated, reveal the gaps in existing approaches, and offer a possible direction for improvement.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://senri-video.github.io/

</details>

### 20. [Local Evidence, Global Failure: Diagnosing Speech-Vision Temporal Composition in Audio-Visual Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25352v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25352

**作者：** Jaehong Myung、Seunghun Oh、Unsang Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25352v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25352v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的 Temporal Evidence Decomposition（TED）诊断框架，把音频-视觉大模型的「局部视觉验证」与「相对语音的聚合」拆开：由 ASR 给出转录与话语区间，在无音频窗口上用转录做时间对齐与预测、或用候选答案做跨模态时间绑定，再按该区间聚合证据，用于诊断全视频语音-视觉决策的失败。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及多模态推理中「局部可恢复证据」与「全视频决策失败」的落差，与视觉证据筛选、证据获取与聚合、时间对齐等兴趣点相关，可供核查其证据分离诊断能否迁移到 LVR 的 latent 状态与证据使用评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Local Evidence, Global Failure: Diagnosing Speech-Vision Temporal Composition in Audio-Visual Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) can fail at full-video speech-vision decisions even when useful visual evidence is locally recoverable. We introduce Temporal Evidence Decomposition (TED), a training-free diagnostic framework that separates local visual verification from speech-relative aggregation. Automatic speech recognition supplies a transcript and utterance interval. TED queries audio-free windows with the transcript for Temporal Alignment and Forecasting, or answer candidates for Cross-Modal Temporal Binding, then aggregates evidence relative to that interval. Across four frozen AV-LLMs on SVHalluc, Temporal Forecasting accuracy rises from 29.3-33.7% under full-video questioning to 79.3-82.2% with TED. Query replacement reduces recovery; the observed anchor remains beneficial when temporal-region availability is held fixed. Physical-isolation and timing-shortcut controls test alternative explanations. The findings distinguish locally recoverable evidence from successful full-video decisions, motivating explicit separation of narration content, utterance timing, and time-indexed visual evidence.

</details>

### 21. [From Label Priors to Task Evidence: Efficient Long-Video Frame Selection via Bayesian GRPO](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25418v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25418

**作者：** Shuochen Chang、Bingjie Gao、Qingyang Liu、Qianli Ma、Yibo Miao、Haonan Zhao、Zhaohe Liao、Xiaofeng Zhang、Jiangtong Li、Li Niu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25418v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25418v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把长视频帧选择重新表述为潜变量推断：先用监督学习初始化轻量选择策略，再以冻结 MLLM 的答案似然作为稠密任务奖励，用 Bayesian GRPO 配合先验匹配 KL 项微调策略，训练一次即可迁移到多个下游 MLLM。

**相关性简评：** 帧选择本质是视觉证据筛选，与「哪些视觉细节需保留给推理使用」直接相关；以 MLLM 答案似然充当证据贡献的稠密奖励，可供核查其是否反映真实证据使用而非静态标注先验，以及策略迁移到不同下游模型的稳健性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Label Priors to Task Evidence: Efficient Long-Video Frame Selection via Bayesian GRPO

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at \\url{github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame\_Selection\_GRPO}.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GroundedVDR，一个视频深度研究基准：通过人工审核与受限访问探测排除可凭参数知识或单一来源作答的问题，为每题标注视频片段到网页证据的结构化依赖，并将视频定位、网页证据定位与最终答案正确性分开评分，评测了八个多模态智能体。

**相关性简评：** 其核心正是检验模型是否真正使用了时序视觉信息与检索证据而非参数知识，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和贡献分配问题直接相关，其「无系统能恢复完整网页证据」的观察可供核查模型对内部状态的依赖程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GroundedVDR: Grounding Video-to-Web Evidence Dependencies in Video Deep Research

**abstract/A1：** Video large multimodal models have improved at identifying cross-frame visual evidence and conducting open-web retrieval, as reflected in recent video deep research (VDR) benchmarks. However, existing VDR benchmarks primarily evaluate tool-use trajectories and final responses without verifying whether a model actually uses the temporal video information or the retrieved web evidence. To fill this gap, we introduce \\method{}, an evidence-grounded benchmark with three features. First, it combines human review with restricted-access probing across multiple models to exclude questions answerable from parametric knowledge or a single information source. Second, each question carries structured video-to-web evidence annotations that link the relevant video segments to their supporting web evidence. Third, its evaluation protocol separately scores video grounding, web evidence grounding, and final-answer correctness. Across eight multimodal agent systems, the best reaches 76.0\\% answer accuracy, yet none recovers the complete required web evidence for more than 8\\% of questions. Our benchmark is publicly available at \\url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hh721/vdr\_temp}.

</details>

### 23. [Think, Compress, Answer: Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding via Reasoning Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25640

**作者：** Jinbae Seo、Hyeongjun Kwon、Jiyoung Lee、Hyunsung Jang、Namkoo Ha、Jungin Park、Kwanghoon Sohn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25640v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25640v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TCA 框架，用多阶段 GRPO 强化学习将多模态 grounding 拆成自由推理、目标感知上下文压缩、基于压缩上下文生成答案三阶段，以渐进奖励压缩推理信息，并在六个 grounding 基准上取得零样本提升。

**相关性简评：** 论文关注长推理轨迹稀释定位证据、需蒸馏出目标相关的最小上下文，直接对应视觉证据是否保留在推理状态与信息坍缩问题；压缩后的上下文是否等价 latent 瓶颈、是否真被定位使用，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Think, Compress, Answer: Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding via Reasoning Compression

**abstract/A1：** Extended reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on tasks requiring compositional and relational inference. However, multimodal grounding imposes a distinct requirement: reasoning must ultimately converge on a target-specific compact representation that supports precise localization. As reasoning trajectories grow longer, they often expand into broad scene narratives and peripheral relational details, which can dilute grounded perceptual evidence and lead to ambiguous or incorrect predictions. Motivated by the information bottleneck principle, we propose Think-Compress-Answer (TCA), a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes multimodal grounding into three phases: free-form reasoning, target-aware context compression, and answer generation conditioned on the compressed context. TCA is optimized through a multi-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with progressive rewards that establish the structured output protocol, minimize reasoning-specific information while preserving target-relevant content, and directly improve localization accuracy. This staged design enables MLLMs to retain the benefits of extended reasoning while distilling it into the minimal context required for grounding. Experiments across six multimodal grounding benchmarks show that TCA attains substantial zero-shot performance gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of reasoning compression.

</details>

### 24. [Think Densely, Act Sparsely: Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25734

**作者：** Jie Wang、Guang Li、Zhijian Huang、Jinlong Li、Chenxu Dang、Hangjun Ye、Yahong Han、Long Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25734v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向自动驾驶 VLA 模型，提出「Think Densely, Act Sparsely」范式与 LECDrive 框架：注入少量任务特定 latent token 作为载体，按课程学习从视觉表示（DINOv3）、语义结构（SAM3）、空间几何（DepthAnything3）依次蒸馏密集知识，以缓解稀疏监督造成的场景信息压缩或丢失，并在多个驾驶基准上验证感知、状态预测与轨迹规划效果。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关心的信息坍缩和内部状态保留高度对应：latent token 被当作视觉细节、语义与几何信息的载体，且以基础视觉模型提供密集监督，可供核查「latent 是否真正承载任务必要信息」以及训练期 latent 监督与课程式结构化设计的有效性；具体推理期如何使用这些 latent 仍需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Think Densely, Act Sparsely: Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Autonomous driving fundamentally demands dense understanding of visual, semantic, and geometric information, yet existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with sparse supervision such as language instructions or trajectory signals. This direct mapping from dense visual observations to sparse representations forces the model to compress or even discard critical scene information essential for safe driving. We argue that this limitation does not stem from insufficient model capacity, but from the lack of explicit mechanisms that encourage the formation of dense world representations in the latent space. In this spirit, we propose a novel paradigm for driving intelligence, Think Densely, Act Sparsely, and instantiate it with an efficient and interpretable framework, LECDrive (Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action autonomous Driving). The core idea is to mimic the hierarchical perception process of humans by embedding a progressive chain of latent expert cognition within the VLA model. Concretely, we inject a compact set of task-specific latent tokens as carriers, enabling the model to internalize dense knowledge from foundational vision models, including visual representations (DINOv3), semantic structures (SAM3), and spatial geometry (DepthAnything3), while maintaining efficient inference. This interdependent cognitive chain follows a curriculum learning principle, where supervision is progressively structured from representation to semantics and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LECDrive consistently improves the performance of base VLMs across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks, covering key tasks such as object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning. These findings suggest that constructing dense world models through structured latent expert chains is a promising direction for VLA-based autonomous driving.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互检测的评测可靠性，提出固定同一批预测、在官方类别、身份控制、词汇归一化、分级语义得分与严格命题等价五种视图下重打分的诊断协议，并在 HICO-DET 上比较六个系统。

**相关性简评：** 其核心诊断是语义相似度会给错误动作或角色反转的预测发放奖励，直接关系 LVR 所关注的实体关系与任务必要信息是否真正被内部状态使用；五视图与「恢复的语义得分不等于更好的交互理解」的结论，可供核查 latent 推理的收益是否来自关系结构而非表面语义匹配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing Semantic and Relational Reliability in Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary human-object interaction detectors describe interactions in free text, and this creates a problem for evaluation. Category scoring rejects valid paraphrases, while semantic similarity scoring can reward predictions that name the wrong action or reverse the roles of the participants. We present a diagnostic protocol that holds every prediction fixed and scores it under five views, namely official category evaluation, an identity control, lexical normalization, graded semantic credit, and strict propositional equivalence. Comparing these views separates the effect of the matching engine from the effect of semantic credit. The protocol pairs controlled transformations that preserve or break meaning with a blinded audit of natural predictions, and we derive consistency checks that link mean credit, invalid acceptance, and transformation counts. Applied to six systems on HICO-DET, the views disagree on which system leads. GEN-VLKT leads under official evaluation, SL-HOI leads under SHOE, and GEN-VLKT leads again under strict equivalence. Semantic gains range from 1.6 to 20.3 mAP, and AgentHOI keeps less than half of its gain once equivalence is enforced. We recommend that semantic scores be reported together with relational validity and paired uncertainty, so that recovered credit is not read as better interaction understanding.

**comment/C1：** Under review at WACV 2027

</details>

### 26. [Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25947v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文考察 agent 决策模型在环境观测与自身动作记录冲突（动作静默失败）时依据哪一来源决策：在 Android 界面、ALFWorld、WebShop 构建配对状态，发现记录对承诺决策的影响普遍大于观测；线性探针显示中间隐状态已可区分成功/失败步骤，激活补丁显示记录影响随层加深，并据此提出无需额外前向的中间层否决模块 EVIGATE。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「答案是否使用 latent 内容／视觉旁路」与「LOOK 后是否 STOP」问题：其探针与激活补丁证据可供核查视觉证据虽被内部编码却未被决策采用的现象，EVIGATE 也是中间层干预的可借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality

**abstract/A1：** Agent decision models select actions in a single forward pass from inputs that combine environmental observations with the agent's own record of previous actions. When an action fails silently, these sources can conflict: the record reports success, but the environment shows that the step did not take effect. We ask which source determines the next decision. Across Android screen traces, ALFWorld, and WebShop, we construct paired states that independently vary the observation, the logged action, and an explicit success claim. In all 12 configurations of four decision models and three domains, records have a larger average effect on commitment decisions than observations; after claimed-but-failed steps, the models still stop, advance, or purchase in 53-100% of cases. Yet the relevant evidence is often represented internally: linear probes on intermediate hidden states distinguish successful from failed steps on held-out apps, tasks, and goals (AUROC 0.77-1.00), and activation patching reveals increasing influence from records in later layers. We use this signal in EVIGATE, an intermediate-layer veto that requires no additional forward pass and adds 0.04-2.0% serving latency. Under injected silent failures, EVIGATE improves task success by 18.7 points in live ALFWorld agents, 5.0 in WebShop, and 5.1 in a phone simulator, and in WebShop and the simulator it also outperforms random vetoes at the same rate. Its effectiveness depends on representative calibration states: gates calibrated on offline counterfactual states do not transfer reliably to live agent trajectories.

</details>

### 27. [Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25964v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25964

**作者：** Kesav Kumar Jayakumar、Karthigeyan Thilak

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25964v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25964v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文系统审计 POPE 幻觉评测中的 yes/no 读出协议：LLaVA-1.5-7B 实际生成的是带空格的「 Yes」/「 No」而非原用词表 ID，改用覆盖表面形式的读出后三个 split 的 F1 明显上升；作者进一步在多个 tokenizer 家族复现该混淆，并用注意力探针发现错误预测反而更关注图像。

**相关性简评：** 答案读出与量化精度的匹配会直接改变 VLM 评测结论，对 LVR 中从内部状态到答案的读出、THINK/LOOK/STOP 阈值设定及视觉证据使用的评价协议有校验价值；其「错误预测图像注意力更高」可能反驳基于 grounding 的视觉旁路假设，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the VLM4RWD workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 21 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/Kesav2k04/ugaa-research

</details>

### 28. [FrameGRPO: Incentivizing Video Reasoning via Multi-Frame Rollouts and Temporal Credit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26022v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26022

**作者：** Jiaxuan Sun、Biao Wang、Shuai Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26022v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26022v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FrameGRPO，一个无需辅助网络、不改架构的强化学习框架，用「多帧 rollout」（对单次最大帧解码做均匀时间子采样以构造对齐视图）与门控时间效率信用两个轻量组件，为视频 MLLM 多样化视觉证据并改进信用分配。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及视觉证据筛选与贡献分配：少帧轨迹的「选择性强化」可能关联 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本、视觉旁路与信息坍缩，可作为核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FrameGRPO: Incentivizing Video Reasoning via Multi-Frame Rollouts and Temporal Credit

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has improved video reasoning in multimodal large language models. However, standard video GRPO varies only linguistic trajectories while conditioning every rollout in a group on the same sampled frames, which can produce homogeneous rewards and weaken group-relative learning when the shared visual evidence is insufficient or distracting. We propose \\textbf{FrameGRPO}, a simple and effective reinforcement-learning framework that requires neither auxiliary networks nor changes to the model architecture. Specifically, FrameGRPO combines two lightweight components: (1) \\textbf{Multi-Frame Rollouts}, which use only uniform temporal subsampling of a single maximal-frame decode to construct aligned views that diversify visual evidence and reasoning trajectories; and (2) \\textbf{Gated Temporal Efficiency Credit}, which selectively reinforces a correct lower-ratio trajectory when all rollouts in a fixed full-ratio reference subset fail, without imposing an unconditional preference for fewer frames. Extensive experiments across diverse video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate robust overall improvements over standard GRPO, highlighting temporal-view diversification as an effective mechanism for exploration and credit assignment in video MLLMs.

</details>

### 29. [Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26203v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26203

**作者：** Fuyao Zhang、Wenwen He、Jiaming Zhang、Yurong Hao、Xuan Wang、Guowei Guan、Che Wang、Longtao Huang、Wei Yang Bryan Lim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26203v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26203v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 omni-modal GUI agent 中「序列分心」问题提出 Focused Perception 要求，并实现 FocusGUI：一个轻量适配器按当前决策参考动态筛选多模态通道，将最相关证据压缩为紧凑 latent 注入冻结解码器的嵌入中，仅用动作监督训练。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关注点重合：按步筛选视觉证据、压缩为 latent 并注入冻结解码器，且只用动作监督，可用于核查该 latent 是否真正承载被使用的证据、是否出现视觉旁路或信息坍缩。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

</details>

### 30. [From Cause to Effect: Generating Intermediate Event Chains in Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26275v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26275

**作者：** Ridouane Ghermi、Vicky Kalogeiton、Ivan Laptev

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26275v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26275v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Causal Chain Generation（CCG）任务，要求 VLM 生成连接原因与结果的中间事件链，并配套 SODA-Embedding 与 Causal-QA 两种自动指标及 SF20K-CC、CMD-CC 两个测试集，还用 GRPO 加复合奖励微调 VLM。

**相关性简评：** 中间事件链相当于显式推理轨迹，论文报告的 VLM 幻觉与关键事件遗漏，可供核查视觉证据是否被真正保留和使用；其结构化任务与 RL 监督方式也可能为 latent 推理的贡献分配与评价提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Cause to Effect: Generating Intermediate Event Chains in Videos

**abstract/A1：** Video-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual recognition but struggle with causal reasoning. Current evaluations are flawed: multiple-choice QA allows shortcuts, and open-ended QA lacks robust automatic evaluation. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a novel task where models have to generate the sequence of intermediate events connecting a cause and an effect. This structured setup demands genuine reasoning and enables reliable automatic scoring. We accompany this task with two complementary metrics: SODA-Embedding, which measures the semantic matching of a generated chain against a reference, and Causal-QA, which probes the chain's causal coherence by asking whether it contains the specific causal facts needed to reconstruct the narrative. We provide two test sets: SF20K-CC, a manually annotated diagnostic on 20 short films, and CMD-CC, a movie clip benchmark derived from audio descriptions. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with narrative causality understanding, frequently hallucinating or omitting key events. To address this, we fine-tune VLMs with GRPO using a composite reward that combines a format reward, SODA-Embedding, and Causal-QA accuracy, demonstrating substantial improvements over strong baselines.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://ridouaneg.github.io/ccg

</details>

### 31. [One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26401v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26401

**作者：** Xiaokang Yuan、Binhui Yao、Luwei Yang、Ruimin Chen、Zeng Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26401v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26401v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 MMDocRAG 上标注 420 个问题中能独立支撑同一事实的全部位置，量化长视觉文档中跨页、跨模态的冗余证据，并展示单 gold 评估在检索召回、引用排序和遮挡实验上的三类系统性偏差，同时提出冗余感知指标。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及多模态推理中的证据筛选与评价：其遮挡实验显示有副本时模型答案在 gold 被遮挡后仍正确，与视觉旁路、视觉证据因果贡献的核查问题高度契合，冗余感知指标可供评估 LVR 证据归因。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution

**abstract/A1：** Document understanding is increasingly judged on where an answer comes from, scored against annotated gold locations as if each fact lived in one place. In long visual documents, a fact often lives in several places: a chart value is restated in the text, a key figure reappears in the summary. We ask how often such copies occur in standard benchmarks and what they do to evaluation. We annotate 420 questions from MMLongBench-Doc and MMDocRAG with the locations that independently establish each required fact, checked by two independent reviewers. Copies are common and often cross-modal: 19.5% of MMLongBench-Doc test questions have a strict copy outside the gold, and in 28% of MMDocRAG questions a non-gold candidate alone supplies a required fact. Single-gold scoring then fails in three predictable ways. A retriever that finds a copy is scored as a miss: page recall@1 of text and visual retrievers is underestimated by 13-24 points on questions with a cross-page copy. A model that cites a copy is scored as citing wrongly: crediting equivalent evidence reverses 11% of pairwise orderings among 65 competitive MMDocRAG systems. Masking the gold region leaves the fact available elsewhere: with a copy in the input, 41-56% of correct answers across four models survive it yet fail once every annotated instance is masked. Set-level masking with automatically found copies closes 78% of the gap to masking every annotated instance at matched granularity (three models); an unverified key-string rule lowers survival at least as far but masks three times the area. We release the annotations and redundancy-aware metrics.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 5 figures; includes supplementary material. Code, data and editable figure sources provided as ancillary files

</details>

### 32. [Policy-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Spatial Reasoning with Verifiable Rewards](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26410v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26410

**作者：** Hailiang Yang、Shengchao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26410v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26410v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CALIPER 自适应过程奖励框架与分阶段空间推理轨迹语料 SpatialTrace，用组内岭回归估计各阶段参考覆盖率与答案正确性的关联并动态更新奖励权重，另设闭环 harness 监控估计可靠性以指导回滚、rollout 多样化与早停。

**相关性简评：** 直接研究 VLM 空间推理中阶段级（感知、分解、推理）信用分配与过程监督，正对应「贡献分配与监督」及分阶段收益成本问题；其自适应权重与可靠性监控可供核查是否能更细地区分 latent 阶段的贡献。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Policy-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Spatial Reasoning with Verifiable Rewards

**abstract/A1：** Image-based spatial reasoning requires perception, decomposition, and inference, but the stage that limits accuracy can change during training. Answer-level rewards neither localize failures to individual stages nor provide discriminative group-relative feedback when all rollouts receive the same reward. Process supervision provides intermediate feedback, but fixed weights cannot adapt reward allocation to these changing bottlenecks. To address this gap, we propose CALIPER, an adaptive process-reward framework supported by SpatialTrace, a corpus of stage-decomposed spatial reasoning traces. CALIPER jointly estimates the associations between stage-wise reference coverage and answer correctness through within-group ridge regression, using these associations as utility proxies to gradually update reward weights. The resulting process reward supervises all rollout groups, including uniformly failing ones. Because utility estimates can become unreliable when answer-discriminative groups are scarce, a closed-loop harness monitors estimator reliability and validation performance to guide checkpoint rollback, rollout diversification, and early stopping. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks and three backbones show that CALIPER achieves the highest mean under both one-shot and harness training, with consistent gains over fixed allocation across RL optimizers. Further analyses confirm the benefits of adaptive reward allocation and harness control, with favorable scaling in model/data size.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 33. [ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26503v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26503

**作者：** Zhicheng Zheng、Cheng Zhang、Shengping Yu、Tianxiang Zhao

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究给冻结 VLM 的 GUI 智能体提供 latent memory（prefix 向量）的做法：控制实验表明逐步 CE 训练出的前缀带来的提升主要来自「动作修正」而非历史编码，且会无差别地改坏 8–13% 原本正确的决策；为此提出 ScopeMem，以模型初始答案为条件生成前缀，只做有范围的修正，并在 AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey、AITW 等基准上超过提示与 latent-memory 基线。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接触及 latent 前缀作为推理期状态的使用方式与训练监督目标，指出准确率指标会掩盖「原本正确决策被改坏」，与 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真被使用、收益贡献分配及保留正确信息的问题高度相关，可供核查其控制实验与「有范围修正」的判定设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Zhicheng Zheng and Cheng Zhang contributed equally

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SpatialScout 基准，让 VLM agent 在 80 个室内场景、3140 个目标上主动控制相机探索，并在统一坐标系中估计物体中心；以目标尺度 IoU 重叠与覆盖率联合评分，显示前沿模型只能恢复粗略布局、难以构建精确度量地图。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及主动获取视觉证据、跨视角关联与有限交互预算下的表示构建，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策的评价方式，以及 3D 空间表示是否真正保留任务必要信息。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?

**abstract/A1：** Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.

</details>
