### 35. [What Language Adds, and at What Cost: Four Controlled Probes of Pathology Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26805v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26805

**作者：** Wenhao Zhang、Zhongliang Zhou、Yi Ping、Zirui Wang、Sheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、q-bio.QM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26805v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26805v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对病理 VLM 做四项受控探针，复用已发布 checkpoint 与公开数据、每次只改一个输入，量化语言相对视觉骨干的增益，并揭示语言先验、提示与 agentic 导航收益难以归因的问题。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及 LVR 关心的视觉证据是否被真正使用：报告文本有信号、提示无增益、去掉切片仍答对 74.41%、改述翻转 8–23% 答案，可能为检验视觉 grounding、视觉旁路与贡献分配提供可控探针设计线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Language Adds, and at What Cost: Four Controlled Probes of Pathology Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision--language models (VLMs) promise to make computational pathology queryable and able to draft reports, but how much language adds beyond the vision backbone is unclear, because almost every system is evaluated by its developers on test sets of their own choosing. We grade published evidence by how it was produced and test four claims with controlled probes that reuse released checkpoints and public data, varying one input at a time. Report text adds prognostic signal: adding a frozen embedding of the stage-redacted report to a slide embedding raises the pooled C-index by 0.019 for progression-free interval and by 0.016 for overall survival across 1{,}633 TCGA patients, and restoring the stage statement adds nothing. Prompts add no measurable accuracy at inference: with features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification is statistically indistinguishable from a supervised linear probe for lung and renal cancer subtyping. Slide-level question answering is barely grounded: SlideChat answers 74.82\\% of SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) items correctly with the slide and 74.41\\% without it, whereas its language backbone alone reaches 43.52\\%. Paraphrasing leaves accuracy unchanged but flips 8--23\\% of answers. Self-reported gains from agentic navigation and few-shot language priors cannot yet be attributed to language. Language thus adds real but narrow value, and we propose minimum controls that would expose these failure modes in future evaluations.

</details>

### 36. [Train An Imaginative Agent](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26845v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26845

**作者：** Jiaxin Ge、Junyi Zhang、Tianning Chai、Hanjun Yoo、Chenyang Wang、Xiuyu Li、Weijia Shi、XuDong Wang、Sewon Min、Luke Zettlemoyer、Trevor Darrell、Haiwen Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26845v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26845v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Agima 训练框架：先用 SFT 让单一 omni 模型同时承担策略与世界模型，生成动作结果的未来图像，再用 agentic RL 教它基于想象出的未来做推理与规划，在 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman、PushT 上验证并泛化到更难设置。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及推理期内部视觉状态的生成与使用：以想象出的未来图像作为推理素材并按需前瞻、在关键点分支，可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的触发条件与成本、动态计算及证据筛选机制；与 latent 推理的差别在于其状态为显式图像，可作对照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Train An Imaginative Agent

**abstract/A1：** A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

</details>

### 37. [Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26856

**作者：** Shiao Xie、Siyu Chen、Jianwei Lv、Xiandong Li、Yujin Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26856v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多模态 RLVR 与 on-policy 自蒸馏中的「特权修正污染」问题：当特权教师的 token 级修正无法稳定归因于视觉证据时，直接蒸馏会强化错误更新。作者以 verifier 优势为优化锚，用「证据齐全/证据退化」两种教师视图的对比来门控修正（VAG），在六个视觉推理基准上超过 GRPO 与 OPSD。

**相关性简评：** 它按「是否可归因于视觉证据」筛选 token 级监督，直接对应 LVR 关心的视觉信息是否真被使用、视觉旁路与贡献分配问题；证据退化对照这一设计可供核查 latent 状态中视觉内容与语言先验、风格偏移的混淆。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.

</details>

### 38. [Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23857v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23857

**作者：** Qianli Ma、Limengxi Yue、Shuyang Xu、Yanpei Shi、Hongrui Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23857v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23857v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向 web agent 的约束式 agentic 强化学习模型：把页面访问、搜索请求与外部 API 调用统一为带成本的长期决策框架，以累计请求数、总时延和失败惩罚构成多维成本向量，通过 Lagrange 对偶更新满足预算约束，并加入 CVaR 风险项抑制高失败概率路径，在 30–70 个站点/页面模板、800–1500 条端到端任务上对比无约束 RL、预算约束 RL 与规则式 agent。

**相关性简评：** 其「成本向量 + 预算约束 + 尾部风险抑制」的决策式权衡方式，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本核算、动态计算预算分配与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk

**abstract/A1：** Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk." Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation. Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability. Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for presentation at the 5th International Conference on Big Data, Information and Computer Network (BDICN 2026); proceedings published by ACM ICPS

</details>

### 39. [Path-Conditioned Attention Mobility: From Depth to Execution Hubs in SegFormer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23893v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23893

**作者：** Aleksandr Druzhinin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23893v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23893v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究分层视觉 Transformer（SegFormer-B5 人像分割）中的注意力头能否在深度方向局部迁移，发现仅迁移头不够、需联合调整相邻表示边界并保留捐赠者特定的归一化与空间降采样路径；据此把 120 个保留头从 40 个执行深度整合为 20 个执行 hub，报告质量无可测损失并使端到端延迟下降约 3%–5%。

**相关性简评：** 其「执行深度冗余」与「路径条件化上下文必须一并保留」的发现，可能为 LVR 中顺序 latent 步骤能否压缩为更少或并行步骤、以及推理状态上下文对功能保持的作用提供可核查线索，但该工作本身并非多模态推理研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Path-Conditioned Attention Mobility: From Depth to Execution Hubs in SegFormer

**abstract/A1：** Transformer compression often couples two distinct quantities: retained attention capacity and the number of sequential depths at which that capacity is executed. We study whether useful attention functions in a hierarchical vision transformer are locally mobile across depth. Using SegFormer-B5 for human segmentation, we find that some task-relevant attention heads can be relocated to nearby depths, but only when their computational context is respected. Head-only relocation is insufficient, while joint adaptation of the relocated head and surrounding representation boundary improves functional preservation; replacing donor-specific normalization and spatial-reduction preprocessing causes large degradation. We use this path-conditioned mobility to reorganize retained attention from depth into width. Starting from a fixed parent with 120 retained Stage-3 heads across 40 attention execution depths, we consolidate the same 120-head budget into 20 execution hubs. Under a layout-matched three-seed recovery control, K20 reaches 0.960686 +/- 0.000059 mIoU versus 0.960400 +/- 0.000074 for the corresponding State120 control. The paired point difference is +0.000285, while a paired image-bootstrap confidence interval includes zero; we therefore interpret the result as no measurable quality penalty rather than statistical superiority. For deployment, FOLDED\_VEC preserves donor-specific paths while vectorizing their execution. Relative to the same 120-head State120 parent, it reduces end-to-end NVIDIA L4 latency by 5.28%, 3.15%, and 3.58% at batch sizes 1, 4, and 8. These results suggest that attention redundancy includes not only removable capacity but also execution-depth redundancy, provided that the computational path defining a relocated function is preserved.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 8 figures; includes supplementary material

</details>

### 40. [VERDICT: Visual Extraction-Result Decoder with Integrated Confidence and Traceable Evidence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23933v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23933

**作者：** Harikrishnan P M、Goutham Vignesh、Siva Prasad、Zishan Ahmad、Mahesh Basveshwar Deshmukhe、Varun V、Rohit Agrawal、Vishal Vaddina

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23933v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23933v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VERDICT 插件框架：在固定抽取器的输出上，用小型 VLM 为每个字段定位文档中的视觉证据，并校准数值与证据的置信度以支持选择性预测；作者还比较了开放权重 VLM 的内部状态与输出 log-prob 在标定中的差别。

**相关性简评：** 「内部状态比输出概率含更多可用信号、证据定位与置信度门槛下的取舍」可供核查 latent 状态的可用性、证据获取与 STOP 决策；但场景限于文档字段抽取，且该优势在分布迁移下失效，能否迁移到 LVR 推理状态仍待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VERDICT: Visual Extraction-Result Decoder with Integrated Confidence and Traceable Evidence

**abstract/A1：** Enterprises run schema-guided structured field extraction on documents with frontier multimodal models, and accuracy keeps improving as new models and systems arrive. Two things have not kept pace: the evidence for each extracted value, meaning the location of the document it was read from, and how far to trust the value and that evidence. Neither is a component of most extraction systems today, so we build them as a framework that attaches to an existing extractor and leaves it untouched. We present VERDICT, a plug-in framework that uses a small Vision--Language Model (VLM) to ground/localize the evidence once per document over a fixed external extractor's output, then calibrates value and evidence confidence. Fine-tuning the VLM for evidence localization substantially improves visual evidence quality and, more importantly, expands VERDICT's selective-prediction operating range. At a strict confidence threshold $0.80$, VERDICT with the fine-tuned VLM gives usable precision--coverage trade-offs for both value and evidence confidence across the in-distribution and out of distribution datasets, whereas the frozen setting often collapses to little or no coverage. Running an open-weight VLM for localization rather than a closed API makes its internal states available to the calibrator, and they are worth more than output log-probabilities: in-distribution AUROC rises from $0.730$ to $0.914$ for value confidence and from $0.681$ to $0.906$ for evidence confidence. This advantage does not survive a distribution shift. We show that the signal is displaced rather than destroyed, and that labeling roughly $120$ fields from the target dataset takes evidence confidence from $0.641$ to $0.905$ on one dataset and from $0.675$ to $0.829$ on the other.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Workshop on VLM4RWD

</details>

### 41. [Beyond Prediction: A Component-Level Study of Concept Recovery in In-Context Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23936v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23936

**作者：** Xufeng Liu、Fang Wan、Yi Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23936v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23936v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出组件级概念恢复框架，将概念拆解为定义性组件，用受控结构干预在可识别演示下评估四个指令微调 LLM 的组件级与整体概念恢复，并比较联合监督恢复与隐式预测的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测正确不等于恢复概念」的诊断视角、组件级干预与恢复/预测联合监督，可能可供核查 LVR 内部状态是否保留任务必要组件以及如何设计辅助监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Prediction: A Component-Level Study of Concept Recovery in In-Context Learning

**abstract/A1：** In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to make accurate predictions from demonstrations, but prediction success alone does not reveal the extent to which the underlying concept has been recovered. Existing evaluations typically assess recovery at the level of the whole concept, making it difficult to identify which components are recovered and to separate model limitations from ambiguity in the demonstrations. We introduce a component-level framework for concept recovery that decomposes concepts into their defining components and uses controlled structural interventions to evaluate both component-level and whole-concept recovery under identifiable demonstrations. Across four instruction-tuned LLMs and three composition forms, we find that models often achieve high prediction accuracy despite poor whole-concept recovery, with systematic over-specification of relevant attributes and level constraints. Individual structural components are generally insufficient for whole-concept recovery, whereas jointly specifying complementary components, particularly relevant attributes and their level constraints, substantially improves recovery. However, this improvement is fragile: a single plausible but unnecessary level constraint can substantially disrupt recovery. Finally, joint supervision of recovery and implicit prediction substantially improves recovery while preserving prediction performance, with the learned capability transferring across composition forms. Overall, our component-level analysis provides a more diagnostic view of what models recover from demonstrations than the existing holistic view.

</details>

### 42. [LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23951v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23951

**作者：** Shaorong Zhang、Shiyuan Li、Longxuan Yu、Greg Ver Steeg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23951v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23951v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LatLM：把文本置于二维格上，将「承诺调度」变为解码时的自适应选择——每轮给可扩展的 frontier token 打分，对高置信候选立即提交、对未就绪者延迟以换取更长上下文；并用 2D 因果掩码一次前向监督整条采样轨迹、以追加式缓存保留精确状态，在 482M 规模上与自回归基线对比。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本并行解码方法，但「延迟承诺」与逐轮置信度评分直接对应 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的提交时机与停止决策，二维掩码下的轨迹监督和 append-only 缓存可供核查 latent 状态更新与缓存结构问题；目前不涉及视觉证据或多模态输入。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment

**abstract/A1：** Line-parallel language models advance multiple lines concurrently for substantial speedups. However, frameworks like the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM) enforce a fixed commitment schedule across lines. Because dependencies vary within text, a fixed schedule cannot hold back a line whose prerequisites remain uncomputed, forcing premature commitments and cascading reasoning errors. To address this limitation, we introduce the Lattice Language Model (LatLM), making commitment schedules an adaptive decoding-time choice. Text occupies a 2D lattice where eligible frontier tokens are scored each round; a policy commits confident candidates while deferring unready ones for extended context. One forward pass supervises entire sampled trajectories via 2D causal masking, while an append-only cache retains exact states. At 482M parameters, we establish two findings. (1) LatLM matches a data- and capacity-matched autoregressive model on held-out text when decoded sequentially, while its adaptive parallel decoder achieves near-autoregressive accuracy on independent-line tasks using 25--41% as many decoding rounds. (2) When cross-line dependencies cause LCLM's fixed schedule to fail, deferred commitment substantially improves accuracy while retaining parallelism where dependencies permit. On mixed dependency chains, LatLM achieves 96.5% accuracy versus LCLM's 78.5%, using fewer than half the decoding rounds of the autoregressive baseline.

</details>

### 43. [FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23975v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23975

**作者：** Haonan Hu、Shuhao Chen、Weisen Jiang、Lizhao Gao、James Kwok、Yu Zhang

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FrameScout 提出长视频问答的关键帧选择器：用滑动窗口 KV cache 与 successor 聚合生成带时序上下文的帧嵌入，并以帧-查询对比目标把帧与查询对齐到同一空间，在三个长视频基准与六个 VideoLLM 上验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant ones. Extensive experiments on three long-video benchmarks and six base VideoLLMs demonstrate that FrameScout consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages

</details>

### 44. [Pretrained Features as Teachers, Not States: Compact Latent World Models for Visual Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23984v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23984

**作者：** Yanbo Wang、Nan Lin、Wendelin Böhmer、Javier Alonso-Mora

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23984v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23984v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Anchor-WM：把预训练 DINO 视觉特征当作「教师」而非世界模型的状态本身，用动作条件动力学学习紧凑 latent，并通过仅训练期使用的蒸馏头对齐 DINO 的密集表示，推理时丢弃 DINO 编码器与蒸馏头，全部预测与规划在学到的紧凑 latent 中进行；在四个环境中取得最佳平均成功率，且规划显著快于直接在 DINO patch 特征上运行的世界模型。

**相关性简评：** 把密集视觉特征作为「仅训练期」监督来约束紧凑 latent，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据是否保留在内部推理状态、如何通过监督避免信息坍缩与视觉旁路」提供可核查线索，其表示保留诊断与教师／状态解耦设计值得借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pretrained Features as Teachers, Not States: Compact Latent World Models for Visual Planning

**abstract/A1：** A key design choice in visual world models is what information the latent state is encouraged to preserve. Models that learn a latent space with only a latent-prediction objective adapt to environment dynamics, but the predictive objective alone admits collapsed solutions and provides no explicit constraint on the visual information retained by the latent. Models built directly on pretrained visual features inherit a strong visual prior, but tie prediction and planning to a frozen state space. We propose Anchor-WM, which instead uses pretrained visual features as a teacher for learning a compact latent state rather than as the world-model state itself. Anchor-WM learns this compact latent with action-conditioned dynamics, while distilling the dense DINO representations through a training-only distillation head. This encourages the compact latent to retain visual information captured by the pretrained representation while discouraging representational collapse. At inference, the DINO encoder and distillation head are discarded, allowing prediction and planning to operate entirely in the learned latent space. Anchor-WM achieves the best average success rate across the four evaluated environments while enabling substantially faster planning than world models operating directly on DINO patch features. These results show that pretrained visual features can effectively guide world-model learning without defining the state space used for prediction and planning.

</details>

### 45. [Dynamical Kernel Attention: Estimating the Present from a Record of the Past](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24026v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24026

**作者：** Peter Racioppo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24026v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24026v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Dynamical Kernel Attention：把注意力视作对随机动态下演化的 latent state 的稳健估计，使过去状态携带的关于当前的信息随衰减而受限，并可在相关证据薄弱时弃权；方法保持标准注意力的并行结构与计算成本，目前只给出模型与理论，实验留待后续版本。

**相关性简评：** 「旧 token 证据衰减有界、证据不足即弃权」这一机制可能对应 LVR 中 STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选／缓存遗忘的收益成本问题，可供核查；但论文目前仅停留在理论层面、未含多模态验证，迁移效果需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamical Kernel Attention: Estimating the Present from a Record of the Past

**abstract/A1：** Standard self-attention compares tokens by similarity but does not account for how much of a past state survives to the present. We introduce Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA), which derives attention from robust estimation of a latent state evolving under stochastic dynamics. As a past state decays toward equilibrium under the dynamics, the information it carries about the present vanishes, bounding the total evidence a head can draw. Unlike recency biases, DKA can abstain when relevant evidence is weak and guarantees a bounded error when old tokens are discarded. DKA preserves the parallel structure and computational cost of standard attention. We present the model and its theory; empirical evaluation is deferred to a subsequent version.

</details>

**作者：** Parsa Rahimi、Azim Dehghani Amirabad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24029v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24029v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验知识／推理类基准是否在 7B–31B 语言模型内部形成可复用的表示特征：采用任务级留出、标签跨任务置换并逐次重选最佳层与表示流的探针协议，发现原始探针虽能区分 MMLU 任务，但提示文本几乎同等可预测，词法校正后激活优势不再显著，所选位点也随任务面板漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其探针与置换协议直接针对「内部状态是否携带任务必要信息、还是仅反映表面词法线索」这一问题，可为 LVR 中 latent 内容探针的混淆控制、层与位点选择以及负结果解释提供可供核查的方法线索，但需人工确认能否迁移到多模态视觉状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Knowledge and Reasoning Oriented Benchmarks Induce Stable Representation Signatures in LLMs?

**abstract/A1：** Internal signatures could support monitoring, adaptive computation, and mechanistic analysis, but benchmark prompts can be separable without any shared computational distinction. We test whether a prespecified knowledge/reasoning label defines a reusable internal signature in five contemporary 7B to 31B models. We treat the \\textbf{task} as the unit of inference probes hold out complete tasks, labels are permuted across tasks, and the best layer and stream are reselected for every permutation. Raw probes recover an eight-versus-eight-subject MMLU partition in all five models (macro-F1 $0.78$--$0.81$), but prompt text predicts it nearly as well: under an identical probe configuration, the activation advantage is only $0.017$--$0.070$ macro-F1 and is not significant. At the prespecified $0.01$ level, lexical adjustment removes significance while the adjusted states still identify individual subjects, and the selected site changes across task panels and selection rules. Additionally, two released base-training trajectories show no common direction. These pooled layerwise measures recover the task label but identify no transferable knowledge/reasoning signature at the tested sensitivity, which cannot exclude moderate effects. The resulting protocol gives future internal monitors and intervention studies a sequence of tests to pass. Project page: \\url{https://parsa-ra.github.io/lmbehave/}.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 Interpretability as a Science Workshop

</details>

### 47. [Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24107v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24107

**作者：** Yi Fang、Gaurav Srivastava、Zhenyu Bi、Sirui Ding、Xuan Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24107v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24107v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文受控诊断 context-to-LoRA 在事实区分、目标保持与回复适配上的失效，并提出 Cache2LoRA：用查询从可复用的冻结文档缓存中聚合证据再生成 LoRA 更新，可训练编码仅作用于查询与 memory token 后缀，并以多风格监督同时教证据保持与答案表达，在 17 个任务上接近全上下文 ICL。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本、非视觉工作，但其查询条件化的缓存证据聚合、memory token 后缀上的训练监督、生成式 LoRA 与保留文档 KV 的混合，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新与「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」的贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization

**abstract/A1：** Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

</details>

### 48. [Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24112v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24112

**作者：** Zhiyang Wang、Zhishang Luo、Yusu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24112v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24112v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究「looped GNN」：先用 GNN 预训练学得局部更新规则，再在更大图上重复应用同一参数共享处理器以突破训练深度，分析固定深度的信息上限与迭代复用条件，并提出 Loop-Freeze-Steer，冻结预训练处理器、只训练小型控制器来引导重复迭代，从而以更少可训练参数改善图尺寸泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其「参数共享循环迭代扩展有效深度」与 LVR 的 loop/循环 latent 计算、长度泛化及「冻结主干＋轻量控制器」适配思路可能相通，可供核查其信息传播上限与复用条件能否迁移到 VLM 推理状态更新与测试时深度外推。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Generalizing from small graphs to larger ones can require computation beyond the depth of a neural model used during training. We study target tasks that admit a common local iterative computation and whose effective dependency radius grows with graph size. The central idea is to learn a local update rule through GNN pretraining, then repeatedly apply the same learned processor beyond the training depth to extend information reach on larger graphs without retraining. Calling such parameter-shared architecture a \\emph{looped GNN}, we categorize six schemes for looped GNNs to separate the effects of depth extension, fine-tuning, and freeze-and-steer adaptation. Our analysis establishes fixed-depth information limits and sufficient conditions under which accurate iterative reuse overcomes them. To improve beyond unadapted reuse, we introduce \\emph{Loop-Freeze-Steer} (LFS), which freezes the pretrained processor and learns a small controller to steer its repeated application, using much fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning. Our finite-sample analysis gives sufficient conditions for adaptation to improve performance on larger graphs. Experiments on synthetic tasks and chip placement evaluate depth extension and adaptation, highlighting LFS's accuracy--trainable-parameter trade-off for size generalization.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 12 figures

</details>

### 49. [A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24133v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24133

**作者：** Shuyang Xiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24133v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24133v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究自回归 transformer 生成 t 个 token 后还剩多少 prompt 信息：用同一续写、不同 prompt 的隐藏状态距离刻画影响，证明其按 t^{-α} 幂律衰减（α 由注意力稀释与 relay 传递决定），并给出深度 L、长度 P 的界，用可解线性模型与 logit bias 实验说明该界不可改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「prompt 影响随生成被稀释、relay 只能补对数因子」的机制与反事实 prompt 对的度量方式，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否随推理步数衰减、latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息（纯文本设定需迁移）。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt

**abstract/A1：** We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-α}$, where $α=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($α\\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($α\\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\\big(P(\\log t)^{L-1}/t\\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \\emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. This is what we call the \\emph{conditional no-hair theorem}: given the text generated so far, the prompt's influence on the next token vanishes as $t$ grows, so any property of the prompt that survives, such as its language, must be carried by the text itself. An exactly solvable linear relay model shows that the bound cannot be improved and reproduces the rise of the local exponent towards $1$ seen in untrained networks. Cancelling the dilution with a logit bias stops the decay early in training and reverses it after, so dilution is necessary for the forgetting we measure; untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.

</details>

### 50. [Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24137v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24137

**作者：** Guangya Hao、Yiting Duan、Longyan Tan、Yunbo Long、Hao Wu、Ge Zheng、Alexandra Brintrup、Zhuokai Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24137v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24137v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ESRL：在参数空间扰动锚策略构造策略群体，为每个策略采样一条轨迹并聚合成无标签的组相对信号来更新中心学生模型，用于持续测试时学习，在数学推理、常识与医学任务上优于测试时自适应基线并缓解灾难性遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 其「群体自生成监督＋锚策略分块刷新」的机制可能缓解 latent 推理中自监督信号随策略漂移而坍缩、退化的风险，可供核查是否能迁移为 latent 状态更新的稳定监督与多假设贡献分配方案。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies

**abstract/A1：** Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \\textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

</details>

### 51. [Not Every User Says It All: Training Tool-Using Agents Beyond Ideal Simulated Users](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24294v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24294

**作者：** Han Bao、Zheyuan Zhang、Kaiwen Shi、Yanfang Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24294v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24294v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用遮蔽模拟用户回复的方式构造「弱用户」，在 tau2-bench 与 ToolWOZ 上评测工具使用智能体，发现弱用户降低所有策略表现且针对弱用户训练无效；随后提出 StaGPO，让智能体显式写出任务所需、缺失与补全状态，GRPO 据此对到达相同情境的不同 rollout 轮次做 step-level 信用分配。

**相关性简评：** 显式状态分组下的步级信用分配，可为 LVR 轨迹训练、贡献分配与「同一情境」对齐监督提供方法线索，但其与视觉或 latent 状态的结合仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not Every User Says It All: Training Tool-Using Agents Beyond Ideal Simulated Users

**abstract/A1：** Tool-using agents are trained and evaluated almost exclusively with strong simulated users who state every detail clearly, yet real users are often weaker. We construct weak users by masking sentences of a simulated user's replies, holding the task and the user's knowledge fixed, and cross-evaluate agents trained with strong and weak users on tau2-bench and ToolWOZ. Weak users lower the success of every policy, and training with them does not help: no policy trained with weak users, through fixed masks, mixtures or a curriculum, serves weak users better than the strong-trained policy beyond run-to-run noise, and prompting the agent to ask more does not help either. We propose StaGPO (State-Grouped Policy Optimization): the agent writes what the task needs, what is missing and how it is being filled, and GRPO uses this state to compare turns of different rollouts that reach the same situation, assigning step-level credit. Within the standard recipe of a small SFT cold start followed by RL, StaGPO makes weak-user training useful: on ToolWOZ, the Qwen3.5-2B policy trained with weak users reaches 76.8% with weak users, the highest of any Qwen3.5-2B policy we trained, 4.8 points above GRPO and 2.8 above the strongest baseline; it is also 5.4 points above GRPO with strong users, and generalises to an unseen mask rate; trained with strong users instead, it serves weak users at least as well as GRPO trained with weak users. On tau2-bench it scores highest with weak users for both models, by a small margin for Qwen3.5-4B.

</details>

### 52. [Measuring the Task Value of Precision Upgrades in Closed-Loop Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24346v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24346

**作者：** Sicheng Lyu、Xinyu Wang、Yu Gu、Lei Ding、Ziyang Song、Xiao-Wen Chang

**内容简述：** 论文研究闭环 agent 在关键决策处回退调用 BF16 全精度模型的价值度量：从恢复状态出发做配对分支，分别考察「替换单个动作」、「接管后续执行」及两者兼有的净任务收益，并在 tau2-bench 的 Qwen3 agent 上发现替换动作的拯救与损害近乎抵消、部分低精度设置下才有正增益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Measuring the Task Value of Precision Upgrades in Closed-Loop Agents

**abstract/A1：** A low-precision agent can call its full-precision (BF16) model at selected decisions as a fallback. A learned precision router chooses where to call it from the disagreement between the two models and is judged by end-to-end success. An inserted BF16 action, however, can rescue a failing task or damage a succeeding one. We argue that a fallback's value is the number of tasks it saves minus the number it spoils, measured for the intervention that will actually run. From restored states, we run paired branches that cross which model supplies the current action with which model continues, separating replacement of one action, takeover of later execution, and both. On Qwen3 agents with simulated 4-bit weights in tau2-bench, replacing the first action where the two models differed in tool use changed many task outcomes, but rescues and damages nearly cancelled, and on held-out telecom tasks the action-only estimate was negative. Replacing both the action and the continuation had a positive net gain in two of five exploratory lower-bit stress settings. Two references changed outcomes at fixed bit width: replacing an action with that of a second 4-bit checkpoint changed about as many outcomes as replacing it with the BF16 action, and reordering tool-argument keys changed outcomes while the executed tool call stayed identical. At common states, the additional value of the BF16 action over that checkpoint remained unresolved. A frozen uncertainty trigger found more outcome changes than random selection, while its net benefit stayed within the range of random selection. We recommend evaluating each fallback by its signed task benefit under the intended continuation, against same-precision references, before attributing gains to more bits.

</details>

### 53. [Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24372v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24372

**作者：** Sizhe Tang、Hanhan Zhou、Jeffrey Svajlenko、Rashmi Gangadharaiah

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24372v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24372v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 GUI world model 预测在动作选择中的真实贡献：通过固定候选与预测的受控干预，说明端到端 lookahead 收益受评估器呈现方式影响，并据此提出不生成未来屏幕、直接从参考动作学习打分的 Direct Action Ranking（DAR）。结果显示在匹配监督下，预测后继屏幕不再提供可检测的排序信号，DAR 在 AndroidWorld 上显著优于 world-model lookahead 并能零样本迁移到未见应用。

**相关性简评：** 其「决策价值」定义与受控干预归因（预测内容 vs. 直接评估器）可供核查，可能迁移到判断 latent 推理内容是否在强直接求解之外仍带来增量证据，以及其对未见任务的泛化表现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models

**abstract/A1：** GUI world models are increasingly used to improve action selection by predicting the consequences of candidate actions, but it is unclear how much of the resulting gain comes from prediction itself rather than from the evaluator that interprets those predictions. We study this attribution problem through controlled interventions on GUI action selection. With candidates and predictions held fixed, lookahead gains can change with how the prediction is presented to the evaluator, so end-to-end gains cannot be attributed to prediction alone. We then introduce Direct Action Ranking (DAR), which learns from reference actions to score candidates without generating future screens, and compare it with a prediction-augmented variant under matched supervision. Predicted successors add no detectable ranking signal once evaluation is learned directly. Without retraining, DAR improves AndroidWorld task success by 5.8--16.4 points across three proposers, outperforms world-model lookahead, and transfers zero-shot to unseen apps, where every prediction-conditioned configuration falls below proposer confidence. These results suggest that GUI world models should be evaluated by their decision value, the incremental action-selection value of their predictions beyond a strong direct evaluator, rather than by prediction fidelity or end-to-end lookahead gain alone.

</details>

### 54. [CoTs remain monitorable when being unfaithful requires computation: Replicating and Extending the Necessity Effect Across Eleven Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24495v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24495

**作者：** Arav Dhoot、Yixiong Hao、Zephaniah Roe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24495v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24495v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 复制并扩展 Emmons 等人的 CoT「必要性效应」实验：在 6 个家族共 11 个模型上，用 5 类提示线索与 3 个难度等级测量 CoT 必要性（计算是否被迫写入推理轨迹）与不忠实性，发现简单线索大多被隐蔽遵循、复杂线索的隐蔽遵循会回落到无提示基线附近。

**相关性简评：** 其「计算是否被迫进入显式轨迹」的线索类型与难度操纵范式，可能可供核查 VLM 推理中答案是否真正使用视觉/latent 内容、以及视觉旁路与信息坍缩下的可监控性问题；纯文本设置，迁移需自行核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoTs remain monitorable when being unfaithful requires computation: Replicating and Extending the Necessity Effect Across Eleven Models

**abstract/A1：** While a LLM's chain of thought (CoT) is a promising approach to interpreting model outputs, prior work shows CoT's content does not always accurately reflect the reasoning process. Emmons et al. (2025) finds that models can follow a question hint without revealing so in its chain of thought, but when the hint is sufficiently complex the computation is forced into the CoT. This claim, however, has only been tested on Gemini models, and the datasets and code is closed source. We replicate their proxy task across eleven models from six families and find the necessity effect generalizes. Every model follows simple cues above a no-hint baseline, while concealed complex-cue following falls back near baseline for most models. We also extend the study from Emmons et al. (2025) to measure CoT-necessity and unfaithfulness across five cue families (four of them new) and three difficulty levels. The relationship between when CoT is necessary and unfaithfulness is task-specific and model-specific. For some hint types, models often verbalize their hint-following behavior even when the hint can be decoded in a single forward pass. These results support the case for CoT monitoring when unsafe behavior requires non-trivial computation, and that properties of CoT unfaithfulness are sensitive to model and setting.

</details>

### 55. [ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24515v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24515

**作者：** Diyi Hu、Ruizhong Qiu、Lin Qiu、Hanghang Tong、Hanqing Zeng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24515v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24515v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ProbePO，一种无 critic 的 LLM 强化学习方法：用无奖励的不确定性分数挑选部分解状态，在受限续写预算下估计其期望验证奖励，再将 GRPO 的轨迹级优势重新分配到各 token 上并保持轨迹均值不变，从而细化信用分配。

**相关性简评：** 其「预算受限下选择哪些部分解进行评估、再用测量结果细化轨迹级优势」的思路，与 LVR 关心的推理步贡献分配、停止与计算预算决策、潜在状态监督有具体可借鉴线索，可供核查能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO's trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory's mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training

</details>

### 56. [Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24519v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24519

**作者：** Xinye Yang、Zhenyang Liu、Yuxuan Wang、Yuanyuan Lei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24519v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24519v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 LLM 物理推理的失败归因为「建模漂移」，即模型内部公理化世界模型与题目给定真实物理世界之间的偏差，并提出 RLAWM：用建模层与求解层两级物理化奖励惩罚该偏差，仅在训练期使用。

**相关性简评：** 建模漂移与 LVR 关注的内部状态是否保留任务必要信息、是否发生信息坍缩高度同构，其「先保证世界建模正确、再检查推导一致」的分级奖励设计，可能可供核查用于监督 latent 推理状态的保真度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about. Models often silently alter given quantities, fabricate laws, or inject unstated assumptions to force a problem into familiar patterns, and then reason inside this corrupted world. We define this premise-level divergence as modeling drift: the gap between a model's internal axiomatic world model (AWM) and the true physical world specified in the problem. Although RLVR and PRM have yielded substantial gains in mathematics and code, their reward shapes do not directly supervise world modeling in axiomatic domains such as physics. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling (RLAWM), which optimizes the policy by penalizing divergence between its inferred axiomatic world model and the true physics world. RLAWM probes physics reasoning at two hierarchical levels (modeling and solving), each scored by a physically grounded reward. The modeling reward targets abstract knowledge formulation, evaluating whether the model captures the true axiomatic world before attempting calculation. The solving reward targets instantiated knowledge reasoning, checking whether the model's concrete derivation remains consistent with the axiomatic world. This two-level structure separates what world the model believes it is reasoning in from how it reasons within that world. The framework operates exclusively during training, with no extra cost during inference. RLAWM improves performance by up to +12.2 points on PhysReason and +5.2 on PHYSICS over the baseline. It also generalizes zero-shot across difficulty, source, and domain, with a 2.45x gain and +10 points over the strongest baseline on olympiad-level physics and math.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 57. [The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24873v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24873

**作者：** Jinwei Hu、Youcheng Sun、Yi Dong、Xiaowei Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CR、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24873v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24873v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 one-relation attack（ORA）：定位连接证据与结论的关键隐含 warrant，用一句有来源支撑的句子做单点干预，把 agent 从原本正确的答案引向错误信念；在 18 个模型的生物医学推断与漏洞检测任务上报告了较高的翻转率、攻击可迁移性，并发现多智能体辩论反而提高了团队错误率。

**相关性简评：** 其「定位关键隐含 warrant 并作最小单点干预」的探测思路，可能为核查 LVR/VLM 推理中哪一步证据或内部状态对结论具因果作用、以及贡献分配提供可借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.

**comment/C1：** Under Review

</details>

### 58. [ControlJEPA: Principled Trajectory Regularization via Lyapunov Tube Loss](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24951v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24951

**作者：** Thai-Khanh Nguyen、Nhi Y. Pham、Uyen N. B. Vo、Thieu N. Vo、Cuong Pham、Tan M. Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24951v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24951v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ControlJEPA，基于实用输入到状态稳定性（ISS）的离散时间 Lyapunov 收缩条件设计 Lyapunov Tube Loss，对隐藏状态轨迹的横向偏离幅度施加尺度不变正则，无需改动架构，在六个基准与六类模型上提升精度和数据效率。

**相关性简评：** 该工作约束隐藏状态轨迹的幅度与稳定性，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新约束与轨迹监督提供借鉴线索；但其面向纯文本 next-token prediction，缺少视觉/多模态推理验证，迁移可行性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ControlJEPA: Principled Trajectory Regularization via Lyapunov Tube Loss

**abstract/A1：** Next-token prediction leaves hidden-state trajectories largely unconstrained, while existing geometric regularizers primarily control the direction rather than the magnitude of trajectory deviations. We introduce \\emph{ControlJEPA}, a trajectory regularization framework based on a discrete-time Lyapunov contraction condition from practical Input-to-State Stability theory. Its Lyapunov Tube Loss penalizes violations of this condition on a normalized, scale-invariant measure of transversal deviation. When the contraction condition holds at every step, the hidden-state trajectory remains within an explicit tube around the reference secant. In the partial-ISS regime, we bound mean transversal energy, temporal variance, and average tube width using the Lyapunov loss and contraction parameters, with horizon-independent variance bounds under uniformly bounded violations. ControlJEPA requires no architectural modifications. Across six benchmarks and six model families, it consistently improves accuracy and data efficiency over standard fine-tuning and prior trajectory regularizers. The resulting smoother transversal profile also persists empirically during inference, when the regularizer is inactive. The code is publicly available at: \\url{https://github.com/t-khanusa/ControlJEPA}

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 59. [UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25004v1>)

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25004v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25004v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UpLoop 后训练方案：不循环整个模型或中间块，而是让每个选定层局部循环，保留预训练深度层级；并在注意力与 MLP 残差分支上加 hidden-wise 门控，使后续循环成为渐进精化。以 Qwen3-4B 为例，R=3 时 20 个基准平均提升 6.17%，突破了此前 R=2 的饱和，R=4 仍有增益。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本的循环计算与状态更新线索可供核查：逐层局部循环加门控是否能迁移到 VLM latent 推理的迭代状态生成，缓解多次循环的冗余改写与饱和，并与长度泛化问题相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop

**abstract/A1：** Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-training upcycling of a pretrained non-looped LLM an attractive alternative. We introduce \\textbf{UpLoop}, a post-training recipe based on \\emph{layer-wise} recurrence. Instead of looping a whole model or a middle block, UpLoop loops each selected layer locally, preserving the pretrained depth hierarchy and avoiding feature-space mismatch. To make loop execution useful, we add hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, so later loops act as progressive refinements rather than redundant rewrites. Empirically, UpLoop breaks the commonly observed saturation at two loops ($R=2$) in prior looped models. Starting from Qwen3-4B Base and applying SFT, UpLoop improves the average accuracy across 20 benchmarks by 6.17\\% at $R=3$. We use $R=3$ as the main setting for the best accuracy--cost trade-off, while both native and extrapolated $R=4$ yield further gains.

</details>

### 60. [SteadyThought: Mitigating LLM Under-Thinking via Thought-Level Preference Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25045v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25045

**作者：** Zhenyue Peng、Lin Yang、Jie Wang、Xiaoqi Ni、Hanzhu Chen、Xize Liang、Yanjun Wu、Rujing Wang、Kaiwen Zhou、Jianye Hao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25045v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25045v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对大推理模型「思考不足」（频繁切换却无法维持有前景的推理轨迹）提出 SteadyThought 框架，在切换点构造单路径续写，并以「新续写为偏好、原回复为非偏好」做思维级偏好优化，在多模型与数据集上最多减少 63.8% token 消耗且保持准确率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本工作，但其「在决策点比较不同续写路径并做偏好优化以抑制冗余切换」的训练思路，可能可供核查如何训练 VLM 维持 latent 推理状态、控制切换与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SteadyThought: Mitigating LLM Under-Thinking via Thought-Level Preference Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Flexible switching between reasoning trajectories (i.e., thought switching) has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). However, existing models often switch excessively yet fail to sustain promising reasoning thoughts, a phenomenon termed "under-thinking". While recent efforts suppress switching to mitigate this, such over-correction may discard valuable trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Steady Thought (ST), a novel thought-level preference optimization framework. ST formalizes under-thinking as a preference issue at switching points, forcing single-path continuations from identified points to yield high-quality reasoning. Then, ST performs thought-level preference optimization by treating the newly generated response as preferred and the original one as dis-preferred. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that ST effectively reduces token consumption, achieving reductions of up to 63.8%, while maintaining strong reasoning accuracy. Further analysis suggests that ST helps models acquire a generalizable ability to reduce redundant switching across domains and languages. Code is available at https://github.com/MIRALab-USTC/SteadyThought.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**作者：** Yam Eitan、Gilad Yehudai、Haggai Maron

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25250v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25250v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从表达能力角度分析混合序列模型：证明常规混合块与 top-κ KV 缓存访问计算两函数复合需 Ω(√n) 容量，并提出 MuRA 混合块，通过共享 KV 缓存上的多跳检索以固定规模实现 m 函数复合，形成随检索深度递增的严格表达能力层级，并用合成实验验证。

**相关性简评：** 多跳检索共享 KV 缓存、按检索深度划分表达能力层级的设计，可能为 LVR 中潜在状态如何跨跳获取视觉证据、以及视觉信息坍缩与检索深度取舍提供可核查的方法线索；属纯文本架构理论，迁移到多模态尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving the Expressive Power of Hybrid Sequence Models via Multi-Hop Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Hybrid architectures offer a promising approach to efficient language modeling by combining a small number of full-attention layers with a larger number of efficient sequence layers, such as sparse attention and recurrent layers. While full-attention layers maintain a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, efficient layers typically rely on separate, fixed-size states rather than accessing this richer existing memory. Recent work has begun exploring ways to allow efficient layers access to the KV cache, but the theoretical benefits of such access, and the extent to which existing approaches can realize them remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions by analyzing the expressive power of individual hybrid blocks on function composition, a well-studied task in sequence-model expressivity associated with multi-hop reasoning. We first establish that both conventional hybrid blocks and those with top-$κ$ KV-cache access require $Ω(\\sqrt{n})$ capacity to compute even two-function composition over a domain of size $n$. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the \\emph{Multi-hop Retrieval Attention} (MuRA) hybrid block, a simple architecture that enables multi-hop retrieval from a shared KV cache while preserving asymptotic computational and memory efficiency. We prove that a single fixed size $m$-hop MuRA block can compute $m$-function composition, whereas computing $(m+1)$-function composition with the same retrieval depth requires polynomial model size, establishing a strict expressivity hierarchy in retrieval depth. Synthetic experiments support this hierarchy, showing that increasing retrieval depth enables learning progressively deeper compositions, substantially outperforming existing hybrid architectures. Together, our results identify multi-hop retrieval as a promising mechanism for improving the expressive power of efficient hybrid architectures.

</details>

### 62. [BatchParScale: Sparse Batch-Mixing for Sequence Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25254v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25254

**作者：** Hans Peter Lyngsøe Raaschou-jensen、M. Onurcan Kaya、Desmond Elliott

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25254v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25254v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 BatchParScale，一种在 batch 内多条并行序列流之间通过少量「通信位置」交换信息的注意力机制，用于并行测试时扩展，并在自建的 Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack 检索基准、预训练、LoRA 微调与协作式多智能体强化学习中与 ParScale 及单序列基线比较。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关注的「parallel 方式如何产生与更新推理状态」直接相关：多流在解码过程中经稀疏通信位置互通信息，可能为多条 latent 推理轨迹的协同、聚合与信息坍缩问题提供方法线索；但属纯文本序列模型、事实检索效果作者自述尚不明确，可否迁移到多模态推理可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BatchParScale: Sparse Batch-Mixing for Sequence Models

**abstract/A1：** Recent test-time scaling methods improve model performance by increasing inference-time compute. One practical form of this is parallel scaling, where a model samples multiple independent reasoning streams and aggregates their answers using methods like voting, reranking, or verification. While effective, this approach leaves the streams uncoordinated, and a discovery made in one rollout cannot influence any other. Multi-Sequence Verifiers jointly score candidate answers after generation, but the reasoning streams remain independent during inference. ParScale takes a step toward model-internal parallel scaling by learning to aggregate multiple forward passes, but its streams still do not exchange information while processing a sequence. We introduce BatchParScale, an attention mechanism that allows parallel streams to exchange information through a small set of communication positions. We evaluate BatchParScale on a new Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval benchmark and in pretraining, fine-tuning, and cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning. Across these settings, BatchParScale outperforms ParScale on language-model loss and remains competitive on coordination-sensitive MARL tasks. Masked pretraining runs beat an unmasked single-sequence baseline despite local sequence corruption, and LoRA fine-tuning shows the mechanism can be added to a pretrained Transformer. At the same time, fact retrieval performance for pretrained and finetuned BatchParScale models remains unclear.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 10 figures

</details>

### 63. [EG-GRPO: Evidence-Guided Step-level Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25269v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25269

**作者：** Sijia Luo、Mengjie Gao、Yuxiao He、Mengshu Sun、Cuiping Li、Hong Chen、Jing Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25269v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25269v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EG-GRPO：利用合成深度搜索数据中的证据标注，定位每条必需证据的首个支撑引用，并据此构造步骤级过程奖励；同时把累积证据表示为演化的知识状态，做状态条件下的相对优势估计，再与轨迹级结果优势结合，在五个深度搜索基准上验证其优于 GRPO 及已有奖励增强与步骤级 RL 基线。

**相关性简评：** 研究对象是纯文本搜索智能体而非视觉推理，但其「累积证据作为演化状态 + 步骤级信用分配」的做法，可能与 LVR 关注的轨迹训练、贡献分配和 latent 状态更新形成可核查的方法借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EG-GRPO: Evidence-Guided Step-level Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based search agents demonstrate strong capabilities in long-horizon information seeking and reasoning, typically trained via reinforcement learning. However, existing approaches predominantly rely on trajectory-level outcome rewards, providing limited supervision for complex search and reasoning processes. Although step-level credit assignment offers a promising solution, obtaining reliable and task-grounded supervision for open-ended search remains challenging. In this paper, we propose Evidence-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO), a framework that derives step-level supervision from the evidence annotations available in synthetic deep search data. EG-GRPO identifies the first supporting citation for each required evidence claim and uses the newly acquired evidence to construct step-level process rewards. By representing the accumulated evidence as an evolving knowledge state, EG-GRPO further performs state-conditioned relative advantage estimation and combines the resulting step-level signal with the standard trajectory-level outcome advantage. Experiments on five challenging deep search benchmarks show that EG-GRPO generally outperforms standard GRPO and existing reward-enhanced and step-level RL baselines across different model scales. These results demonstrate that task-grounded evidence annotations can provide effective process supervision for credit assignment in deep search RL.

</details>

### 64. [Learning When to Abort in Transformer Planning: A Mechanistic Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25300v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25300

**作者：** Shi Feng、Qimin Zhong、Siwei Wang、Yifei Shen、Shang-Hua Teng、Hao Liao、Wei Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25300v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25300v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把规划抽象为图上寻路，训练 Transformer 在生成非法转移后输出 abort token，并给出前馈宽度下界与内部机制分析，最后用中止后重试提升图、Countdown 与迷宫任务的规划可靠性。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本规划研究，但中止 token 的监督训练与推理期重试可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与验证提供线索；其「有效／无效判别主要位于 FFN 输出、错误检测增强对前一节点的注意」这一结论，或可供核查 latent 状态中的证据筛选与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning When to Abort in Transformer Planning: A Mechanistic Study

**abstract/A1：** Planning does not by itself imply the ability to recognise errors, but recognising errors can improve planning capacity. In this paper, we study this phenomenon in Transformer planning. To analyze the inner mechanism, we follow the approach of Wang et al. (2024) and abstract planning as path-finding in graphs. In this setting, we train the model to detect the error of invalid transitions, i.e., after the model generates a next node that is not adjacent with the current node, the model should then generate a special abort token x. For expressiveness, we construct a Transformer with feed-forward width $O(\|V\|)$ for any fixed graph with node set $V$. It can detect all possible invalid transitions, and select a valid next node if the prefix is valid. We then propose a worst-case lower bound on feed-forward width, which makes the detector's linear width near-optimal up to logarithmic factors. In trained models, we demonstrate that invalid-transition detection increases previous-node attention, and most of the valid--invalid separation locates in the feed-forward network's output. This accords with our theoretical insights. Finally, we use this error detection to improve the model's performance: at inference, generating the abort token x will directly cause an external procedure to discard the attempt and restart from the original prompt. Experiments show that error detection combined with retry improves model's planning reliability on graphs, Countdown, and mazes.

</details>

### 65. [Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25384v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25384

**作者：** Mingyuan Li、Yucheng Li、Xiaxia Wang、Gong Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25384v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25384v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 agentic KGQA 中结果监督 RL 把整条 rollout 的结果优势均匀摊给所有生成 token，造成「轨迹—操作」错配；为此提出 OACR，用仅训练时的 KG 状态结果模型估计相邻搜索状态间的奖励变化，转为操作级 credit 并派生 token 权重，在保持优势符号不变的前提下重分配更新幅度，在三个基准上以更少推理调用和 token 取得更好整体表现。

**相关性简评：** 其轨迹级优势与操作级贡献错配的诊断、以及相邻状态 credit 差异化的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与步级监督提供可供核查的线索；但研究对象是 KG/文本智能体而非视觉推理，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态仍需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.

</details>

### 66. [On Reasoning Correctness Directions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25464v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25464

**作者：** Munachiso Samuel Nwadike、Zayd M. K. Zuhri、Rifo Genadi、Abzal Nurgazy、Ali Mekky、Alham Fikri Aji、Zangir Iklassov、Kentaro Inui

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25464v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25464v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ChainSearch——在 Countdown 上加入显式搜索与回溯的受控算术推理任务，训练一个 3M 参数小模型，用线性探针、平均激活差与直接优化系统地寻找「推理正确性方向」，并做因果干预检验。结果显示内部正确性方向虽统计显著，但干预后无法稳定提升推理表现。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 latent 情形，但方法线索明确：探针＋因果干预验证内部状态是否真的被用于推理，可供核查 LVR 中「latent 内容是否被答案使用」「贡献分配」以及线性表示假设在视觉推理中是否成立；其负面结论提示可解码性不等于因果可用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On Reasoning Correctness Directions

**abstract/A1：** We present experimental evidence suggesting that information about whether a model's reasoning is on the right track can be linearly decodable without defining a causally useful direction for steering. To study this, we introduce ChainSearch, a controlled arithmetic reasoning task that extends Countdown with explicit search and backtracking. We train a 3-million-parameter model to solve this task. Its compact size allows us to study internal model correctness directions in detail using linear probes, mean activation differences, and direct optimisation, as part of a rigorous search for internal reasoning-correctness directions. We find that while the model contains statistically significant internal directions of reasoning correctness, none of the resulting directions consistently improves reasoning under causal intervention. This calls into question whether the linear representation hypothesis is sufficient for identifying causally useful directions in the context of reasoning. Our code is made available together with this work.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**相关性简评：** 提供以模型自评分作验证器、引导候选答案搜索的免训练测试时扩展线索，可能迁移到 LVR 中候选 latent 假设的筛选、搜索与停止判断；但研究对象为纯文本决策任务，与视觉推理状态的联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** P(Yes): 15$\\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

### 68. [ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25519v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25519

**作者：** Mobina Kashaniyan、Ali Jannesari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.DC、cs.PF

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25519v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25519v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 LLM 推理的 test-time scaling，提出资源感知框架 ATEST，联合权衡额外采样的期望收益与当前 GPU 能耗；其在线模式增量采样、估计多数答案的稳定性、监控实时 GPU 负载并在线学习单步能耗，从而决定何时停止。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本 LLM 场景，但基于答案稳定性的在线停止准则与能耗/负载建模，可为 LVR 中 STOP 决策及动态计算成本权衡提供可核查的方法线索，其能否迁移到多模态与 latent 推理状态仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference

**abstract/A1：** Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 69. [StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25525v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25525

**作者：** Jiarong Liang、Xueguang Ma、Dongfu Jiang、Yuxuan Zhang、Ping Nie、Wenhu Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25525v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25525v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 StopLoss，一个小型外部监控器，从完成的 coding agent 轨迹及其验证结果中学习失败识别，单次前向即可为最近若干工具步骤打分，并用成功轨迹校准的阈值决定是否提前中止运行，以节省算力。

**相关性简评：** 其「以最终结果监督早期窗口、再以校准阈值触发提前停止」的机制，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策、停止时机与计算成本权衡提供可核查线索；但对象为纯文本 coding agent，未涉及视觉内部状态，迁移到多模态 latent 推理需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early

**abstract/A1：** Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\\% on Verified while preserving 99\\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.

</details>

### 70. [Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25540v1>)

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25540v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25540v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文提出两阶段审计流程：先用 Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition 把串联工具输出中具有标签预测性的片段定位到单个工具结果，再用 Token-Class Redaction 做反事实测试；在 TCR-pMHC 结合预测上发现模型实际依赖数据集标识符等隐藏捷径，遮蔽后性能跌回随机水平。
