<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing

**abstract/A1：** Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace. Stage 2, Token-Class Redaction, counterfactually tests whether the frozen LLM depends on the localized shortcut. We apply this audit to TCR-pMHC binding, where tool augmentation substantially outperforms a no-evidence baseline. At face value, this suggests that the LLM has learned to use scientific evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)

</details>

### 71. [Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25612v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25612

**作者：** Jimson Huang、Maxwell Nickell、Ruowang Zhang、Abulhair Saparov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25612v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25612v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究课程学习能否扩展 LLM 的隐式推理（单次前向内「提前搜索」）深度：按逐步增大的词表规模与 lookahead 微调，发现匹配算力下课程训练可在无课程失败处成功，但进展趋于饱和指数，暗示存在内在最大 lookahead，更大模型与预训练起点上限更高，且能力可迁移到自然语言推理基准。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本的隐式/单次前向推理与 LVR 的 latent 状态生成高度同构，其 lookahead 上限、饱和曲线与课程步长过大会停滞等发现，可能为 latent 轨迹深度、训练监督与长度泛化提供可核查线索，但需在视觉多模态设定下另行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit

**abstract/A1：** LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 72. [Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25646v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25646

**作者：** Arber Zela、Artavazd Maranjyan、Pol Puigdemont、David Berghaus、Valentyn Boreiko、Volkan Cevher

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25646v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25646v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners（SFPRM），将权重共享循环 transformer 的阻尼定点求解搬到 nGPT 单位超球面上，使输入注入、阻尼与停机成为测地操作，并在 Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard、Mini-ARC 上报告精度与测试时计算分配。

**相关性简评：** 循环迭代、阻尼与自适应停机机制可直接对应 LVR 的 latent 状态生成与 STOP 决策问题；其收敛几何（token-输入夹角编码题型结构并预测正确性）为 latent 状态内容与相似度分析提供了可供核查的线索，但任务为纯文本，向多模态 LVR 迁移仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere

**abstract/A1：** Looped (weight-tied) transformers enable adaptive computation by allocating more iterations to harder inputs. Fixed-Point Reasoners (FPRM) achieve this with a damped fixed-point solver, but operate in an unbounded Euclidean residual space with coupled rescaling and relative-norm halting. We introduce Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners (SFPRM), which perform the same computation on the unit hypersphere of normalized transformers (nGPT). Input injection, damping, and halting become geodesic operations, yielding boundedness by construction and eliminating coefficient coupling. We prove fixed-point existence, local convergence under an explicit step-size condition, and global convergence under strong injection. On Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and Mini-ARC, SFPRM achieves 96.6%, 87.9%, and 59.1% test accuracy, respectively, outperforming FPRM and other baselines while allocating test-time compute more effectively. Its converged geometry is also interpretable: token-input angles capture puzzle structure and predict correctness.

**comment/C1：** 37 pages, 24 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 73. [ToolOPD: Credit-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Tool-Use Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25693v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25693

**作者：** Chu Zhao、Lei Tang、Yanming Wang、Jianzhe Zhao、Guibing Guo、Zhengzong Chen、Yuanyuan Zhao、Fei Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25693v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25693v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作针对长程工具使用智能体，分析出轨迹信用集中在少数关键动作、且最终结果反转会改变信用分配，据此提出结果感知的在线蒸馏框架 ToolOPD，用 hindsight skill 生成信用以重加权动作级蒸馏损失，并与强化学习联合优化，在多个长程工具交互基准上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「信用集中于少数关键步骤」及结果反转改变信用分配的发现，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步的贡献分配与监督权重设计提供可核查线索；但研究对象是纯文本工具智能体，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ToolOPD: Credit-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Tool-Use Agents

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) enhances the capabilities of small language agents by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model on student-generated trajectories. However, standard OPD implicitly assumes that credit is uniformly distributed across long-horizon trajectories, assigning the same strength of teacher supervision to different actions. Through credit-distribution analysis and outcome-reversal counterfactual experiments, we find that trajectory credit is concentrated on a small number of critical actions. Moreover, even when the trajectory is held fixed, reversing only the final outcome substantially changes the credit assigned to multiple interaction turns. These findings show that the uniform-credit assumption fails to identify critical decisions and ultimately degrades the model's reasoning accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose ToolOPD, an outcome-aware on-policy distillation framework designed for long-horizon tool use. ToolOPD first summarizes each completed trajectory and its outcome into a reusable hindsight skill. It then measures how this skill changes the teacher's probability of each student action token and converts the change into outcome-aware credit. The resulting credit preserves supervision that supports successful decisions or discourages failed ones, while suppressing irrelevant and conflicting signals. ToolOPD uses these credits to reweight the action-level distillation loss and jointly optimizes it with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across multiple long-horizon tool interaction benchmarks demonstrate that ToolOPD significantly outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.

</details>

### 74. [Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25760v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25760

**作者：** Pedram Mouseli、Massieh Moayedi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25760v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25760v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在一个小型文件系统加锁任务中，用 Qwen3-8B/9B 区分「行动前生成推理」与「在提示中保留先前推理」两种作用，并比较线性探针读出的状态与反事实推理干预对该模型行动的实际影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「可解码性不能预测干预效果」的探针—干预对照，以及对推理内容是否为真实计算而非记忆的拆解，可为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正被使用、以及用探针评价内部表示的做法提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.

</details>

### 75. [When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25827v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25827

**作者：** Guanqun Jiang、Pengfei Cao、Kang Liu、Jun Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25827v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25827v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 SourceClash 匹配基准（十个流程领域、1271 个 bundle），研究语言模型在检索上下文与所选技能规定部分冲突时采纳冲突线索、产出「检索支持但技能无效」答案的 procedural hallucination，并对开放权重模型做机制分析。实验中冲突检索下有效答案率平均 25.7%，远低于两种支持性检索设置。

**相关性简评：** 其机制分析（残差替换、注意力分解将修复主要归因于 value 向量通路、对该通路干预可提升答案有效性）可能为 LVR 中视觉证据与先验或指令冲突时的信息筛选、latent 内容贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴线索；论文为纯文本、非多模态，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. After a relevant skill has been selected, the model may need to apply its governing procedure together with retrieved task context. When the retrieved context is useful but contains cues that violate the skill, the model must retain compatible information while rejecting the conflicting cues. We study failures in which the model adopts such cues and produces a retrieval-supported but skill-invalid answer, which we call procedural hallucination. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.

</details>

### 76. [CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25927v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25927

**作者：** Feiyang Hong、Yujie Wei、Bo Zhao、Xiu Su、Hongxun Yao、Shuo Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25927v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25927v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CondenseVLA，在 VLA 策略的解码端用可学习 query 与多头交叉注意力，把缓存的多帧视觉特征蒸馏为固定数量的 slot token 供动作解码，并以辅助正则抑制 slot 注意力重叠、降低冗余，从而在有限历史窗口内利用短期视觉证据。

**相关性简评：** 其「可学习 query + 交叉注意力 + 冗余正则」的固定潜状态压缩，可为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态设计与信息坍缩问题提供方法线索；但该工作面向机器人动作解码而非推理主线，作者也指出更难的多观测任务受有限窗口限制，这一长度/历史瓶颈与 latent 长度泛化问题可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA

**abstract/A1：** Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

### 77. [OmniGround: Strengthening Omni-Modal Temporal Grounding via Attention-Consistency Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25929v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25929

**作者：** Zixuan Chen、Depeng Wang、Hao Lin、Ke Xu、Ya Guo、Huijia Zhu、Tanfeng Sun、Xinghao Jiang

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对全模态模型时序定位薄弱的问题，发现「内部注意力比生成时间戳更准」的时序生成鸿沟，提出 TACG 后训练方法，用注意力一致性训练把内部注意力与模型预测、真值标注对齐，并构建 58 万样本数据训练出 OmniGround 模型。

**相关性简评：** 其内部状态比显式输出更可靠的诊断，与 LVR 关心的隐状态信息是否被答案使用、监督与贡献分配问题相通；把注意力当作枢轴做一致性对齐的训练思路，可供核查是否能用于对齐 latent 推理状态与最终答案。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniGround: Strengthening Omni-Modal Temporal Grounding via Attention-Consistency Training

**abstract/A1：** Omni-modal large language models can jointly understand video, audio, and text, yet they remain weak at temporal grounding, a capability essential for real-world audio-visual applications. To understand this limitation, we look beyond final predictions and examine the model's internal temporal evidence. We identify a temporal generation gap: the internal attention of the model localizes the target moment more accurately than the timestamps it generates. To close this gap, we propose TACG (Temporal Attention-Consistency Grounding), a post-training method that treats internal attention as a reliable temporal pivot and aligns it with both the model prediction and the ground-truth annotation through attention-consistency training. We further build a 580K-sample training dataset by reconstructing temporal QA from dense audio-visual annotations and organizing general omni-modal instruction data. Using TACG and this training dataset, we train OmniGround, a general-purpose omni-modal model with stronger temporal grounding capability, without injecting any additional temporal cues. OmniGround reaches state-of-the-art omni-modal temporal grounding, including 37.5 mIoU on LongVALE and 35.7 mIoU on UnAV-100, while staying competitive on both general audio-visual understanding and vision-only grounding.

</details>

### 78. [Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25932v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25932

**作者：** Minoo Ahmadi、Seyedarmin Azizi、Mehdi Kamal、Massoud Pedram

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、stat.AP、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25932v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25932v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 masked diffusion LLM 的推理时 SMC 解码，指出多项式重采样会复制高权重粒子、丢失仍有希望的谱系且 ESS 无法反映，提出 LP-SMC（Chopthin 重采样加输入权重下限），在数学推理与代码生成基准上提升 oracle coverage 与端到端准确率。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留多样化候选谱系」的重采样与权重下限机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中并行 latent 假设的多样性保持、早停与轨迹坍缩问题；但工作限于纯文本 diffusion 解码，与视觉证据筛选和 VLM 内部状态的联系需人工核验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.

</details>

### 79. [GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25970v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25970

**作者：** Xinyue Peng、Zhenlin Liang、Meng Cai、Hua Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25970v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25970v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的在线提前退出算法 GLOBE：将每段已完成的推理嵌入单位球面，通过试答分支的置信阈值与轨迹方向反复逆转、净进展很小的几何信号决定是否终止 CoT；在数学推理、工具调用、智能体记忆等五个基准上约减少 49.7% 输出 token 与 51.0% 端到端耗时。

**相关性简评：** 其基于语义轨迹几何形状的在线停止判据，可能为 LVR 关注的 STOP 决策与动态计算成本控制提供方法线索，可供核查；但对象是纯文本 CoT，能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理状态尚不确定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories

**abstract/A1：** Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

</details>

### 80. [GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25978v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25978

**作者：** Suxing Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25978v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25978v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的多跳问答自反思协议 GraphEvoResearcher，把生成—批评—修订过程显式组织为推理图，用含正确性、效率、反思、多样性及连通性、无环性、分支覆盖、路径收敛四种结构信号的图感知元奖励，决定修订、回溯或停止，并以证据分支收敛作为早停条件。

**相关性简评：** 工作限于纯文本 LLM 推理、不涉及视觉状态，但其显式图结构推理状态、结构化信号驱动的回溯与收敛式早停，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策、证据分支筛选与状态表示设计提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -&gt; critique -&gt; revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends\_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

</details>

### 81. [ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25980v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25980

**作者：** Yicheng Wang、Wentao Tan、Yidan Huang、Yifei Liu、Qiong Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25980v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25980v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ClueFlow 面向长程搜索智能体，构建「来源—状态—最终答案」归因链，把取证据的浏览动作、证据与候选状态更新和最终答案连起来，用该归因挑选 SFT 监督的决策并在 Turn-PPO 中沿链分配信用，在多个搜索基准上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 其按状态转移做归因、进而决定监督对象与信用分配的思路，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配与证据获取/停止决策的监督筛选提供可核查线索；但该工作为纯文本搜索智能体，未涉及视觉证据或 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 82. [TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26002

**作者：** Chenghao Liu、Wei Fan、Jindong Han、Dongjie Wang、Aniket Mahanti、Pengyang Wang、Hao Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26002v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TimesJev，一个面向时间序列的 System 1 模型：把原始序列压缩为保留关键频率模式的表示，用「充分性散度」刻画压缩丢失的核心信息、用「可实现性散度」刻画模型对该表示的可用性，并以门控学习与嵌入空间对齐来优化，从而用即时决策替代长思维链推理，在 13 个数据集上更快且更准。

**相关性简评：** 其以充分性/可实现性目标学习紧凑 latent 表示再对齐到模型嵌入空间的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、压缩是否引发信息坍缩与「解码不可用」，而「用单步决策替代长 CoT」也与推理成本与停止决策的兴趣相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. To construct this representation, we derive a dimension reduction objective that combines (i) a sufficiency divergence that measures the core information lost during compression, and (ii) a realizability divergence that quantifies the incompatibility of the System 1 model to the optimal prediction given this representation. We optimize this objective by learning time series compression with a gating mechanism for sufficiency, and then aligning the selected representation with the embedding space for realizability. Finally, experiments on 13 datasets demonstrate that TimesJev outperforms reasoning models by over 62% with 62.9% less inference time than their fine-tuned versions on average.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用近600次训练实验，联合变化模型规模、训练token数与前向/反向循环次数，拟合统一缩放律，考察循环Transformer中截断BPTT的收益与代价，并比较全BPTT与截断在等计算量下的表现。

**相关性简评：** 循环块复用、循环次数与梯度截断的缩放关系，可能为loop式latent推理的循环深度选取、训练监督方式与计算分配提供可核查线索，尤其涉及最优循环次数随计算增长的趋势；但原文任务是语言建模损失，未涉及多模态推理状态，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation

**abstract/A1：** Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, although this may weaken the benefit of looping. To study this tradeoff systematically, we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law further shows that at fixed model size, the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. When model size is also free, the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. Experimentally, this setting achieves lower loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

</details>

**内容简述：** 研究在硬性单实例 prompt 加 completion token 上限下，何时停止推理、再生成一个候选，还是把剩余 token 用于裁决已有候选；提出免训练的 BOSS 三分支策略，在共享 token 账本下做在线生成—裁决分配，并在两个 Llama-3.1 模型与四个推理基准上比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「停止／继续采样／裁决」的在线预算分配与最坏情况预算检查，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策和动态计算分配提供可核查线索，但论文为纯文本设置、无视觉证据，需核查能否迁移到多模态场景。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BOSS: Token-Budgeted Online Sampling and Selection for LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Test-time scaling can improve LLM reasoning, but existing approaches typically adapt generation or apply answer selection after a predetermined generation schedule. We study within-instance allocation: under a hard per-instance prompt-plus-completion token cap, when should inference stop, generate another candidate, or spend residual tokens adjudicating candidates already observed? BOSS is a training-free policy for this three-way decision, with worst-case budget checks before every generation and judge call. Its key contribution is online generation-adjudication allocation under one shared token ledger. Across two Llama-3.1 models and four reasoning benchmarks, BOSS attains the highest accuracy in 22 of 24 model-task-budget cells under the common hard cap. At Llama-3.1-8B and B=4k, it reaches 60.5 macro-average accuracy versus 58.6 for Adaptive-Consistency, 59.1 for TALE-EP, and 58.9 for fixed-schedule League. On identical Stage-I candidate pools, randomized A/B judging with repeated voting improves plurality from 58.4 to 60.3, with the full BOSS selector reaching 60.5. Approximately matched-cost controls further characterize how the benefit of adjudication changes with available inference budget. Together, these results establish generation-adjudication allocation as a distinct design axis for reasoning under strict per-instance caps.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Draft Refinement Language Models：用单一 denoiser 从均匀损坏的草稿重建每个 token，从而并行提出修订；评估时用已知损坏过程修正「自 token 证据」，一次前向算出 cavity energy，只有能量下降才保留候选草稿，在 Countdown、Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard 上优于自回归与离散扩散基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「完整草稿并行修订 + 单次前向能量式候选取舍」与 LVR 中并行状态更新、候选验证及停止决策有方法上的对照价值，但其为纯文本、非反向扩散框架，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement

**abstract/A1：** Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. Yet repeated diffusion denoising does not ensure that individually plausible token updates form a better answer together. We introduce Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLMs), which use a single denoiser to propose parallel revisions and evaluate a candidate draft. We train the denoiser to reconstruct every token from uniformly corrupted drafts, teaching both preservation and repair. Its predictions specify revisions directly, without a diffusion reverse transition. Evaluation requires a different use of these predictions: confidence in an existing token reflects both contextual support and evidence from observing the token itself. Using the known corruption process, we correct for this self-token evidence to estimate how well each token is supported by the prompt and the remaining draft. Aggregating these estimates yields a cavity energy computed in one forward pass, without an additional scoring model. Each round proposes a revision, reads the completed candidate in its revised context, and retains it only if its energy is lower. Across Countdown, Sudoku-Extreme, and Maze-Hard, our method outperforms autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. With 6M parameters, DRLM reaches 44.4% on Countdown-5 and 93.9% on Sudoku-Extreme. The results establish complete-draft parallel refinement as an effective alternative to reverse diffusion for complex reasoning.

</details>

**title/T1：** Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\\text{-}5.7\\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究重复字符串复制中的位置消歧与正确终止问题：提出用带小素数周期的 RoPE 式注意力值/输出旋转（VO-rotations）编码相对分隔符锚点的距离，借中国剩余定理由一条检索规则决定取下一源 token 还是结束标记；同时证明在顺序有限精度 softmax 累加下（含 NoPE 与递归 ALiBi 类加性位置偏置）存在与宽度无关的不可行性，即重复片段超过饱和阈值后 logits 不再变化。

**相关性简评：** 论文对位置哈希、重复导致的 logits 饱和与终止判定的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态里位置与内容的区分、信息坍缩，以及 STOP 决策和长度泛化提供可核查线索；但其为纯文本合成任务，与视觉多模态推理的联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing

**abstract/A1：** Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\\log\\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\\log N/\\log\\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.

</details>

### 89. [recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26747v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26747

**作者：** Saurav Jha、Qianli Liao、Robert Vernon、Sarath Chandar、Quentin Fournier

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26747v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26747v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将递归式预训练引入掩码蛋白质语言模型：权重共享的 Transformer 核心在固定循环次数内反复精化与残基对齐的隐状态，并提出 Gated Mixture Recurrence，用可学习的残差门（标量、低秩或逐维）控制每轮更新被接纳进状态的比例，从循环途中的隐状态混合解码，把停止与门控统一为一个自适应计算目标。

**相关性简评：** 其权重共享循环核心、残差门控的状态更新、以及由 PonderNet 式停止推广出的“访问过的隐状态混合解码”，可为 LVR 的 loop 式 latent 状态迭代、更新幅度控制与 STOP 决策提供可供核查的方法线索，但该文面向蛋白质序列而非视觉证据，迁移需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.

**comment/C1：** Models: https://huggingface.co/chandar-lab/recamplify Code: https://github.com/chandar-lab/AMPLIFY/tree/recamplify

</details>

### 90. [I$^2$-Med: Interpretable Medical Inference through Visual-Guided Dynamic Logits Calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23858v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23858

**作者：** Md Sajid、Shreeyut Maheshwari、Akshat Mishra、Ritik Mishra、Mohammad Tanveer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23858v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23858v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 I$^2$-Med 框架：生成时用视觉引导模块逐词判断候选词是否有医学图像支持并与当前推理一致，据此动态校准输出 logits 以偏向视觉有据的词，在 OmniMedVQA 上提升推理链的临床与视觉忠实度、减少视觉幻觉。

**相关性简评：** 属推理期的视觉证据筛选与解码干预，与「答案是否真正使用视觉内容、是否发生视觉旁路」直接相关；其逐候选词视觉校验可作核查线索，但未涉及内部 latent 状态或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 式动态计算。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** I$^2$-Med: Interpretable Medical Inference through Visual-Guided Dynamic Logits Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Medical vision language models have demonstrated strong potential for medical image understanding and reasoning. However, their interpretability and reliability remain limited because medical vision language tasks require precise visual grounding and clinically coherent explanations. This is particularly challenging due to complex imaging patterns and scarce expert annotations. These challenges reduce the effectiveness of conventional reasoning methods and lead to visual hallucination, defined as the generation of text that is not grounded in the given visual input, which further limits their applicability in clinical practice. To mitigate these challenges, we propose an interpretable medical inference (I$^2$-Med) framework that enhances visual faithfulness during inference without additional training to improve reasoning and explanation faithfulness in medical vision language models. During text generation, I$^2$-Med uses a visual guidance module to check whether each candidate word is supported by the medical image and consistent with the current reasoning. Based on this guidance, the model's output scores are adjusted to favor visually grounded words, without changing the model parameters. Extensive experiments on the OmniMedVQA benchmark, covering eight medical imaging modalities and five clinical question types, demonstrate that our proposed I$^2$-Med framework generates more clinically meaningful and visually faithful reasoning chains and reduces visual hallucination under standard medical VQA evaluation metrics. The source code is publicly available at \\url{https://github.com/mtanveer1/l2-med}.

</details>

### 91. [CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24304v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24304

**作者：** Jin Gene Wong、Anjney Midha、Joseph Mathew Tennyson、Wei-Lin Chiang、Ion Stoica、Zhi-Xun Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cond-mat.other、cond-mat.str-el、cond-mat.supr-con

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24304v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24304v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 CME-SpectrumBench，用 190 道专家设计题目评测前沿 LLM 分析凝聚态实验光谱数据的能力：在噪声与有限仪器分辨率下从 2D 强度数组中识别结构并给出数值答案，结果发现直接问答弱于手写代码，且高分辨率、高噪声会加剧性能下降，允许调用 Python 解释器（可加 ReAct）后接近手写代码水平。

**相关性简评：** 作为面向研究级数据视觉分析的诊断型基准，它报告模型能找简单特征却难以追踪复杂模式、计算派生量，提示直接读取高密度数据的内部状态受限而依赖代码旁路，与视觉细节保留、视觉旁路和证据获取问题相关；但未涉及 latent 推理状态，且输入形式（图像还是数值数组）与「dense context reasoning」具体含义可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. LLM performance becomes comparable to handwritten code by allowing tool use (access to a Python interpreter) with/without ReAct prompting, in effect mapping questions onto agentic code generation problems. Our findings show that frontier models can serve as research assistants by interfacing with data through code, but still face difficulties processing information directly from large datasets - a key barrier future foundation models must overcome. The code and data are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jingene/CMESpectrumBench.

</details>

### 92. [GeoEdit: Adversarial De-Evidencing for Silent Geoprivacy Protection via Image Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26194v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26194

**作者：** Yu Yan、Shengjia Cheng、Fei Ma、Zhe Wang、Peng Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26194v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26194v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GeoEdit，对图像中高风险「证据锚点」做最小编辑，以破坏 MLRM 地理定位所依赖的隐式证据链，同时保留整体场景语义；并用可学习策略迭代优化编辑决策，将成功轨迹蒸馏为自然语言经验。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据锚点/证据链」视角直接涉及哪些视觉细节支撑多模态推理，可供核查视觉证据筛选与视觉旁路问题；但目标是隐私保护而非 latent 状态生成，需确认编辑作用于输入证据而非内部表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoEdit: Adversarial De-Evidencing for Silent Geoprivacy Protection via Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

</details>

### 93. [Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23862v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23862

**作者：** Simon A. Lee、Jiahang Hank Sha、Soomin Chung、Kai Akamatsu、Eran Halperin、Jeffrey N. Chiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23862v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23862v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 EHR 世界模型，将患者病史表示为动作条件化的 latent 轨迹：把患者状态与临床动作显式分离，用状态—动作条件转移算子并配合状态相关的线性化预测器实现多步 rollout 与动作条件模拟，在分类和时间到事件任务上以约 30 倍更小参数量取得有竞争力的表现。

**相关性简评：** 虽属医疗时序建模、无视觉与推理链，但其「状态/动作分离 + latent 转移算子 + 多步 rollout + 动作扰动敏感性」的可供核查线索，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新机制与轨迹监督设计提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models

**abstract/A1：** We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. We further decode free running rollouts into the original clinical feature space and evaluate future clinical measurements against observed values using task matched forecasting baselines, demonstrating that the learned dynamics retain predictive information beyond latent space agreement. Across binary classification and time to event tasks, EHR WM achieves competitive, though task dependent, performance relative to substantially larger EHR foundation models while using a 30x smaller parameter footprint. Finally, perturbing observed action sequences produces corresponding changes in generated trajectories, demonstrating the action sensitivity of the learned dynamics. Together, these results support world modeling as a complementary framework for learning explicit, time indexed representations of patient evolution from longitudinal EHR.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EMMA，一个事件驱动的多模态记忆系统：用融合视觉语义漂移与语音转折的双流检测器自适应切分事件边界，构建原始视频、片段级、事件级三级记忆层级，并以多智能体框架完成查询分解、分层搜索、证据校验与答案生成，用于长视频理解与问答。

**相关性简评：** 其粗到细的分层检索与「证据校验」环节可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/取证据决策提供可核查的方法线索，但论文面向外部视频记忆检索，不涉及 latent 推理状态，需确认校验环节的具体收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EMMA: Event-Driven Multimodal Memory System with Multi-Agent Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Long video understanding requires reasoning over hours of content that far exceed the context window of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches compress video into fixed-length clips, yet events are fragmented and unrelated content is merged, yielding noisy retrieval. To overcome this challenge, we propose EMMA, an Event-driven Multimodal Memory system with Multi-Agent retrieval, which organizes memory around semantic events in three stages: (1) Event segmentation: a dual-stream detector adaptively locates event boundaries by fusing visual semantic drift with spoken transitions, rather than fixed windows. (2) Memory construction: built on the detected events, a three-level hierarchy of raw video, clip-level memory, and event-level memory stores content at progressively higher semantic abstraction. (3) Memory retrieval: a multi-agent framework collaboratively queries this hierarchy through query decomposition, tiered search, evidence validation, and answer generation, narrowing evidence from coarse events to precise clips. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements, showing the effectiveness of our event-aligned memory system. Code, prompt templates, and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/BAI-LAB/EMMA.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23898v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23898v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RhinoNet：以 Vietoris–Rips 过滤构建单纯复形并配合小波与 MLP 编码高维点云，用自编码器隐空间约束成对点云的最优传输距离保持；在单细胞队列上生成患者层面的 phenoscape，并经隐空间 flow matching 与测地插值解码生成新点云。

**相关性简评：** 虽非视觉语言推理主线，但其隐空间的 flow matching 与测地插值可作为 latent 状态生成与逐步更新的方法线索，可供核查几何／距离保持的隐表示是否有助于推理状态的结构化与轨迹插值，单纯复形中学到的边也可能对应实体关系建模。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RhinoNet: Unsupervised Learning for Phenoscaping and Generation of High Dimensional Point Clouds

**abstract/A1：** We present RhinoNet, a simplicial complex-based point cloud neural network, that creates a geometry-preserving embedding of high-dimensional point clouds. RhinoNet takes collections of datasets, also called {\\em data cohorts}, and processes each dataset (point cloud) within the cohort as a simplicial complex. These simplicial complexes have datapoints as vertices and edges learned by Vietoris-Rips filtration. Using simplicial wavelets and MLP layers, RhinoNet computes a vector representation of each dataset in a latent space produced by an autoencoder. The latent space is optimized such that an optimal transport distance between pairs of point clouds is preserved between the latent representations. We apply RhinoNet to single-cell datasets collected on patients---a common source of such high-dimensional data. RhinoNet creates a patient level representation, known in biological contexts as a phenoscape. We establish that RhinoNet generates organized phenoscapes, whereas other methods such as static maps do not. Next we show that we can generate entire point clouds by sampling and decoding this phenoscape. We show two modes of generation via 1) latent flow matching and 2) geodesic interpolation in latent space, followed by a decoding back into the point cloud space. RhinoNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on single-cell and spatial data cohorts relative to tested baselines. Overall, RhinoNet lifts the concepts of representation learning and generative modeling to the point cloud or population level and defines a neural model for phenoscaping.

</details>

### 96. [Rethinking weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs: position nulls, protocol dependence, and PACE](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23902v1>)

**作者：** Shixin Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23902v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23902v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以胸片弱监督定位为对象，用「位置零对照」检验 CAM 类读出是否真有空间信号，量化结果制度、阈值与掩码转框规则等协议选择对结论的影响，并提出 PACE 方法并同时报告其收益与代价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs: position nulls, protocol dependence, and PACE

**abstract/A1：** Weakly supervised localization on chest radiographs is reported as a single overlap accuracy, and those numbers are not comparable across papers. We measure what one contains. Against position-null controls that keep a readout's own box and move only its position, class activation mapping and its gradient-weighted variant beat the null on two to four of seven annotated findings on ChestX-ray14 and two of eight on CheXlocalize. The null is beatable: three board-certified radiologists clear it on four to seven. Three rarely stated choices each move a result by more than most reported method effects: the results regime, the extraction threshold, and the mask-to-box rule, whose cost is predicted by how fragmented the thresholded mask is. Predicted box area alone reverses a paired comparison. These measurements produced PACE, for \\emph{population anomaly and class evidence}, which multiplies the finding identity from the label-trained head by the spatial evidence from a frozen radiograph backbone that never sees a pathology label. It is the case study that made the protocol dependence visible, and we report its costs beside its gain: in an exploratory matched-area analysis it improves strict-overlap accuracy on both corpora and beats a label-derived second map, but it is the least faithful of the three readouts to the classifier's causal map, its advantage depends on the box rule, and, this benchmark releasing no localization validation set, every design choice behind it was made on the boxes it is scored on. Its one clean transfer beats one baseline and loses to the other.

</details>

### 97. [Beyond Generator-Specific Shortcuts: Open-World AI-Generated Video Detection via Adversarial Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23906v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23906

**作者：** Qi Zhou、Yuanfan Li、Huiqi Deng、Hongbin Pei、Yazhe Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23906v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23906v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究开放世界下的 AI 生成视频检测，分析跨生成器 OOD 场景中检测器的失败模式，发现其表示强烈编码生成器特有线索；据此提出 FORGE，用梯度引导的 token 级对抗训练选择性扰动「生成器捷径 token」，以学习更可迁移的取证表示，在 29 个留出基准上取得平均 F1 92.62。

**相关性简评：** 其「区分与捷径相关的 token 和判别关键证据、只扰动前者」的做法，可能为 LVR 中筛选任务必要的视觉证据、抑制与推理无关的表示成分提供可核查的方法线索，但研究对象是视频取证检测而非多模态推理，迁移价值需读原文验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Generator-Specific Shortcuts: Open-World AI-Generated Video Detection via Adversarial Training

**abstract/A1：** AI-generated video (AIGV) detection is increasingly important for mitigating misinformation, impersonation, and other malicious uses of synthetic media, yet existing detectors often generalize poorly to unseen generators in open-world settings. To better understand this challenge, we analyze the failure modes of AIGV detectors under cross-generator out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts and observe that detector representations strongly encode generator-specific cues, which are associated with substantial ID-OOD performance drops. Further analysis shows that naively perturbing generator-sensitive tokens can even reduce OOD performance, indicating that generator-related cues and detection-relevant evidence are only partially separable. Motivated by these findings, we propose Forensic Obfuscation of geneRator-specific cues via Gradient-guided Embedding perturbation (FORGE), a token-aware adversarial training framework for open-world AIGV detection. FORGE identifies tokens that are strongly associated with generator-specific shortcuts yet less critical to real/fake discrimination, and selectively perturbs them during training to suppress generator-dependent patterns while preserving useful forensic evidence. Through synchronized adversarial training between an attacker and a detector, FORGE encourages the detector to learn more transferable generator-invariant forensic representations. Experiments on 29 held-out benchmark entries show that FORGE achieves an average F1 of 92.62, outperforming eight strong baselines by 5.31 points, while also remaining robust under four common post-processing attacks. We will release our code and datasets upon acceptance.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages

</details>

### 98. [EgoVine: Post-Training with Branching Experience Compiled from Real-World Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23907v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23907

**作者：** Qinchuan Cheng、Bowen Lyu、Zhantao Gong、Angela Yao、Cheston Tan、Shijie Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23907v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23907v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EgoVine 把真实第一视角视频标注编译成可执行的符号环境，通过恢复决策状态做分支探索并比较不同延续的结果，用同一批执行同时训练动作生成与后果预测，并加入失败修复目标迭代提升紧凑规划器。

**相关性简评：** 其「分支经验 + 后果预测 + 失败修复监督」的训练线索可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配与搜索验证提供参考，可供核查；但推理发生在符号环境中而非 latent 视觉状态，与主线联系有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EgoVine: Post-Training with Branching Experience Compiled from Real-World Videos

**abstract/A1：** Real-world egocentric videos capture multi-step household procedures, but their recorded trajectories leave alternative actions and recovery from the learner's own mistakes largely unexplored. We introduce EgoVine, a post-training framework that turns a fixed demonstration set into interactive experience for long-horizon planning. EgoVine operates in executable symbolic environments compiled from real-world video annotations, where an agent must coordinate object manipulations under partial observation and account for delayed consequences. Restoring a decision state allows the learner to explore alternative actions and compare their eventual outcomes. Union jointly trains action generation and consequence prediction in one model, using the same executions to supervise candidate comparison and recovery. Verified repairs add recovery targets from failed attempts, while comparisons among sampled continuations guide policy updates. The updated planner then returns to the environments, with its own decisions and mistakes shaping the next round of experience. On a shared benchmark, EgoVine-1.5B achieves 81.8% success on Main planning tasks and 66.7% on longer task compositions, outperforming all evaluated Flash LLM baselines on both. EgoVine connects real demonstrations to an iterative learning process that trains compact planners on choices and futures beyond the recorded trajectories.

</details>

### 99. [ContraSafe-VL: A Contrastive Safety Preference Dataset for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23908v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23908

**作者：** Di Wu、Yanyan Zhao、Xin Lu、Hao Yang、Taotao Zhang、Yunzhen Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23908v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23908v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 ContraSafe-VL：对同一文本查询配对安全标签不同的视觉上下文，并给出基于无害性与有用性的响应偏好对，用于 VLM 安全对齐训练，实验显示跨模态安全识别改善、安全与过度拒答的权衡更好。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定文本、只改视觉上下文」的对比数据构造，可能为检验模型是否真正使用视觉证据、区分视觉旁路与过度拒答提供线索，但论文聚焦安全偏好对齐而非 latent 推理状态，与本主线的关联需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ContraSafe-VL: A Contrastive Safety Preference Dataset for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as general-purpose multimodal assistants, making multimodal safety alignment an important challenge. Safety depends on the interplay between textual and visual content, with visual context often playing a critical role. However, VLMs may fail to use visual information appropriately, either overlooking safety-relevant visual content or over-interpreting sensitive visual content, leading to unsafe responses or over-refusal. Existing multimodal safety alignment datasets largely follow the response-preference paradigm, which teaches models how to respond but provides limited supervision on how visual context should inform the safety judgment, making it difficult to balance safety and over-refusal. To address this limitation, we introduce ContraSafe-VL, a Contrastive Safety preference dataset for Vision-Language Models. For each fixed textual query, ContraSafe-VL constructs paired visual contexts that result in multimodal queries with different safety labels, providing direct supervision for how visual context should inform multimodal safety judgments. It further provides response preference pairs based on harmlessness and helpfulness to encourage models to generate responses that are both safe and helpful. Experiments across three VLM architectures and multiple benchmarks demonstrate that training with ContraSafe-VL improves cross-modal safety recognition and achieves a better safety--over-refusal trade-off while preserving general multimodal capabilities. The dataset will be publicly released.

**comment/C1：** 5 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 100. [Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23915v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23915

**作者：** Arthur Aubret、Jochen Triesch、Céline Teulière

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23915v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23915v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文借用分割模型构建物体级数据集，在多种自监督模型上探测发现视觉骨干主要编码物体类别、而投影头专门编码类别间共现统计，并通过对预训练共现模式的控制显示共现信号能加速类别级表示的形成。

**相关性简评：** 其逐层探测与「控制共现」实验设计可供核查 LVR 内部状态是否保留实体关系与视觉细节、以及表示层间的功能分工，但该工作面向静态视觉表示而非推理态生成，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics

**abstract/A1：** Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has achieved impressive success in learning semantic visual representations, yet the underlying principles driving this success remain underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that common SSL pretext tasks implicitly model object co-occurrence statistics, a fundamental cue for visual learning. To test this, we curate three datasets of segmented objects from existing vision benchmarks using a state-of-the-art segmentation model. Through experiments across many SSL models, we reveal a hierarchical encoding of semantic information: while the visual backbone captures object categories, the projection head specializes in encoding co-occurrences between object categories. As a result, the projection head outperforms the backbone in aligning with human judgments of inter-category similarity. Furthermore, by controlling co-occurrence patterns during pre-training, we demonstrate that encoding object co-occurrences can significantly accelerate the emergence of category-level representations. Our findings uncover a previously hidden learning principle in SSL and suggest a path toward designing more effective pretext tasks by explicitly leveraging object co-occurrence structure.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in NeuRIPS

</details>

### 101. [Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23919v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23919

**作者：** Si Qin、Jiawei Tang、Yaxin Hou、Yan Chen、Yutong Xie、Chen Li、Yuheng Jia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23919v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23919v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出词表不完整的无监督 VLM 适配设定（VI-UVA）：适配阶段只能看到部分类名，会带来偏向已给类别的偏差；作者用 Label Space Reconstruction 从无标注数据重建一个 latent 标签空间并注入 prompt tuning，以缓解该偏差、改善遗漏类识别，并给出遗漏类语义差异界与八个基准上的实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「用无标注数据重建 latent 标签空间以补偿不完整监督、抑制适配偏差」的思路，可能为 LVR 训练中监督信号不完备、偏差与贡献分配问题提供可核查线索；但论文不涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用，与主线仅有方法层面的间接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** In certain real-world scenarios, obtaining labeled data is excessively expensive, motivating increasing interest in adapting models without annotations. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide pseudo-labels for unlabeled images through image-text similarity, enabling adaptation without manual labeling. The previous unsupervised vision-language model adaption methods assume access to an adaptation vocabulary containing all class names. However, a complete vocabulary is difficult to construct in real-world scenarios, as unlabeled data may contain classes that are overlooked or fall outside the current task scope. Thus, we propose Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-language model Adaptation (VI-UVA), where only a subset of class names are available during adaptation. The vocabulary incompleteness induces an adaptation bias toward provided classes, which degrades omitted-class recognition. To address this issue, we propose Label Space Reconstruction (LSR), which reconstructs a latent label space from the unlabeled data and incorporates it into prompt tuning, thereby extending adaptation beyond the incomplete vocabulary and mitigating the adaptation bias. Furthermore, we derive an omitted-class semantic discrepancy bound for LSR and identify the key factors affecting the bound. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that LSR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

</details>

### 102. [Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23923v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23923

**作者：** Geon Lee、Kyungho Kim、Dongwon Choi、Juyeon Kim、Shinhwan Kang、Kijung Shin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23923v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23923v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TABHGR+：用 LLM 依列与任务描述生成规则，为表格行打弱标签，再按规则把语义相关行聚成超图做标签传播，并给超边赋标签自适应权重以提纯噪声标签，从而在零样本表格分类上以与数据规模无关的常数次 LLM 调用替代逐行提示。

**相关性简评：** 表格零样本任务与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「恒定 LLM 调用 + 超图迭代传播 + 自适应边权重」的廉价状态提纯思路，可能为 latent 状态的多轮更新、证据聚合与推理成本控制提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Tabular data are prevalent across diverse domains such as healthcare and finance. Zero-shot tabular learning aims to make predictions without labeled data. However, existing LLM-based approaches rely on row-wise prompting, resulting in high inference cost and limited use of inter-row dependencies. In this work, we propose TABHGR+, an efficient relation-aware zero-shot framework for tabular data that leverages LLM-generated rules to label and group rows. Specifically, based on column and task descriptions, we use LLMs to generate rules that assign weak labels to all rows. To refine these noisy weak labels, we construct a hypergraph by grouping semantically related rows using LLM-generated rules and perform hypergraph-based label propagation. Lastly, we further enhance the LLM-generated hypergraph for propagation, which is potentially sub-optimal, by assigning label-adaptive weights to hyperedges. By requiring only a constant number of LLM calls independent of dataset size, TABHGR+ substantially reduces inference cost while achieving higher classification accuracy than zero-shot and strong few-shot baselines.

**comment/C1：** EMNLP 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 将视觉 token 压缩建模为非平衡最优传输问题，用交替优化统一 token 重要性、语义冗余与覆盖度三个目标，并证明降低传输代价可上界 MaxSim 检索误差，在 ViDoRe V1/V3 上验证效率与效果的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「重要性—冗余—覆盖」的视觉 token 筛选准则与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、细节保留问题可能相通，且传输代价上界检索误差的论证可供核查是否适用于 latent 状态选择；但论文目标是文档检索而非多模态推理，迁移需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models(VLMs)have advanced Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) by enabling OCR-free, multi-vector representations. However, these models generate excessive tokens to preserve dense visual details, which severely limits retrieval scalability. Existing compression methods mitigate this overhead but rely on isolated heuristics that fail to balance token importance, semantic redundancy, and coverage capacity. We propose a visual token compression framework formulated as an Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) problem. Our approach unifies these three objectives into a single alternating optimization process. Furthermore, we theoretically show that minimizing the transport cost upper-bounds the MaxSim retrieval error, ensuring ranking stability. Extensive experiments on the ViDoRe V1 and V3 benchmarks demonstrate that our method preserves fine-grained document semantics and improves the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off over state-of-the-art base-lines. Code is available at https://github.com/shhhhhyy/Unbalanced-Optimal-Transport-for-EVDR.

### 104. [Trimodal Context-Aware Micro-Expression Recognition in Real-World Conversations: A Dataset and a Hierarchical Fusion Network](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23930v1>)

**作者：** Junbo Wang、Yan Zhao、Shigang Wang、Jian Wei、Qiming Zhang、Yu Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23930v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23930v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 TriCoME 三模态（视觉、音频、文本）真实对话微表情数据集，并提出分层聚焦融合网络 HFFNet：细粒度对齐声学与语义流、压缩长对话序列，并用上下文类型嵌入调制注意力、按视觉置信度在纯视觉与多模态决策间路由。

**相关性简评：** 其基于视觉置信度在纯视觉与多模态分支间路由、以避免噪声上下文干扰的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「何时依赖视觉、何时引入上下文」提供可核查的借鉴线索，但该文并不涉及 latent 推理状态或 VLM。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trimodal Context-Aware Micro-Expression Recognition in Real-World Conversations: A Dataset and a Hierarchical Fusion Network

**abstract/A1：** Recognizing micro-expressions in real-world conversations is challenging, as these facial movements are brief and faint, and their interpretations are strongly dependent on the contextual circumstances of their occurrence. Most existing methods are de-contextualized, as they analyze isolated video clips while disregarding the semantic and acoustic cues in the surrounding dialogue that help explain the emergence of an expression. Decades of psychological studies have shown that social context exerts influences on facial behavior over two key dimensions: how an expression is interpreted and how strongly it is generated to begin with. However, existing micro-expression research rarely incorporates such contextual factors into its models. As an example, provocative utterances from an interlocutor may elicit suppressed negative affective reactions, which isolated silent clips are unable to account for. We propose TriCoME, a trimodal dataset consisting of visual, audio and text data sourced from real-world conversations. In this dataset, each micro-expression is paired with its concurrent utterance and preceding context. We further annotate the context based on conversational role to denote two categories: external stimuli from an interlocutor's utterance and internal background from the subject's own utterance. On this basis, we propose the Hierarchical Focusing Fusion Network (HFFNet), which aligns acoustic and semantic streams at fine granularity, compresses long dialogue sequences, modulates attention toward conversational roles via a context-type embedding, and routes each sample between visual-only and multimodal decisions based on visual confidence to prevent noisy context from degrading recognition performance.

</details>
