### 105. [Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23935v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23935

**作者：** Jiakun Fan、Min Xiao、Qiang Wang、Neiwen Ling、Zhichao Liu、Zhihao Jia、Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos、Zijun Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23935v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23935v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DScout，用于 diffusion drafter 的推测解码：训练端把逐位置损失分解为 inclusion、weighting、prediction 三项，据此组合 mixed-horizon 训练、块内 unmasking 与接受加权损失；推理端把吞吐分解为 MAT 与每轮延迟之比，用于选择 target-conditioning 深度、drafter 深度与块大小，在六个基准上取得约 3.8–4.1 倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 该文不研究多模态推理，但「仅连续前缀被接受」与「按 MAT/延迟选配置」两条线索，可能可供核查并行生成中的监督对齐与推理期动态计算、停止决策问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves $3.84\\times$ and $4.14\\times$ mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.

</details>

<a id="paper-106"></a>

### 106. [SECURE-AI: Multi-Signal Uncertainty Quantification for Trustworthy Acoustic Cough Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23937v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23937

**作者：** Sejal Solkhan、Feiya Xiang、Mayur Sanap、Geet Khatri、Edgar Lobaton

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.SD、eess.AS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23937v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23937v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文为声学咳嗽检测提出 SECURE-AI 多信号不确定性量化框架，在冻结的 MobileNetV3 分类器外挂 Monte Carlo Dropout、温度缩放与嵌入空间 Mahalanobis 距离，发现概率空间方法不足、嵌入距离最能区分正误预测，并报告拒绝阈值跨数据划分不可迁移的负结果。

**相关性简评：** 虽属音频健康监测，其「嵌入空间距离优于概率校准」来判定预测可信度并选择拒绝作答的线索，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态可靠性与 STOP／弃答决策提供可供核查的方法参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SECURE-AI: Multi-Signal Uncertainty Quantification for Trustworthy Acoustic Cough Detection

**abstract/A1：** Acoustic models for cough detection achieve high accuracy on curated benchmarks but fail silently in deployment, where speech, environmental noise, and audio unlike the training data induce confident misclassifications. In health monitoring, a confidently wrong prediction is worse than no answer at all. We present SECURE-AI (Self-aware Estimation of Cough Uncertainty for Reliable Evaluation of AI), a multi-signal uncertainty quantification framework that wraps a frozen MobileNetV3 cough classifier and estimates when its predictions should not be trusted, combining Monte Carlo Dropout, Temperature Scaling, and Mahalanobis distance in the embedding space. On a held-out split of 12,161 Coswara recordings, the probability-space methods are individually insufficient: Monte Carlo Dropout assigns lower uncertainty to incorrect than to correct predictions, and temperature scaling improves calibration but not discrimination. The strongest signal is embedding-space distance: Mahalanobis distance separates true positives from false positives (means 44.7 versus 63.4; Cohen's $d = 0.94$; AUROC 0.86) and, among predicted non-coughs, false negatives from true negatives (AUROC 0.82), so the same signal can flag both false alarms and missed coughs. At a descriptive operating point selected from labeled test data, retaining 90 percent of true-positive detections removes about two-thirds of false positives and raises precision from 59.9 to roughly 80 percent. A rejection threshold tuned on one split does not transfer to another (validation F1 of 82 percent falls to 34 percent on test), so we report threshold-independent AUROC as the main measure. An error taxonomy shows that failures are systematic, with most false positives related to speech. The pipeline runs on Raspberry Pi hardware costing 30 to 90 US dollars. Probabilistic calibration alone is thus inadequate for reliable cough detection.

</details>

### 107. [PeekKV: The First Content Token Already Knows Which Heads Matter](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23939v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23939

**作者：** Minyoung Go、Yongjun Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23939v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23939v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PeekKV，一种无需训练与离线剖析的 KV cache 压缩方法：在 prefill 后仅「偷看」单个内容 token，同时得到注意力头分组分数与 token 重要性分数，据此为各头组按比例分配缓存预算，并在各组内只保留最高分 token。

**相关性简评：** 其关于活跃注意力头组成在 prefill 与 decode 之间变化、却在内容 token 间保持稳定的观察，可能为 LVR 中「注意力结构与缓存如何影响 latent 状态及相似度」提供核查线索；但论文面向纯文本服务效率，未涉及多模态推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PeekKV: The First Content Token Already Knows Which Heads Matter

**abstract/A1：** The size of the KV cache grows linearly with context length, making it a major memory bottleneck in LLM serving. Motivated by recent progress in identifying the functional roles of attention heads, a growing body of work compresses the KV cache non-uniformly across heads. Existing methods either fix the important heads via offline profiling or select them using attention signals from the prefill stage. In both cases, however, accuracy fluctuates substantially across workloads. While investigating the cause of this instability, we find that the active heads shift between the prefill and decode stages even within a single input. Along the decode path, by contrast, the activehead composition remains stable across content tokens once format tokens are filtered out. Based on this observation, we propose PeekKV. PeekKV observes a single content token immediately after prefill - a one-token peek - to jointly obtain head-group scores and token-importance scores. Guided by these scores, PeekKV allocates KV cache budgets to head groups in proportion to their group scores and retains only the top-scoring tokens within each budget. PeekKV requires no offline profiling or training and thus applies directly to unseen workloads and new models. Across four public benchmarks, PeekKV achieves the highest accuracy in more than half of the per-model comparisons against state-of-the-art methods, and stays closest to the full-cache accuracy on RULER and LongBench. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, PeekKV retains 95.7% of the full-cache accuracy at a 10% memory budget on RULER with 16K contexts and 95.9% at a 1.5% budget on LongBench.

</details>

### 108. [ReTTT: Reflection-Driven Test-Time Training via Experience-Based Parametric Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23942v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23942

**作者：** Kangcong Li、Hangfan Zhang、Shuyue Hu、Shengji Tang、Tao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23942v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23942v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ReTTT 让 LLM 智能体在多轮任务中反思交互反馈、把「经验教训」写入显式记忆，并据此在 episode 内训练一份 LoRA 适配器（主干冻结），使适配后的模型同时承担后续动作与反思；在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、SWE-bench Lite 上优于基于轨迹的 test-time training。

**相关性简评：** 其用 episode 内 LoRA 参数记忆承载并持续修订经验、且比较适配反思策略的增益，与 LVR 关注的「轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督」有可核查的方法线索，但对象是纯文本智能体、不涉及视觉证据，迁移到 latent 推理状态仍需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReTTT: Reflection-Driven Test-Time Training via Experience-Based Parametric Memory

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents accumulate valuable task-specific information through their actions, observations, and environmental feedback during multi-turn task execution. When effectively used, this information can help agents refine subsequent decisions and improve task performance. However, the learning value of an interaction depends on its context and subsequent feedback, making it challenging to extract reliable, actionable lessons and revise them as the task unfolds. In this paper, we introduce ReTTT, which enables experience-driven self-adaptation through test-time training on lessons constructed and continually revised within an episode. ReTTT lets the agent reflect on interaction feedback, maintain the resulting lessons in an explicit memory, and learn from them by updating an episode-local LoRA adapter while keeping the backbone frozen. The adapted model then performs both subsequent actions and reflection, coupling policy adaptation with the construction of future learning experience. We evaluate ReTTT on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SWE-bench Lite using two model families. ReTTT outperforms trajectory-based test-time training across all six model--benchmark settings, improving task success by up to 12.14 percentage points. A frozen-reflection comparison further shows a 7.14-point benefit from adapting the reflection policy, while trajectory analysis illustrates how adapted reflection derives more task-specific guidance from failed attempts. These findings suggest that learning to reflect on its own behavior can boost agents' performance on long-horizon tasks.

</details>

### 109. [How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23946v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23946

**作者：** Bowei He、Yankai Chen、Xiaokun Zhang、Changjiang Han、Ye Yuan、Chong Li、Xue Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23946v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23946v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 agentic RL 的训练数据分解为任务、环境、轨迹三个基数轴并加一个奖励密度控制变量，在不同模型、领域和 PPO/GRPO 下拟合各自的缩放关系，用拟合结果给合成方法「定价」，再把预算分配写成约束优化，推出 Chinchilla 式 compute-optimal 配方。

**相关性简评：** LVR 的轨迹训练与监督同样面对「在有限预算下扩哪一轴」的问题，该文按轴给出的缩放指数与合成—真实比例临界值可供核查，用来推断轨迹级监督相对任务多样性的实际收益；但研究对象为纯文本 agentic RL，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies

**abstract/A1：** Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \\textit{tasks}, \\textit{environments}, and \\textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \\textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $&gt;$ task $&gt;$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method's efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant \`\`scale-the-trajectories'' practice.

**comment/C1：** This paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 110. [Parameter misspecification in physics-informed neural networks: A closed-form audit and its limits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23948v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23948

**作者：** David McShannon、Nicholas Dietrich

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.NA、physics.comp-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23948v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23948v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 PINN 中方程系数被错误指定时，仅凭训练后的网络能推断出多少该参数：在残差对参数线性（A-νB）时给出闭式最小二乘估计，不需重训或参考数据，并引入归一化残差 ρ 刻画网络满足自身方程的程度，在多个方程上统计恢复误差与错设检测率。

**相关性简评：** 对冻结网络做单次评估即可闭式读出内部编码参数、并用 ρ 作为内部一致性的可靠性指标，可能为核查 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及为错设/失败检测提供可借鉴的探针思路，需进一步核查其能否迁移到 VLM 推理诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Parameter misspecification in physics-informed neural networks: A closed-form audit and its limits

**abstract/A1：** Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to minimize the residual of a prescribed equation, so a low training loss does not indicate whether a coefficient in that equation was specified incorrectly. This study evaluates what can be inferred about the encoded parameter from the trained network alone. When the residual is linear in the parameter, written as $A - νB$, the least-squares estimate $\\hatν = A^{\\top}B/B^{\\top}B$ is obtained from a single evaluation of the frozen network, without retraining or reference data. Its accuracy depends on how closely the network satisfies its own equation, quantified by a normalized residual $ρ$. Recovery error is associated with $ρ$ (log-log correlation 0.72 across 36 convection-diffusion networks), and empirical exponents of 0.63 to 1.20 across three equations decompose into one half plus a measurable angular term. For Burgers' equation, a single-model test based on a block-bootstrap standard error flagged 3 of 300 correctly specified networks (observed false-alarm rate 1%), all 2% misspecifications at a practical budget, and two thirds of 1% misspecifications after convergence. For the self-similar blowup rate of the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation, where the rate also enters the architecture, the estimator recovers about half of the misspecification, whereas $ρ$ increases approximately quadratically and distinguishes a 0.2% error. When the incorrect rate enters both the equation and the architecture, errors of up to 2% were not detected at the precision reached. At practical budgets, the raw loss can be lower for the misspecified model, a scaling effect that $ρ$ does not share.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages main body, 3 figures main body, 7 pages supplementary material

</details>

### 111. [Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23950v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23950

**作者：** Chuansai Zhou、Yanlin Liu、Bingning Huang、Shidi Xi、Chao Huang、Boxing Chen、Mingming Zhu、Guanghuan Fang、Ben Feng、Zongzuo Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23950v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23950v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ATRL，把 GRPO 改造成面向长程 Triton kernel 生成的「压缩感知、分段级」后训练目标，并配合带编译、正确性与性能反馈的轻量 agent 框架和 Ascend 知识库，在 NPUKernelBench 与 KernelBench 上提升正确率与加速比。

**相关性简评：** 其压缩感知上下文管理与分段级奖励设计，可能与 LVR 中长轨迹训练的贡献分配、上下文累积与停止决策的成本权衡存在可核查的方法线索，但需确认是否可迁移到多模态 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation

**abstract/A1：** Automatically generating high-performance kernels with LLM-based agents promises substantial gains in development efficiency, but two obstacles remain. First, while increasing multi-turn interaction with execution environments is crucial for refining generation quality, continuous context accumulation rapidly exceeds the model's effective context window. Second, training long-horizon tasks via GRPO inherently incurs sparse rewards due to its reliance on terminal outcome evaluation, severely hindering step-level credit assignment; To address these obstacles, we propose ATRL (Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning), a post-training method that refines GRPO into a compaction-aware, segment-level objective for long-horizon kernel generation. We also design a lightweight agent harness providing cascaded compilation, correctness, and profiling feedback, alongside an Ascend-specific knowledge base injected during agentic RL training and evaluation to compensate for the base model's missing platform expertise. Evaluations on NPUKernelBench and KernelBench, both executed on Ascend hardware, show that ATRL consistently surpasses all baselines, including GRPO, in both correctness and speedup.

</details>

### 113. [SPELUNKA: A Framework for Finding Unanticipated Associations in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23979v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23979

**作者：** Cassandra Parent、Isha Agarwal、Kumail Alhamoud、Charikleia Moraitaki、Rafiya Javed、Walter Gerych、Marzyeh Ghassemi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23979v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23979v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPELUNKA，一个推理期自动化框架：给定感兴趣概念后生成相关图像描述、抽取实体、筛出语义关联，再用基于频率的检测规则，通过属性在 VLM 排序输出中相对全数据集的过/欠表示来发现未预期的虚假关联，并在四个数据集上验证其能恢复合成与自然存在的相关性。

**相关性简评：** 其「描述→实体抽取→统计排序输出中属性的过/欠表示」的探针思路，可能可供核查 VLM 内部是否保留并使用了特定视觉细节与实体关系，从而迁移为 LVR 中表示诊断与视觉证据筛选的工具线索；但论文本身面向检索偏差发现，与推理状态生成无直接关系，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPELUNKA: A Framework for Finding Unanticipated Associations in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the backbone of many state-of-the-art multimodal systems, but often encode spurious and harmful associations from their training data. While prior work focuses on removing known biases from VLMs, methods for discovering unanticipated associations for retrieval tasks remain underexplored. We introduce SPELUNKA, an automated, inference-time framework for finding unanticipated distributional biases for retrieval tasks in VLMs without pre-specified labeled subgroups, inference-time human supervision, or model fine-tuning. Given a concept of interest, SPELUNKA generates captions for related images, extracts relevant entities from captions, and selects semantically meaningful associations. A frequency-based detection rule then identifies spurious associations by measuring over- or under-representation of these attributes in a VLM's top-ranked outputs relative to their full dataset distribution. We evaluate SPELUNKA across four datasets, and find that it 1) successfully recovers both synthetic and naturally occurring spurious correlations, 2) achieves an average AUROC of 0.93 across four datasets in identifying images strongly associated with a query, and 3) outperforms baselines in finding features that are strongly associated with a given query.

</details>

### 114. [Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23982v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23982

**作者：** Shenyi Li、Ziyang Zhang、Wen Wu、Ming Liu、Chao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23982v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23982v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Time-JEPA 用低维、时间对齐的物理时间序列作为辅助监督微调视频世界模型，在自动驾驶、机器人操作与人体运动等域提升当前状态解码、多步未来状态预测与运动学重建。

**相关性简评：** 其把 latent 视频表示与相同时刻的物理状态对齐并加监督，可能为 latent 推理状态的监督方式与任务必要信息保留提供可核查线索；但属视频世界模型，能否迁移到 VLM 推理尚不确定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Video world models learn how visual environments evolve by predicting missing or future content. However, physical-state information can provide useful context for predicting how environments evolve. Prior work incorporates this information through different mechanisms: domain-specific physical laws can complicate multi-domain training, while supervision on individual frames or frame pairs gives limited attention to how physical state evolves over time. We introduce Time-JEPA, which fine-tunes a video world model using low-dimensional, temporally aligned physical time series as auxiliary supervision. Physical time series connect video representations with physical state at corresponding temporal positions, encouraging the model to preserve how physical state evolves. In multiple domains including autonomous driving, robot manipulation, and human motion, Time-JEPA improves current-state decoding, multi-horizon future-state prediction, and kinematic reconstruction over matched video-fine-tuned controls across both condition and state-variable distribution shifts. Multi-domain training provides aggregate gains over matched single-domain training in all three tasks. External evaluations further suggest that time-series supervision improves sensitivity to physical anomalies and the representation of physical interactions, including in unseen scenarios. Aggregate gains on a second video backbone indicate that the method can be applied to more backbones. These results suggest that physical time series help video world models better understand the physical world.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/Lishenyi2004/Time-JEPA

</details>

### 115. [TWIN-MoE: Two-stage Intra-Expert Imputation Network for Incomplete Multimodal Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24014v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24014

**作者：** Liang Nathan Zheng、Jiyuan Liu、Wenhao Liang、Wei Emma Zhang、Weitong Chen、Lin Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24014v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24014v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析 MoE 路由会形成专家条件表示邻域，并据此提出 TWIN 两阶段框架：先在编码器嵌入空间生成上下文条件估计、用 FIFO 队列统计做径向软裁剪，再在 MoE 之后于同一专家内聚合已观测表示来补全缺失模态，在四个缺失模态基准上以更少参数取得最优结果。

**相关性简评：** 在潜在空间内对缺失模态表示做估计与校准、并按局部特征散布给出重建误差界，这一思路可能为 LVR 中视觉证据缺失或信息坍缩时如何修复内部状态提供方法线索，可供核查其分析能否迁移到 VLM 推理表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TWIN-MoE: Two-stage Intra-Expert Imputation Network for Incomplete Multimodal Learning

**abstract/A1：** Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address missing modalities either by routing each missingness pattern to a dedicated expert, which scales poorly as the number of modalities grows, or by imputing the missing modality from representations contributed by multiple experts, which requires a costly retrieval mechanism. We show that routing induces expert-conditioned representation neighborhoods and derive an imputation-error bound controlled by their local feature dispersion. When these expert-conditioned neighborhoods are more compact than the global representation space, intra-expert aggregation admits a tighter worst-case reconstruction bound than unconstrained global aggregation. Guided by this analysis, we propose TWIN, a two-stage intra-expert imputation framework. Pre-imputation generates a context-conditioned estimate in the encoder embedding space and radially soft-clips it using modality-specific statistics maintained in an observed FIFO queue, this ensures that the pre-imputed modality stays in empirically calibrated region of the target modality space. Post-imputation refines the missing representation after MoE by aggregating expert-conditioned observed representations within the same sample. Across four missing-modality benchmarks under natural, random, and asymmetric dropout protocols, TWIN achieves state-of-the-art performance while using substantially fewer parameters than competing MoE-based imputation methods.

</details>

### 116. [SynerGest: Temporal-Spatial Synergistic Gesture Generation for Dyadic Conversations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24031v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24031

**作者：** Chengxiang Guo、Jian Wang、Lanmiao Liu、Zhan Tang、Junhua Fei、Xiao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.SD、eess.AS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24031v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24031v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向双人对话虚拟人的手势生成框架 SynerGest：提出对比流匹配（CFM）目标，在训练中惩罚语义错配的配对、抑制空间捷径与过度平滑，并设计脉冲-趋势协同注意力（ITSA）模块，把「什么在动」与「何时动」解耦以兼顾节奏同步与肢体稳定。

**相关性简评：** 应用域为动作生成，与视觉推理主线无直接关系；但 CFM 通过错配对惩罚抑制捷径的对比训练信号、以及内容与时序解耦的表示思路，可能可供核查用于 latent 推理轨迹的监督设计与状态分解。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SynerGest: Temporal-Spatial Synergistic Gesture Generation for Dyadic Conversations

**abstract/A1：** Co-speech gesture generation in dyadic conversations for creating immersive virtual avatars remains highly challenging. Existing models often struggle to balance kinematic stability with rhythmic responsiveness and suffer from semantic entanglement, leading to either generic mean-pose regression or unnatural micro-jitters. To address these challenges, we propose SynerGest, a high-fidelity dyadic gesture generation framework grounded in Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM). Specifically, our CFM objective explicitly penalizes mismatched semantic pairs during training, discouraging spatial shortcuts and over-smoothed predictions while improving conditional semantic alignment. Furthermore, to overcome architectural bottlenecks, we introduce the Impulse-Trend Synergistic Attention (ITSA) module. Grounded in the key insight of decoupling "what moves" from "when it moves," ITSA models sharp, speech-driven rhythmic impulses separately from continuous kinematic trends, supporting precise audio-motion synchronization and global structural stability. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations on two public datasets demonstrate that SynerGest achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering contextually responsive and kinematically fluid dyadic interactions.

**comment/C1：** accepted by ACM MM 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究异构联邦学习下 ViT 的本地 early exit 推理，用基于标签熵与浅层置信度的客户端专属阈值替代单一全局阈值，并按预测熵、置信度、top-2 类间隔和退出深度逐样本调整，在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet-1K 上报告约 30% 深度节省。

**相关性简评：** 其逐输入依据熵、置信度与类别间隔决定退出深度的接受准则，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与精度—计算成本权衡提供可核查线索；但该工作面向联邦分类而非多模态 latent 推理，迁移性需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Client-Aware Security Adaptive Early Exit Vision Transformers for Heterogeneous Federated Learning

**abstract/A1：** Federated learning (FL) trains a shared model across data-owning clients without centralizing raw data, but client data difficulty and compute budgets can differ. We study local early-exit Vision Transformer (ViT) inference, where an intermediate classifier may return a prediction before the final Transformer stage. The proposed method replaces one global acceptance threshold with a client-specific base threshold from label entropy and shallow-exit confidence, then adjusts each input using predictive entropy, confidence, top-two class margin, and exit depth. Aggregation uses only clients that updated a parameter. Security-aware routing reaches 88.70% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 32.0% depth saving and 73.7% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with 30\\% saving. On matched six-client non-IID CIFAR-100, full-depth accuracy is 72.28% versus 68.20--71.80% for four heterogeneous-FL baselines; robustness-aware routing reaches 70.01% with 32.55% saving.

</details>

### 118. [Generative Text Modelling and Language-Guided Visual Attention for Deciphering Palimpsests](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24060v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24060

**作者：** Robin Hollifeldt、Tianru Zhang、Jessica Ström、Ekta Vats

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24060v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24060v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究羊皮纸重写本（palimpsest）中被擦除底层文本的自动恢复：用 GAN 与自定义扩散模型重建底层文字，再由微调的手写文本识别网络处理，并提出以 CLIP 生成的视觉注意力图将文本类别描述落地为识别先验，同时发布合成数据与预训练模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「用语言描述引导 CLIP 视觉注意力、把有意义特征与噪声区分开」的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选及注意力/位置结构如何影响 latent 内容提供可核查的方法线索，但原文面向古籍复原，迁移到多模态推理的有效性尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Generative Text Modelling and Language-Guided Visual Attention for Deciphering Palimpsests

**abstract/A1：** Recovering obscured text in palimpsests, i.e. the manuscripts where the original writing (under-text) was erased and overwritten for reuse, is vital for preserving lost information. Due to the nature of the material, such a task can be highly challenging and time-consuming. This paper presents an approach towards automated palimpsest handwritten text modeling for under-text recovery. We investigate generative models, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models, and design a custom denoising diffusion model that learns structured noise patterns to reconstruct the under-text. The recovered text is subsequently processed by a fine-tuned, attention-based handwritten text recognition network. Furthermore, we investigate a language-guided recognition framework that leverages textual class descriptions as informative priors, enabling the text recognition model to distinguish meaningful features from noise. This is achieved by grounding task-specific descriptions, phrased in words or sentences, through visual attention maps generated by pretrained vision-language models like CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training). To facilitate future research and benchmarking, we release new datasets for synthetic palimpsests (currently scarce), CLIP-compatible text descriptions, and pre-trained models with code.

**comment/C1：** This is a pre-MIT Press publication version, accepted for publication at TACL

</details>

### 119. [Persistent Memory and Iterative Improvement in an LLM Agent for Chinese-Character Drawing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24090v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24090

**作者：** Peilin Wu、Yi-Zhuang You

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24090v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24090v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在程序化汉字书写任务上比较五种 agent 条件下 668 个条目的表现，检验从既往尝试累积的持久记忆（自由笔记、可复用代码库）是否以及如何提升新问题的首次成功率，并额外用目标专属结构监督做事后对比。

**相关性简评：** 其「记忆库设计 + 迭代改进」机制可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中跨轮推理状态的更新与经验积累方式，而「结构监督事后增益大、平均收益有限」也提示监督信息量与贡献分配的问题；但任务为文本/代码 agent，与内部 latent 状态的关系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Persistent Memory and Iterative Improvement in an LLM Agent for Chinese-Character Drawing

**abstract/A1：** Does persistent memory accumulated from previous attempts help an LLM agent solve new problems, and does memory design affect that benefit? We study programmatic Chinese-character drawing across five agent conditions attempting the same 668 items. Accumulated memory produces modest aggregate gains despite substantial growth in the memory stores: free-form notes improve first-attempt success by 4.6 percentage points, while a design combining free-form memory with reusable code improves it by 2.8 points. The two designs do not differ significantly overall, but the code bank shows a suggestive advantage on later, harder items. A separate post-hoc comparison finds a much larger improvement when the code-bank agent receives privileged, target-specific structural supervision. The agent can therefore exploit highly informative structural guidance, although the privileged per-item information does not establish what could have been learned from experience alone. These results suggest that memory design may affect where accumulated experience becomes useful, even when its average benefit is modest.

</details>

### 120. [Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24108v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24108

**作者：** Yi Fang、Gaurav Srivastava、Sirui Ding、Xuan Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24108v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24108v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在16个配对数据集、五个领域与多种标注预算下比较三种多模态对齐范式：在冻结联合预训练编码器上训练融合头的 JOINT、在独立预训练编码器上训练的 DECOUPLED，以及给冻结 LLM 指令、标注示例与单模态读出结果的 AGENT，并尝试用表示与任务诊断级联选择范式。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时需要跨模态融合、何时可走无视觉编码的 agent 路径」的判断，以及 5-NN 精度与几何诊断驱动的路由，可能为 LVR 中视觉信息是否保留在内部状态、LOOK 类证据获取与停止决策的成本收益提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins

**abstract/A1：** Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $ρ=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

</details>

### 121. [SERO: Semantic Prediction for Single-Step Object Removal](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24173v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24173

**作者：** Amreen Hasheem Siraj、Alireza Javanmardi、Pragati Jaiswal、Didier Stricker、Alain Pagani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24173v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24173v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SERO：先在 embedding 空间预测被移除区域的语义先验，再由 latent bridge-matching 生成器单步完成物体移除与场景补全。

**相关性简评：** 其「在 latent 空间预测不可见区域的语义内容 + 单次前向生成」的做法，可能为 LVR 中内部状态如何承载缺失视觉细节、以及少步/非迭代的 latent 状态生成提供可核查线索；但任务属图像编辑，与 VLM 推理的联系尚需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SERO: Semantic Prediction for Single-Step Object Removal

**abstract/A1：** Object removal and semantic inpainting of missing regions remain inherently ill-posed, as multiple plausible completions may exist for a given scene. Recent diffusion-based methods have demonstrated strong potential for high-quality object removal; however, they still face two key limitations. First, although they can synthesise sharp and high-resolution images, they often struggle to complete removed regions in a semantically consistent and contextually meaningful manner, where the generated content should agree with the surrounding scene layout and object relationships rather than merely appear visually realistic. Second, their iterative denoising process makes them computationally expensive, limiting their practicality for downstream applications. We propose SERO, a semantic prediction framework for single-step object removal. Our model predicts a hidden-region semantic prior in embedding space, which guides a latent bridge-matching generator toward plausible scene completion by providing both where to edit and what structure is likely to exist behind the removed object. This enables visually realistic and contextually coherent completions in one forward pass. Experiments on the RORD and OBER datasets show that SERO achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance while requiring only a single generation step.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at CVMP 2026. Project page: https://dfki-av.github.io/SERO

</details>

### 122. [Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24177v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24177

**作者：** Hyunwoo Ryu、Eric Ming Chen、Max Wilcoxson、Vincent Sitzmann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24177v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24177v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Mirror：在无动作标签和无奖励的前提下，通过尝试执行视频规划器给出的视觉计划生成 video-action 对，自监督训练 video-to-action 逆动力学模型并迭代自我改进，在 Atari、OGBench、DMC 与 Minecraft 上超过既有模仿学习方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「视觉计划→环境执行→回填监督」闭环可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何解码为可检验动作、以及无标注轨迹训练与贡献分配提供借鉴线索，可供核查；但论文面向具身控制，未涉及 VLM 内部推理状态本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or "inverse dynamics" model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror, a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 18 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://wilcoxsonm21.github.io/mirror/

</details>

### 123. [Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree for Inference-time Search Under Sparse Reward](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24185v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24185

**作者：** Binglin Ji、Anindya Sarkar、Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24185v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24185v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree（BSIT）采样器：在稀疏奖励下的推理期搜索中，让子节点生成摆脱对父节点的显式依赖，以扩大采样自由度、提升轨迹与路径空间多样性，从而在不增加函数评估与奖励反馈的情况下加快收敛并扩大分布覆盖；在稀有物种发现、分子生成等任务上验证搜索效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「解耦子节点与父节点的状态转移以换取搜索多样性」及无需逐步奖励反馈的树式推理期搜索，可能为 LVR 的 latent 轨迹生成、探索多样性与动态计算/停止决策提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作属生成式采样领域，迁移性待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree for Inference-time Search Under Sparse Reward

**abstract/A1：** Tree-based samplers offer a compelling alternative for scalable inference-time search, bypassing the per-step reward and gradient dependencies that introduce systematic bias into SMC-style frameworks. Despite this advantage, contemporary tree samplers fail to achieve broad exploration. Their reliance on learned, DDPM-like transitions inherently couples neighbor states in a trajectory, thereby restricting child-parent feature divergence in the tree sampler. Consequently, these samplers suffer from restricted coverage of the target marginal distribution, severely hindering the exploration critical for efficient search under sparse reward. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a simple yet effective Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT) sampler that decouples child node generation from explicit parent dependencies. By expanding the degrees of freedom during child node sampling, BSIT encourages diverse trajectory rollouts and unlocks broader path-space diversity-the exact catalyst needed for efficient exploration. Crucially, we show that BSIT's improved exploration accelerates convergence to the target distribution while achieving broader distributional coverage than samplers that rely on DDPM-like transitions for child-node generation, all without incurring additional function evaluations or reward feedback, thereby providing a highly efficient basis for rare target search. Extensive experiments across diverse search settings, including rare-species discovery and target-aligned molecule generation tasks, demonstrate BSIT's superior search efficiency over the baselines.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 12 figures, Preprint

</details>

### 124. [On Reparameterizing the Score Function](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24188v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24188

**作者：** Mohammad Hossein Amani、Leonardo Bocchieri、Maxime Peyrard、Clément Hongler、Robert West

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24188v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24188v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 History-Reparameterized（HR）策略梯度，把 score function 中冻结的 conditioning history 换成可微或松弛的历史，使下游 token log-prob 的梯度能沿整条生成轨迹回传；并推导 OHR——一种带闭式系数的居中控制变量估计量以最小化梯度方差，在 Gaussian 线性 Markov 模型、稀疏奖励 T-maze 和小规模 TSP 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「历史路径项」贡献分配与方差控制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练的监督信号设计提供线索；值得核查的是它关于随机/弱结构策略收益甚微、以及 embedding 级松弛的方差缩减随 horizon 增长而 straight-through 几乎无收益等结论，是否适用于 latent 推理轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On Reparameterizing the Score Function

**abstract/A1：** Policy gradients for autoregressive sequence models differentiate each token's log-probability while holding the conditioning history fixed. This discards information about how earlier decisions shape later conditional distributions, creating a credit-assignment bottleneck when rewards are sparse. We introduce History-Reparameterized (HR) policy gradients, which replace the frozen prefix in the score function with a differentiable reparameterized or relaxed history, allowing gradients of downstream log-probabilities to propagate backward through the generated trajectory. The resulting history-pathwise term is generally biased when added directly, so we derive Optimal HR (OHR), a centered control-variate estimator with a closed-form coefficient that minimizes the trace of the gradient variance at the population level. The variance reduction is governed by temporal structure in the policy dynamics: random or weakly structured policies provide little benefit, while policies with learned sequential dependencies yield informative history-pathwise corrections. For discrete tokens, the choice of relaxation is crucial: embedding-level relaxation yields substantial variance reduction that grows with horizon, whereas straight-through Gumbel-Softmax yields essentially none in our diagnostics. We validate the method on a Gaussian linear Markov model, a sparse-reward T-maze with a recurrent policy, and an autoregressive Transformer model for small Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) instances.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages

</details>

### 125. [Distillation, Self-Training, and the Fragility of Learned Chemical Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24199v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24199

**作者：** Anagha Aneesh、Sebastian Ibarraran、Frank Hu、Jason Liu、Grant Rotskoff

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24199v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24199v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文训练开放权重小模型做正向反应预测（Resonance）：先用前沿模型的推理轨迹蒸馏，再用自己验证过的输出做自训练，发现准确率可大幅提升甚至超过教师，但推理并不鲁棒，自训练主要只是强化模型本已能得到的答案，模型在受到质疑时容易放弃正确答案。

**相关性简评：** 其「蒸馏轨迹＋自训练是否真的带来推理能力、还是只强化已有答案」的诊断，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督与「latent 内容是否真正被用于答案」的贡献分配与旁路问题提供可核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distillation, Self-Training, and the Fragility of Learned Chemical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Automating synthesis planning for small-molecule drug design requires chemical reasoners that are accurate as well as open to inspection and adaptation, yet frontier language models remain unreliable at predicting reaction outcomes and difficult to deploy, while small open-weight models lack the necessary domain reasoning. We show that frontier supervision can serve as a one-time bootstrap for open models on forward reaction prediction. Our models, Resonance, distill an open-weight teacher's reasoning traces and then learn from their own verified outputs, turning a small base model with near-zero accuracy into a capable reaction predictor, while a stronger student surpasses its teacher through distillation alone. Accuracy, however, does not bring robust reasoning: the small student inherits its teacher's single-pass style, self-training mainly sharpens answers it could already reach, and it readily abandons correct answers under pushback, suggesting that chemical reasoning models should be evaluated on the robustness of their reasoning as well as on the accuracy of their answers.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 126. [Hidden Trajectories Don't Lie: Correcting Corruption Drift for Test-Time Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24220v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24220

**作者：** Amirhossein Sabour、Amir Khasahmadi、Mengliu Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24220v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24220v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究深度网络中间表征的有序序列（hidden trajectories），提出 Drift-TTA：在冻结骨干上加入零初始化低秩适配器，把受损输入的隐藏轨迹对齐到更干净输入的轨迹，含源相关与无源两种变体及在线门控更新，并把轨迹对齐写成高斯观测模型下的 MAP 推断、给出 KL 迁移界。

**相关性简评：** 其按深度对齐中间表征并量化轨迹错位，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据在内部状态中的保留程度、以及 latent 相似度受深度与位置影响提供可供核查的分析线索；但该工作面向纯视觉分类的测试时自适应，不涉及多模态推理或推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hidden Trajectories Don't Lie: Correcting Corruption Drift for Test-Time Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts pretrained models to distribution shifts encountered during deployment. However, most existing methods rely on the weight representations of the final layer or signals derived from the model's output probability distribution. We study hidden trajectories: the ordered sequence of intermediate representations produced across a deep neural network. We observe that clean and corrupted trajectories become more separable as corruption severity increases. We introduce Drift-TTA, which adds zero-initialized low-rank adapters to a frozen backbone and trains them to align corrupted hidden trajectories with those from cleaner inputs. The approach supports two variants: a source-dependent version trained with clean targets, and a source-free setting that learns from corrupted images at different severities. We develop an online TTA approach that freezes the backbone and adapters while updating a scalar gate to control adaptation strength. We further cast trajectory alignment as MAP inference under a Gaussian observation model and derive a KL-based transfer bound characterizing test-time trajectory misalignment in terms of offline residual error, residual dimensionality, and distribution shift between offline and test corruptions. We evaluate Drift-TTA on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C using supervised ViTs and CLIP models. On CIFAR-100-C at severity 5, our source-free online approach improves accuracy over no TTA by 13.3 percentage points with ViT-B/16 and 11.6 percentage points with CLIP ViT-B/16, reaching 74.9% and 47.4%, respectively. Under the same setting, prior TTA baselines yield ECEs of 18.00% for ViT and 14.70% for CLIP, while our approach reduces them to 9.53% and 5.77%, respectively. These results demonstrate that hidden trajectory alignment provides an effective signal for both offline correction and lightweight online test-time adaptation.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 15 figures

</details>

### 127. [Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24229v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24229

**作者：** Lei Jiang、Honghui Bao、Yue Zhou、Zhengyao Gu、Langzhou He、Natalie Parde

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24229v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24229v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LIFT，一种免训练的 RLVR 数据选择器，用 Partial Rollout Context Lift 分数从很短的推理前缀（而非完整 rollout）估计 prompt 的价值，从而以更低生成成本挑选有影响力的训练样本。

**相关性简评：** 可核查线索在于用部分轨迹前缀上的 token 级似然比来估计样本/轨迹价值，可能对 LVR 的贡献分配、latent 状态价值估计与提前停止决策有借鉴；但它面向纯文本 RLVR 与数据筛选，不含视觉状态或生成机制，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for training reasoning models, but its computational cost makes efficient data selection increasingly important. Since training examples contribute unequally to learning, selecting a small, informative subset can offer a more efficient alternative to using the entire data pool. The training-free selection method estimates prompt value with hidden states from complete greedy rollouts. However, in our datasets, $26$--$32\\%$ of these rollouts fail to terminate within the generation budget. We introduce LIFT, a training-free data selector that identifies impactful prompts using only partial reasoning rollouts. At its core, LIFT uses Partial Rollout Context Lift (PRCL), a score inspired by pointwise $\\mathcal{V}$-information that accumulates token-level log-likelihood ratios between a question-conditioned context and a null context with the question removed. This enables prompt scoring from a short rollout prefix rather than a complete trajectory. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, prefixes retaining at least 90\\% and 95\\% of the full-rollout PRCL score, respectively, require only 26\\% and 4.7\\% of the tokens generated by full rollouts. Compared with SHIFT, LIFT reduces selection cost by 3.7--9.1$\\times$ while achieving competitive downstream RLVR performance, with the highest six-benchmark average in three of six settings.

</details>

### 128. [Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24255v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24255

**作者：** Marius-Constantin Dinu、Florian Zeba

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24255v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24255v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为编码智能体的治理型监督层（Cortex）建立形式化分析：在有限格上定义需求闭合，证明在校验规则单调且证据持久时穷尽迭代可收敛到最小不动点，并给出随机模型下的期望完成时间界与若干评估指标。

**相关性简评：** 其「单调校验+持久证据下的最小不动点迭代与收敛步数界」可能为 latent 迭代推理的状态收敛判定与 STOP 条件设计提供可核查的形式化线索，但论文对象是编码智能体治理，与视觉推理的联系需自行迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report

**abstract/A1：** A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. We report retained benchmark observations, including rescoring of existing artifacts; constructed outcomes are excluded. Unequal observation sets and incomplete provenance prevent causal claims about governance or measured long-horizon scaling.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文评测13个通用与金融专用LLM在2001–2024年45,964份10-Q的MD&amp;A文本上的零样本输出，比较五种受控信息视图下的收益排序(RankIC)与下一季度EPS预测，并对照分析师分布与已实现异常收益检验对齐程度。

**相关性简评：** 其「受控信息视图」逐步加入外部证据（基本面排名、分析师摘要）再测量输出与真实结果对齐的做法，可能为核查LVR中视觉/外部证据是否真正被使用与贡献归属提供评价线索，属推测性借鉴，需核查具体协议。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From SEC Filings to Financial Signals: Evaluating LLMs on Stock Market Reactions and Analyst Forecasts

**abstract/A1：** Form 10-Q MD&amp;A sections combine long-form management narrative with accounting and forward-looking information. Benchmarks for financial filings commonly evaluate question answering or numerical reasoning, leaving unclear whether outputs from large language models (LLMs) align with market and analyst outcomes. We evaluate prompted, zero-shot outputs from 13 general-purpose and finance-specialized LLMs on 45,964 Form 10-Q filing events from 2001 to 2024, linking MD&amp;A text to cross-sectional fundamental ranks, pre-filing analyst forecasts, and realized abnormal returns. The evaluation covers return ranking under five controlled information views and next-quarter EPS forecasting under direct and consensus-anchored interfaces. Relative to disclosure alone, adding cross-sectional fundamental ranks raises mean effective-date rank correlation (RankIC) by 0.0089 for effective-event-date returns and 0.0098 for following-day returns, whereas analyst-summary context provides no comparable average gain. Across the four disclosure-containing views, finance-specialized models show an effective-event-date group advantage but no statistically reliable following-day advantage, while general-purpose Qwen models produce the strongest individual return-ranking results. Under the full-information view, direct LLM forecasts average the 43.4th percentile of the analyst distribution and do not consistently beat individual analysts. Consensus anchoring raises the mean inside-range share from 41.1% to 59.5% but increases reported-EPS error.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究检索增强语言模型在推理/检索过程中被用户中途改目标时的行为，指出「答案目标锚定」失败模式，提出 RL 框架 SteerSearch、配套基准 SteerSearch-Bench 以及 Contrastive Context Reward，以在保留上下文的前提下重新设定答案目标。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本搜索 agent 的中途目标重定向、上下文保持与「已检索新证据却仍回答旧问题」的失败诊断，可能为 LVR 中动态目标更新、检索证据是否真正被用于答案、以及推理轨迹的监督分配提供线索，可供核查。

**title/T1：** SteerSearch: Interactive Search Reasoning with Mid-Response Steering

**abstract/A1：** Search-augmented language models increasingly serve as long-horizon research agents, yet most open training methods assume a fixed user goal throughout search. We study mid-response steering, where users redirect a model during ongoing reasoning or retrieval. We identify answer-target anchoring, a failure mode in which fixed-query search agents retrieve evidence for the updated request but still answer an earlier question. We introduce SteerSearch, an RL framework that trains on interactive search trajectories with injected interventions to enable context-preserving target reassignment, and SteerSearch-Bench, a benchmark adapted from multi-hop QA datasets. We also investigate Contrastive Context Reward (CCR), an auxiliary signal for aligning post-intervention reasoning with the updated goal. Without CCR, SteerSearch improves average steering accuracy over Search-R1 from 11.1% to 31.3% on Qwen2.5-3B and from 36.6% to 44.6% on Qwen3-4B, while preserving standard single-query performance. Gains also extend to larger Qwen2.5 models and natural multi-turn conversations.

**title/T1：** CRISP: Progressive Illumination Curriculum for Recurrent Low-Light Video Enhancement with Semantic Priors

**abstract/A1：** Low-light video enhancement requires the recovery of brightness, color, and fine spatial structures while preserving temporal coherence in the presence of noise and motion. Existing methods often struggle to balance these objectives, particularly in severely degraded regions. This paper presents CRISP, a recurrent framework trained using a progressive illumination curriculum. Its two-frame recurrent architecture propagates information across successive frames to exploit temporal context beyond the immediate input pair. During training, supervision progressively transitions from intermediate targets interpolated between the low-light input and the reference to the full reference, gradually increasing the required brightness and color correction. This curriculum stabilizes recurrent training without introducing additional inference cost and yields the largest performance improvement among the components evaluated in the ablation study. To further support structural reconstruction, the framework optionally incorporates frozen DINOv3 semantic features through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN)-style modulation, without fine-tuning the foundation model. Experiments on DID and BVI-RLV demonstrate that CRISP achieves the highest PSNR on DID and the highest SSIM on BVI-RLV among the evaluated methods, while maintaining computational efficiency.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文用互信息衡量概率电路（PC）加入隐状态后所学依赖随隐状态规模的变化，在 HCLT 与 ImageNet32 上追踪单样本对隐状态的偏好强度与状态使用广度，并用早期测量指导 HCLT/HMM 的初始化与树结构选择以提升性能。

**title/T1：** Latent State Utilization in Probabilistic Circuits

**abstract/A1：** Probabilistic circuits (PCs) are generative models that support efficient probabilistic inference. Adding latent states to a PC increases its representational capacity, but yields diminishing gains in likelihood. We use mutual information to examine how the dependence represented by a trained PC changes with latent size. Experiments with Hidden Chow-Liu Trees (HCLTs) on ImageNet32 show that learned dependence grows slowly and remains well below both the latent-state upper bound and estimates of dependence in the data. To understand how learning uses these states, we examine how strongly each sample favors particular latent states and how broadly states are used across the dataset. Tracking these measurements during HCLT training distinguishes rapid early posterior concentration from the more gradual stabilization of sample-dependent state preferences. Early measurements also guide initialization selection in HCLTs and hidden Markov models (HMMs), as well as tree selection in HCLTs. The resulting choices improve the ultimate performance across the tested latent sizes, providing a practical benefit from our study of latent-state utilization.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 LLM-as-a-Judge 的系统性偏差，提出免训练的「偏差感知提示」和「自我去偏」（让评判模型事后审查初始判断是否受偏差影响）两种策略，并新增权威、自信、格式三类偏差基准，在三个前沿模型、七类偏差上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其免训练的事后自我审查循环可能为推理期自验证、信念修正与停止决策提供可核查线索，同时评判偏差如何扭曲对 latent 推理增益的评价也值得留意。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Judge Can Debias Itself: Awareness and Self-Debiasing for Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge

**abstract/A1：** LLM-as-a-Judge systems are increasingly employed for automated evaluation, yet remain susceptible to systematic biases that undermine their reliability. We demonstrate that the judge can effectively debias itself without additional training. We propose two lightweight strategies: bias-aware prompting, which explicitly alerts the judge to potential target biases prior to evaluation, and self-debiasing, in which the judge critiques the initial judgment for bias influence. To broaden the evaluation scope, we introduce three novel benchmarks--authority bias (fabricated citations), confidence bias (assertive phrasing), and formatting bias (structured presentation)--and evaluate across seven bias types in total. Across three frontier models, self-debiasing improves performance in 20 out of 21 model-bias combinations with gains up to 15 percentage points, while bias-aware prompting also yields consistent improvements. The recent fine-tuned external critic, however, does not generalize as reliably to the newly-introduced bias types (degradation observed in 5 out of 9 cases). Our findings demonstrate that prompting a judge to reason about bias, either preemptively or retrospectively, is a robust and generalizable approach for enhancing evaluation integrity.

</details>

### 134. [Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24321v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24321

**作者：** Aakriti、Manoj Cherukumalli、Prathamesh Patil、Leonidas Tsepenekas、Amit Varshney、Penghang Liu、Elizabeth Fons、Vamsi Potluru

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24321v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24321v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Morpheus-2.0 编码器式时间序列基础模型，在统一变量-时间网格上用双轴注意力在同一层并行建模变量间与时间内关系，逐层学习门控权重并配合轴感知旋转编码；训练时采样预测长度，使单套权重覆盖多个 horizon，多尺度版本同时处理多种时间分辨率，在 GIFT-Eval 上取得较好相对 MASE 与 CRPS。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐层门控的双轴注意力 + 轴感知位置编码 + 训练期采样预测长度」可能为 LVR 的多轴 latent 状态更新、位置/坐标结构保留与长度泛化设计提供可供核查的方法线索，但该迁移目前仅为推测，需先确认机制细节与可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention

**abstract/A1：** A universal forecaster is trained once and applied everywhere, so it must serve tasks whose schemas, forecast horizons, and temporal resolutions all differ. The number of targets and covariates changes from dataset to dataset, horizons vary by orders of magnitude, and sampling rates range from seconds to years. Existing time-series foundation models address these only in part, since they isolate each series or visit the two grid relations in separate blocks, and they fix the horizon and resolution before training begins. We introduce Morpheus-2.0, a compact encoder-only foundation model that represents targets and covariates on a single variable-time grid. Its dual-axis attention runs both relations side by side in every layer, one across variables at a timestep and one across time within a variable; a learned gate weights the two per layer, and an axis-aware rotary encoding preserves both grid coordinates. The forecast length is sampled during training, so one set of weights spans short to long horizons at no additional inference cost. Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale extends the model to several temporal resolutions at once, weighting them according to the series being forecast. Across GIFT-Eval, which spans several domains and frequencies, the two models give complementary operating points: Morpheus-2.0 attains 0.685 relative MASE with 81M parameters, while the larger Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale attains 0.646 relative MASE and 0.455 relative CRPS, the lowest of any published system on both metrics.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Aakriti and Manoj Cherukumalli contributed equally

</details>

### 135. [Screening LLM Judges Without Ground Truth: A Preliminary Evaluation of an AI Dental Hygiene Coach](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24335v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出一个分阶段流水线，在专家评审前筛选候选 LLM judge 与学生模型，每阶段使用显式判定规则（输出审计、与托管 judge 的一致性、偏差检查、决策稳健性），并在 AI 口腔卫生教练案例上演示；本地 judge 与托管 judge 在部分指标上一致性不可区分，且流水线暴露了原始分数掩盖的截断输出与幻觉标记问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「无真值条件下多阶段筛选＋偏差与稳健性判定规则」的评判流程，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理输出在缺乏标注时的自动评判与证据核验提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Screening LLM Judges Without Ground Truth: A Preliminary Evaluation of an AI Dental Hygiene Coach

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating a fine-tuned coaching model with expert graders is slow and expensive, and an LLM judge cannot be trusted without ground truth. We present a staged pipeline that screens candidate LLM judges and student models before expert review, using explicit decision rules at each stage: judge output audit, similarity with hosted judges, bias checks, and decision robustness. We demonstrate it on an AI dental hygiene coach. The case study uses synthetic, clinically unvalidated training and reference data to demonstrate the operation of the pipeline, rather than to establish the clinical performance of the resulting models. Two fine-tuned small language models (Granite-4.1-8B and Qwen3-8B), each trained at three data sizes, were scored on seven metrics by five judges (three local, two hosted). Two local judges, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, were not distinguishable from the agreement between the hosted judges on six of seven metrics by rank correlation, and Qwen3.8-27B was the most similar to the hosted judges overall. No judge met our criterion for favoring its own model family or training-data source. The student comparison did not separate the two models on any metric under the pipeline's rule, so the choice of Granite-4.1-8B, which led in 29 of 35 judge-by-metric cells, is a lean that depends partly on truncated Qwen3-8B outputs. The pipeline also surfaced problems that raw scores hid, including the truncated outputs and hallucination flags from one hosted judge that no other judge corroborated. No dental hygiene expert has graded these responses, so the findings are preliminary and the pipeline's final stage, anchoring to expert judgement, is proposed but not performed.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables

</details>

### 136. [DKnown-Jev: Fine-Tuning and Evaluation of a JEV-Style Model for Tasks Involving Normative Knowledge](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24358v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24358

**作者：** Qi Li、Jianjun Xu、Pingtao Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24358v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24358v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作开发 DKnown-Jev，基于 Qwen3.5-2B 与 3.8-27B 微调，将候选段落按「可回答问题」与否分为 Answer Evidence 与 Non-answer Evidence 两类，并在同一 1,120 条人工验证测试集上比较五种配置的准确率与 macro-F1。

**相关性简评：** 其「结合问题条件、元数据与段落内容做候选证据可用性打分」的监督式筛选思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与证据贡献判定提供方法线索，但该工作为纯文本领域适配、不含 latent 状态或推理期状态生成，迁移可行性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DKnown-Jev: Fine-Tuning and Evaluation of a JEV-Style Model for Tasks Involving Normative Knowledge

**abstract/A1：** Tasks involving normative knowledge include concept interpretation, eligibility determination, procedure explanation, material requirements, and service-outcome assessment, all of which require rules and facts published, maintained, or recorded by authorized entities. Whether a candidate paragraph can answer a question therefore depends on applicability and answer completeness as well as topical relevance. We develop DKnown-Jev to classify the normative usability of candidate paragraphs into two classes. The 2B and 27B configurations are fine-tuned directly from the native Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.8-27B base models, respectively. The models combine question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, adopt the classes Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE), and undergo domain adaptation using human-verified training data. Five configurations are evaluated on the same test set of 1,120 human-verified examples. DKnown-Jev 27B trained for one epoch achieves the highest accuracy of 98.75% and macro-F1 of 98.60%, exceeding Jev by 6.07 and 6.76 percentage points, respectively. DKnown-Jev 2B trained for one epoch achieves 92.86% accuracy and 92.18% macro-F1, the best aggregate results among the tested 2B configurations. Its gains over Jev are 0.18 and 0.33 percentage points on this test set, corresponding to only two additional correct predictions, which is insufficient to establish a stable advantage. The 27B one-epoch, 27B two-epoch, and 2B one-epoch configurations all exceed Jev on both metrics on this test set. Class-level analysis shows that the 27B two-epoch configuration has the highest AE recall, while the 27B one-epoch configuration has the highest NE recall. This study provides practical and empirical evidence for developing and applying candidate-scoring models to tasks involving normative knowledge.

</details>

### 137. [WAQS: Weight Absorption for Quadratic Probing and Affine Steering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24367v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24367

**作者：** Ding Zhu、Mohammad Mahdi Khalili

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24367v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24367v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WAQS：用二次探针刻画概念，其梯度给出依赖激活的仿射引导方向，并证明该干预可离线精确折叠进相邻线性层，从而在不增加推理开销的前提下获得状态相关的 steering；在高维表示上用低秩参数化，并在真实性、拒答、谄媚任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理主线没有直接联系，但「二次探针→仿射干预→权重吸收」及低秩参数化、Mahalanobis 解释，可能为从内部状态读取概念方向、以近乎零成本自适应调制隐藏状态提供方法线索，可供核查其能否迁移到 latent 状态的证据读取与干预。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WAQS: Weight Absorption for Quadratic Probing and Affine Steering

**abstract/A1：** Activation steering provides a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for controlling large language model behavior. Existing methods, however, often face a trade-off between efficiency and expressiveness: fixed steering vectors incur negligible inference overhead but cannot adapt to the current model input, whereas input-dependent nonlinear interventions provide greater flexibility at additional runtime cost. We introduce \\textbf{WAQS} (\\textbf{W}eight \\textbf{A}bsorption for \\textbf{Q}uadratic probing and affine \\textbf{S}teering), a framework that obtains state-dependent steering, without additional inference-time computation. WAQS models a concept with a quadratic probe, whose gradient yields an affine, activation-dependent steering direction. We show that this affine intervention can be folded exactly into adjacent linear transformations through an offline weight update. Moreover, we prove that quadratic functions form the maximal class of smooth concept scores whose gradient-based interventions are affine and therefore exactly absorbable into linear layers. Under a Gaussian representation model, our formulation admits an interpretation as the difference of class-conditional Mahalanobis pulls and naturally generalizes linear discriminant and difference-in-means steering. To scale to high-dimensional representations, we introduce a low-rank parameterization of the quadratic term. Across truthfulness, refusal, and sycophancy steering tasks, quadratic steering matches or improves upon constant linear steering while preserving model utility, with the absorbed implementation introducing no additional inference-time operations. Our results suggest that quadratic probes provide a practical middle ground between static linear steering and computationally expensive dynamic nonlinear interventions.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages

</details>

### 138. [Learning from the Right Regions: Class-Conditioned Explanation Guidance for Medical Imaging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24381v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24381

**作者：** Zubair Faruqui、Rahul Dubey

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24381v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24381v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出类条件解释引导学习框架：为每个阳性类别单独构造 Grad-CAM 解释，惩罚落在该类标注区域之外的证据，从而在多标签医学影像上提升证据与标注区域的对齐，且分类性能变化不大。

**相关性简评：** 其按类别监督「解释证据集中在何处」的思路，可能为 LVR 中答案是否使用正确视觉证据、如何做视觉证据筛选与贡献分配监督提供线索，有待核查能否迁移到 latent 推理状态；该文本身不做 latent 推理或语言模型推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning from the Right Regions: Class-Conditioned Explanation Guidance for Medical Imaging

**abstract/A1：** Deep neural networks can achieve strong predictive performance in medical imaging while relying on regions unrelated to the predicted finding. Explanation-guided learning can address this problem, but multi-label classification introduces a key challenge: multiple abnormalities may coexist in an image, requiring each prediction to align with its corresponding spatial evidence. We propose a class-conditioned explanation-guided learning framework that constructs a separate explanation for each positive class and penalizes evidence outside its class-specific annotated regions. We instantiate the framework using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) and evaluate it on 14 abnormalities using EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, and Swin-B. Explanation guidance substantially improves annotation alignment across all architectures: All-Saliency Precision increases from 0.140 to 0.625, 0.052 to 0.551, 0.060 to 0.403, and 0.095 to 0.570, respectively. These improvements are accompanied by smaller, architecture-dependent changes in classification performance. Our results show that class-conditioned explanation guidance can substantially improve where multi-label classifiers concentrate their explanatory evidence while largely preserving predictive performance.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to the Explainable and Trustworthy AI for Clinical Decision Support Systems Workshop, IEEE BIBM 2026

</details>

### 139. [IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24383v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24383

**作者：** Jie Mao、Pingchen Lu、Zikun Qu、Jiahang Sun、Xiangyi Wang、Zhiwei Shang、Zhiyong Wang、Guojun Xiong、Zhongxiang Dai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24383v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24383v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 IF-MAP：对多智能体系统中每个 agent 施加受控的语义提示扰动，在低维提示嵌入子空间拟合正则化局部响应模型，以响应范数作为优先级分数，用于指导提示优化与模型升级的资源分配，并在六个多智能体工作流上验证端到端增益与 token 节省。

**相关性简评：** 影响函数式的黑盒扰动归因可用于定位对端到端损失贡献大的组件，可能为 LVR 的贡献分配与监督（判断哪些 latent 步骤或模块关键）提供借鉴线索，可供核查其局部响应模型是否适用于连续 latent 状态而非离散提示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Improving every agent in an LLM-based multi-agent system can be prohibitively costly, making it important to identify which agent should be prioritized to achieve the greatest system-level gain with limited resources. Failure attribution can inform this decision, but an agent's responsibility for failures does not directly reveal the system-level gains achievable by improving it. We therefore introduce IF-MAP, an influence-function-inspired method for identifying agents with high potential for system-level improvement. For each agent, IF-MAP measures end-to-end loss changes under controlled semantic prompt perturbations, fits a regularized local response model in a low-dimensional prompt-embedding subspace, and uses the estimated response norm as a priority score. This black-box procedure requires no access to model parameters or gradients and produces agent priorities that can guide subsequent improvement effort. We evaluate IF-MAP across six multi-agent workflows spanning code generation, question answering, and mathematical reasoning, using the same priorities for prompt optimization and model upgrades. Optimizing the selected agents' prompts achieves a macro-average gain of 3.81 percentage points, compared with 1.85 for uniform agent selection. Across five target models, upgrading the selected agents yields macro-average gains of 7.62-16.42 percentage points, compared with 3.81-8.62 for uniform agent selection. Despite its probing overhead, IF-MAP reduces Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-V3.2 token use by 74.2% and 35.2%, respectively, relative to optimizing every agent, and reduces target-model tokens by 63.6-64.9% relative to upgrading every agent. These results support the use of IF-MAP to identify promising agents and direct improvement effort toward greater end-to-end performance gains.

</details>

### 140. [MSCR: Jointly Balancing Utilization Across Modalities and Discovering Synergistic Information](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24395v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24395

**作者：** Xinyu Chen、Liangjian Wen、Jiang Duan、Dongkai Wang、Yong Dai、Jiayu Bai、Jianzhuang Liu、Zhen Tian、Guoping Qiu、Zhao Kan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24395v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24395v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对多模态学习中模态不平衡削弱协同信息的问题，提出融合方法 MSCR，用「抗主导」目标与「协同」目标配合自适应门控，联合促进模态均衡利用与协同信息发现，在五个基准上优于 MCR。

**相关性简评：** 其抑制单一模态过度影响的训练正则、以及以融合预测优于单模态参照来度量协同增益（并用 InterSHAP 归因）的思路，可能可供核查 VLM 推理中文本先验主导与视觉旁路问题，以及视觉证据贡献的监督与评价设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MSCR: Jointly Balancing Utilization Across Modalities and Discovering Synergistic Information

**abstract/A1：** In multimodal learning, modality imbalance often lets one modality dominate optimization and keeps the model from fully exploiting cross-modal interactions. Balance-oriented methods such as the Multimodal Competition Regularizer (MCR) perform well by alleviating this imbalance during training. These dynamic balancing methods, however, mainly adjust modality contributions and do not consider how imbalance affects the formation of synergistic information during fusion. Synergy is a major source of multimodal advantage, because it is predictive gain that cannot be recovered from unimodal evidence alone. We propose the Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer (MSCR), a fusion method that jointly promotes balanced modality utilization and the discovery of synergistic information. MSCR has two complementary objectives. An anti-dominance objective suppresses excessive unimodal influence and leaves room for synergistic information, and a synergy objective encourages the fused predictor to outperform a non-synergistic unimodal reference. An adaptive gate further concentrates the regularization on samples that need stronger collaborative modeling. Experiments on five benchmarks show that MSCR consistently improves performance over MCR and strengthens synergistic capability. It raises conditional recovery, the accuracy of the fused prediction on samples that the unimodal predictors misclassify, as well as the share of the model's output that InterSHAP attributes to cross-modal interactions. Its gain in conditional recovery persists when the fusion module is Transformer-based. Code is available at https://github.com/chenxinyu991-collab/MSCR.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>
