### 141. [Transformers as Adaptive Kernel Learners across Tasks for In-Context Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24441v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24441

**作者：** Zhaiming Shen、Alexander Cloninger、Rongjie Lai、Wenjing Liao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.NA、math.ST

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24441v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24441v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作从理论上研究 in-context learning，论证 transformer 的注意力机制可充当自适应各向异性核学习器：针对低秩线性与多指标非线性回归，用宽而浅的 transformer 构造性地实现 oracle 核估计器，并据此分析泛化误差。

**相关性简评：** 「注意力即自适应核」这一视角可能为分析 LVR 中 latent 相似度、注意力结构与上下文组合对表示的影响提供理论工具，但其纯文本回归设定与多模态推理差距较大，线索可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Transformers as Adaptive Kernel Learners across Tasks for In-Context Learning

**abstract/A1：** Transformers have emerged as a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, with in-context learning (ICL) enabling models to adapt to new tasks by conditioning on prompts, without any parameter updates. To understand the attention mechanism in transformer blocks, a growing line of theoretical work interprets ICL through the lens of classical statistical estimators. Recent works have established a connection between the attention mechanism and kernel methods, while the kernel function is usually assumed to be fixed. In practice, the query and key matrices in the attention mechanism are trained, which allows the attention mechanism to serve as an adaptive kernel method. In this work, we demonstrate that transformers can act as adaptive anisotropic kernel learners. Specifically, we study ICL for low-rank linear and multi-index nonlinear regressions, and conduct numerical simulations to show that the learned attention scores closely resemble the oracle kernels for these function classes. We then develop a general framework to analyze the generalization error of ICL by connecting transformers to the oracle kernel estimator for each function class. Our theory gives an explicit and constructive implementation of the oracle kernel estimators for these function classes using a wide and shallow transformer architecture, illustrating how the prediction is carried out by the interaction between the query token and the context tokens. Our work complements existing studies by providing numerical and theoretical evidence of how the attention mechanism adapts to anisotropic kernels in both linear and nonlinear settings.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HumanSkill-4D，一个无需训练、跨 avatar 共享 MLLM 与几何算子的框架：用语义记忆把身体部位与衣物类别绑定到持久高斯区域，再由 MLLM 组合算子程序，按语言查询在空间和时间上选出可动画高斯 avatar 的对应部位或动作区间，并给出三个标注基准。

**相关性简评：** 「MLLM 组合可核查算子程序 + 分区语义记忆」形成显式、可追溯的中间决策与证据筛选路径，可能作为 LVR 中监督信号、贡献分配与显式-隐式推理对照的可核查线索；但对象是 4D avatar 分割，与视觉 latent 推理联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time

**abstract/A1：** We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 14 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://jjunsss.github.io/HumanSkill-4D/

</details>

### 143. [Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24453v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Hippo，一种不更新模型参数的 LLM agent 记忆框架：通过比较同一任务的多条尝试提取可复用决策，并用显式适用条件合并重叠、消解冲突，从而修订既有记忆。

**相关性简评：** 其「比较多次尝试以区分推理缺陷与执行失误」的思路，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练的贡献分配与经验监督提供借鉴线索；但论文面向文本 agent 的长期记忆，与视觉 latent 推理状态的联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay

**abstract/A1：** Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web show performance gains in all three settings and substantially fewer retained experiences than the accumulation baseline. The gains extend across the evaluated base models of varying capabilities, indicating that memory-based adaptation remains useful even for highly capable models.

</details>

### 144. [MELD: Recursive Self-Improvement via Hierarchical Coordination for Multi-Agent Scientific Discovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24454v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24454

**作者：** Sizhe Tang、Zuyuan Zhang、Zeyu Fang、Tian Lan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24454v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24454v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MELD 是面向多智能体科学发现的分层 test-time training 框架：团队级 Coordinator 在共享派生树上生成搜索分支组合与研究指令，个体 Scientist 提出假设与执行方案，两级策略以交替 GRPO 和共享的 best-of-budget 目标递归协同改进，并在 22 个 MLGym/MLE-bench 任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其分层策略的交替更新、分支组合的预算分配与 regret 分析，可能为 latent 推理中的贡献分配、动态计算预算与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MELD: Recursive Self-Improvement via Hierarchical Coordination for Multi-Agent Scientific Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent scientific discovery with large language models raises a coupled learning problem: research assignments determine both which experiments are pursued and the experiences from which agents adapt. We introduce MELD, a unified hierarchical test-time training framework that jointly adapts a team-level Coordinator policy and agent-level individual Scientist policies within a single discovery process. The Coordinator generates a joint portfolio of search branches and research directives over a shared derivation tree, while Scientists develop hypotheses and execution plans implemented by a shared frozen Executor. Both levels receive alternating GRPO-style parameter updates under a shared smooth best-of-budget objective, allowing team organization and individual research behavior to co-evolve in a recursive self-improvement loop. Our analysis establishes objective alignment for the hierarchy, characterizes conditions for coordination gains over independent parallel discovery and the first-order benefit of private adaptation, and derives a finite-budget regret bound for adapted models. On 22 MLGym and MLE-bench tasks, MELD is best on 20 of them and achieves the highest aggregate normalized scores on MLGym, using a 4B backbone for coordination and research. Most baselines use proprietary Scientists, and all systems share one frozen Executor.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把反向靶点垂钓重构成生成式检索任务 GenFish：用残差向量量化把冻结蛋白语言模型特征转为共享语义标识符，并以分子指纹为条件自回归生成码序列、按标识符似然排序蛋白，同时提出蛋白组规模基准 ProTargetBench 并分析未记录配对作为负样本带来的假阴性竞争问题。

**相关性简评：** 把冻结编码器特征经 RVQ 离散成语义 ID、再自回归生成码序列并以标识符似然排序的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的离散化、生成式状态更新与候选打分提供可核查线索；但属远领域方法，迁移方式需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Generative Retrieval for Reverse Target Fishing with a Proteome-Scale Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Reverse target fishing identifies protein targets for a query molecule and is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Discriminative approaches adapted from virtual screening face sparse, long-tailed associations and missing-not-at-random measurements: treating unrecorded pairs as negatives can suppress genuine targets. We reformulate the task as generative retrieval and introduce GenFish. Residual vector quantization converts frozen protein language model features into shared semantic identifiers. Given a molecular fingerprint, GenFish autoregressively models codes conditioned on the query and preceding code, ranking proteins by identifier likelihood without explicitly labeling unrecorded pairs as negatives. We introduce ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for reverse target fishing to jointly support measured-panel discrimination and full-catalogue recovery of experimentally recorded positives. Covering 20,431 UniProt-reviewed human proteins, it integrates curated bioactivity evidence and distinguishes experimental inactivity from unmeasured associations. On 198 held-out molecules, GenFish achieves higher mean performance across all three full-catalogue retrieval metrics than four discriminative neural baselines and three non-neural baselines, including ligand-based methods. A controlled positive-hiding experiment shows that targeted removal of false-negative competition improves contrastive retrieval beyond matched random masking; GenFish remains stronger under the same incomplete supervision. Pfam alignment indicates that the semantic identifiers capture biologically meaningful relationships among proteins. These results establish generative retrieval as a principled paradigm for reverse target fishing under incomplete bioactivity records.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RiSE，冻结预训练 SVD 主成分、仅适配残差子空间，并按伪造类型训练多个独立专家，实现文本中心图像伪造定位的跨域泛化；推理时用潜空间扰动置信度（LPC）在单次前向中选择最可信专家。

**相关性简评：** 其「低秩特征坍缩」诊断与残差子空间适配可供核查 LVR 中视觉信息坍缩与冻结先验保留问题；LPC 借潜空间扰动在单次前向估计置信度，或可启发推理期停止决策与证据筛选，但属跨任务推测，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RiSE: Residual Subspace Expert for Generalizable Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization

**abstract/A1：** As AI-assisted image editing becomes increasingly prevalent, Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization (TFL) is essential for protecting trust in financial and legal records. However, we observe that existing TFL detectors predominantly rely on Full-Parameter Fine-Tuning (FPFT) and fail to generalize to unseen forgery types because FPFT can induce low-rank feature collapse and overfit training artifacts. Meanwhile, prior detectors capture diverse forgery traces with a single unified representation, making subtle traces entangled and difficult to learn. To address these challenges, we propose RiSE, a Residual Subspace Expert model that preserves pre-trained priors by freezing principal SVD components and adapting only the residual subspaces with a ViT-only segmentor to avoid feature collapse. RiSE introduces forgery-aware residual experts, where each expert is trained independently on a training subset with a particular forgery type, and we show that cross-domain localization performance improves consistently as more experts are added. At inference, we introduce Latent Perturbation Confidence (LPC), which selects the most confident expert by analytically computing the latent-perturbed output. LPC enables efficient confidence estimation with a single forward pass, avoiding repeated forward passes on perturbed samples and improving expert selection. By training on synthetic forgery data, RiSE with 1 expert outperforms prior methods on real-world forgery images by 20.4% while reducing training steps by 10 times. Scaling the number of experts to 9 yields a 35.8% gain. RiSE remains effective with DCT feature, even when the majority of the parameters is frozen with RGB-only pretraining. Code: https://github.com/KahimWong/RiSE.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「坐标可寻址、编码后可反复查询而无需重处理历史」的压缩状态与读写几何，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的读取接口、信息保留程度与坍缩诊断提供线索；将误差拆为功能几何近似与记忆失配的思路或可类比 latent 内容保真度分析，但属远领域迁移，需人工核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Irregular time series require models to answer temporal queries at arbitrary coordinates, yet existing approaches typically retain observation-dependent representations that must be repeatedly resolved for each query. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), a functional-memory attention operator that compiles an irregular history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state. Instead of storing observation-indexed tokens or latent trajectories, HiPPO-FM writes observations into a fixed-rank functional space and performs direct coordinate evaluation through matched functional geometry. Kernel-smoothed HiPPO coordinates and Gram-based readout define a shared write/read mechanism, while observed-support self-attention enables content-dependent representations before compression. We characterize the induced finite-dimensional query space and derive an error decomposition separating functional geometry approximation from learned-memory mismatch. Across continuous-coordinate reconstruction, irregular representation learning, real-world extrapolation, and event-sequence prediction, HiPPO-FM consistently improves strong irregular time-series baselines, achieving strong reconstruction accuracy on Spiral, competitive performance across 20 UEA datasets, improved real-world extrapolation, and superior results on several irregular event benchmarks. After encoding, the compact functional state can be reused across different query sets without reprocessing the observation history.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 M²Net，用多尺度掩码注意力按不同时间分辨率动态生成尺度自适应空间掩码，并用动量更新的原型库做「原型残差学习」，把全局共性模式从节点表示中减去，以提升时空预测。

**相关性简评：** 其原型库加残差分解可视为一种分离共享模式与个体偏差的表示学习，或可供核查能否用于区分推理状态中的共性视觉内容与样本特异信息；多尺度掩码注意力对尺度依赖结构的建模，也可能对应 latent 状态中尺度/位置相关的注意力结构。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** $M^2Net$: Unifying Scale-Specific Structures and Prototype Decomposition for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Spatial-temporal forecasting is pivotal for intelligent urban management yet remains challenging due to the intricate coupling of spatial dynamics and temporal non-stationarity. Existing approaches, while effective, often overlook two fundamental characteristics of real-world data: (1) Granularity-dependence, where dominant spatial correlations shift significantly across different time scales, and (2) Signal entanglement, where global common patterns are inextricably mixed with node-specific disturbances. In this paper, we propose a novel framework named $M^2Net$ (Multi-Scale Masked attention and Prototype network) to unify scale-specific structural learning and semantic decomposition. First, to capture the evolution of spatial dependencies, we introduce a Multi-Scale Masked attention mechanism. By downsampling temporal features into multiple resolutions, we dynamically generate scale-adaptive spatial masks, allowing the model to distinguish between micro-scale physical neighbors and macro-scale functional correlations. Second, to disentangle unique variations from shared trends, we propose a Prototype Residual Learning module. It retrieves global common patterns from a momentum-updated prototype bank and subtracts them from node representations, explicitly forcing the network to model the residual unique deviations. By integrating these two orthogonal views, i.e., structural multiscaling and semantic decomposition, our approach effectively isolates valid spatial-temporal signals from noise. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that $M^2Net$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on extensive empirical verifications.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文比较稀疏 MLP 神经元特征与 transcoder 特征，定义权重与单个 MLP 神经元强对齐的「neuron features」，在 13 个开源 transcoder 中统计其占比，发现晚期层大量 transcoder 特征实质上等同于神经元，并对非神经元结构提出归因需求。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Comparing Sparsified MLPs and Transcoders: Many Transcoder Features Are Neurons in Disguise

**abstract/A1：** MLP neurons in transformer language models are widely understood to be polysemantic, motivating transcoders - sparse, learned approximations of MLP layers - as interpretable replacement models for mechanistic analysis. However, recent work shows that MLP neurons can be used to recover sparse, interpretable circuits (Arora et al. 2026, Ye et al. 2025), raising the question of whether transcoders are necessary for circuit analysis. We define neuron features as transcoder features whose weights are strongly aligned with individual MLP neurons, and show that they account for a substantial fraction of active features in late layers across 13 open-source transcoders. Only neuron features have a stable correspondence with something in the underlying MLP: other features vary more between training runs, do not match the MLP's Jacobian, and change less significantly from their random initialization. Our findings reframe MLP neurons as a stronger basis for interpretability than commonly assumed, and call for better methods of attributing the non-neuron structure that is used by the model.

**title/T1：** Contrastive Hypergraph Source-free Domain Adaptive Object Detection in Adverse Weather Conditions--Extended Version

**abstract/A1：** Adverse weather conditions such as fog, rain, snow, and low illumination introduce structured visibility degradations that severely impair object detectors trained on clear-weather data. When source data are inaccessible due to privacy or trans- mission constraints, source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) becomes necessary. However, existing SFDA methods based on pairwise contrastive learning struggle to capture high-order semantics and often suffer from agreement collapse under severe corruption. We propose REUNION, a hypergraph-guided SFDA framework for object detection in adverse weather conditions. REUNION constructs a contrastive hypergraph over target-domain object proposals, encoding high-order relations through intra-image context, weather-aware grouping, prototype-based semantic anchors, and uncertainty-aware connections between reliable and low-confidence instances. To effectively exploit these structured relations, we introduce a group-wise Hyper-InfoNCE objective that optimizes representations at the hyperedge level, enabling semantic information to propagate from confident proposals to corrupted or low-contrast instances. Experiments with diverse benchmarks demonstrate that REUNION effectively mitigates domain shifts and achieves state-of-the-art performance in SFDA settings.

### 151. [Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24534v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24534

**作者：** Kevin Chen、Yu-Wei Zhan、Haoran Liang、Sen Cui、Changshui Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24534v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24534v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HWM 框架，把世界模型主干 latent 表示到学到的相空间（广义坐标与动量）中，用耗散哈密顿动力学递推未来状态并经可学习逆接口映回原 latent，配合多步转移监督，在多个具身世界模型上验证长时程预测稳定性。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构化 latent 状态演化＋多步转移监督」是可核查的方法线索：或可迁移到 LVR 的 latent 推理状态更新与轨迹监督，缓解递归滚动中的表示漂移，但其与语言侧推理状态是否同构仍需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models

**abstract/A1：** Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

</details>

### 152. [From Score to Diagnosis: Search-Independent Post-Diagnosis for Symbolic Regression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24535v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24535

**作者：** Qian Li、Yuxiao Hu、Juncheng Liu、Yanhao Jia、Yuntian Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24535v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24535v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PostDiag——一种与搜索过程解耦、可跨符号回归求解器共享的诊断反馈机制：用 patch 级特征刻画局部行为，量化骨架的表达力风险与稳定性风险，在风险平面上决定保留、修复、简化或重写，并由 LLM 编辑器在 patch 级证据引导下执行干预后回传原求解器。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部证据定位 + 风险判定 → 保留/修复/简化/重写」的诊断决策可能与 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配、证据筛选及 STOP/修订决策有方法同构性，可供核查，但属符号回归领域，能否迁移尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Score to Diagnosis: Search-Independent Post-Diagnosis for Symbolic Regression

**abstract/A1：** Symbolic regression (SR) solvers employ diverse search mechanisms, yet most rely on the same low-information scalar fitness. Such scores provide little guidance on why a skeleton fails or how it should be revised. Recent methods develop new methods to address this bottleneck. Their enhanced feedback mechanisms are tightly coupled to their search processes and are difficult to reuse across diverse SR solvers. Instead, we ask whether a shared feedback mechanism can further improve diverse solvers facing the same bottleneck. To this end, we propose PostDiag, a search-independent feedback mechanism, which can be shared to different SR solvers. PostDiag introduces Patch-wise Feature Profiling (PFP) to capture local behavior through patch-wise features of level, trend, and roughness. Based on PFP, PostDiag quantifies Skeleton Expressiveness Risk by comparing the fitted candidate with the observations, and Skeleton Stability Risk by measuring variability of behavior after bootstrap refitting. The Diagnostic Risk Plane (DRP) combines two risks to determine whether a skeleton should be preserved, repaired, simplified, or rewritten, while the patch-wise discrepancies provide evidence for the intervention. An LLM editor then performs the diagnosis-guided intervention, and the validated revision is returned to the original solver through a lightweight adapter. Experiments across multiple LLM-based and GP-based SR solvers show that PostDiag consistently improves accuracy and accelerates convergence.

</details>

### 153. [Representations Have Trajectories: Characterizing Temporal Representation Dynamics in Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24571v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24571

**作者：** Shivaprasad B. Gowda、Sparsh Mittal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24571v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24571v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对训练全过程做大规模实证追踪，刻画表示几何随优化的演化，归纳出持续高秩、坍缩-恢复与持续低秩三类轨迹，并识别出表示坍缩到秩一且无法恢复的「破坏性表示坍缩」病理状态。

**相关性简评：** 其按秩刻画表示几何轨迹、区分「坍缩-恢复」与不可逆坍缩的度量线索，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态是否发生信息坍缩、容量损失与是否随训练/推理步长恢复，但研究对象是通用网络的训练动态，与 VLM 推理及 latent 状态生成的对应关系需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Representations Have Trajectories: Characterizing Temporal Representation Dynamics in Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Recent work has shown that deep neural networks exhibit an implicit low-rank simplicity bias. In this paper, we investigate the questions that naturally arise from this observation. What are the temporal consequences of low-rank simplicity bias during optimization? How does representation geometry evolve throughout optimization rather than only at convergence? Do different neural architectures exhibit distinct geometric optimization behaviors? To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale empirical study tracking representational geometry throughout training. We find that neural networks follow three recurring geometric trajectories: persistent high-rank, collapse-and-recovery, and persistent low-rank. We further identify Destructive Representation Collapse (DRC) as a pathological regime in which representations collapse to rank-one and fail to recover, leading to a sustained loss of representational capacity. While collapse-and-recovery is consistently associated with successful optimization in controlled settings, experiments on real-world models show that the relationship between geometric trajectories and optimization outcomes is configuration dependent. Overall, our findings suggest that representation geometry evolves dynamically during training and provide a new perspective on how deep neural networks learn.

</details>

### 154. [DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24585v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24585

**作者：** Yibo Yang、Zerui Huang、Haomiao Yang、Zixia Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24585v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24585v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 DeliMF，用时间 Transformer 编码 ICU 结构化生命体征等时序、用临床文本编码器编码带时间戳的报告，并通过 gated cross-attention 融合，做入院首日谵妄预测，在 MIMIC-IV 队列上优于纯结构化基线。

**相关性简评：** 其按样本学习的门控可让文本缺失时退化为单模态结构分支，这一「模态贡献门控/旁路」设计可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用、视觉旁路的检测与抑制提供可核查的架构线索，但任务本身属临床预测应用，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Delirium affects a large fraction of intensive care unit (ICU) patients and foreshadows longer stays, lasting cognitive decline, and higher mortality. Flagging the patients who will become delirious within the first day of admission would give clinicians a window to intervene. Yet state-of-the-art predictors rely only on the structured electronic health record (EHR) of vital signs, laboratory values, and medications, while overlooking the free-text clinical notes written in the same window, which carry information the numbers cannot encode. To this end, we present DeliMF, a multimodal framework that fuses the structured time series with clinical text. It encodes the structured signals with a temporal Transformer and the time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder, and fuses the two through a gated cross-attention module. The gate learns a per-patient weight on the text; when a patient has no note the gate closes and DeliMF reduces to its structured-only form, giving robustness to missing text by construction. On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, DeliMF improves significantly over the baselines, particularly on patients who carry clinical text, while losing nothing on those without. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of multimodal fusion and gated cross-attention, and a case study further shows that fusing clinical text with the structured stream recovers delirium cases that the structured data alone misses. We hope DeliMF encourages early ICU prediction to make fuller use of the overlooked clinical text and contributes to the early identification and timely intervention of delirium.

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

### 155. [Scene-Adaptive VLA: Efficient Autonomous Driving via Dynamic Layer Routing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24590v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24590

**作者：** Yujia Yang、Quan Yuan、Jiawei Fan、Yang Li、Tiange Fu、Xiaoyuan Fu、Guiyang Luo、Jinglin Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24590v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24590v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向自动驾驶 VLA，提出 Scene-Adaptive VLA：用帧级时序场景变化与决策偏差刻画模型感知的场景复杂度，编码为 scene-aware token，再经 budget-conditioned 层路由为每个场景分配激活参数比例并选择层组合，端到端训练，在 Bench2Drive 上减少约 53.5% 推理开销而几乎不损驾驶与语言能力。

**相关性简评：** 其按不确定性/场景变化动态分配计算预算的层路由机制，可能为 LVR 中的自适应计算、THINK/LOOK/STOP 式停止与预算决策提供方法线索，可供核查；但工作面向驾驶推理效率与参数冗余，不涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移到多模态推理需较多验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scene-Adaptive VLA: Efficient Autonomous Driving via Dynamic Layer Routing

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs strains onboard computational resources during real-time inference. This directly increases energy consumption and limits vehicle battery range, making it critical to minimize computational overhead without compromising driving capability and explainability. Current research on efficient VLA-based driving focuses on sequential adaptation (\\textit{e.g.}, Chain-of-Thought and token adjustment), leaving structural adaptation underexplored despite parameter redundancy across dynamic driving scenes. To address this gap, we propose Scene-Adaptive VLA, an efficient framework leveraging dynamic layer routing to adjust active parameters based on real-time scenes. Inspired by the temporal continuity of scenes and model predictive uncertainty, our approach characterizes model-perceived scene complexity via frame-level temporal scene variations and decision deviations. To uncover latent scene-to-parameter correspondences, we encode this characterization into scene-aware tokens, alongside two specialized queries. A budget-conditioned layer routing mechanism evaluates these refined queries to allocate a budget that determines the active parameter ratio and subsequently selects appropriate layer combinations. The entire framework is optimized end-to-end. Extensive evaluations on the Bench2Drive benchmark show that when adapted to a state-of-the-art VLA model, our approach significantly reduces inference-time computational overhead by 53.5\\% with negligible degradation in driving and language capabilities. Code is available at https:github.com/yang-luvu/Scene-Adaptive-VLA.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 156. [Dynamic self-ensemble on multi-exit residual vision transformer for small-data image classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24602v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24602

**作者：** Stephen Ekaputra Limantoro、Yan-Kai Wang、Ching-Chun Huang、Hong-Han Shuai、Wen-Huang Cheng、Jungwoo Huh、Sanghoon Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24602v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24602v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对小样本图像分类，提出多阶段残差 ViT（ReSEViT），用类 ResNet 的残差 token 建模局部结构，并以「自集成学习」加动态学习器选择（DLS）自适应聚合各阶段分类器，以降低冗余、预测误差与方差。

**相关性简评：** 多出口结构与 DLS 对中间阶段重要性的自适应选择，可能为 LVR 的动态计算分配与停止/出口决策提供可核查的方法线索，但该文面向分类精度，未涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamic self-ensemble on multi-exit residual vision transformer for small-data image classification

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformer (ViT) has garnered increased attention for image classification in recent years. However, ViT is notorious for its data-hungry problem as it achieves high-performance results when only trained on large-size datasets. In this paper, we study how ViT specifically works on small-scale datasets with limited data where the availability of image data is often constrained in practice, especially in fields such as medical imaging. To mitigate the issue, we designed a multi-stage residual ViT, dubbed ReSEViT, with the self-ensemble method to utilize multi-level information from intermediate features. Due to the complex decision boundaries for classifications, relying on a single classifier can lead to prediction errors. Hence, we propose a new learning method for ViT, named self-ensemble learning, which ensembles multi-stage classifiers in a single model. Our self-ensemble comprises a novel approach, Dynamic Learner Selection (DLS), to adaptively select the importance of different stages. ReSEViT incorporates residual token embeddings which is a ResNet-like block to model effective local structures alongside with transformer blocks in each stage. The integration of residual tokens and self-ensemble learning into a multi-stage ViT highlights the reduction in redundancy, prediction error and variance while maintaining an efficient model size for small-scale image datasets.

</details>

### 157. [IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24607v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24607

**作者：** Jiaxing Chen、Zizheng Yan、Jingyu Zhuang、Jinwei Chen、Shuguang Cui、Guanying Chen、Qingnan Fan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24607v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24607v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 IntriAdapt：把已知相机内参当作输出端的几何验证器，通过比较点云视线与内参定义的视线得到闭式几何残差并最小化它，在冻结的几何基础模型上只优化轻量 LoRA 适配器，无需深度传感器或外部先验；并扩展到视频序列，使短序列上适配的模型可前馈迁移到同一相机的其他序列。

**相关性简评：** 用闭式几何残差充当无标签自监督信号来驱动适配器、且不改变冻结基础模型，这一「输出端验证器 + 轻量适配」线索可供核查是否迁移到 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态自验证与训练监督设计，但其本身属几何估计任务，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \\textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \\textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

</details>

### 158. [How Much Do Activation Monitors Benefit from Original Model Computations?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24613v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24613

**作者：** James Oldfield、Shawn Im、Jay J Culligan、Philip Torr、Sharon Li、Adel Bibi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24613v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24613v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 activation monitor 在多大程度上依赖原始行为生成计算：固定目标模型与监测架构后，比较在不同计算上下文轨迹上训练/评估的监测器，在严格控制 transcript（改写文本、chat 格式等）变化后预测原执行行为的能力，并分析 native 访问带来的增益及特权信息基线的局限。

**相关性简评：** 其反事实监测设计可供核查 LVR 中「内部状态是否在文本旁路之外提供额外预测价值」这一贡献分配问题，改写导致标签翻转样本上的增益与 logit margin 基线对比也可能对 latent 内容使用与视觉旁路分析有方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Do Activation Monitors Benefit from Original Model Computations?

**abstract/A1：** One powerful way to safeguard AI systems is to monitor their internal computations--where signs of undesirable behavior might be more easily detectable than from models' inputs and outputs alone. However, recent studies begin to question the premise that activations provide a unique window into model behavior. In this paper, we study how much of activation monitors' success depends on access to the original behavior-generating computations. Within a fixed choice of target model and monitoring architecture, we compare how well monitors trained and evaluated on trajectories that differ in computational context can predict the behavior of the original execution, after the transcript is changed in a controlled manner (e.g., its exact text, or chat formatting). We first find that much performance can be recovered without access to the original behavior-generating trace (in up to 4 models across 2 counterfactual monitoring tasks), but a mild yet consistent advantage to native-trained monitors remains, outperforming strongest controls by up to 0.014 AUROC. Interestingly, we find monitors trained with native access have notable uplift on original examples whose behavioral label changes under paraphrasing. We further find this a useful lens to expose limitations of baselines that use simple forms of privileged information (i.e., answer logit margins). While our results show the advantage of native monitor access is modest in aggregate, they highlight the importance of evaluations that identify if and when original model computations provide additional predictive value.

</details>

### 159. [Uncovering Semantic Hierarchies in Text-Attributed Graphs via Variational EM-based LLM-GNN Synergy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24624v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24624

**作者：** Yunhui Liu、Xudong Jin、Qizhuo Xie、Chunhui Zhao、Xiao Luo、Tao Zheng、Bin Chong、Tieke He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24624v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24624v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SHiFT，在 EM 框架下让 LLM 在 E 步归纳显式语义树、GNN 在 M 步对齐该层级，并用轻量 Mapping &amp; Diagnosis 仅在检测到异常时更新层级以降低推理成本，在文本属性图上取得 SOTA 并给出类变分 EM 的理论解释。

**相关性简评：** 其交替式「LLM 提议结构 + 编码器对齐」与异常触发的按需层级更新，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新时机、停止判据与推理成本控制提供可核查的方法线索，但原文并不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncovering Semantic Hierarchies in Text-Attributed Graphs via Variational EM-based LLM-GNN Synergy

**abstract/A1：** While hierarchical structures are intrinsic to organizing human knowledge, current representation learning on text-attributed graphs predominantly operates on flat semantic spaces, overlooking the rich coarse-to-fine granularity inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we propose SHiFT, which synergizes the reasoning power of LLMs with the structural representation capability of GNNs within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) paradigm. In the E-step, we harness LLMs as expert taxonomists to induce an explicit semantic tree, introducing a lightweight Mapping &amp; Diagnosis strategy that reduces inference costs by surgically updating the hierarchy only when anomalies are detected. In the M-step, we align the GNN encoder with this induced hierarchy from complementary perspectives, including clustering partition, topological skeleton, and semantic concepts. Theoretical analysis interprets SHiFT as a generalized Variational EM algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SHiFT not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but also uncovers high-quality, human-readable taxonomies. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/SHiFT.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 160. [Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24630v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24630

**作者：** Mengxi Hu、Yuxuan Hu、Jinbo Su、Ke Wang、Honghao Shi、Wenli Wu、Cuiping Li、Hong Chen、Jing Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24630v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24630v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SELM 框架，把 LLM Agent 的技能演化表述为技能库级管理问题，用置信度与效用信号联合管理技能的检索、更新与生命周期，并在四个 Agent 基准上评测。

**相关性简评：** 效用感知检索与按有效性保留/淘汰技能的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 假设与中间状态的筛选、复用及停止决策提供管理式线索，可供核查其效用信号的构建方式；但原文不涉及视觉多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills as a lightweight way to acquire task-specific knowledge. Recent work enables skills to evolve from task trajectories. However, these methods often lack systematic management of evolved skills, making it difficult for agents to reuse and accumulate skills across domains, thus limiting performance on subsequent tasks.To reliably accumulate, reuse, and maintain useful skills across tasks, we present SELM (Self-Evolving Library Management), a framework that formulates skill evolution as library-level management. SELM jointly manages skill retrieval, updating, and lifecycle by maintaining skill confidence and utility signals. It introduces utility-aware retrieval to select useful skills, a Map-Reduce framework to generate targeted updates from task-specific experience, and lifecycle controls to retain or remove skills based on their effectiveness. These mechanisms enable the skill library to continuously accumulate useful experience while preserving and pruning skills across tasks, improving agent performance on complex tasks across diverse domains. We evaluate SELM on four agent benchmarks covering diverse tasks and execution environments, and SELM consistently outperforms in most settings.

</details>

### 161. [Spectral-Aware Proposal Enhancement for Diffusion-Based Multispectral UAV Multi-Object Tracking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24642v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24642

**作者：** Xu Lin、Tingfa Xu、Tianhao Li、Haolin Qin、Huawei Gao、Jichuan Xing、Jianan Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24642v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24642v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DSATrack，在多光谱无人机多目标跟踪的扩散式框架中，用轻量光谱编码器为 RPN 注入多光谱特征以生成高质量候选，并以光谱显著性置信度调制精炼后的候选选择，在 MMOT 基准上相比 DiffusionTrack 基线提升 HOTA、MOTA 与 IDF1。

**相关性简评：** 其扩散式迭代精炼循环中「注入可靠空间先验 + 精炼后置信度重标定再阈值筛选」的流程，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态迭代更新、证据筛选与停止/决策机制提供可核查的方法线索，但面向遥感跟踪任务，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spectral-Aware Proposal Enhancement for Diffusion-Based Multispectral UAV Multi-Object Tracking

**abstract/A1：** Multispectral UAV multi-object tracking (MOT) with oriented bounding boxes remains challenging due to small targets, cluttered backgrounds, and unstable inter-frame associations. Although diffusion-based MOT provides an effective iterative proposal refinement paradigm, existing diffusion-based trackers lack dedicated designs for exploiting multispectral cues in proposal initialization and confidence calibration, limiting tracking robustness in complex UAV scenarios. This letter proposes DSATrack, a diffusion-guided spectral-aware tracking framework for multispectral UAV MOT. Specifically, a lightweight spectral encoder injects multispectral information into the RPN branch through feature fusion, enabling the RPN head to generate high-quality object-aware proposals. These proposals are then injected into the initial proposal set to provide reliable spatial priors for diffusion refinement. Furthermore, a spectral-saliency confidence modulation strategy recalibrates refined tracking confidence according to local multispectral saliency contrast before score thresholding, enhancing spectrally reliable candidates while suppressing unreliable ones. Without modifying the original diffusion refinement head, DSATrack improves both proposal quality and post-refinement candidate selection. Experiments on the MMOT benchmark demonstrate that DSATrack outperforms the adapted DiffusionTrack baseline by 4.6 HOTA, 9.0 MOTA, and 7.7 IDF1 points, showing its effectiveness for multispectral UAV MOT.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters. 5 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Author accepted version

</details>

### 162. [Verifying Human-Written Reasoning References](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24690v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24690

**作者：** Ali Ansari、Farhana Ferdousi Liza

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24690v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24690v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出以人类参考推理链为中心的评价方法：用 LLM 将各步结论翻译为一阶逻辑、由 Z3 检查是否被所述前提蕴含，并配合全前提复查与失败归因，在 P-FOLIO 上核查 386 条推导，发现多数初始失败源于支持不完整或错配而非无依据。

**相关性简评：** 其步骤级蕴含检查加失败归因（区分人类推理错误、形式化翻译错误、标注错误）的流程，可能为 LVR 中推理步骤监督、以及「错误源自模型还是参考表示」的溯源提供可核查线索，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Verifying Human-Written Reasoning References

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating the reasoning of AI systems often relies on human-written reasoning chains as references, yet the logical support for their individual steps is rarely verified. Although prior neuro-symbolic approaches have formalized and checked reasoning, their reported evaluations do not systematically assess whether step conclusions in human-written reference derivations are entailed by their cited premise sets or investigate the sources of failures in those references. To address these limitations, we present a novel reference-centred assessment method for human-written derivations that combines entailment checking against cited premise sets, full-premise rechecking, and failure attribution to examine the reliability of these derivations and their formal representations. We evaluate it on P-FOLIO, using a large language model (LLM) to translate step conclusions into first-order logic (FOL) and the Z3 SMT solver to check entailment. Of 386 derivations examined, 202 (52.3%) meet all our checking criteria, meaning that every translated step is entailed by its stated support and the required target is established under the available FOL representations. Among 230 steps not entailed by their stated support, 191 become entailed when checked against the complete original premises, indicating that most initial failures reflect incomplete or mismatched support rather than unsupported claims. Manual analysis of the remaining 39 cases identifies 21 human reasoning errors, 11 FOL translation errors, and 7 dataset annotation errors. A separate manual audit of 50 randomly sampled steps that passed the entailment checks found 46 faithful FOL translations (92%). These findings suggest that disagreement with a human-written reasoning reference may originate in the reference or its formal representation rather than in the AI system being evaluated.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Preprint

</details>

### 163. [Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24718v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24718

**作者：** Nima H. Siboni、Magdalena Springer、Vahid Rostami

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24718v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24718v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的通信路由「inhibitory message passing」，仿皮层抑制原理，按证据句和接收者分别抵消冗余证据，仅在对方缺少该证据时至多转发一次并排除推理与答案，从而在多智能体群组中提升准确率并减少 token 消耗。

**相关性简评：** 其「抑制共享冗余、保留弱信号」的逐接收者证据路由，可能为 LVR 中被反复提到的视觉证据筛选与细节被淹没问题提供可核查的方法线索，但它处理的是文本多智能体消息，能否迁移到视觉 token 或 latent 状态尚待人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent's context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents' messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders' reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.

</details>

### 164. [Tensor Network Datamodels for Training Data Attribution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24721v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24721

**作者：** Farzaneh Heidari、Md Rifat Arefin、Louis Jaburi、Guillaume Rabusseau

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24721v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24721v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Tensor Network Datamodels，用低秩张量网络学习「训练数据子集→训练结果」的映射，以紧凑表示刻画多个训练单元之间的非加性交互，并用单一拟合模型支持删除效应预测、单元重要性、交互识别与子集选择，在受控推理任务和分类/推理微调上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其把训练数据贡献建模为子集函数并显式刻画单元间交互，与 LVR 关注的数据/轨迹贡献分配和监督选择有方法层面的对应，可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 推理步骤或推理轨迹的信用分配与训练子集筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tensor Network Datamodels for Training Data Attribution

**abstract/A1：** Datamodels predict how a model's behavior changes when different parts of its training data are included or removed. However, linear datamodels assign fixed contributions to training units and cannot represent non-additive joint effects. We introduce Tensor Network Datamodels (TNDMs), which use low-rank tensor networks to model dependencies among training units while keeping the representation compact. TNDMs learn a map from subsets of the training data to the outcome of training on those subsets, allowing them to represent interactions among several training units. We prove that complementary and redundant training groups can induce high-degree subset functions with compact low-rank representations. A single fitted TNDM can then be used for several training data questions, including predicting the effect of removing data, measuring the importance of individual training units, identifying interactions between training units, and selecting useful subsets of the training data. We evaluate TNDMs on controlled tasks designed to contain strong interactions, as well as standard fine-tuning settings for classification and reasoning. On a controlled reasoning task, TNDMs outperform every baseline while observing only half as many training subsets, and TNDM-TT reduces prediction NMSE by $89\\%$ relative to the linear datamodel after observing approximately $0.0061\\%$ of all possible training subsets. In factual-association fine-tuning, a single TNDM-CP raises held-out $\\mathrm{R}^2$ from $0.579$ to $0.668$ over the linear datamodel. These results demonstrate that compact low-rank models improve prediction when training data effects depend on combinations of training groups.

</details>

### 165. [CorrFlow: Self-Correcting Flow Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24750v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24750

**作者：** Hangwei Zhang、Nathan Rouillé、Chuanxia Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24750v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24750v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CorrFlow 自校正 flow matching 框架：在 rectified-flow 插值下，单步干净预测的误差等于按噪声水平缩放的实现速度残差，据此用轻量 refiner 复用同一次前向的干净预测、条件、噪声水平与隐藏状态来预测残差修正，叠加到基础速度上再进行后续采样更新。理论分析比较了特征复用与原始输入仿射预测器，以及在匹配训练算力下 refiner 训练与继续训练基模型的残差风险下降；在类别条件图像、文生视频和图生视频生成上报告了一致改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「复用同次前向的隐藏状态预测残差、在每步更新前修正当前状态」的机制，可能与 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、错误累积抑制及监督信号设计有可核查的方法线索，但其理论条件是否适用于多模态推理状态需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CorrFlow: Self-Correcting Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Flow-matching models generate samples through iterative velocity predictions, but typically do not revisit these predictions using the intermediate representations that produced them. We introduce CorrFlow, a self-correcting flow-matching framework that reuses this information through a lightweight refiner. Under rectified-flow interpolation, the error of the one-step clean prediction equals the realized velocity residual scaled by the noise level. Motivated by this identity, the refiner learns to predict residual corrections from the base model's clean prediction, conditioning, noise level and hidden states from the same forward pass. The correction is added to the base velocity before each sampling update, so subsequent predictions are made from the corrected state. This requires no additional base-model evaluations and only one lightweight refiner evaluation per step. Our theoretical analyses establish conditions under which feature reuse outperforms raw-input affine predictors and refiner training achieves greater residual-risk reduction than continued base-model training under a matched training compute budget. Experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video generation and image-to-video generation show consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, including gains in visual quality and physical consistency. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

</details>

### 166. [CorrCLIPv2: Harnessing Unlabeled Images for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24757v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24757

**作者：** Dengke Zhang、Fagui Liu、Quan Tang、C. L. Philip Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的开放词表语义分割框架 CorrCLIPv2：用类别无关掩码显式解耦 patch 间交互，借助自监督模型的空间一致特征修正掩码，加入同时强化空间细节与语义的特征细化，并在掩码内投票统一输出；进一步用无标注图像构建记忆库做跨图像目标检索与多 CLIP 集成以缓解上下文偏差。

**相关性简评：** 其基于掩码的区域级特征聚合与跨图像检索式记忆库，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、上下文干扰抑制及特征状态更新提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理轨迹的生成或使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CorrCLIPv2: Harnessing Unlabeled Images for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation aims to classify pixels without being restricted to a fixed set of categories. Although Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) demonstrates remarkable potential for open-vocabulary recognition, its segmentation capability is impaired by noisy inter-class patch interactions. To this end, this work proposes a unified training-free object-centric framework, named CorrCLIPv2, from three complementary aspects of patch correlation, feature representation, and output regularization. Specifically, for patch correlation, we leverage class-agnostic mask generators to explicitly disentangle inter-class interactions. Moreover, we utilize spatially-coherent features from self-supervised models to compute attention scores to mitigate mask inaccuracies. Regarding feature representation, we devise a refinement mechanism to simultaneously strengthen spatial details and semantic representation. Within the output space, we unify predictions via voting in each mask to enhance spatial consistency. To mitigate contextual bias and enhance prediction accuracy of objects, we further extend the framework by incorporating a cross-image object retrieval paradigm, which incurs minimal computational overhead. We build a memory bank of CorrCLIP-enhanced features from unlabeled images and implement a regime of multi-CLIP ensemble. By aggregating semantically consistent object features across diverse contexts retrieved from the memory bank, CorrCLIPv2 mitigates context-induced interference and obtains more robust predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art on 10 standard benchmarks. Remarkably, it even surpasses fully supervised open-vocabulary methods across 22 multi-domain datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/zdk258/CorrCLIP.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. Published in International Journal of Computer Vision

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究力矩受限下航天器姿态捕获控制器的选择性改造：用 paired-outcome 方法对同一上下文下的「失败」与「成功配对增益」分别预测，并在收益不确定时回退执行原始基线控制器，从而在平均收益与单次退化之间取舍。

**相关性简评：** 其「成对结果监督 + 上下文相关拒绝并回退基线」的机制，可能为 LVR 中何时启用高成本 latent 推理、如何抑制个别样本退化提供可核查的方法线索，但与视觉或多模态推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Paired-Outcome Learning for Selective Spacecraft Attitude Capture under Torque Limits

**abstract/A1：** Torque-limited spacecraft attitude capture requires adapting the maneuver speed to uncertain braking authority. Faster settings can reduce average tracking error while worsening individual maneuvers, making selective modification of an existing controller a baseline-relative learning problem. A paired-outcome method combines three mechanisms: physically interpretable continuation policies with different speed envelopes, separate prediction of task failure and successful-pair tracking gains, and context-dependent rejection that executes the unchanged baseline. Complete paired simulations provide labels under common plant parameters and measurement seeds; training, validation, and calibration are separated by context. Basilisk experiments use 108 development contexts, 324 labeling rollouts, and 624 evaluation episodes across 48 test contexts, including disclosed post-freeze diagnostics. The selective controller reduces aggregate integrated attitude error by 4.67% relative to the branch baseline, with 17 improvements, 31 exact ties, and no observed regressions. Always using the fast alternative achieves a 4.81% reduction but worsens 11 cases. Gains occur in principal-axis, near-axis, braking-boundary, and selected noise/drift maneuvers; general coupled cases retain the baseline. Ablations show no additional aggregate benefit from branch commitment, active querying, or score subtraction. The evidence supports a restricted empirical trade-off between average improvement and individual regression, without establishing a closed-loop safety guarantee.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SiamSA-PPM：面向预测式流程监控，用 Siamese 自监督学习结合基于控制流语义与高频行为模式的日志增强，在缺乏标注时学习可泛化的前缀表示，并用于下一活动与最终结果预测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity

**abstract/A1：** Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, SiamSA-PPM achieves competitive or superior predictive performance in both next activity and final outcome prediction tasks. An open source implementation of our method is publicly available under https://github.com/SvStraten/SiamSA-PPM-Extension..

### 169. [ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24783v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24783

**作者：** Hamidreza Dastmalchi、Ali Cheraghian、Aijun An、Abdelwahed Khamis、Lars Petersson

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24783v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24783v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ATLAS，将 LVLM 各层、各注意力头及不同模态的注意力视为结构化特征，用带时序注意力和 FiLM 调制的轻量 U-Net 融合帧级高分辨率与视频级低分辨率注意力，生成粗分割热图，再由 SAM2 在视频中传播，用于推理式视频目标分割。

**相关性简评：** 其「LVLM 注意力跨层、跨头、跨模态噪声大且分散」的观察与可学习注意力聚合方式，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选及注意力结构对内部表示的影响提供核查线索，但原论文面向视频分割应用，未研究 latent 推理状态的生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to localize and segment objects referred to by natural-language expressions throughout a video. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) implicitly encode localization cues in their attention maps, these attentions are often noisy, diffuse, and scattered across layers, heads, and modalities, limiting their direct use for segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on handcrafted attention-selection heuristics or computationally expensive attention refinement. We propose ATLAS, an attention adaptation framework that learns to transform raw LVLM attentions into object-centric localization cues. ATLAS treats attentions from all layers, heads, and modalities as structured features, combining high-resolution frame-level attentions that capture spatial information with low-resolution video-level attentions that encode temporal context. A lightweight U-Net equipped with temporal attention and FiLM-based modulation fuses these complementary representations to generate coarse segmentation heatmaps, which are propagated across the video using SAM2. Extensive experiments on challenging referring and reasoning video segmentation benchmarks show that ATLAS outperforms existing frozen-backbone methods. Code and models are available at \\url{https://hamidreza-136.github.io/atlas/}.

**comment/C1：** WACV2027

</details>

### 170. [SL-Ground: Sentence-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24814v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24814

**作者：** Yang-Syu Li、Cheng-Huan Yang、Chia-Yung Jui、Peggy Joy Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24814v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24814v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SL-Ground，把基于 grounding 的开词汇目标检测从「token 级打分 + token 到类别聚合」改为「句级类别描述表示直接与 object query 对齐打分」，并构建车辆类型／品牌／车型多层级的 Stanford Cars 基准检验细粒度识别效果。

**相关性简评：** 用完整句级表示替代碎片化 token 证据的做法，可能为 LVR 中组合式任务描述与视觉证据如何作为整体保留在内部状态、避免信息碎片化提供可核查的方法线索，但其不涉及推理状态生成与更新，迁移需另行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SL-Ground: Sentence-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors provide a widely used framework for text-conditioned localization, with a phrase-grounding formulation that aligns object queries to individual text tokens and recovers class scores through token-to-class aggregation. We observe that this token-level scoring design becomes a bottleneck for fine-grained open-vocabulary object detection, where the target category is defined by a complete compositional description rather than by isolated tokens. Based on this observation, we propose SL-Ground, a sentence-level grounding reformulation for grounding-based open-vocabulary detection. Instead of scoring queries against fragmented token evidence, SL-Ground encodes each category description as a complete sentence-level representation and directly scores object queries against these representations. To evaluate fine-grained recognition across label granularity, we construct a multi-granularity Stanford Cars benchmark spanning vehicle type, brand, and car model. At the finest car-model granularity, SL-Ground raises AP over the token-level variant from 14.5 to 70.6 under matched training candidate sampling and to 86.0 with full-vocabulary training, while better preserving open-vocabulary capability and avoiding repeated prompt chunking. Beyond Stanford Cars, SL-Ground also improves FG-OVD performance, achieving the best average AP among compared methods. These results show that sentence-level grounding provides a more suitable scoring unit for fine-grained OVOD and offers a practical path toward fine-grained grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors.

</details>

### 171. [Pair-Aware Optimization: Coordinating Exploration and Refinement for Jailbreaking LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24823v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24823

**作者：** Juanyang Xu、Zheng Wang、Xingyu Zhao、Siddartha Khastgir、Andi Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24823v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24823v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 LLM agent 的越狱攻击优化，系统比较纯 ZO、纯 FO 及 ZO→FO、FO→ZO 四种策略，提出先以 ZO 探索对抗前缀、再以 FO 精炼后缀的配对感知框架，保留多个候选并条件式精炼后择优，同时在优化与评估中采用一致的随机解码。

**相关性简评：** 其「多候选保留—条件精炼—成对选择」的探索/精炼协调，以及实验显示优化顺序显著影响效果，可能为 latent 推理中多假设状态的搜索与精炼、THINK 与 LOOK 的先后安排提供方法线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pair-Aware Optimization: Coordinating Exploration and Refinement for Jailbreaking LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to adversarial inputs that induce attacker-specified malicious behaviors, commonly referred to as jailbreaking. Existing optimization-based jailbreak attacks primarily employ first-order (FO) methods that leverage gradient information or zeroth-order (ZO) methods that rely on function-value feedback. However, their complementarity and optimization ordering remain underexplored. We systematically investigate four strategies: pure ZO, pure FO, ZO-&gt;FO, and FO-&gt;ZO, and develop a ZO-FO framework that explores adversarial prefixes through ZO optimization and refines their corresponding suffixes through FO optimization. To coordinate the two processes, we introduce Pair-aware optimization, which retains multiple prefix candidates, conditionally refines their suffixes and selects among the resulting prefix-suffix pairs. We further investigate agent jailbreaking from a more general stochastic-generation perspective, where the same adversarial input can induce diverse reasoning trajectories and actions that a single greedy output cannot capture. Accordingly, we adopt consistent stochastic decoding during both optimization and evaluation. Experiments across malicious-instruction and malicious-environment benchmarks demonstrate that hybrid optimization improves attack effectiveness over single-optimizer methods, while optimization order substantially influences performance.

</details>

### 172. [Teaching Code Agents to Ask Without Leaking Private Code](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24824v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24824

**作者：** Wenjia Jiang、Jieke Shi、Zhensu Sun、Chengran Yang、Shidong Pan、Peixin Zhang、Yifan Jia、James Hoang、Xiwei Xu、Zhenchang Xing、David Lo、Zhou Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24824v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24824v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 utility-verified abstraction（UVA）：把代码 agent 向云端强模型提问中涉及的私有标识符改写为「角色＋类型」式描述，并从同一执行状态回放修复轨迹，只有在披露更少私有实体且修复仍能完成时才保留该改写，用于训练咨询行为；在仓库级 issue 修复上提升解决率并显著减少问题中的隐私泄露。

**相关性简评：** 其「抽象只有在回放验证任务效用未受损时才被保留」的数据筛选思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 抽象与轨迹监督的保真度判定；但研究域为代码隐私保护，与视觉/多模态推理状态无直接联系，借鉴线索需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teaching Code Agents to Ask Without Leaking Private Code

**abstract/A1：** Local coding agents can extend their reach by consulting a stronger cloud model. Such consultations, however, often expose the repository's private identifiers, file paths, and source code. Host-side masking hides recognized identifiers but leaves the surrounding code and the agent's phrasing unchanged, while training for less disclosure risks suppressing consultation or producing questions too vague to answer. We propose utility-verified abstraction (UVA), which teaches the agent to describe private entities by their role and type while retaining the technical details an expert needs. From solved repair trajectories, we rewrite each question into this form and keep the rewrite only if it discloses fewer private entities and the repair, replayed from the same execution state with the repair trajectories. Across two benchmarks, the trained agent consults more often than before training. On repository-level issue repair, it solves 37.6% of issues, against 25.3% for the same model working alone, a gain from the training as a whole rather than from consultation alone. Its questions disclose 3.7-fold fewer private entities and 1.4-fold less verbatim code than the untrained agent's questions to the same expert.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages of main text, 33 pages in total with references and appendix, 4 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 173. [Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24826v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24826

**作者：** Zeyan Li、Weiheng Li、Shengda Zhuo、Libing Chen、Min Chen、Yin Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24826v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24826v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出递归函数分解（RFD），用参数共享的算子分块滚动预测长时程未来，并把已发出的块回灌进滚动上下文；通过消融考察前向反馈和回传梯度的影响，讨论以存储参数换取顺序计算时的速度与显存代价。

**相关性简评：** 参数共享算子的迭代复用与「块回灌上下文」可能为 LVR 循环/latent 状态的生成与更新方式提供线索，其「去掉前向反馈普遍有害、阻断其回传梯度影响不大」的消融可供核查 latent 步间监督与状态贡献分配时参照，但领域相隔较远，属待核查的方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off

**abstract/A1：** Most long-horizon forecasters emit the complete future in one pass. We ask whether a compact operator can instead be reused to emit contiguous future blocks, trading stored parameters for sequential computation. Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD) factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions. The blocks occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated, not added as trend, seasonal, or residual components, and each emitted block joins the rolling context that conditions the next application. In controlled three-seed experiments, removing forward feedback hurts all four evaluated datasets while stopping gradients through it changes little, so the useful signal is the evolving forecast state itself; reapplying the shared operator helps consistently, but by less than widening it. The model uses 0.08--0.46M parameters, yet its sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel count. In a frozen long-context evaluation against ten strong baseline families, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells; the comparison is cross-protocol, with RFD using 512/720-step context and the baselines using 96.

</details>

### 174. [Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machines as Unsupervised Encoders for Biomechanical Movement Sequences](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24829v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24829

**作者：** Wafi Sharif、Nicholas LaHaye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24829v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24829v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把循环时序受限玻尔兹曼机（RTRBM）适配为无监督编码器，将生物力学运动序列的窗口映射为定长嵌入，堆叠成深层结构并接入 SIT-FUSE 分割流程，用聚类、重建、未见受试者步速分类与 PCA、自编码器及去掉循环连接的对照比较。

**相关性简评：** 循环能量模型的隐状态与「移除循环连接」消融设计，可供核查 LVR 中循环 latent 状态如何生成、以及循环结构是否真正贡献增益；其嵌入未胜过简单统计量的负结果也可能有参考价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machines as Unsupervised Encoders for Biomechanical Movement Sequences

**abstract/A1：** Biomechanical movement recordings are continuous, high-dimensional time series, and analyzing them without manually labeling them requires representations that capture how movements evolve over time. Most unsupervised representation-learning pipelines, however, treat each observation frame independently and discard this temporal structure, while energy-based models that could capture it have not extensively been adapted to biomechanical signals. So, this paper implements the Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RTRBM), a recurrent energy-based model, into an unsupervised encoder that maps windows of movement data to fixed-length embeddings, and tests what its recurrent structure contributes. We adapt the model to continuous-valued signals, stack it into a deep architecture, and integrate it into the SIT-FUSE segmentation pipeline. We evaluate the embeddings on simulated musculoskeletal reaching and on two real gait datasets, using clustering, reconstruction, and walking-speed classification of unseen subjects, and compare them against non-recurrent and non-probabilistic baselines, including a control that removes the recurrent connection. Clustering the embeddings recovers movement structure tied to progress toward the target without any labels, which also transfers to unseen episodes. On gait data, the embeddings outperform PCA and autoencoder baselines under a nonlinear probe. However, removing the recurrent connection does not yield a measurable loss on the reaching task, and simple per-channel summary statistics classify walking speed at least as well as the embeddings. The model is therefore a working, verified encoder for SIT-FUSE, while the evidence for a benefit of recurrence is mixed, and the learned embeddings did not outperform simple summary statistics on gait.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Under review at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)

</details>

### 175. [Bellman Language Models: Solving the Recurring Decisions of LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24871v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24871

**作者：** Adarsh Vatsa、William Eiers

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24871v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24871v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把有界 LLM agent 的重复决策当作优化问题：从工作流日志或自身运行中把对话离散为状态，估计各结果概率与动作代价直至状态与概率收敛，求解所得 MDP，并以其解作为围绕模型的控制器（BLM），只在未见状态才回退给 LLM；在 τ²-bench telecom、InventoryBench 上大幅减少模型调用与成本。

**相关性简评：** 状态离散化、解一次后复用、仅未见过状态回退模型的控制器结构，可能为 LVR 中「何时复用已解 latent 状态、何时再花计算继续推理」以及 STOP 决策提供可核查线索；但对象是纯文本 agent、无视觉状态，迁移性需自行核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bellman Language Models: Solving the Recurring Decisions of LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** A general observation in agentic workflows, especially bounded ones, is that the decision space of the LLM, when we separate a decision from generation, starts approaching saturation: the agent meets the same states again and again, and after enough conversations it stops meeting new ones. LLMs generally don't treat these decisions as an optimization problem and instead re-derive them from their context/prompt on every turn. We show that treating decision making within reasonable bounds as an optimization problem, solving it once, and reusing the solved decisions can often make an agent faster, cheaper and more reliable. Our approach, which we call Discretize, Then Decide, starts from data such as the workflow's own logs or, when none exists, runs of the LLM agent itself. It reads each conversation into discrete states and estimates the probability of each outcome and the cost of each move, until no new states appear and the probabilities stop changing. It then solves the resulting Markov decision process. The solution runs as a controller around the model, sending moves whose content is fixed in the state, such as a tool call or a templated reply, and any state it hasn't seen is sent back to the LLM. We call an LLM run this way a Bellman language model (BLM), after Richard Bellman's equation for the best move in each state. On $τ^2$-bench telecom, the controller with no model solves 79% of tasks. As a BLM, Qwen3.8-27B, an open model, goes from 29% to 96% with 93% fewer model calls. For Claude Opus 5.5, which solves 96% of tasks on its own, running it as a BLM cuts model calls and cost per task by about 98% and lets it solve 2 more tasks. On InventoryBench, the solved policy with no model beats every published method. Where the hard part is writing content rather than choosing moves, such as resolving SymPy issues, few decisions can be solved in advance, and a BLM helps little.

**comment/C1：** 52 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Preregistrations: https://github.com/adarsh-vatsa/dtd-preregistration

</details>
