### 176. [RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24875v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24875

**作者：** Yue Dai、Sarah Zhou、Youtao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24875v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24875v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RAFT，一种面向时序图神经网络训练的相关性感知输入过滤框架：以训练过程中节点记忆的变化为判据，分别过滤作为预测目标的事件与被采样的历史支持事件，在三个模型、五个数据集上将训练输入平均减少 35.23%。

**相关性简评：** 用「内部状态变化幅度」判定输入是否需要处理并提前跳过其下游计算，这一线索可供核查是否能迁移为 latent 推理中依据状态变化筛选必要的视觉证据、决定 LOOK 与否；但其对象是时序图事件与训练效率，与多模态推理无直接关系，属于远距离方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training

**abstract/A1：** Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have shown strong performance on dynamic graph learning tasks by continuously updating node memories from evolving interactions (i.e., events) and leveraging these memories for downstream predictions. As graphs grow rapidly in modern applications, training requires processing an increasing number of events; meanwhile, each event can update node memories used by later events, creating dependencies that constrain parallel execution and limit the benefits of additional computing resources. These costs motivate an upstream question: Are all events, and the dependencies they introduce, necessary for learning? We investigate this question through two roles of temporal events: prediction targets and historical events sampled as inputs. We observe that targets involving stable node memories tend to exhibit lower prediction loss, while filtering historical events associated with stable memories can retain similar training-loss trajectories in several evaluated settings. Together, these observations suggest an opportunity to identify input redundancy through changes in node memories. Building on this opportunity, we propose RAFT, a redundancy-aware input-filtering framework for TGNN training. RAFT tracks memory changes during training and uses them to guide two filters: a root-event filter removes selected prediction targets before training, and a support-event filter excludes selected historical context during sampling. Filtering inputs before their downstream preparation and processing reduces the work they trigger. Across three TGNN models and five datasets, RAFT reduces training inputs by 35.23% on average and up to 97.11%, while reducing recorded training time by up to 52.56\\% with negligible changes to model precisions.

</details>

### 177. [Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24880v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24880

**作者：** Ankur Naskar、Vaneet Aggarwal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24880v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24880v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对凹的一般效用强化学习（RLGU），提出自然 actor-critic 方法：不再先估计 occupancy measure 再构造策略梯度伪奖励，而是用神经网络 critic 直接从状态-动作对学习该伪奖励，配合投影随机更新与多层级 Monte Carlo 控制偏差，并给出 O(T^{-1/2}) 全局收敛与采样复杂度分析。

**相关性简评：** 「跳过中间量估计、直接用 critic 学习伪奖励」的监督方式可能可供核查 LVR 中以训练信号直接塑造 latent 状态、避免显式重建视觉中间量的做法；MLMC 的对数成本偏差控制或与动态计算预算相关，但联系较弱属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.

</details>

### 178. [Goal Images Are Control Targets: Spatially-Grounded Goal-Image Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24885v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究机器人操作中目标图像的生成与评价，发现图像编辑质量排行榜与下游控制成功率脱节，并提出先预测初始/最终 2D 编辑区域掩码、再进行目标图合成的分解式框架 SGE-Goal。

**相关性简评：** 其「先预测空间掩码再生成」的分解式设计，可能为 LVR 中显式视觉证据筛选与基于掩码的 latent 状态更新提供方法线索；同时「按下游效用而非感知质量评价视觉中间产物」这一结论，可供核查 latent 表示的评价标准时参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Goal Images Are Control Targets: Spatially-Grounded Goal-Image Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation

**abstract/A1：** Goal-conditioned manipulation policies are steered by a goal image, a picture of the desired post-manipulation scene synthesized from the current observation and a language instruction. The prevailing assumption is that better image-editing quality yields better goals, so goal generators are built and compared using general image-editing metrics. We show this assumption is false. Across two independent goal-conditioned policies on CALVIN, the image editors that top aggregate editing-quality leaderboards (Gemini 3 Pro Image and GPT Image 1.5) produce worse control targets than our proposed far smaller finetuned open models, and the gap widens sharply for the multi-step (long-horizon) tasks robots actually face. A per-dimension analysis explains why. Downstream policy success is governed almost entirely by manipulation adherence (selecting the right object and the right final state; Spearman $ρ\\approx 0.9$ with success), while photorealism and aesthetic fidelity, precisely where large proprietary editors excel, are uncorrelated with success ($ρ\\approx 0$). This dissociation holds on both CALVIN and the real-world-aligned SIMPLER-Bridge benchmark. We then present SGE-Goal, a spatially-grounded decomposed editing framework that predicts initial and final 2D edit-region masks before goal-image synthesis. SGE-Goal turns open base models (FLUX.1 Kontext, FLUX.2 klein) into the strongest goal generators we evaluate on CALVIN, and second only to Gemini 3 Pro Image on SIMPLER-Bridge. Base models fine-tuned with SGE-Goal also hold up under chaining far better than the best proprietary editor, sustaining roughly seven times the success rate at the longest (five-step) chains. We release code, datasets, checkpoints, and a human-aligned diagnostic evaluator. Our results argue that goal generators must be selected by downstream utility, not by editing-quality leaderboards.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at WACV 2027. Project page: https://riddhi-chatterjee.github.io/SGE-Goal/

</details>

### 179. [Distribution-Based Regularization for Reward Fine-Tuning Diffusion and Flow Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24897v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24897v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24897v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DFR，将 KL 正则化目标从对模型分布线性的期望奖励推广为分布的凸泛函，由该目标的一阶变分导出分布相关的逐样本奖励，用于 diffusion/flow 模型的 reward fine-tuning，在同等漂移下提升生成多样性。

**相关性简评：** 并非 VLM 推理工作，但其「直接作用于分布而非间接约束采样动态」的目标设计可供核查：LVR 的轨迹训练与 latent 状态监督或可借类似分布级正则抑制推理状态坍缩与漂移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distribution-Based Regularization for Reward Fine-Tuning Diffusion and Flow Models

**abstract/A1：** Reward fine-tuning is an effective way to adapt pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models to downstream objectives, but aggressive optimization often leads to mode collapse and distributional drift. Existing methods attempt to control this drift with reverse-KL regularization, implemented as an $\\ell\_2$ penalty on the velocity field; however, this functions by indirectly constraining sampling dynamics rather than directly acting on the generated distribution. To address this, we propose DFR (Distributional Functional Rewards), which augments the task reward with a distribution-dependent, per-sample reward that acts explicitly on the generated distribution. Formally, we generalize the KL-regularized objective from expected rewards, which are linear in the model's distribution, to convex functionals of it. The first variation of this objective defines an effective, distribution-dependent reward that directly penalizes deviation from the pretrained distribution. This formulation yields additive per-sample rewards for the Fréchet distance (FD), maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and DreamSim diversity, recovering several recently proposed rewards as special cases. Across various text-to-image fine-tuning tasks, DFR matches the peak reward of KL-tuned baselines while increasing diversity by up to 29% at equal or lower drift.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 9 figures

</details>

### 180. [HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24899v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24899

**作者：** Soyoung Yoon、Peiran Xu、Han Wang、Ruofan Wu、Xiaodong Yu、Feng Yan、Mohit Bansal、Debiao Li、Seung-Won Hwang、Yuxiong He、Zhewei Yao

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HybridResearcher，一个 4B 的深度研究智能体：围绕「桥接实体」从已验证的单源任务合成跨结构化—非结构化源的桥接轨迹，并用严格构造门控保证两侧缺一不可，再以 SFT+RL 训练，在 HybridDeepResearch 基准上大幅提升且未损害单源能力。

**相关性简评：** 其合成桥接轨迹加门控筛选与 RL 训练的做法，可能为 LVR 中「何时需要外部/视觉证据、证据是否必要」的数据构造与轨迹级监督提供可核查线索，但该工作为纯文本智能体、不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents

**abstract/A1：** While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. To build it, we synthesize cross-source bridge trajectories by starting with validated single-source tasks-such as existing text-to-SQL or web search queries-and fabricating the missing source around a bridge entity drawn from the seed's own output. We retain a sample only when strict construction gates confirm that neither side alone suffices, ensuring the data requires true cross-source interdependence. Finally, we train on this curated dataset using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Evaluated on the existing HybridDeepResearch benchmark, HybridResearcher improves over our base model, Qwen3.5-4B, by 30.0 points pass@8 and surpasses the far larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points, while also improving over its base model on established, held-out single-source benchmarks (BrowseComp and BrowseComp-Plus), demonstrating that this complex cross-source reasoning can be taught directly to small models without triggering catastrophic forgetting.

</details>

### 181. [A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24908v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24908

**作者：** Csaba Balogh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24908v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24908v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对语言模型在表示层把语义不同输入视为可互换的「盲点」，从对称匹配视角提出在 SAE 训练中加入可微的 V\_Gini 正则项以惩罚指定扰动族内的响应不均，并在 GPT-2、Gemma 2、Qwen 2.5 上以冻结多随机种子协议评估弱尾响应、重建质量与下游可判别性。

**相关性简评：** 该训练期扰动敏感正则可能为 LVR 关注的「latent 状态是否保留任务必要细节、避免信息坍缩」提供表示层正则化线索，但原文面向纯文本 LLM 的 SAE 特征基，迁移到多模态 latent 推理属推测，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders

**abstract/A1：** Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V\_{\\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. Family-geometry controls show that the effect is not explained by template duplication or a single dominant perturbation family, and held-out probes plus null-calibrated separation tests evaluate how far the representation-level change carries to downstream discriminability. A zero-shot audit on out-of-distribution clinical radiology minimal pairs finds the relative weak-tail lift in all evaluated model-by-family cells, not perfectly rank-aligned with the trained statistic, and a held-out family audit finds it on family kinds never used in training. Together, the results show that perturbation-aware SAE training can reorient feature bases toward safety-relevant input changes while leaving downstream validation as a separate empirical step.

**comment/C1：** https://openreview.net/forum?id=NWWpKC9CZH

</details>

### 182. [Means-Ends Analysis Helps LLMs Plan in Continuous-State Domains](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24928v1>)

**作者：** Jiayi Li、Carl Kingsford

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Medaka：一个受 Newell 与 Simon 手段-目的分析（MEA）启发的结构化提示框架，通过递归目标分解、代数推导和逐步状态跟踪，让 LLM 在无法枚举动作的连续状态域中完成规划，并构建液体混合测试台 Liquidworld 进行评估。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其中递归目标分解与每步状态跟踪的显式结构，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态的生成、更新以及停止与动态计算设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Means-Ends Analysis Helps LLMs Plan in Continuous-State Domains

**abstract/A1：** LLM planning research has traditionally focused on discrete-state domains, where actions form a finite, enumerable set. Existing LLM planning frameworks largely assume actions are enumerable, modeling planning as a search process over candidate actions. However, in continuous-state domains, where actions form a continuum and cannot be enumerated, this assumption breaks down. We find a remedy in Newell and Simon's Means-Ends Analysis (MEA), a general problem-solving technique rooted in heuristics from human psychology. We develop Medaka, an MEA-inspired structured prompting framework that encourages recursive goal decomposition, algebraic derivation, and per-step state tracking. To evaluate native LLM planning abilities in continuous-state domains, we develop Liquidworld, a systematic testbed on liquid mixing. On Liquidworld, Medaka can improve performance across model families, suggesting that classical means-ends analysis elicits LLM-native reasoning abilities that are helpful for continuous-state planning.

</details>

### 183. [CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24952v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24952

**作者：** Hao Wang、Zihan Wang、Kai Wu、Jian Yao、Yiwen Ye、Yongcan Luo、Dapeng Wu、Jiale Chen、Haihua Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24952v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24952v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CasePlay，从无标注临床病例报告出发做自博弈 RL，用知识条件化提问者避免只问少数显著线索，并用 rubric 评判者对线索整合、推理深度和选项质量给出质量反馈，在七个医学基准上优于现有自博弈基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「知识点锚定生成 + rubric 过程质量反馈」的自博弈监督设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练与贡献分配、以及视觉证据筛选的奖励构造提供可核查的借鉴线索；但论文本身为纯文本医学推理，未涉及视觉状态或推理期 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to improve the clinical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but current pipelines often rely on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic-data generation. Meanwhile, the medical literature offers a wealth of high-quality unlabeled documents, including clinical case reports that trace the full clinical course from initial presentation to final treatment decisions. We study whether document-grounded self-play can convert these reports into effective RL training signals. We identify two challenges that limit existing self-play methods in this setting: knowledge-point fixation}, where the proposer repeatedly asks about a narrow set of salient clues in a source report, and difficulty-quality mismatch, where appropriately difficult questions may still be poorly formed or shallow, limiting their value for reasoner training. To address these challenges, we propose CasePlay, a self-play framework with two key components: (a) a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer, which anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points so that questions draw on a broader range of evidence from the source report; and (b) a Rubric-Judge Reasoner, which augments answer-accuracy feedback with rubric-based quality feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality, guiding the proposer toward reasoning-intensive questions that better support reasoner training. Extensive experiments across seven medically related benchmarks demonstrate that CasePlay outperforms existing self-play baselines and improves the SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average, highlighted by a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin. This approach offers an effective path toward continually improving medical reasoning ability through self-play RL.

</details>

### 184. [MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24955v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24955

**作者：** Yiming Zong、Shiyuan Piao、Jiashuo Jiang、Fugee Tsung

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24955v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24955v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MemPrice，把长时程 agent 的活跃上下文视为共享资源，用自适应价格在记忆条目与表示层次之间动态分配预算，仅在估计保留价值足以抵偿占用时保留细节，并在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、AppWorld、WebShop 等基准上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其按「估计保留价值」购买上下文与表示细节、并在硬预算下滚动调节占用的定价机制及分配 regret 分析，可能为 LVR 的动态计算分配、状态保留粒度与停止决策提供方法线索，但属纯文本 agent 记忆场景，迁移到视觉 latent 状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon LLM agents face a fundamental allocation problem as interaction histories grow: which information to retain, how much context to devote to it, and at what granularity. Existing memory mechanisms largely focus on relevance, retrieval, or compression, leaving this allocation trade-off implicit. We introduce MemPrice, which treats active context as a shared resource and dynamically allocates it across memories and representation levels. MemPrice turns accumulated memory pressure into an adaptive price on context, encouraging detail only when its estimated retention value justifies the additional footprint. This pressure persists across memory refreshes, allowing the contents of memory to evolve while preserving long-run control over context usage. We show that irreversible compression can force linear worst-case regret against hindsight following its own memory trajectory, and introduce a same-state benchmark to evaluate allocation on MemPrice's realized memory states. MemPrice enforces the hard context budget at every round and regulates long-run occupancy through adaptive pricing, without prior knowledge of the interaction horizon. Under priced-frontier regularity, its average allocation-regret bound against this benchmark vanishes when accumulated estimation error is sublinear. We evaluate the framework under matched memory budgets on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, AppWorld, and WebShop across three foundation models, spanning both query-blind memory construction and goal-directed agent context management.

</details>

**title/T1：** CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents

**abstract/A1：** AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24965v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24965v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究视频生成模型的逆向提示问题，把逆提示形式化为元学习任务，学习一个在时间维度上优化的 meta-prompt，从而摊销逆向过程、省去测试时的逐样本迭代优化，并比较重建保真度与效率。

**相关性简评：** 其用元学习摊销测试时迭代优化、跨时间维度聚合学习到 prompt 状态的做法，可能为 LVR 中可学习 latent 工作区的初始化与多步状态聚合提供方法线索，可供核查这种压缩状态是否保留任务必要的视觉证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Meta Inverse Prompting for Video Generative Models

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in video generative models have enabled flexible conditional generation and editing pipelines, such as text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-guided synthesis. However, these workflows are inherently one-directional, mapping conditions to videos without providing a mechanism to invert this process. In complex media production settings, the ability to recover controllable textual conditions from a given video is highly desirable, yet remains underexplored. While inverse prompting has been studied for image generation, directly extending these approaches to video is challenging due to the need to capture temporal dynamics beyond static appearance, as well as the substantial computational cost of per-video optimization. In this work, we propose the first practical framework for efficient video inverse prompting. Specifically, we formulate inverse prompting as a meta-learning problem and introduce Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP), which learns a meta-prompt optimized over temporal dimensions to enable fast and effective prompt inference. Our approach amortizes the inversion process, eliminating the need for costly iterative optimization at test time. Experimental results demonstrate that MVIP recovers higher-quality inverse prompts with significantly improved reconstruction fidelity compared to image-based inversion and iterative captioning baselines, while achieving substantial gains in efficiency. Code and video results are available at https://ueriniuno.github.io/mvip-page/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://ueriniuno.github.io/mvip-page/ Code: https://github.com/ueriniuno/MVIP

</details>

### 187. [Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24991v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24991

**作者：** Runguo Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24991v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24991v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对每个 key 的注意力分数加独立 Exp(1) 扰动，使阈值检索等价于按注意力权重采样，并在几何网格上得到嵌套样本、Horvitz–Thompson 输出估计与对所有层级同时成立的置信界，从而让每个 head 在首个满足目标误差 ε 的层级停止，实现有误差证书的稀疏注意力，并在多个 LLM 与长上下文设置上验证误差与速度收益。

**相关性简评：** 其可证明的误差证书与逐层自适应停止机制可能可供核查 LVR 中「何时停止读取视觉证据」的 STOP 决策、证据筛选与计算预算分配；但该方法是 token 级 KV 检索、不涉及推理状态，迁移线索需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. Lowering the threshold along a geometric grid gives nested samples, a Horvitz--Thompson estimate of the output at every level, and confidence bounds that hold simultaneously over all levels, so each head stops at the first level whose certificate meets the target error $\\varepsilon$. With fresh perturbations at every decoding step, each certificate fails with probability at most $δ$ during generation. At a suitable threshold, the estimator reads $O(\\varepsilon^{-2}\\log(1/δ))$ values regardless of the context length, and no adaptive method reads fewer, up to constants. A 4-bit scan with deterministic bounds, shared across a grouped-query-attention group, generates the candidates exactly but reads every key. On three LLMs and ten settings at 16K--128K tokens, no certificate is violated, and at equal keys read our 90th-percentile error is 4.6--7.9$\\times$ lower than that of the best of 15 baseline families. At equal bytes, the best baselines have 0.6--1.6 times our 90th-percentile error and at least 4.9 times our largest. End to end, our method stays within one point of dense attention on tasks and within 0.1\\% in PG-19 perplexity, and the strongest baselines at equal bytes score as well. On CPU, decoding steps at 32K--128K tokens run 1.1--1.4$\\times$ faster than dense attention on the same 16-bit cache.

**comment/C1：** 58 pages (10 pages main text, 48 pages appendix), 10 figures, 35 tables

</details>

### 188. [Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24998v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24998

**作者：** Josep Marques、Hyunyoung A. Cho、Youngeun Kim、Youjia Zhang、Aecheon Jung、Kyuhong Shim、Sungeun Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24998v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24998v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Block Recursive Transformers（BRT），把层划分成连续块并逐块递归复用，在 decoder-only（至 1.7B）、encoder-decoder 与 encoder-only 设置下比较层内重复与全局循环两种极端共享拓扑，发现中间块粒度在验证 NLL 与下游准确率上更优，并用消融与表示分析说明其平衡了局部精修与深度分化。

**相关性简评：** 其「递归复用深度如何组织」的共享粒度结论，可供核查 LVR 中 loop/递归式 latent 状态更新与深度—表示分化关系，但论文为纯文本架构研究，未涉及视觉证据或多模态推理，借鉴属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing

**abstract/A1：** Recursive Transformers depend not only on how many parameters are shared, but also on how shared parameters are organized across depth. Existing static schemes adopt two extreme reuse topologies: layer-wise repetition, where each layer is reused independently, and global cyclic reuse, where the entire stack is repeatedly applied as a single shared function. We argue that sharing granularity is an important factor in recursive parameter sharing. This study proposes Block Recursive Transformers (BRT), which partition layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reuse each block before moving to the next. This intermediate topology enables local refinement within blocks while preserving depth-wise transitions, without adding routing modules, auxiliary states, or extra training objectives. Across decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters, with additional encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies, BRT improves validation negative log-likelihood and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines. Ablations and representation analyses further show that intermediate block granularity better balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 9 figures. Published at EMNLP Findings 2026. Typo correction from camera-ready manuscript. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/

</details>

### 189. [UtoMe: Observation-Uncertainty-Guided Token Merging for Weather Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25001v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25001

**作者：** Yunbei Zhang、Janet Wang、Xi Xiao、Jihun Hamm、Xiao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25001v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25001v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 UtoMe，将集合资料同化的离散度作为观测不确定性代理，与动力学显著性结合形成重要性评分，用于保护锚点 token 并校准其余 token 的二分匹配合并，在 ERA5 72 小时预报中于相同 token 预算下降低误差。

**相关性简评：** 其核心论断「仅靠特征相似度不足以决定 token 取舍，应按输入可靠性分配预算」可能为 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态容量分配提供方法线索，但领域为气象预报，与 LVR 的具体迁移路径尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UtoMe: Observation-Uncertainty-Guided Token Merging for Weather Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Weather transformers process dense reanalysis fields whose reliability varies across variables, locations, and weather regimes. Token merging can reduce computation, but feature similarity alone does not account for this heterogeneous input uncertainty. We introduce UtoMe, an observation-uncertainty-guided token merging framework that combines dynamics saliency with ensemble data assimilation spread as a relative input-reliability proxy. The resulting importance score protects selected tokens as anchors and calibrates bipartite matching between the remaining tokens. Three variants use external uncertainty at both training and inference, during training only, or neither stage. In ERA5 72-hour forecasting at two spatial resolutions, UtoMe improves Overall error over train-time ToMe at matched token budgets. At $1.40625^\\circ$ and 50% token reduction, UtoMe-E lowers Overall error from 67.32 to 53.00 at the same 0.55x encoder FLOPs. Small reductions remain close to the full-token baseline; larger reductions incur measurable accuracy losses. Component ablations and spatial uncertainty controls support combining dynamics with aligned uncertainty when allocating a weather transformer's token budget.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code and project page: https://ornl-utome.github.io/

</details>

### 190. [FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25011

**作者：** Hyebin Kim、Hwasik Jeong、Joonhyuk Park、Gyeongjin Kang、Jungwoo Kim、Younghyun Kim、Eunbyung Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25011v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FineSplat 是面向细粒度图像 patch 的 feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架：为控制高分辨率 token 上的注意力开销，采用视角分组与 3D 空间分组两种局部性聚合策略，并以重建误差作为反馈信号细化几何与外观。

**相关性简评：** 其「视角局部性 + 提升到 3D 空间重连不相邻 token」的分组聚合，以及「用渲染重建误差做显式反馈、突破一次前向预测」的迭代细化，可能为 LVR 中细粒度视觉证据的聚合与筛选、latent 状态的迭代更新提供可核查的方法线索，但与多模态推理本身距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats

**abstract/A1：** Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.

</details>

### 191. [Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25034v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25034

**作者：** Jike Zhong、Ming Li、Yuxiang Lai、Xi Xiao、Sheng Zhang、Ritwick Chaudhry、Tianle Chen、Jingyu Xie、Zheda Mai、Shao-Yuan Lo、Konstantinos Psounis、Yuanyuan Lei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25034v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25034v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发现多轮 agentic 任务中 on-policy distillation 存在「蒸馏过冲」：较弱的学生在训练中先超越教师、随后回退，并归因于修复弱决策与侵蚀教师不认可的学生成功决策两种效应的竞争；据此提出 SPOD，仅在成功轨迹上屏蔽冲突的教师监督并加入概率下界，从而保住并扩大超越教师的收益。

**相关性简评：** 其「选择性屏蔽教师监督以保护学生成功行为」的做法，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督冲突（如何避免教师监督抹掉有效的 latent 推理状态）提供可核查的借鉴，但论文面向文本智能体蒸馏、无视觉与 latent 状态，联系需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher's corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD's final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD's best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

</details>

### 192. [VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25043v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25043

**作者：** Sicheng He、Yi Pan、Qiuting Yu、Jiaming Huang、Qi Lu、Shuyan Wu、Hongyan Feng、Xuanyu Liu、Jun Zhang、Jie Zhang、Wenqi Zhang、Xuhong Zhang、Jianwei Yin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25043v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25043v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的推理框架 VLA-Rolling：把流匹配 VLA 中被丢弃的 action tail 作为下一轮去噪的初始化，并用逐动作置信度估计引导再噪与去噪步数分配，在 16 组模型-基准上降低推断成本、多数提升成功率。

**相关性简评：** 动作去噪中的「复用未执行中间状态 + 按样本自适应分配去噪预算、置信度引导细化」可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态复用与动态计算/停止决策提供可核查线索，但该状态是动作轨迹而非推理表征，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse

**abstract/A1：** Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $π\_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

</details>

### 193. [HCFM: Helmholtz Component Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25059v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25059

**作者：** Shyam Sundar Saravanan、Tie Luo、Sanjay Madria

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.DB

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25059v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25059v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HCFM，一种无监督时间序列异常检测框架，用 Helmholtz 式分解把 Flow Matching 的向量场拆成无散度的传输头、压缩头与残差头，把散度估计限制在压缩头上，从而以更低成本分离保体积的常态传输与改变密度的压缩信号。

**相关性简评：** 其把状态演化的「保体积传输」与「密度改变」结构化分离、并用轻量残差头吸收不匹配的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的贡献分配与信息坍缩诊断提供可核查的分解线索，但与多模态推理主线无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HCFM: Helmholtz Component Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Flow Matching (FM) is an efficient simulation-free approach for training flow-based generative models, making it a promising foundation for scalable time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). However, standard FM learns a monolithic vector field in which nominal transport and local density-changing behavior are entangled. This creates a central challenge for TSAD; local expansion and contraction carry crucial anomaly-sensitive information, yet isolating this signal requires expensive Jacobian-trace estimation over the entire field. We propose \\emph{Helmholtz Component Flow Matching} (HCFM), an unsupervised TSAD framework that parameterizes the vector field prediction network with separate transport, compression, and residual heads. The transport head is constrained to be divergence-free, so divergence estimation is restricted to the compression head, while a lightweight residual head absorbs the remaining mismatch. This structured parameterization improves scalability and detection performance by separating volume-preserving nominal transport from density-changing compression, yielding cleaner anomaly signals from distinct deviations of nominal behavior. Experiments on large-scale univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks show that HCFM consistently improves detection accuracy while maintaining efficient inference compared with 16 baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/TrustAIoT/HCFM\_\_time-series-anomaly/

**comment/C1：** To appear as a conference paper in ICDE 2027

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25074

**作者：** Reaz Hassan Joarder、Sidratul Tanzila Tasmi、Alif Arshad Bakshi、Md. Bakhtiar Hasan、Md Hasanul Kabir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25074v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25074v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MoWE，用上下文感知的路由器把局部区域分配给固定的小波族，替换 U-Net 中的最大池化与步幅卷积，并在解码器复用编码器的空间路由图、以可学习通道门控缩放高频子带，在多个超声与心脏分割基准上取得 Dice 与边界距离的改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「按局部纹理自适应路由 + 门控高频子带」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节在内部状态里如何被选择性保留与压缩提供可核查的方法线索，但该文本身面向分割而非多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoWE: Spatially Adaptive Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts Pooling for Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** We present Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts (MoWE), a spatially adaptive routing mechanism that replaces max-pooling and strided convolutions in U-Net architectures for ultrasound lesion segmentation. Standard pooling operations suppress high-frequency spatial details, including potential boundary cues in speckled regions. Recent frequency-domain methods preserve some of these details, but a single wavelet family applies the same spectral bias across the image. MoWE instead uses a context-aware router to assign local regions to fixed wavelet families according to local texture and global feature context. The decoder reuses the encoder's spatial routing maps during the inverse transform. Learnable channel-wise gates rescale the high-frequency subbands before reconstruction. We evaluate MoWE with U-Net on four ultrasound lesion benchmarks (BUSI, TN3K, UDIAT, BUS-UCLM) and one cardiac dataset (CAMUS), and with nnU-Net on BUSI. On BUSI, MoWE improves U-Net Dice from 72.59\\% to 74.55\\% and reduces HD95 from 47.01 to 43.49\\,px. With nnU-Net, MoWE improves Dice from 80.18\\% to 81.97\\% and reduces ASSD from 20.07 to 17.25\\,px. On U-Net, MoWE reduces trainable parameters by 6.4\\%.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to WACV 2027

</details>

### 195. [MoCKEFA: Model-Conditioned Keyframe Extraction and Fair Attribution for Video Model Explanation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25075v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25075

**作者：** Lahiru Wijayasingha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25075v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25075v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MoCKEFA，以视频模型的预测为条件抽取少量关键帧，使模型对该视频的判断基本不变，并用 Shapley 值把视频的重要性公平分摊到关键帧上，通过定性与定量实验比较关键帧归因与传统逐帧归因，并初步探索相邻关键帧间的变化。

**相关性简评：** 「以模型预测为条件、用最少视觉证据维持模型判断」这一线索可能可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与信息充分性判断，Shapley 分摊也可能启发推理步与视觉输入的贡献分配；但该工作属视频模型可解释性，与多模态推理内部状态的联系需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoCKEFA: Model-Conditioned Keyframe Extraction and Fair Attribution for Video Model Explanation

**abstract/A1：** We show that a video can be represented with just a few keyframes without sacrificing a given model's belief about the video. Our method is the first of its kind that extracts these keyframes conditioned on the model's prediction, which is massively helpful for building explainable video models. We then fairly distribute the importance of the video to the model among the keyframes with game theoretically fair Shapley values. Through qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that keyframe attribution is superior to the traditional frame attribution. Further, we conduct preliminary exploration on highlighting the important changes among the frames by looking at the differences between adjacent keyframes.

</details>

### 196. [CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25078v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25078

**作者：** Jiaqi Su、Guibin Zhang、Jie-Jing Shao、Cong Pang、Tiankuo Yao、Ivor Tsang、Haiyan Yin、Shuicheng Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25078v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25078v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CoEvo-RSI，让 agent 的执行脚手架（harness）与模型检查点基于共享演化档案和执行反馈进行双向共同演化，以缓解「脑—体不匹配」，仅用自采样轨迹的 SFT 在多个垂直任务上提升 9B 模型表现。

**相关性简评：** 与 latent visual reasoning 主线无直接关系，但其检查点选择/合并与拒绝采样轨迹监督的协同机制，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练、监督信号分配与状态更新的配合提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?

**abstract/A1：** Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.

</details>

### 197. [Sufficient Frame Subsets for Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25084v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25084

**作者：** Lahiru Wijayasingha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25084v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25084v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Sufficient Frame Subsets：在掩码其余帧的条件下，搜索能独立保持模型预测的紧凑帧子集，并在 UCF101、Something-Something v2 上用 CNN 与 Transformer 架构评估其解释效果与失败案例分析价值。

**相关性简评：** 其「最小充分证据子集」的掩码搜索与预测保持这一充分性判据，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、以及 LOOK/STOP 是否已获取足够信息的判定提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是视频分类归因而非多模态推理，迁移需另行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sufficient Frame Subsets for Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Understanding when during a video a model makes its critical observations is essential for interpreting video-understanding systems. However, existing attribution methods often spread evidence diffusely across near-duplicate frames. We introduce Sufficient Frame Subsets: compact sets of frames in which all other frames are masked, yet each subset independently preserves the model's prediction. We evaluate our method on two complementary benchmarks, UCF101 and Something-Something v2, using both CNN- and transformer-based architectures. Our results show that the proposed algorithm identifies highly compact and effective frame subsets for explaining model decisions. We also find that models capable of relying on a greater number of sufficient frame subsets tend to perform better, possibly because they are more robust, consistent with prior research. Finally, the extracted frame subsets help us analyze model failure cases, reveal which aspects of a video the model has learned to emphasize, and identify opportunities for improving future training procedures.

</details>

### 198. [Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25092v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25092

**作者：** Hui Yang、Wan Tian、Tao Ren、Zhongyi Li、Yijie Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25092v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25092v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CSPO，用 conformal prediction 依据近期训练统计自适应校准序列级裁剪边界，替代 GSPO 的固定裁剪区间，并给出新分数越界概率及目标/梯度误差的界，在 Qwen3-1.7B 的困难数学推理基准与 ALFWorld 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 RL 训练方法，不涉及视觉输入或 latent 状态生成；但其「信用分配单元是序列而非 token」以及自适应校准裁剪区间（对应尾部预算随分布漂移变化）的思路，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督设计提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning improves the reasoning capability of large language models through verifiable rewards for mathematical and coding tasks. In token-level methods such as GRPO, clipping acts on individual token ratios while the reward and advantage apply to a complete response. Recent sequence-level methods align these units but still use fixed clipping bands, whose tail probabilities change as the score distribution evolves. We propose Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization (CSPO), which adaptively calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics. The resulting band targets a specified marginal tail budget and adapts to policy drift; calibration conditional on response length requires additional assumptions. We bound the probability that a fresh score falls outside the band by the target miscoverage level plus explicit CDF discrepancy and drift terms. Under additional moment conditions, this bound also controls the objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate. Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series show improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints that adapt during training.

</details>

### 199. [Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25096v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25096

**作者：** Jeonghwan Choi、Jibin Hwang、Hayoon Park、Hyeonjae Cheon、Hwanjun Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25096v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 RetailBridge 零售组合式基准（基于 persona 模拟、跨异构数据源连接实体与中间答案）与 RetailRAG 框架（自动 schema 简报、源路由计划链、诊断式计划修订），并在其上评估十个 LLM 主干，指出多源串联是主要瓶颈。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本 agentic RAG、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其源路由、跨源证据携带与计划修订机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 编排提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources

**abstract/A1：** Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assessing LLM agents on retail workflows. On RetailBridge, evaluating ten LLM backbones with RetailRAG reveals multi-source chaining as the dominant bottleneck across providers and model scales, suggesting that reliable retail agents require explicit cross-source orchestration rather than scaling alone. Code and data are publicly available at \\url{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/RetailBridge}.

**comment/C1：** Preprint. Under review

</details>

### 200. [ClinSDT: LLM-Encoded Clinical Semantic Guidance for Sepsis Treatment via Decision Transformer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25121v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25121

**作者：** Yanyan Wu、Guanyu Zhu、Changbin Zhao、Jin Zhang、Dexu Yu、Tianmin Sun、Jining Luan、Chunxiao Li、Hanwen Du、Youhua Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25121v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25121v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ClinSDT 用冻结 LLM 从 ICU 轨迹构造 Profile、Context、Advisory 三种临床语义视图，编码为独立 token 注入 Decision Transformer 策略，并训练治疗反应预测器筛选低不确定性、SAPS-II 改善更优的反事实候选，蒸馏回策略，在 MIMIC-III/IV 上做离线脓毒症治疗与闭环 rollout。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「冻结 LLM 语义编码作为独立 token 注入序列决策模型」和「不确定性门控的反事实候选筛选与蒸馏」可能为 latent 状态注入、候选证据筛选和监督贡献分配提供方法线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ClinSDT: LLM-Encoded Clinical Semantic Guidance for Sepsis Treatment via Decision Transformer

**abstract/A1：** Offline sepsis treatment aims to learn treatment policies from retrospective ICU trajectories. Decision Transformer-based methods provide a natural sequence modeling framework for this task, but they mainly rely on raw physiological states and historical clinician actions. Such raw trajectory tokens may not explicitly capture clinical semantics that clinicians use in practice, such as patient severity, recent treatment response, and current risk priorities. To address this limitation, we propose ClinSDT, an LLM-assisted Decision Transformer framework for offline sepsis treatment. ClinSDT uses a frozen LLM as a semantic bridge rather than a treatment decision maker. It constructs three clinical semantic views from ICU trajectories, namely Profile, Context, and Advisory, and inserts their encoded representations as independent tokens into a Decision Transformer policy. To support policy refinement and rollout, ClinSDT further trains a Treatment-Response Forecaster to estimate the next physiological state, SAPS-II change, and predictive uncertainty from state-action inputs. In the second training stage, the forecaster screens local counterfactual treatment candidates, and only low-uncertainty candidates with lower predicted SAPS-II increase are distilled into the policy after semantic regeneration. During inference, ClinSDT performs closed-loop treatment rollout by refreshing semantic inputs from the currently available patient state. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that ClinSDT achieves consistent relative improvements over representative imitation learning, offline reinforcement learning, and Decision Transformer baselines under the same rollout protocol. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KAG778/ClinSDT.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Full Research Track, Oral Presentation)

</details>

### 201. [Reflection-Guided Dynamics Rectification for Text-to-Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25139v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25139

**作者：** Shuo Xu、Hanrui Ying、Debin Liu、Jianjun Li、Zhiyuan Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25139v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25139v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Reflection-Guided Dynamics Rectification（RGDR），把对已完成输出的反思转化为对采样动力学在轨迹层面的校正干预，使每个采样步都接受即时干预，并在生成候选与参考之间进行判别；在额外生成预算匹配的设置下优于 TIR prompt refinement 与 Dynamic CFG。

**相关性简评：** 其「轨迹级反馈校正＋候选判别」的测试时动力学干预机制，可能与 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的迭代更新、候选验证与停止决策存在方法层面的借鉴线索，供核查是否能迁移到多模态推理状态而非仅图像采样。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reflection-Guided Dynamics Rectification for Text-to-Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Fine-grained rectification of existing generations under a limited additional budget remains a key problem in test-time optimization (TTO) for image generation. As for prior approaches, they could identify residual errors, but could not directly ensure that the model acts on the feedback during reasoning. Such errors stem from multiple sources, such as the initial noise or text prompt, and ultimately induce an execution gap of failing to handle potential deviations along the trajectory generating. However, classic models generally cannot remedy this gap. To narrow it, we propose Reflection-Guided Dynamics Rectification (RGDR), which turns reflections on completed outputs into corrective interventions on the process of sampling dynamics at the trajectory level. Specifically, RGDR could impact every sampling step by adapting to instantaneous intervention. Moreover, RGDR generates flexible candidates while adjudicating between them and the reference. As experiments show, rectification from RGDR starts from the existing base trajectory and reflection, and RGDR is substantially more effective than former trajectory exploration. Under matched budgets for additional image generation, RGDR's gain in the cross-model average final checklist score over the reference is $1.51\\times$ that of TIR prompt refinement and $1.81\\times$ that of Dynamic CFG.

**comment/C1：** This paper is 20 pages long, including the appendices, and contains 10 figures. Interactive demos, code, and the dataset are available on the project page: https://mair-lab-hust.github.io/RGDR/

</details>

### 202. [Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25150v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25150

**作者：** Kanishk Bakshi、Amitansu Pattanaik、Kathiravan Srinivasan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25150v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25150v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Knowledge Fusion Network：每个新任务先在独立的轻量 specialist 子网中学习，再经 Structural Fusion Module 按定量 novelty 分数分配专属通道容量完成融合，并以通道隔离与分阶段梯度解冻保护已有知识，在 Split CIFAR-100 与 EuroSAT 类增量分类上验证参数高效扩展。

**相关性简评：** 论文面向图像分类的持续学习，与 VLM 推理主线无直接关系；但其 novelty 门控的结构扩展与分阶段梯度解冻机制，可能为 latent 推理状态的持续更新、容量分配及避免信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior representations. We introduce the Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN), which mitigates the stability-plasticity trade-off in class-incremental learning through novelty-gated structural expansion rather than parameter negotiation within a shared capacity budget. KFN decouples task acquisition from knowledge consolidation: each incoming task is learned in an isolated lightweight specialist network (2.8M parameters) and integrated into the global model via a Structural Fusion Module that allocates dedicated channel capacity conditioned on a quantitative novelty score. Dual structural isolation--channel-space separation with temporally phased gradient unfreezing--protects consolidated knowledge. On ten-task Split CIFAR-100, KFN achieves 11.94% minimum task accuracy and 71.16% task-10 accuracy, whereas shared-parameter baselines degrade severely: LwF to 9.07% average accuracy (0.00% min), Replay++ to 8.91% (85.08% forgetting), and Replay to 16.21% (73.44% forgetting); KFN's forgetting (57.92%) is 15.5 pp lower than Replay. Furthermore, KFN prevents logit-scale drift, maintaining near-symmetric task performance. Across CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT satellite imagery, KFN's class-incremental retention (72.7% and 42.5%) substantially exceeds the best baselines (29.6% and 0.94%). Crucially, KFN achieves parameter-efficient linear scaling, adding 25% of the base parameter count per step and requiring 25.1% of naive backbone duplication over ten tasks (28.1M vs 112.0M). With a 37.1% peak GPU memory reduction over full retraining, KFN establishes novelty-gated expansion as a practical path beyond fixed-capacity architectures.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 7 figures, preprint

</details>

### 203. [M-JEPA: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs with Scaffold-Shift Evaluation on Tox21](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25163v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25163

**作者：** Karthik Iyer、Nasser Sabar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25163v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25163v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将JEPA适配到分子图自监督学习：掩码化学上连贯的连通子图，用上下文编码器回归EMA教师产生的被掩码目标嵌入，并提出三阶段评估协议，含Tox21在Bemis-Murcko骨架划分下的判别力-可靠性联合分析与归因诊断。

**相关性简评：** 掩码后于表示空间回归目标embedding、以EMA教师提供监督的做法，可能为LVR中latent状态预测与轨迹监督提供线索；但其对象是分子图而非多模态视觉推理，需核查这类预测目标是否伴随信息坍缩、以及其计算匹配与校准评估思路可否迁移到latent推理的成本与评价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** M-JEPA: Predictive Self-Supervised Learning for Molecular Graphs with Scaffold-Shift Evaluation on Tox21

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised molecular representation learning is increasingly used to improve transfer on small, label-limited property prediction tasks, yet commonly used contrastive objectives can be sensitive to view construction and are often evaluated with protocols that report only discrimination. We adapt Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) to molecular graphs by masking chemically coherent connected subgraphs and training a context encoder to regress the masked target embedding produced by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher. To evaluate predictive self-supervision under realistic distribution shift, we introduce a leakage-resistant, compute-matched three-phase protocol: (i) an 80-run objective screening on ESOL with fixed compute budgets, (ii) JEPA-only refinement of masking and augmentation choices, and (iii) per-assay Tox21 evaluation under Bemis-Murcko scaffold splits with joint discrimination-reliability analysis and attribution diagnostics. Under matched compute, M-JEPA achieves substantially lower ESOL proxy RMSE than a compute-matched InfoNCE baseline (mean RMSE 2.12 vs 3.75; mean paired dRMSE 1.61; 95% bootstrap CI \[1.52, 1.72\]; Wilcoxon p=2.4e-4) and typically completes runs faster (~15-25 min vs ~35-45 min on a single GPU under identical hardware), albeit with higher runtime variance. On Tox21, improvements in ROC-AUC/PR-AUC are assay-dependent and do not uniformly imply better calibration; reliability diagrams and Brier/ECE metrics reveal endpoints where fine-tuning improves ranking but leaves probabilities miscalibrated.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 9 figures. Submitted (pre-peer-review) version; the final published version appeared in J. Chem. Inf. Model

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoART: Geometry-Aware Refinement via Test-Time Scaling for Camera-Conditioned Video Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Camera-conditioned video diffusion models often suffer from inaccurate camera control and geometric inconsisten- cies because camera constraints and estimated geometry are only weakly enforced during denoising. Existing reme- dies often require costly geometry-aware fine-tuning or ad- ditional 3D supervision. We introduce GeoART, a training- free self-refinement framework that improves camera con- trollability through geometry-aware test-time scaling. At selected denoising steps, GeoART generates multiple can- didates within the Predict-and-Perturb cycle and eval- uates them using a geometry prior, without directly modify- ing the denoising trajectory. A confidence gate suppresses unreliable geometric evidence, while rank-calibrated prob- abilistic selection combines score magnitude and relative rank to choose the next refinement state. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in camera controlla- bility, multi-view consistency, and visual quality over exist- ing sampling and self-refinement methods, without training or modifying the pretrained video diffusion model

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 11 figures

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25281

**作者：** Donggyu Yoon、Minsung Hwang、Juneha Baek、Donghyuk Shin、Joyce Jiyoung Whang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.IR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25281v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25281v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建科学概念图（节点为 LLM 从论文文本抽取的细粒度概念、边为共现），提出 MiroGraph 多智能体框架：特征设计 agent 从结构、语义、趋势角度设计预测特征，三个 LLM agent 在概念对的子图上计算特征值，再由分类器设计 agent 构建分类器预测概念对影响力，并配套 CIKM/KDD/SIGIR 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「先由 agent 决定抽取哪些特征、再在子图上计算取值」的两段式流程，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、潜在状态该携带何种任务信息的问题相通，可供核查；但论文本身不涉及多模态或 latent 推理状态，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bridging Concepts: Multi-Agent Reasoning over Scientific Concept Graphs for High-Impact Research Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Within a research community, new topics often emerge when previously unconnected concepts are first studied together. We construct scientific concept graphs (SCGs)--domain knowledge graphs whose nodes are fine-grained research concepts extracted from paper text by LLMs and whose edges capture their co-occurrence in papers--and study the task of forecasting high-impact concept pairs, i.e., discovering concept pairs that are currently unconnected but will have high impact when connected. To this end, we introduce new benchmark datasets constructed from CIKM, KDD, and SIGIR conference papers, with varied prediction settings, including impact forecasting for emerging concepts unseen during training. We propose MiroGraph, a Multi-agent reasoning framework with scientific concept Graphs, in which a feature designer agent designs predictive features for a given concept pair from structural, semantic, and trend perspectives, and then three LLM agents compute the actual feature values from the enclosing subgraph of the concept pair. Using these feature values, a classifier designer agent constructs a classifier that predicts the final impact labels. MiroGraph outperforms various impact forecasting and temporal link prediction methods.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Knowledge-Enhanced Information Retrieval (KEIR) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)

</details>

### 206. [Learning Lane-Structured Conditioning Fields for Online HD Mapping](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25284v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25284

**作者：** Andrea Bertogalli、Anthony Dell'Eva、Marcello Ceresini、Federico Pirazzoli、Lorenzo Cipelli、Filippo D'Addeo、Nicola Marinello、Massimo Bertozzi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25284v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25284v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Lane Field：一种密集 BEV 对齐的几何表示，在每个空间位置编码局部车道结构，可由车载观测预测或由外部地图先验构建；并给出即插即用框架，通过 BEV 特征调制与可变形注意力引导提升在线 HD 地图构建，在 OpenLane-V2 车道段感知上达到 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 其把结构化几何先验注入 latent BEV 特征并引导查询采样的做法，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要几何信息如何写入内部状态」以及「先验如何指导 latent 状态生成与证据采样」提供方法线索，需人工核查其调制与注意力引导机制；属远领域工作，非多模态推理主线。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Lane-Structured Conditioning Fields for Online HD Mapping

**abstract/A1：** High-definition maps provide critical structural information for downstream autonomous driving tasks. Recent methods increasingly rely on external priors to improve prediction accuracy and robustness. Yet, existing prior representations expose a trade-off: dense rasters are easy to integrate but ignore certain map geometric properties, while sparse vectors preserve geometric structure but require dedicated encoders and are difficult to plug into existing architectures. Moreover, external priors can be inaccurate, costly to acquire, or difficult to maintain, motivating a structural representation that can provide geometric guidance while remaining learnable and broadly applicable. We address this limitation with the Lane Field, a dense BEV-aligned geometric representation that encodes local lane structure at each spatial location and can be either predicted from onboard observations or constructed from external map priors. Building on this representation, we introduce a plug-and-play framework that enhances online HD mapping through two complementary mechanisms: BEV feature modulation, which injects lane-structured cues into latent BEV features, and deformable attention guidance, which steers query sampling toward the underlying lane geometry. We primarily evaluate our method on OpenLane-V2, showing that conditioning BEV features and guiding deformable attention with local lane geometry enables our framework to consistently improve existing methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance on lane segment perception. Project page: https://andberto.github.io/LaneField/

</details>

### 207. [MotionShift: Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer via Planner-Evaluator Synergistic Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25290v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25290

**作者：** Yanchen Liu、Junyao Gao、Yanan Sun、Wensheng Chen、Guangming Lu、Wenjie Pei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25290v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25290v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MotionShift，用 LLM 作为 planner 生成运动轨迹、VLM 作为 evaluator 依据场景视觉理解迭代修正，从而在无训练条件下把参考运动迁移到目标场景，并作为条件驱动 I2V 模型渲染。

**相关性简评：** 虽属视频生成与运动迁移，但「planner 生成候选—VLM 视觉评估—迭代修正」的训练无关循环，可供核查其是否对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、验证与停止决策等状态更新机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MotionShift: Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer via Planner-Evaluator Synergistic Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Existing motion transfer methods excel at exact, rigid motion replication from reference videos to target scenes, whereas they often fail to account for the compatibility between the transferred motion and the target scene environment in accordance with physical laws. In this work, we propose MotionShift, a novel motion transfer framework that achieves high-fidelity motion transfer while ensuring physical compatibility with the target scene. In particular, we design a planner--evaluator iterative motion adaptation mechanism, in which a Large Language Model (LLM) acts as the planner to generate motion trajectories by leveraging its strong semantic reasoning capabilities, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the evaluator to rectify the motion based on its superior visual perception and scene understanding. Through this planner--evaluator synergistic reasoning process, the motion is adapted to the target scene in a training-free manner. The adapted motion is then used as a generative condition for an image-to-video (I2V) model to render videos in the target scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionShift achieves high-fidelity and physically compatible motion transfer across diverse and complex scenes. Moreover, we show that MotionShift can be readily integrated into existing trajectory-conditioned I2V models, endowing them with realistic motion transfer capabilities.

</details>

### 208. [Where Groups Split: A Probe Prior for Nonzero Within-Group Variance in RL Post-Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25325v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25325

**作者：** Jonah Ellison、Mateo Ruiz、Owen Pell、Tomas Duncun、Hanae Fujita、Ingrid Solberg、Caleb Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25325v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25325v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Aperture：用同一训练配方在池中小子集上训练一个 probe 模型，对每个 prompt 在基础模型与 probe 模型上分别打分，把两个通过率代入「训练组全错或分裂」的概率，作为静态先验对 GRPO 的 prompt 采样加权，以增加非零优势组比例、提升贪心准确率。

**相关性简评：** 其按「是否还存在学习信号」重新分配训练算力的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 训练中如何筛出仍有 latent 贡献、尚未坍缩的样本或轨迹；但纯文本 RL 后训练的采样调度，与视觉多模态推理状态无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Groups Split: A Probe Prior for Nonzero Within-Group Variance in RL Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** Group relative policy optimization learns from a prompt only when the rewards in the sampled group disagree. With a binary verifier, a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has within-group variance zero and a zero advantage. Uniform sampling continues to spend rollouts on prompts that are unanimous now and stay unanimous as training goes on. Pass rate is a weak forecast of that future. Two prompts at the same pass rate can move apart: one into the range where a finite group splits, and one toward a ceiling where the group becomes unanimous again. Aperture estimates the later pass rate from a short probe. A small subset of the pool is trained with the same recipe, every prompt is scored on the base model and on the probe model, and the two pass rates are plugged into the probability that a group of the training size is all wrong or split. The resulting weight is a static prior. It can be used alone or multiplied by an online scheduler, and the GRPO update is left as it is. On mathematical and logical reasoning with 1.7B and 4B models, the prior improves greedy accuracy over uniform GRPO and raises the fraction of groups with a nonzero advantage. The same prior still helps when it is combined with dynamic sampling or with selective rollouts.

</details>

### 209. [CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25333v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25333

**作者：** Lin Zhao、Bowen Chen、Qiaohui Gao、Shaowen Wan、Xiang Li、Wei Liu、Tianming Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25333v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25333v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把纵向 pCR 预测重构为世界建模问题，提出 CoRe-WM：用患者临床信息与治疗方案通过加性偏移和特征级调制来条件化隐状态转移，并设置因子化的「响应状态」通路分离治疗响应动态与成像外观，预训练后冻结全部参数、仅用线性读出做逐决策点预测。

**相关性简评：** 其隐状态转移建模、条件化状态更新与冻结表示加线性读出评估，可能为 LVR 提供「推理状态如何随证据更新」及「latent 中保留多少任务必要信息」的可核查线索；因子化通路分离动态与视觉外观的思路，或可对照视觉细节保留与信息坍缩问题，但属医学影像领域，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI

**abstract/A1：** Pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy is a key prognostic indicator in aggressive breast cancer, yet existing prediction approaches either rely on pretreatment imaging alone, missing the patient's evolving response, or optimize multi-visit classifiers under direct outcome supervision, coupling representation learning with the clinical endpoint. We formulate longitudinal pCR prediction as a world-modeling problem and propose Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM), which learns a latent state-transition model that predicts the next imaging state from the observed sequence. The transition function is conditioned on patient clinical profile and assigned therapy through additive shift and feature-wise modulation, enabling patient- and treatment-specific dynamics. A Factorized Response State pathway further decouples treatment-response dynamics from imaging appearance by encoding the structural prior that response manifests primarily in lesion morphology. After pretraining, all parameters are frozen and a linear readout predicts pCR at each clinical decision point. We evaluate CoRe-WM on I-SPY2 under five-fold cross-validation and assess cross-cohort transfer on I-SPY1. CoRe-WM achieves the highest discrimination among all evaluated methods at every prospective decision point, and demonstrates robust cross-cohort transfer. Ablation studies identify patient-profile conditioning and the factorized response pathway as the principal contributors. These results establish world-model-based representation learning as a promising framework for outcome prediction in oncology and beyond.

</details>

### 210. [CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25356v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25356

**作者：** Ilia Badanin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25356v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25356v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CHSM8：一个 2.1 亿参数的国际象棋 Transformer，在 10.7 亿局过滤后的 Lichess 棋局上预训练，能按自由文本风格提示（如「走西西里防御」「稳健无风险」）落子；用合成风格描述数据做 SFT（冻结文本编码器经门控交叉注意力接入）与 DPO，并完整公开流程、失败消融与千局评测。

**相关性简评：** 该文的 DPO 把「同一走法配错配风格描述」作为负样本，可用于检验模型是否真正使用了条件信号，这一监督设计可能为 LVR 中「答案是否使用 latent 内容」与贡献分配问题提供可核查的借鉴线索，但属跨领域推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts

**abstract/A1：** We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. Supervised fine-tuning attaches a frozen text encoder through gated cross-attention, and direct preference optimization (DPO) uses the same moves under a mismatched description as the rejected sample. After DPO, style adherence rises on every prompt we test (for example, queens traded early 53% -&gt; 67%, pawn moves 29% -&gt; 32% of all moves, queenside castling 97.3% -&gt; 99.7%), and strength without a prompt stays within noise of SFT (1792 vs. 1797 Elo). Design choices at every stage were made by fixed-budget automated search loops on top of standard architectures and training recipes. We document the full pipeline and the decisions behind it, report the ablations that failed, and evaluate the models across many style prompts and kinds of games, with 1,000 games per setting. The work is fully open source and reproducible: weights, datasets with all training labels, prompts, configurations, inference code and playable demos are public and free to build on.

</details>
