### 211. [LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25358v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25358

**作者：** Mohammad Omama、Aeyan Ashraf、Sandeep Chinchali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25358v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25358v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对深度特征匹配器在多图定位中的交互瓶颈，提出 LateMatch：把跨图交互推迟到网络末层，使图内处理成为可离线缓存的 Context Block，并用 E-SToRE 依据后层交互块的香农熵动态裁剪 token，从而降低在线计算量。

**相关性简评：** 「延迟交互 + 离线缓存图内表示」和熵引导的 token 约简，可能为 LVR 中视觉状态缓存复用、证据筛选与 token/状态压缩提供方法线索，但该工作面向图像匹配定位，是否可迁移到多模态推理期的 latent 状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization

**abstract/A1：** Visual localization is critical for embodied agents, but deploying state-of-the-art deep feature matchers on edge devices is fundamentally limited by their massive computational cost. Standard deep matchers tightly interleave intra-image context building and inter-image matching at every layer, creating a severe interaction bottleneck. Localizing a single query against K database images forces the system to execute the full network K independent times with no capacity for caching. To break this bottleneck, we advocate for a paradigm shift toward cacheable image matching. We realize this paradigm with LateMatch, a versatile approach that restructures existing matchers by deferring inter-image interaction to their final layers. By isolating intra-image processing into offline-cacheable Context Blocks, only a small set of Interaction Blocks must be executed online. To further optimize LateMatch, we introduce E-SToRE (Entropy-guided Spatial Token Reduction and Expansion). E-SToRE leverages the decreasing Shannon entropy of the late Interaction Blocks to dynamically reduce token counts just prior to cross-image interaction. Evaluated across HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth, ETH-3D, and Aachen, LateMatch reduces effective computational cost by over 2x compared to standard deep matchers, while E-SToRE yields an additional 10% to 14% savings with negligible degradation in accuracy.

</details>

### 212. [CD-OPD: Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25359v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25359

**作者：** Mingyuan Li、Yucheng Li、Xiaxia Wang、Gong Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25359v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25359v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文关注 on-policy 蒸馏中「教师接管」反而导致学生单独作答出错的现象，提出 CFR 指标量化该失败，并给出 CD-OPD：用教师生成的依赖图把先前上下文整理成节点摘要形成 Contextual Digest，再以在线元重加权提升学生的独立表现。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本蒸馏训练工作，与视觉推理无直接关联；但其按段梯度与任务梯度比较来决定更新权重的做法，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的监督信号与贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CD-OPD: Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Teacher takeover in on-policy distillation (OPD) can produce incorrect responses even when the student and teacher independently answer the same problem correctly, a failure we quantify using Collaboration Failure Rate (CFR). To address it, we propose Contextual Digest for On-Policy Distillation (CD-OPD). CD-OPD structures the earlier context of teacher guidance through a teacher-generated dependency graph, curating the required problem conditions and preceding reasoning as node summaries alongside the unchanged guidance in a Contextual Digest before student continuation. We further develop online meta-reweighting, which compares Digest segment gradients with a task gradient from independent student responses to improve student-only performance, favoring updates predicted to reduce task loss. Across eight benchmarks, CD-OPD improves average accuracy by 1.32--7.05 percentage points over representative existing OPD methods. It also reduces CFR by 27.4\\%--56.4\\% relative to existing takeover-based OPD methods.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ATLAS: Attention-Guided Test-Time Latent Selection for Compositional Visual Autoregressive Generation

**abstract/A1：** Visual autoregressive models produce convincing images but can misassign attributes and spatial relations. Searching multiple generation paths can improve composition, yet completing every candidate is costly. We introduce ATLAS, a training-free framework that uses the frozen generator's internal attention to guide search before final images are available. Within-prompt diagnostics identify attention-derived scores that predict final compositional preferences on Infinity, with category-dependent transfer to Switti. ATLAS uses these on-the-fly signals to progressively concentrate computation on promising trajectories. It maintains multiple coarse alternatives, prunes candidates without decoding at intermediate scales, and reserves image-space evaluation for a final choice among partial trajectories. ATLAS scales effectively on both backbones, achieving higher mean scores on the evaluated T2I-CompBench and GenEval categories as more computation is devoted to search. At the largest tested budget, the targeted T2I-CompBench mean improves by over 10% relative to each backbone. Separate profiles show over 50% less generation time than completing and evaluating all candidates at equal initial counts, alongside lower peak allocated GPU memory. Relative time savings are larger at the higher tested candidate count. Together, these results support scalable compositional search: additional sampling expands exploration, while attention-guided selection limits continuation cost without parameter updates or gradient-based optimization.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages

</details>

### 214. [RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25400v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25400

**作者：** R. D. Lin、Pengcheng Weng、Ge Wang、Han Ding、Fei Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25400v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25400v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RAHF-Net 做 LiDAR 辅助的 RGB 语义分割：用 C2P 把预训练柱状体素特征投影到图像平面以保留 3D 语义先验，再用深度导出的软 range mask 在近场做 LiDAR 引导的几何增强、远场做视觉上下文增强。

**相关性简评：** 该文的距离可靠性门控融合与几何先验投影，可能为 LVR 中按可靠性筛选视觉证据、以及在内部状态中保留几何信息提供方法线索，尚待人工核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** This paper studies LiDAR-assisted RGB semantic segmentation, where LiDAR point-cloud features improve dense pixel-wise predictions in the RGB image plane rather than 3D point labels or detections. Existing 2D fusion methods often project point clouds into shallow depth/range maps and apply spatially uniform fusion, discarding rich 3D structure and ignoring the range-dependent reliability of outdoor LiDAR. We propose RAHF-Net, a Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network. Its Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) module projects pretrained cylindrical voxel features into the image plane, preserving structured 3D semantic priors. A Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) module then uses a soft depth-derived range mask to perform LiDAR-guided geometric enhancement in reliable near-field regions and visual-context enhancement in sparse far-field regions. On KITTI-360, RAHF-Net achieves 65.76 mIoU, outperforming representative RGB-only and RGB-LiDAR baselines, including CMX by 1.45 points. Experiments on DELIVER further demonstrate improved robustness under adverse weather, illumination degradation, and sensor corruption.

</details>

### 215. [When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25402v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25402

**作者：** Xuyuan Liu、Xinshuai Dong、Elynn Chen、Yujun Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25402v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25402v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文先系统评测 LLM 在逻辑等价输入上预测是否一致，发现强模型也常失败、对未见逻辑形式泛化差；随后提出 LoGIST，将输入映射为决策图（DAG）并编码为 logical embedding，用以条件化 LLM 的推理过程。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本结构引导的 latent 推理：把显式结构图编码成隐向量条件化生成、并以逻辑不变性与未见形式泛化作为训练目标，可能可供核查 LVR 中内部状态的结构保持、不变性监督与泛化评价，但能否迁移到视觉/多模态状态尚需核验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. LoGIST maps each input instance to a decision diagram, a directed acyclic graph that captures the underlying logical structure, and encodes this graph into a logical embedding that conditions the LLM's reasoning process. Across multiple training settings, LoGIST reduces inconsistency under logical equivalence and improves generalization to unseen logical forms, suggesting that logical invariance is a useful target for building more robust and generalizable logical reasoning in LLMs.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, 24 Pages

</details>

### 216. [MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25404v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25404

**作者：** Houyuan Chen、Fanzhou Wang、Xiangyu Fan、Zesong Qiu、Yukun Wei、Songlin Yang、Zhitao Yang、Lvmin Zhang、Pei Yang、Hao Zhao、Lei Yang、Anyi Rao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25404v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25404v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MT Forcing 训练范式，用「单轮累积编辑」的教师模型监督学生的自 rollout 做分布匹配蒸馏（Single-Turn DMD），并引入 Teacher-Forcing Guidance 作为预热监督与蒸馏正则，以缓解多轮图像编辑中的视觉质量漂移与跨轮内容不一致。

**相关性简评：** 多轮自 rollout 与教师强制的混合监督、递归误差累积的规避、跨轮历史依赖状态的一致性约束，可能为 LVR 的 latent 轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是图像编辑而非视觉推理，需人工判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://houyuanchen111.github.io/mt-forcing.github.io/

</details>

### 217. [Preserving the Manifold: Frozen Expert Alignment for Label-Efficient SAR Scene Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25429v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25429

**作者：** Eli A. Underwood、I. Taylor McKechnie、Leslie M. Collins

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25429v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25429v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 SAR 与文本跨模态对齐中的模态失配与「物理遗忘」，提出 Frozen Expert 框架：冻结 CROMA SAR 编码器与 CLIP 文本编码器，只训练轻量约束残差桥，并用 Procrustes disparity 量化表征几何的漂移，在零样本 SAR 场景分类上以更少训练数据超过微调基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结编码器＋结构保持残差桥」及用 Procrustes 差异度量表示几何漂移的诊断方式，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否在内部状态被保留、跨模块对齐是否引发信息坍缩，但本身不涉及推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Preserving the Manifold: Frozen Expert Alignment for Label-Efficient SAR Scene Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Cross-modal alignment of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery to natural language is constrained by two distinct failures. The first is modality mismatch: text encoders pre-trained on optical imagery, such as CLIP, cannot be efficiently fine-tuned on SAR, because active microwave backscatter is physically incompatible with passive optical reflectance and the available SAR caption datasets are orders of magnitude too small to bridge this gap without substantially degrading the learned semantic manifold. The second is physical forgetting: SAR encoders pre-trained on large-scale self-supervised objectives encode radar physics that are progressively erased when the encoder is fine-tuned for text alignment on limited caption data. A single design principle addresses both failures: keep both encoders frozen and learn only a constrained, structure-preserving bridge. Our Frozen Expert framework aligns a frozen CROMA SAR encoder with a frozen CLIP text encoder via a lightweight constrained residual bridge. We formally define physical forgetting via Procrustes disparity and show our bridge preserves SAR geometry significantly better than fine-tuning (disparity: 0.210 vs. 0.351). We validate generality across multiple SAR backbones and text encoders. On zero-shot SAR scene classification, our approach outperforms fine-tuned baselines using up to 8x less training data: DFC2020 (+10.3% R@1, +15.5% mAP), EuroSAT-SAR (+15.7% R@1, +12.2% mAP), BigEarthNet-MM (+14.7% R@1). These results establish frozen manifold alignment as a principled, data-efficient alternative to fine-tuning in high-disparity cross-modal settings.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages. A shorter version of this work was presented at the ECCV 2026 Workshop TerraBytes II: Towards Global Datasets and Models for Earth Observation (non-archival)

</details>

### 218. [MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25431v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25431

**作者：** Sravanth Kodavanti、Manjunath Arveti

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25431v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25431v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MOSAIC 用多目标神经架构搜索为每个 decoder 层学习不同的 KV-cache 预算，使任意 token 淘汰方法都能按层分配缓存；一次搜索给出的分配可迁移到不同目标预算，在 Llama-3 与 Mistral 上多数设置优于均匀分配，且学到的分配偏向中间若干层。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 LLM 推理效率工作，但按层分配信息预算、并发现中间层更关键的结论，可能为「缓存与层深如何影响 latent 状态及其可保留信息」提供可核查线索；论文未涉及多模态或 latent 推理，需自行判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers

**abstract/A1：** The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

</details>

### 219. [Stepwise Reasoning Verification: Don't Generate, Classify!](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25441v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25441

**作者：** Yifei Shi、Michalis Korakakis、Rami Aly、Eric Chamoun、Lukasz Szpruch、Andreas Vlachos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25441v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25441v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作把步骤级推理验证重构为自然语言推理任务，以问题加部分解答前缀为前提、下一步推理为待分类假设，在五个推理数据集上比较编码器分类、解码器分类与解码器生成式判定，发现 0.15B 编码器分类器优于多数至 4B 的生成式验证器，且分类范式更省参数与标注。

**相关性简评：** 步骤级判别式验证器可能为 LVR 的推理链／latent 轨迹校验与停止、回退判据提供低成本组件线索；但该研究为纯文本设定，其对多模态内部状态是否适用尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stepwise Reasoning Verification: Don't Generate, Classify!

**abstract/A1：** Verifying the reasoning of large language models is increasingly important as they are applied to complex mathematical and scientific problems. Existing work focuses on large decoder models and reports mixed results for generative and discriminative verifiers, leaving unclear which paradigm is more effective and whether large models are necessary. In this work, we cast stepwise verification as a natural language inference task: the problem and partial solution prefix form the premise, while the next reasoning step serves as the hypothesis to be classified as entailed or non-entailed. This formulation enables error localisation at individual reasoning steps and direct comparison of encoder classification, decoder classification, and decoder verdict generation across model scales and annotation budgets. Across five reasoning datasets, a 0.15B encoder classifier outperforms most generative verifiers with up to 4B parameters. On identical decoder backbones, classification outperforms generation from 0.5B to 4B parameters and matches it on the strongest 7B backbone---reaching comparable performance with roughly one tenth as many annotated problems. Our findings establish classification as a parameter- and data-efficient approach to stepwise verification and show that strong verification does not require large generative decoders.

</details>

### 220. [Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25447v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25447

**作者：** Tomer Garber、Tom Tirer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25447v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25447v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究掩码扩散语言模型的机器遗忘，指出现有 MDU 的两个失效模式——随机答案掩码会让关键遗忘 token 对锚点可见、在近似 one-hot 预测处 anchor-last KL 的 logit 梯度消失；据此提出 EMDU，改为对答案跨度整体掩码的冻结锚点做 anchor-first KL，并在 TOFU、RWKU 上验证遗忘效果与保留能力的平衡。

**相关性简评：** 多步迭代去掩码生成、掩码粒度对状态泄漏的影响，以及 KL 方向选择导致的梯度消失问题，可能为 latent 推理状态的训练监督与逐步更新目标设计提供可供核查的线索；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移属推测，需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning

**abstract/A1：** Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional context. As these models reach real-world deployment, machine unlearning becomes essential. This process aims to remove the influence of a designated "forget set" without retraining from scratch, so that sensitive, copyrighted, or restricted content can no longer be elicited while preserving retained capabilities. Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU) is the first publicly available unlearning method customized for these models: it tunes the model $p\_θ$ to match a frozen prompt-masked anchor $p\_{\\mathrm{anchor}}$ on the forget set by minimizing the anchor-last divergence $\\mathrm{KL}(p\_θ\\Vert p\_{\\mathrm{anchor}})$. We identify two failure modes of MDU. First, random answer masking can leave key forget tokens visible to the anchor even when the question is fully masked. Second, at a memorized (near-one-hot) prediction, the anchor-last logit gradient vanishes while the anchor-first divergence $\\mathrm{KL}(p\_{\\mathrm{anchor}} \\Vert p\_θ)$ logit gradient does not. As a result, MDU training stalls on the tokens we most need to forget. Backed by theoretical and empirical analyses, we propose Enhanced Masked Diffusion Unlearning (EMDU): anchor-first KL divergence toward a frozen anchor whose entire answer span is masked. On TOFU and RWKU benchmarks using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, our EMDU matches or exceeds the forgetting of MDU and adapted AR baselines, while better preserving retain utility.

</details>

### 221. [System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25456v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25456

**作者：** Syed Usama Khalid Bukhari、Syed Safwan Khalid、Muhammad Aamir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25456v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25456v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 System X：在 LLM-as-judge 式决策读出中加入文本回复选项，命中该选项或置信度低时直接从决策的 KV cache 续写以省去重复 prefill，并用 LoRA 微调 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B，报告校准误差、路由准确率与端侧延迟变化。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本决策模型、无视觉输入，本不属主线；但其把 KV cache 当作可复用的内部状态并在低置信度时触发续写，可能与 LVR 关注的缓存/注意力结构与动态计算成本线索相关，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache

**abstract/A1：** Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PRIMA: Pose Refined Inductive Motion Adapter for Zero Shot Social Bodily Behavior Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Recognizing fine-grained bodily behaviors, such as self-grooming, postural shifts, and backchanneling, is a useful intermediate step for computational social signal analysis. But the behaviors that matter vary across social contexts, and retraining a model for each new taxonomy is expensive. Vision-language models (VLMs) can adapt to new categories through text prompts, yet they lack sensitivity to body structure and often confuse subtle postural distinctions. We propose PRIMA (Pose Refined Inductive Motion Adapter), a lightweight module that injects a body-structure prior into frozen VLMs using human pose as a training-time supervisory signal, requiring no pose input at inference. PRIMA separates a model-specific projection head from a shared core that encodes transferable body-configuration knowledge; adapting to a new VLM requires retraining only the head. We train PRIMA on a micro-action dataset and evaluate entirely through zero-shot prompting. The adapter improves recognition on its training domain, transfers to additional VLM backbones at different scales with the core frozen, and generalizes to two unseen target datasets from social psychology and daily activity recognition. In a supporting downstream study, the improved behavior predictions also yield higher correlations with human ratings of rapport and dominance in a collaboration context. Within the scope of the tested models and indoor datasets, the results indicate that pose-guided training can produce body-structure priors that generalize across unseen behavior vocabularies and can be partially reused across VLM backbones while preserving RGB-only inference.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026)

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「device-aware 器械抑制视图」可能为 LVR 中过滤干扰性视觉证据、按区域筛选视觉输入提供线索，可供核查；但本文是临床影像流水线，未涉及推理期状态生成或答案对视觉内容的依赖，关联偏间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues

**abstract/A1：** Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.

### 224. [Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25516v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25516

**作者：** Jithin VG、Ditto PS

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25516v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25516v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文介绍 Bud agent runtime 内置的上下文压缩（ContextCompact 2.0）：把较早轮次替换为摘要以延续会话，并在小模型的会话回忆问答与 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 端到端任务上比较压缩、截断与全历史三种策略，报告准确率/解决率与 token、时间成本，并做触发阈值研究。

**相关性简评：** 压缩在受限窗口下的有损状态替换、触发时机阈值、以及「推理回合耗尽历史剩余空间」的观察，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态保留取舍、计算预算分配与停止/触发决策提供可核查线索；但属纯文本 agent 上下文管理，与视觉证据和推理期 latent 生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows

**abstract/A1：** Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p &lt; 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.

</details>

### 225. [ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25517v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25517

**作者：** Abteen Arab、Guile Wu、Dongfeng Bai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25517v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25517v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReDT，一种前馈视觉几何 transformer：先将每个视角映射为固定数量的 basis token，在这一恒定规模的紧凑空间中计算对应关系，再投影回原分辨率做稠密预测，使内部表示与输入分辨率解耦，从而把多视图重建扩展到 2K 高清输入并提升效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定大小 basis token 工作区 + 分辨率解耦」思路可供核查：或可类比 LVR 中 latent 状态容量设定、以及分辨率/长度变化下的泛化与视觉细节坍缩问题，但属 3D 重建场景，迁移仅为可能。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer

**abstract/A1：** We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\\times$ speedup, a $34\\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \\href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}

**comment/C1：** Technical report

</details>

### 226. [Modaliff: A Unified Token Diffusion Model for Any-to-Any Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25533v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25533

**作者：** Duc Kieu、Kien Do、Minh Khoa Le、Tung Kieu、Dang Nguyen、Thin Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25533v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25533v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Modaliff，一种基于 token 的扩散模型，把条件与目标拼成统一 token 序列，配合 per-token 属性与 role-based positional embedding，在保留各模态原生 latent 序列的前提下由双模态对训练，实现文本、图像、音频间的任意到任意生成。

**相关性简评：** 其统一 token 序列布局、角色位置嵌入与「不做共享跨模态 latent」的设计，可能为 LVR 中多模态 latent 状态的组织、位置/角色编码及信息坍缩问题提供可供核查的方法线索，但原文面向生成而非推理，需进一步判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Modaliff: A Unified Token Diffusion Model for Any-to-Any Generation

**abstract/A1：** Any-to-any generation seeks a single model that translates flexibly among text, image, and audio, yet existing approaches either require fully aligned multimodal tuples or a shared representation that suppresses modality-specific structure. We introduce Modaliff, a novel token-based diffusion model that learns from widely available bimodal pairs while preserving each modality in its native latent sequence. Modaliff assembles conditions and targets into a unified token sequence, with per-token attributes to disambiguate token identities and role-based positional embedding to preserve each modality's internal structure across sequence layouts. This design enables a single denoiser to support diverse generation tasks without task-specific architectural changes or a shared cross-modal latent space. Beyond one-to-one generation, Modaliff supports multiple conditions either by combining single-condition predictions at inference or by lightweight finetuning on captions that jointly describe multiple inputs. Experiments across text, image, and audio show that Modaliff achieves the best fidelity among any-to-any models on most generation tasks while using substantially fewer parameters and training data.

</details>

### 227. [Editing as Language: Teaching LLM Agents a Grammar for Native Context Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25550v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25550

**作者：** Yunlong Deng、Yan Li、Xing Hu、Yida Zhu、Sean Du、Weiyang Liu、Guangyi Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25550v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25550v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Native Context Editing（NCE）框架，用一组专用特殊 token 构成「语法」把上下文编辑操作写入语言本身，并以迭代构建的轨迹片段（教师在演化上下文上给出编辑）训练 LLM agent 在长程推理与交互中自行修改上下文；在四个长程 agent 基准上提升成功率并显著减少 token 消耗。

**相关性简评：** 虽属纯文本 agent 工作，不涉及视觉输入，但把「状态修改」内化为模型原生生成能力、并以演化上下文上的教师编辑做轨迹级监督，可能与 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、控制 token 化与贡献分配/轨迹监督训练可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Editing as Language: Teaching LLM Agents a Grammar for Native Context Editing

**abstract/A1：** A synopsis in novels folds a story into a few lines; a function in code gathers many steps with a single execution. Context editing is native to language itself. In this paper, we propose the Native Context Editing (NCE) framework, which gives language model agents a grammar for natively editing their own context. By encoding context-editing operations in a grammar of dedicated special tokens, we teach the agents to invoke edits through the language itself. We train agents on iteratively constructed trajectory segments, with each teacher edit conditioned on the evolving context. This establishes context editing as an atomic and inherent capability of LLM agents, enabling them to dynamically modify their context as they generate responses over long-horizon reasoning and interaction. Compared with context-editing methods that learn to generate tool-use code within specific external harness environments, our approach integrates context editing as an internal mechanism of the model's native generation process, enabling better generalization across diverse real-world workflows. On four long-horizon agentic benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro), NCE improves the average task success rate over the base model by 5.6 percentage points for LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse and by 4.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, while reducing average token usage by 36% and 15%, respectively.

</details>

### 228. [Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25552v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25552

**作者：** Jinu Lee、Shraddha Barke

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25552v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25552v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Symbolic Constraint Agents 框架：从 API 文档挖掘符号约束、用执行轨迹精化，并在运行时用 SMT 求解器检查工具调用，违规时给出自然语言警告或在替换唯一时自动修复，在 AppWorld 与 τ²-bench 上提升任务成功率并减少失败调用。

**相关性简评：** 其「从文档挖掘约束＋用轨迹精化＋运行时校验与自动修复」的流程可能为 LVR 的中间推理状态验证、轨迹监督与修复/停止决策提供可核查的方法线索；但对象是文本工具调用而非视觉 latent 状态，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors

**abstract/A1：** Symbolic constraints (programmatic, deterministic checks for tool calls) enable deterministic verification of LLM agents' tool calls, but existing approaches primarily enforce predefined safety policies rather than tool dependencies in complex tool environments. We explore whether symbolic constraints can be mined from environments and observations beyond predefined policies, and whether they can improve end-to-end task performance. We present Symbolic Constraint Agents (SCA), a framework that mines symbolic constraints from API documentation, refines them against execution traces, and checks the agent's tool calls with an SMT solver at runtime. A violation triggers a natural-language warning or, when the valid replacement is uniquely determined, an automatic repair. On AppWorld, refinement raises error-detection F1 from 37.0 to 58.3 on GPT-5.5 traces and from 39.3 to 61.9 on Qwen3.5-27B traces. At runtime, repair raises GPT-5.4-mini's task success by 5.4 points under a 40-call budget and 9.8 points when environment errors are hidden, while removing 59--87\\% of failed calls across models, and transfers to $τ^2$-bench with gains of up to 5.6 points. These findings show that automatically acquired symbolic constraints can improve tool-calling reliability and task completion, particularly when failures are costly or difficult to diagnose.

</details>

### 229. [Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25577v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25577

**作者：** Nozomu Fujisawa

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25577v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25577v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Finite Interaction Lens（FIL），一种混合精度方法：在选定的线性投影处把每个候选输入分解为原生状态、两个单干预分量与满维混合残差，对单干预分量以更高精度投影并在联合候选中复用同一数值贡献，从而降低「联合效果减单独效果」四输出差分中被舍入误差淹没的部分，并在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 的一个 MLP 上以合成族与 COCO 四图研究验证误差下降。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成机制，但其对干预交互效应（joint 与 separate 之差）的可靠数值估计，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、视觉干预贡献与交互度量的评估做法，属需较多核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Identifying which visual interventions interact in a vision-language model requires comparing their joint and separate effects. The resulting four-output difference can be small enough for rounding error to obscure it. We introduce the Finite Interaction Lens (FIL), a mixed-precision method for evaluating finite intervention families. At each selected linear projection, FIL decomposes each candidate's input into a native state, two single-intervention components, and a full-dimensional mixed residual. It projects the single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses the same numerical contributions in the joint candidates, while retaining every mixed residual and nonlinear trajectory. We derive a local cancellation identity and a conditional bound on error propagation through a smooth nonlinearity. In one MLP of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, FIL reduces final interaction MSE by 94.4% on 16 synthetic families and by 99.85% and 99.35% in two separate four-image COCO studies, relative to a control that has the same nominal BF16-product budget and higher-precision single interventions but projects each joint candidate independently. One image accounts for most of the absolute gain in each COCO study. Higher-accuracy multi-product BF16 arithmetic on all candidates gives lower aggregate error at similar total query times. Single-product BF16 already recovers the reference choices in both candidate-selection tasks we tested. On these development inputs, FIL improves interaction fidelity at a fixed nominal precision budget. Its practical value depends on a task that needs the extra fidelity.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages

</details>

### 230. [CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25584v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25584

**作者：** Ankitkumar Joshi、Milos Hauskrecht

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25584v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25584v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CVTA，一个面向不规则采样多变量时间序列的短时连续时间预测框架：用变量条件嵌入把异质变量投影到各自 latent 空间，并基于一个紧凑可解释的近期动态状态做时序注意力，捕捉跨变量依赖，还可作为辅助模块经动态元决策接入现有预测模型。

**相关性简评：** 非多模态视觉工作，但其「紧凑状态 + 跨变量注意力 + 动态元决策组合」可能为 LVR 的内部状态摘要、跨实体（视觉 token）依赖聚合以及 latent 与外部计算模块的切换提供可核查的机制线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Irregularly sampled multivariate time series arise in many real-world domains such as healthcare, climate science, and large-scale monitoring systems. Characterized by asynchronous observations and heterogeneity across variables, such time series pose significant challenges for forecasting. In this work, we introduce Cross-Variable Temporal Attention (CVTA), a short-term, continuous-time forecasting framework that learns prediction functions from its compact, interpretable state summarizing recent temporal dynamics across variables. CVTA uses Variable-Conditioned Embeddings to project heterogeneous variables into variable-specific latent spaces, and applies temporal attention to capture cross-variable dependencies from this state. Furthermore, we demonstrate that CVTA can be integrated as an auxiliary module into existing state-of-the-art prediction models through a dynamic meta-decision model. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks show that CVTA achieves strong short-term predictive accuracy, supports efficient online inference, improves existing prediction models when used as an auxiliary module, and learns attention patterns that align well with domain knowledge.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Divergence based Ranked Preference Alignment for LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Alignment of large language models typically relies on pairwise preference feedback, though ranked feedback can capture more comprehensive information across multiple responses within a single annotation. However, ranked-preference alignment is underexplored in practice compared to simpler pairwise approaches, potentially resulting in suboptimal behavior. Concurrently, recent research has conceptualized large language model alignment objectives as divergence estimators between aligned (preferred) and unaligned (less-preferred) response distributions, resulting in a family of objectives with an interpretable theoretical foundation and strong empirical performance. This work unifies these perspectives by introducing $f$-RPO, a $f$-divergence objective for ranked preference optimization that extends divergence-based alignment to ranked feedback and recovers pairwise preference alignment as a special case. Our theoretical analysis establishes rank-order consistency, showing that $f$-RPO preserves the underlying preference ordering at convergence. Empirical results indicate that total-variation and reverse-KL variants of the proposed objective consistently outperform ranked-alignment baselines in both ranking and generation quality across Qwen, Llama, &amp; Gemma models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters.

</details>

### 232. [ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25595v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25595

**作者：** Bishoy Galoaa、Sarah Ostadabbas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25595v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25595v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ViMoLa 用空间向量量化自编码器把稠密轨迹压成 64 个离散运动 token，由小型 transformer 从文本预测，再通过零门控 cross-attention 适配器注入冻结的图像到视频骨干，以补上语言指令中的运动信息。

**相关性简评：** 其「离散 token 瓶颈 + 从文本预测 + 注入冻结骨干」链路及打乱 token 的对照消融，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何生成、注入以及如何检验其内容是否被真正使用提供可核查的方法线索，但主题属视频生成而非 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 tokens from a 512-entry codebook; a 28M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan~2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462K videos from Something-Something~v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 to 0.442 (chance 0.250), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283, supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 at 1.45% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 to 0.398. Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531, compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments.

</details>

### 233. [Adversarial Post-Training of Foundation Models for High-Frequency Trading](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25604v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25604

**作者：** Alexandre Bismuth、Kang Li、Aramis Marti-Shahandeh、Valentin Mohl、Jakob Foerster、Anisoara Calinescu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25604v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25604v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为限价单簿（LOB）基础模型提出对抗式后训练：以 Wasserstein GAN 形式，用经过真实匹配引擎的 rollout 在线训练 critic，并借 EGGROLL 演化策略对 rank-4 LoRA 扰动更新生成器，在 KL 信赖域下提升市场模拟的真实性与长时间 rollout 的误差累积表现。

**相关性简评：** 其用对抗 critic 直接监督自由运行 rollout、以缓解采样误差累积的思路，可能为 LVR 中长程 latent 轨迹训练、逐步贡献分配与误差累积诊断提供可核查的方法线索；跨领域迁移尚未验证，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adversarial Post-Training of Foundation Models for High-Frequency Trading

**abstract/A1：** While autoregressive foundation models trained on limit order book (LOB) data show state-of-the-art performance for market simulation, pre-training with cross-entropy neither penalizes the compounding of sampling errors over free-running rollouts nor targets desired market properties. We introduce a post-training method for LOB foundation models using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (GAN) objective. A critic, trained online on rollouts through the true, non-differentiable matching engine, guides updates from evolution strategies over rank-4 LoRA perturbations of the pre-trained generator, under a KL trust region. For efficiency, we use EGGROLL (Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning), a memory-efficient variant of evolution strategies. On a held-out panel, adversarial post-training improves LOB-Bench realism by 17.6% (WS-21) and 17.0% (Mean-$L\_1$), while selection-matched random-perturbation and compute-matched continued-pre-training controls yield no improvement. Post-training is thus a necessary stage that more pre-training does not replace. Per-position divergence measurements show that it slows error accumulation over 500-message rollouts from $3.1\\times$ to $2.3\\times$. Adversarial post-training is also inexpensive, requiring under 50M training tokens and 12 GPU-hours per seed, three orders of magnitude below the 48B-token pre-training budget. Ablations over critic inputs, optimizers, and the population-rollout trade-off, together with an analysis of reward hacking, yield practical design guidelines for adversarial post-training.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy. 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/alexandre-bismuth/WGAN-Post-Training

</details>

### 234. [CheXFuse: Guided Differential Joint Attention Fusion for Robust Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classification in Data-Scarce Medical Settings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25617v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25617

**作者：** Muntaqim Ahmed Raju、Priyanka Siddappa、Md Shifat Haider Al Amin、Ruizhe Ma、Md Ripon Ahammed

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25617v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25617v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CheXFuse 融合框架，用 Guided Differential Joint Attention 在联合 token 序列中引导强调信息性表示、以差分注意力削弱低价值注意响应，并在 IU 胸部 X 光数据集上做正常/异常二分类，含原始报告与遮蔽报告两种设定。

**相关性简评：** 其差分注意力抑制冗余跨模态响应、并借 token 引导突出有效表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与信息坍缩问题提供可核查的注意力结构线索；但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成过程，仅作方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CheXFuse: Guided Differential Joint Attention Fusion for Robust Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classification in Data-Scarce Medical Settings

**abstract/A1：** A central challenge in multimodal learning is how to fuse modalities that differ substantially in predictive strength. When one modality provides a much stronger representation than another, indiscriminate cross-modal interaction can introduce weak, redundant, or unstable signals, limiting or even degrading performance relative to the strongest unimodal representation. To address this problem, we propose CheXFuse, a multimodal fusion framework based on Guided Differential Joint Attention (GuDJA). CheXFuse combines image and text token representations within a joint multimodal sequence, where learned token guidance emphasizes informative representations and differential attention reduces less useful attention responses. We evaluate CheXFuse on the Indiana University (IU) Chest X-ray dataset, using binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification as the downstream task. Experiments are conducted under both original-report and masked-report settings, with the latter serving as a controlled stress test under reduced textual informativeness. CheXFuse with GuDJA achieves the strongest mean overall performance across the evaluated baselines and ablations, reaching 95.73% accuracy, 95.79% F1-score, 96.54% recall, and 95.28% sensitivity at 95% specificity (Sens@95Spec) with original reports, and 95.58%, 95.60%, 95.60%, and 94.34%, respectively, under masked reports. These results suggest that GuDJA provides a promising fusion strategy under asymmetric or partially reduced modality informativeness.

**comment/C1：** IEEE ICDM DMBIH 2026

</details>

### 235. [Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25621v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25621

**作者：** William L. Tong、Aryo Lotfi、Emmanuel Abbe、Josh Susskind、Cengiz Pehlevan、Eran Malach

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25621v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25621v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 weighted state souping：为独立编码各文本块得到的 SSM 缓存状态学习 query-dependent 组合权重，以低成本构造长上下文，并给出稀疏变体与关于 souping 何时有效的理论讨论。

**相关性简评：** 其把上下文压缩为可缓存 latent 状态、再按查询选择性组合的机制，与 LVR 中 latent 缓存复用和视觉证据筛选问题结构相近，可供核查能否迁移到多模态状态组合与检索式推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM independently encodes chunks of tokens like documents, tool definitions, or memory records. The resulting state encodings may be cached and recombined to cheaply construct a context for downstream queries. However, both state souping and vanilla SSMs deteriorate on long, crowded contexts, limiting their utility for long-horizon domains. To address this issue, we propose weighted state souping, a simple method that learns query-dependent weights for composing cached states. The resulting models improve long-context performance substantially across both single- and multi-hop document question answering, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking, and tool use. Our method can be further adapted into an efficient sparse variant, yielding near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length while preserving (and sometimes improving) performance. We also present simple theoretical arguments that illustrate why souping works and when it may fail, and discuss informally the advantages of weighted souping. Weighted state souping thus combines reusable context representations with selective retrieval, offering an efficient approach to language modeling over large collections of documents, tools, and other forms of structured context that increasingly dominate modern agentic workloads.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 236. [Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25622v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25622

**作者：** Sofia McLeod、Mohsi Jawaid、Carl Seubert、Tat-Jun Chin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25622v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25622v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对慢速相对运动与低照度下事件相机信噪比骤降的问题，提出用循环视觉 Transformer（RVT）做航天器位姿估计，以循环记忆跨稀疏事件流保留长期信息，并从完整轨迹学习时间注意力跨度而非固定时间窗。

**相关性简评：** 其循环记忆与可学习时间注意力跨度可能为 LVR 中循环式推理状态更新、动态计算与证据聚合提供方法线索，但任务属位姿估计，状态更新机制能否迁移仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions

**abstract/A1：** Vision-based object pose estimation is vital for conducting spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO). Recent research has demonstrated the robustness of event cameras against the harsh lighting conditions that often occur in orbit, thanks to the extremely high dynamic range of event sensors. However, event-based spacecraft pose estimation (EBSPE) suffers when the relative motion between the chaser and target is slow, since the event rate drops significantly, leading to data with low signal-to-noise ratio. Unfortunately, for safety reasons, real RPO trajectories often involve slow relative motions (e.g., down to 1 mm/s), and operating under low illumination exacerbates the problem. Addressing slow relative motions is thus crucial to raise the practicality of EBSPE. To this end, we propose using recurrent vision transformers (RVT) for EBSPE. The key idea is to exploit recurrent memory to capture longer-term information across sparse event streams, and to learn the temporal attention span from full trajectories rather than fixing the time window. We developed an RVT-based heatmap regressor to produce 2D-3D correspondences for pose estimation, which was validated on real event data collected under slow relative motions representative of RPO trajectories. Results indicate the superior pose estimation accuracy and stability of our RVT-based method, relative to previous per-event-frame-based or fixed-time-window EBSPE methods.

</details>

### 237. [Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25625v1>)

**作者：** Fengfei Yu、Marshall Fisher、Isadora White、Sumanth Varambally、Yasaman Jafari、Shivam Yadav、Samuel M. Bartlett、Shawn Roj、Benjamin J. Moore、Michael D. Warner、Luyu Han、Zhirui Xia、Duncan Watson-Parris、Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick、Yian Ma、Rose Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Zephyrus-R1，用 agentic RL 训练视觉-语言模型在工具调用环境中收集并分析预报证据、生成天气预报报告；方法核心是气象评分标准加双向 claim entailment 的奖励设计、由可验证问题过渡到开放式报告的课程学习，并以气象学家标注审核 LLM 评委。

**相关性简评：** 与主线无直接关系，但其「先可验证子任务、后开放式输出」的课程设计和多组分奖励，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取与 latent 状态监督、贡献分配的训练安排提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key method for training AI models in scientific applications, but RL remains difficult when outputs cannot easily be verified against a known ground-truth answer. Natural-language weather forecast reports are one such domain: they translate atmospheric data into assessments of weather evolution, hazards, and uncertainty for both the general public and key decision-makers. Unlike numerical weather-analysis questions, they admit many valid outputs, which limits deterministic verification. To address this, we develop Zephyrus-R1, a practical framework for RL on scientific weather forecast reporting. We focus on three key components of the agentic RL pipeline: reward design, curriculum learning, and an analysis of human-expert alignment. To encourage both report legibility and factual accuracy, we design a reward function that combines a meteorological rubric with bidirectional claim entailment, both evaluated against National Weather Service reference reports. Our framework optimizes this reward in a simulated tool-calling environment, enabling vision-language agents to gather and analyze forecast evidence across regions and lead times before producing a report. We use annotations from three meteorologists to audit the claim labels produced by our LLM judges. Finally, a curriculum helps small models first develop tool use and scientific reasoning through RL on verifiable weather-analysis questions, then optimize the open-ended report reward. After training Qwen3.5-4B with Zephyrus-R1, we improve the mean across six judge-metric scores by 26% over the base model and achieve results competitive with frontier open-weight models. For Qwen3.8-27B, we improve the same mean by 13% over the base model, by 6.7% over Kimi-K3, and by 2.7% over GPT-5.6-Luna.

### 238. [Conditional Average Treatment Effect Distillation for Hypothetical State-Intervention Targeting Under Budget Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25627v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25627

**作者：** Vasundhara Acharya、Bülent Yener

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25627v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25627v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在预算约束下的个性化公共卫生干预目标定位任务中，将 Causal Forest 与 Bayesian Causal Forest 教师估计的 CATE 蒸馏为决策树和随机森林学生策略，并与 K-means 分组策略、因果树策略对比评估。

**相关性简评：** 非视觉任务，但其决策导向的教师-学生保真度度量与预算受限分配评估，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 监督是否被策略真正使用（贡献分配、信息坍缩诊断）以及算力预算下的策略简化与评价问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conditional Average Treatment Effect Distillation for Hypothetical State-Intervention Targeting Under Budget Constraints

**abstract/A1：** Personalized public-health targeting must capture heterogeneous intervention benefits while remaining interpretable under resource constraints. Flexible causal-effect models can be hard to operationalize, while coarse subgroup policies may lose individualized effect information. We study budget-constrained hypothetical state interventions in observational data without a logged historical decision policy. For obesity, elevated glucose, and lifetime smoking-history states, causal-structure-informed pretreatment covariates are prespecified, with capacity capped at 70% of those observed in the adverse state. We evaluate causal distillation where Causal Forest and Bayesian Causal Forest teachers estimate conditional average treatment effects (CATEs), which decision tree and random forest students approximate. We compare individualized policies with unsupervised K-means subgroup policies and supervised causal-tree policies with leaf counts matched to K-means cluster counts. Observational policies are assessed on held-out data using a doubly robust estimator, bootstrap uncertainty, and decision-focused teacher-student fidelity measures. Across PIMA obesity and glucose and NHANES smoking-history experiments, each distilled student was within 0.011 absolute utility of its teacher, with allocation Jaccard similarities of 0.738-0.937. K-means and causal-tree policies were also competitive, with the highest point-estimate policy varying by application. Prespecified paired comparisons were nonsignificant after Holm adjustment, while near-budget-boundary agreement was less stable than global fidelity for some teacher-student pairs. Findings support causal distillation for translating flexible effect models into simpler budgeted targeting rules, although observational estimates depend on causal-identification assumptions and require longitudinal or prospective validation.

**comment/C1：** Under review at PLOS ONE

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究相机弱监督3D语义占据中的稀疏高斯表示，发现像素级渲染损失使前景小目标获得的高斯密度偏低，为此提出仅训练期使用的前景吸引损失：将前景伪标签像素按伪深度反投影，把附近高斯拉向这些3D点并偏向已预测目标类别者，推理网络不变，从而提升前景高斯密度与前景IoU。

**相关性简评：** 训练期监督把有限表示容量集中到任务关键视觉区域的思路，可能对 LVR 中「潜在状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节」以及监督信号如何塑形内部状态提供可核查线索；但其对象为3D占据的几何原语，与 VLM 推理期 latent 生成距离较远，需较多核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy

**abstract/A1：** Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 240. [Confidence-Guided Pseudo-Label Refinement for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25633v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CGPLR，一种面向无监督跨域行人重识别的置信度引导伪标签精炼框架：由质心兼容性、局部邻域一致性、与最强竞争簇的可分性及时间分配稳定性联合估计样本级可靠性，据此导出簇自适应上下阈值做保留／重分配／延后的三路选择性决策，并采用置信加权、谨慎纠正加权与无标签一致性等差异化监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「可靠则监督、可疑则重分配、模糊则延后」的三路选择性决策与置信度加权监督，可能为 LVR 中不确定 latent 推理轨迹的监督分配与贡献分配提供可核查的线索；但对象为行人重识别的伪标签噪声，与多模态推理关联较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Confidence-Guided Pseudo-Label Refinement for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification

**abstract/A1：** Unsupervised cross-domain person re-identification remains challenging because domain shifts generate noisy pseudo labels that are reinforced during iterative adaptation. Existing clustering-based methods often rely on limited reliability cues or global confidence criteria and may impose hard identity supervision on ambiguous target samples. To address these limitations, we propose CGPLR, a confidence-guided pseudo-label refinement framework for unsupervised domain-adaptive person re-identification. CGPLR estimates sample-level reliability by jointly modeling centroid compatibility, local neighborhood consistency, separation from the strongest competing cluster and temporal assignment stability. The resulting confidence distribution is used to derive cluster-adaptive upper and lower thresholds for a three-way selective decision. Reliable assignments are preserved, recoverable samples are reassigned only when an alternative cluster receives sufficient geometric and neighborhood support and highly ambiguous samples are deferred from hard identity supervision. The learning objective adapts to these decisions through confidence-weighted supervision for preserved samples, cautious corrected-label weighting for reassigned samples and label-free representation consistency for deferred samples. CGPLR achieves 76.4% Rank-1 accuracy and 47.6% mean average precision (mAP) on Market-1501 to MSMT17, and 95.1% Rank-1 accuracy and 87.7% mAP on MSMT17 to Market-1501, demonstrating effective reliability-aware selective adaptation. The code is available at https://github.com/Sundas058/CGPLR.

</details>

### 241. [Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25634v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25634

**作者：** Wenqing Wang、Joonghyuk Shin、Jonathan Tremblay、Chan Hee Song、Yun Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25634v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25634v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对自回归视频扩散模型的暴露偏差与误差累积漂移，提出 Clean Forcing：在冻结基座上训练 5.9M 参数的 LoRA 纠正器回归反事实速度差，并用闭环 DAgger 聚合与漂移收缩目标训练。

**相关性简评：** 其冻结基座纠正器、反事实 gap 回归与自 rollout 闭环训练，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹漂移抑制、长程长度泛化与训练期监督分配提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate streaming video of arbitrary length by conditioning each new chunk of frames on those already generated. However, they suffer from exposure bias, where a model trained on clean context must continue from its own imperfect outputs, and errors compound until quality collapses within seconds (drift). Existing methods either require cluster-scale base retraining, apply training-free inference corrections with inconsistent results, or train frozen-base correctors for sampling and cache errors. We instead find that drift is largely deterministic and therefore learnable, as holding the noisy state fixed while varying only the history reveals a counterfactual velocity gap that is ~95% systematic across noise seeds. Based on this observation, we introduce Clean Forcing, which trains a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector on the frozen base model to regress this gap, with a closed-loop stage that adds DAgger-style aggregation and a drift-contraction objective to expose the corrector to its own rollouts. Because the clean histories can be the base model's own single-shot generations, training needs no real videos, and the merged corrector adds no inference cost. In 50 s text-to-video generation, Clean Forcing reduces Δ-drift from +11.3 to +1.65 without real video and to -0.16 with 40 real clips, improving on the best published result of +3.57 with over 150x less data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Clean Forcing outperforms prior methods in aesthetic quality and data efficiency with reduced drift for long-horizon video generation.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://clean-forcing.github.io/

</details>

### 242. [ACorD: Adaptive Correspondence Discovery for Medical Image Registration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25638v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25638

**作者：** Arghavan Rezvani、Kun Han、Xiaohui Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25638v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25638v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ACorD 提出一个医学图像配准框架：先用相关性引导的跨尺度偏移预测（CCOP）生成多个候选对应，再用多头可变形聚合（MHDA）以注意力对这些候选做非均匀加权，在由粗到细的细化中抑制误差传播。

**相关性简评：** 对多个竞争候选做注意力加权聚合而非等权处理、并抑制跨尺度误差累积，可能可供核查 latent 假设的筛选与合并以及迭代推理状态的错误传播问题，但该线索来自远领域，迁移可行性需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ACorD: Adaptive Correspondence Discovery for Medical Image Registration

**abstract/A1：** Medical image registration is a fundamental task for aligning anatomical structures across images. Exhaustively searching for point-wise correspondences is prohibitively expensive in both computation and memory, particularly for high-resolution 3D medical images. Most recent learning-based methods directly predict correspondences in a coarse-to-fine manner, but often propagate intermediate estimates across scales without explicitly weighting correspondence evidence, which can allow coarse-scale errors to persist during refinement. To address these challenges, we propose ACorD, an adaptive correspondence discovery framework designed to mitigate error propagation with an attention-guided process. ACorD first predicts multiple potential correspondence candidates through Correlation-guided Cross-scale Offset Prediction (CCOP), which combines correlation maps as spatial matching priors with cross-scale features as global deformation context. Then, Multi-Head Deformable Aggregation (MHDA) aggregates these candidate correspondences using attention, producing a learned, non-uniform weighting over competing matches rather than treating them equally. The multi-head design further captures complementary deformation patterns, ensuring both global alignment and local precision. By integrating adaptive offset prediction with selective, attention-based aggregation of correspondence evidence, ACorD enables accurate deformation refinement. Extensive experiments on four public medical registration benchmarks demonstrate that adaptive correspondence discovery within a multi-scale refinement framework improves registration robustness across diverse anatomical structures.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25641

**作者：** Tianqi Wei、Zhi Chen、Xin Yu、Scott Chapman、Zi Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25641v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25641v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ViTA-SAM：在 SAM 3 之上构建视觉记忆模块，将支持样本特征与掩码编码为支持感知的视觉引导，并以跨模态对齐模块把文本语义先验条件化到记忆增强的视觉表示上，再用伪标签精炼策略以预测掩码更新记忆，用于跨模态少样本分割。

**相关性简评：** 其「记忆读入—查询自适应更新」结构及用自身预测掩码做伪标签监督的机制，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的维持、迭代更新与监督来源存在可核查的方法线索；但论文任务是分割而非多模态推理，无显式推理状态生成，联系偏弱，需阅读正文确认是否具备可迁移的状态更新设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Memory and Textual Alignment for Cross-Modal Few-Shot Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment target objects with limited annotated examples. Recent studies have begun to explore large foundation models to improve generalization for this task. In particular, SAM 3 provides strong visual representations and supports text-guided segmentation. However, its performance remains limited in specialized domains, where semantic prompts and visual representations are often poorly aligned. To address this challenge, we propose ViTA-SAM, a framework built upon SAM 3 that integrates visual memory and textual features through cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we construct a visual memory module that encodes support features together with their corresponding masks, providing support-aware visual guidance for query prediction. In parallel, we leverage the text encoder of SAM 3 to extract semantic features as complementary priors. To bridge the gap between semantic and visual representations, we introduce a cross-modal alignment module that conditions textual features on memory-enhanced visual representations, yielding more consistent and visually grounded predictions. In addition, we propose a pseudo-label refinement strategy that updates the memory with predicted query masks, enabling query-adaptive representation learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ViTA-SAM achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, outperforming the strongest competing method by over 5% in average mIoU.

</details>

### 244. [Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25645v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25645

**作者：** Sooyeon Park、Hemraj Singh、Kyunghyun Min、Youngjae Yu、Sung-Bae Cho

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25645v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25645v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 Dero：用辅助提示构建语义保持子空间与偏置子空间，通过双向 SVD 解耦纠缠的文本嵌入并选择性重组，以缓解文生图扩散模型中的否定语义失效问题。

**相关性简评：** 其按「语义 / 偏置」方向分解表征再选择性重组的做法，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要视觉证据与干扰语义、筛选 latent 假设提供可供核查的线索；但作用对象是文本嵌入与图像生成，能否迁移到多模态内部状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Negation-aware image generation remains challenging for text-to-image diffusion models, which often struggle with negation due to implicit linguistic biases that are deeply entangled within text representations. As a result, bias-aligned semantics frequently dominate over intended negative constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a simple training-free method of Decompose and Recompose text embedding (Dero), which constructs a semantic-preserving subspace and a bias subspace using auxiliary prompts and performs semantic disentanglement based on bidirectional SVD. By decomposing entangled representations and selectively recomposing disentangled semantic components, Dero realigns text representations toward intended negation semantics while restoring residual stylistic features to preserve semantic fidelity and image quality. As a model-agnostic inference-time framework operating solely on text representations, Dero can be seamlessly applied to diverse diffusion architectures, including both U-Net and DiT based models. Extensive experiments on both object- and concept-level negation demonstrate consistent improvements in negation-aware image generation, achieving stronger text-image alignment, better semantic fidelity, and higher human preference scores.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25651v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25651v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 OPDArena 框架，在五个预训练模型与多种教师来源上对比 SFT、RLVR 与 on-policy distillation，联合评估目标任务学习、通用能力保持和预测分布变化。

**相关性简评：** 其用「教师相对学生预训练模型的额外信息」解释更新集中度，并区分域内/域外分布变化与遗忘，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中的监督信号贡献分配与状态分布漂移诊断提供可核查的方法线索，但本文仅涉及纯文本后训练，需人工判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OPDArena: Understanding Learning and Forgetting in On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly used for language model post-training, yet how teacher supervision shapes learning and forgetting remains unclear. We present OPDArena, a framework comparing supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), and OPD across five pretrained models and diverse teacher sources. It jointly evaluates mathematical learning, general capability retention, and predictive distribution changes. Teacher choice strongly shapes retention: students of RLVR-trained teachers improve on the target task while retaining prior capabilities, whereas students of SFT-trained teachers incur greater capability loss. Across post-training methods, out-of-domain (OOD) distribution change shows a more consistent positive association with forgetting than in-domain change. To understand how teacher choice affects these changes, we examine the additional information teachers provide relative to the student's pretrained model. Controlled teacher comparisons show that the task-specific preferences teachers acquire through post-training make student updates more concentrated in-domain.

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FluidGen，向预训练视频生成模型注入数据驱动的流体先验：用双流架构在生成 RGB 的同时预测逐帧速度场，并以 Houdini 模拟真值监督该物理隐量，再用速度感知的 DPO 作为奖励来正则化生成运动的物理一致性。

**相关性简评：** 「观测 + 隐物理场」双流预测、用真值监督该隐量并将其作为偏好优化奖励的设计，可能为 VLM 推理中 latent 状态的辅助监督方式与贡献分配／奖励构造提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作在视频生成领域，联系需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FluidGen: Physics-Aware Fluid Video Generation via Motion-Guided Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** Video generation models produce visually compelling motion but systematically fail on fluid phenomena, including smoke, fire, and explosion debris, where outputs lack coherent vortical structure and collapse to bland dynamics that violate the physics of real fluids. Classical solvers achieve high physical fidelity but require detailed 3D scenes and carefully tuned parameters, making them impractical for in-the-wild imagery and video generation. We address this gap by injecting a data-driven fluid prior into a pre-trained video model, trained on a mixture of high-fidelity Houdini simulation data with paired velocity-field ground truth and curated in-the-wild fluid video data for appearance diversity. The core of our approach is a dual stream architecture that predicts per-frame velocity fields alongside RGB, supervised by simulation ground truth. This auxiliary signal regularizes generation toward physically consistent motion and exposes an interpretable physical quantity that we further leverage as a reward for velocity-aware direct preference optimization. Our model produces substantially more realistic fluid dynamics sequences than strong video baselines and optimization-based methods. Project page: https://y-zheng18.github.io/FluidGen/
