### 247. [PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25664v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25664

**作者：** Liwei Lan、Hui Chen、Jungong Han、Guiguang Ding

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25664v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25664v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PoSTCache，一种免训练、即插即用的扩散缓存框架，将缓存重构为可修订的轨迹推理：先用现有缓存策略为被跳过的步生成前向提案，再利用后续完整计算步中刷新预测与提案的差异作为修正信号，反向精化并重整合前面的预测；同时提出 PVR 策略，依据跨时间步依赖估计期望不确定性下降来选择计算锚点。

**相关性简评：** 用后续完整计算反向修正早前近似的做法，以及按期望不确定性下降而非局部误差挑选计算锚点，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新、动态计算与停止决策提供方法线索，可供核查；但研究对象是图像/视频生成而非多模态推理，迁移可行性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion and flow matching models achieve impressive visual generation quality but remain computationally expensive due to iterative sampling. Caching-based acceleration provides a practical training-free solution by reusing or predicting intermediate features. However, existing methods largely enforce a forward-only information flow: approximations produced for skipped model evaluations are immediately committed to the sampling trajectory and cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full-computation steps. We propose \\textbf{PoSTCache} (\\emph{Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache}), a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference. PoSTCache first uses an existing caching strategy to construct forward proposals for skipped steps. At a later full-computation step, the discrepancy between the refreshed prediction and its forward proposal yields a correction signal, which PoSTCache propagates backward to refine and reintegrate the preceding predictions. Viewing full-computation steps as sources of corrective feedback also changes how they should be selected. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and selects anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty rather than local approximation error alone. Experiments on representative image and video generation models show that PoSTCache consistently improves the quality--efficiency trade-off over representative caching methods.

**comment/C1：** 37 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 248. [Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25666v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25666

**作者：** Yian Zhao、Yu Yan、Hongcan Guo、Ruochong Zheng、Jian Zhang、Jie Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25666v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25666v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Fréchet Forcing：在短片段上联合微调流式视频世界模型与其多步采样器，用「生成锚定」的流匹配损失、对 rollout 隐统计的 Fréchet 距离上下文保真约束、以及到真实帧的真实感匹配三项约束，使模型在 4000 帧以上长展开中保持稳定并遵循动作。

**相关性简评：** 以自生成 rollout 的真值锚定加真实数据统计约束来抑制长程漂移，可能可供核查 LVR 中自生成 latent 历史的轨迹训练、误差复利与停止/继续判据如何监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips

**abstract/A1：** Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LOOP，将逐层剪枝与短程 on-policy 蒸馏交替进行（多次 shot，每次只删一层），并复用恢复阶段的 on-policy 轨迹与优化信号来评估剩余各层的推理贡献与恢复敏感度，从而让层选择「恢复感知」；在多个基准上平均准确率优于一次性剪枝基线。

**相关性简评：** 研究纯文本 LLM 的层级剪枝，不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 推理；但其「用 on-policy 轨迹的优化信号逐层归因推理贡献」的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督与贡献分配、以及迭代式状态更新提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LOOP: Recovery-Aligned Iterative Layer Pruning via On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Layer-level pruning is attractive for large language model (LLM) deployment as it reduces the model size while preserving a dense architecture that can be efficiently executed on standard hardware. Current methods typically follow a one-shot paradigm, which first removes selected layers to reach a target model size and then performs additional training to recover model capabilities. However, pruning directly to the target size can substantially degrade reasoning capabilities, making subsequent recovery more difficult under a limited training budget. Moreover, this paradigm separates layer selection from recovery, limiting the use of recovery information to guide selection and potentially hindering the recovery of reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LOOP, a Layer-level Recovery-Oriented On-Policy Pruning framework that interleaves pruning and recovery across multiple shots. In each shot, LOOP removes a single layer and performs short on-policy distillation, mitigating the abrupt degradation in reasoning capabilities associated with one-shot pruning. To guide layer selection in subsequent shots, LOOP reuses on-policy trajectories and optimization signals from recovery to jointly assess each remaining layer's reasoning contribution and recovery sensitivity, thereby making layer selection recovery-aware. Evaluations on several benchmarks show that LOOP consistently outperforms one-shot baselines in average accuracy across different model scales and pruning ratios.

</details>

### 250. [Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25692v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25692

**作者：** Tung M. Luu、Tri Ton、Duc M. Nguyen、Xuan Thanh Nguyen、Nguyen Gia Binh、Quang Tan Nguyen、Vu Duong、Daniel Sonntag、Duy M. H. Nguyen、Vien Anh Ngo、Chang D. Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25692v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25692v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无监督偏好对齐框架 PGPG，用「有序覆盖对齐」度量自主采集的 rollout 相对少量专家示范的序列进度，自动生成伪偏好标签，从而在无人工标注与手工奖励下微调扩散、flow-matching 等生成式控制策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「以进度估计自动构造偏好监督、免人工标注」的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供自动监督线索，可供核查；但任务域为机器人操作控制，与视觉或多模态推理状态的关联尚未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies

**abstract/A1：** Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations. Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.

**comment/C1：** CoRL 2026 (project site: https://pgpg2026.github.io/)

</details>

### 251. [Multi-View Structural Representations for Physically-Consistent TeX Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25695v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25695

**作者：** Daoheng Li、Jianjun Qian\*、Mengkai Yan、Jian Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25695v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25695v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MVR-MoE：从红外与可见光图像中挖掘内在结构线索并组织为多视图表示，用多视图超连接扩展特征空间，再以结构视图级与专家级的分层路由调节特征利用，生成受 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律约束的温度、发射率与纹理图。

**相关性简评：** 该文属红外/可见光图像生成任务，但其多视图结构表示与分层路由机制可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、异质线索的自适应取用提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-View Structural Representations for Physically-Consistent TeX Generation

**abstract/A1：** Infrared and visible images provide complementary cues for low-light image generation, and physics-based methods can better exploit this complementarity. However, existing physics-based methods still rely heavily on paired data. To address these limitations, we propose Multi-View Routing Mixture-of-Experts (MVR-MoE), a framework for physically consistent TeX generation that learns multi-view structural representations. MVR-MoE mines intrinsic structural cues from infrared and visible images to organize them into multi-view representations, while the proposed multi-view hyper connections expand the feature space and preserve both shared evidence and modality-specific details. A hierarchical routing mechanism further regulates feature utilization at both the structural-view level and the expert level, enabling adaptive exploitation of heterogeneous cues. The predicted temperature, emissivity, and texture maps are constrained by the Stefan-Boltzmann law to ensure physically consistent. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate that MVR-MoE achieves superior robustness and discriminability while remaining lightweight.

</details>

### 252. [From Black Box to Controller: Inference-Time Steering of LLM via Feature Amplification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25700v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25700

**作者：** Keqi Chen、Zekai Sun、Yuhua Wen、Tianyi Tian、Xinyang Huang、Huijun Lian、Yingming Gao、Ya Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25700v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25700v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NeuroSteer：用稀疏自编码器（SAE）作为控制器，通过对比正负例的神经元激活频率定位偏好对应的「特征神经元」，在推理期放大其 latent 激活以可量化地调控情感、毒性、立场、礼貌等输出倾向。

**相关性简评：** 该文的 SAE 特征定位与推理期 latent 激活放大，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据是否被真正使用」提供因果核查线索（如放大或抑制特定特征），但原文只调控文本风格偏好，未涉及推理状态、视觉信息或停止决策，需人工判断迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Black Box to Controller: Inference-Time Steering of LLM via Feature Amplification

**abstract/A1：** Inference-time steering is crucial for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications, where they must flexibly adjust behavior preferences. For instance, a model should dynamically adjust its caution level based on the risk of the scenario. This requirement introduces a challenge: modulating the intensity of LLM preferences. Prompt engineering can require task-specific prompt design, while fine-tuning requires additional optimization and data. These requirements can make repeated behavioral adjustments costly. To address this, we introduce NeuroSteer, a plug-and-play framework that enables flexible, quantitative adjustment of LLM preferences at inference time. NeuroSteer employs a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) as its controller. Comparing neuron activation frequencies between positive and negative examples isolates "feature neurons" that correspond to target preferences such as politeness and positive sentiment. During inference, the activations of selected SAE features are amplified in the latent representations to steer the output distribution. Users can adjust the strength of this steering on a per-scenario or per-user basis, granting the LLM fine-grained, quantifiable trait modulation. Our experiments show that NeuroSteer can alter sentiment, toxicity, stance, and politeness at inference time. It achieves higher target-direction steering scores than the compared baselines in several settings, with task- and strength-dependent trade-offs in generation quality.

</details>

### 253. [Predictive Bandit Curriculum Reinforcement Learning via Gradient-Based Sample Group Discovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25704v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25704

**作者：** Liang Xu、Shufan Shen、Zhongni Hou、Chao Bi、Yufei Zhang、Wei Lin、Guojun Yin、Shuhui Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25704v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25704v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PGB 课程学习框架：先用样本级投影梯度聚类发现「优化感知」的学习单元，再用轻量时序预测器预估各单元未来效用，并转为 Boltzmann 采样分布做自适应数据分配，在多种模型规模和推理基准上优于 GRPO 及难度、历史类课程策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「梯度聚类划分样本组 + 预测未来效用」的训练期数据分配思路，可能为 LVR 中的轨迹筛选、贡献分配与监督信号设计提供可核查线索；但该工作针对纯文本 RL 训练效率，未涉及视觉状态保留或推理期 latent 生成，与主线仅有方法层面的间接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Predictive Bandit Curriculum Reinforcement Learning via Gradient-Based Sample Group Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Curriculum learning, which organizes training samples according to their learning priority, has been widely adopted in reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency. However, existing methods commonly construct curriculum units using predefined data properties and estimate their utility by simply aggregating a single proxy signal from recent training history.Such designs may group samples with different optimization effects and fail to anticipate how their utility evolves in relation to the policy. We propose Predictive Gradient-based Bandit (PGB) Curriculum, which first discovers optimization-aware learning units by clustering projected sample-level gradients. PGB then employs a lightweight temporal predictor to forecast the future utility of each unit and converts the predictions into a Boltzmann sampling distribution for adaptive data allocation. Experiments across multiple model scales and reasoning benchmarks show that PGB consistently outperforms standard GRPO, difficulty-based curricula, and history-based scheduling strategies, demonstrating improved data utilization and training efficiency.

</details>

### 254. [Learning to Couple: Context-Adaptive Joint Denoising for Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25723v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25723

**作者：** Zilei Shao、Ian Li、Heng Zhao、Kewei Lian、Guy Van den Broeck、Zhe Zeng、Anji Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25723v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25723v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Codpula，在扩散语言模型的 Transformer 去噪器上叠加可处理概率推断层，由上下文生成的门控调制耦合参数，得到上下文相关的联合去噪分布，并用双流乘性更新共同训练，在推理与代码基准上取得更优精度-延迟权衡。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本扩散模型的联合去噪与并行 token 依赖建模，可能为 LVR 中并行生成的状态耦合、token 承诺与停止决策提供方法线索，值得核查其门控与条件查询机制可否迁移到多模态 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Couple: Context-Adaptive Joint Denoising for Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion language models accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but factorized denoisers treat simultaneous predictions as conditionally independent. Decoding heuristics reduce the resulting errors by controlling which tokens are committed, but leave the underlying distribution factorized. Joint modeling addresses the source of the problem, yet existing methods attach separately learned layers to frozen denoisers, leaving the backbone unadapted to the joint objective and the coupling parameters fixed across contexts. We propose Codpula, a context-parameterized denoiser combining a Transformer with a tractable probabilistic inference layer. Given a partially masked input, the Transformer produces token potentials that shape per-position predictions and compact gates that modulate the layer's coupling parameters, yielding a context-dependent joint distribution while retaining exact conditional inference. We jointly optimize both components under a conditional denoising objective using a dual-flow multiplicative update that preserves valid probabilistic parameters. At inference, Codpula supports standard heuristics and uses conditional queries to adapt commitments to dependencies among proposed tokens without extra Transformer evaluations within a step. Codpula sets new state-of-the-art results across a broad suite of reasoning benchmarks while advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

</details>

**title/T1：** TimelineAgent: An LLM-based Framework for Query-Centric Event Timeline Extraction Across Multiple Documents

**abstract/A1：** Query-centric cross-document event timeline extraction aims to construct event timelines from multiple documents under diverse query focuses. The task is very challenging due to the heterogeneous event modeling and reasoning requirements arising from both the intrinsic complexity of cross-document timeline construction and the diversity of query focuses. In this paper, we propose TimelineAgent, an LLM-based multi-agent framework featuring a multi-stage reasoning workflow, where heterogeneous event features are organized into reusable skills and orchestrated through a goal-oriented protocol. To facilitate evaluation, we construct a benchmark covering diverse query focuses. Experimental results show that TimelineAgent consistently outperforms existing methods, offering a practical framework for complex real-world timeline construction.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25742

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25742v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25742v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对一步扩散蒸馏中单次前向的内部容量分配问题，提出 DeMoE：在图像 FFN 中以常驻共享专家加条件路由的专家切片，配合一步分布匹配目标与执行路径监督，在 FLUX.2-4B 上仅激活约 80.5% 宽度即取得高于稠密一步基线的生成表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享骨干+条件路由残差」的跨层动态算力再分配与「执行路由监督」可供核查，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 latent 贡献归因提供方法线索，但属图像生成领域，与多模态推理状态的关系尚需人工验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Functional Cross-layer Experts Routing for One-step Diffusion Distillation

**abstract/A1：** One-step distillation compresses diffusion trajectories into a single forward evaluation, yet how internal capacity should be structured within that remaining pass remains largely unexplored. In this setting, identical parameters must simultaneously preserve general generative priors and resolve prompt-specific details without iterative refinement. We formalize this challenge as functional allocation. Our analysis reveals that decoupling representations is beneficial only when expert interference outweighs shared transfer, favoring an always-active shared backbone augmented with conditionally routed residuals over standard isolated MoE architectures. We propose DeMoE, which pairs a persistent shared expert with conditionally routed expert slices across image FFNs, trained under a one-step distribution-matching objective with executed-route supervision. On one-step FLUX.2-4B generation, DeMoE achieves a GenEval score of 0.8220 while activating only 80.5% of the image-FFN width, substantially outperforming dense one-step baselines, matching the 50-step teacher overall, and surpassing it on complex composition and counting. Across COCO-10K, DeMoE establishes state-of-the-art fidelity and diversity among single-step models, demonstrating that structured internal computation reallocation provides a superior compression paradigm for diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/toffeecat/demoe-ttt-router.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其把任务规律压缩为查询无关的 TIR 并用双环元学习训练归纳器，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的诱导方式、跨任务监督设计以及「线索归纳与作答解耦」提供可供核查的方法线索。虽是纯文本 ICL 工作，但与视觉推理无直接关系。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cognitively Decoupled Meta-Induction for Out-of-Distribution Generalization

**abstract/A1：** In-context learning (ICL) tackles downstream tasks conditioned on demonstrations. This paradigm relies heavily on neighbor-based matching between queries and demonstrations, limiting out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. For better generalization, rule-based inductive reasoning derives task-level regularities, which we term task-level inductive representations (TIR), before directly answering. However, existing methods lack generalizable inductive ability across diverse tasks. Inspired by meta-learning, we propose Cognitive-Decoupling meta-Induction (CoDI) for TIR-based inductive reasoning on general tasks. CoDI comprises a Cognitive-Decoupling Framework for query-blind TIR induction, and a Dual-Loop Meta-Inductive Learning method for cross-task inducer optimization. Empirically, CoDI achieves substantial performance gains on five ID and OOD benchmarks, and preserves OOD gains without explicit induction at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Yuqian-Wang2277/codi-meta-induction.

### 258. [NADS: Navigator-Guided Data Selection for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25751v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25751

**作者：** Jianhao Zhang、Ou Wu、Yi Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25751v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25751v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NADS 框架：先按目标微调配方训练一个 navigator 模型，以其与预训练模型的预测分歧为合成候选数据打遗忘感知效用分，再用效用—多样性策略构造约束集，在微调新任务时对约束集蒸馏预训练行为以缓解灾难性遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 其「用两个模型的预测分歧估计样本效用、并做效用—多样性筛选」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中推理轨迹或约束数据的筛选与监督分配；但论文面向纯文本 LLM 微调的遗忘问题，与视觉推理主线无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NADS: Navigator-Guided Data Selection for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Catastrophic forgetting is a central obstacle in single-stage fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) on a new task, especially when the original pretraining data are unavailable. Synthetic data offers a practical mitigation path, but candidate pools are often noisy and redundant, making effective selection essential. Existing methods often rely on indirect proxy signals whose alignment with actual training benefit can be limited, while utility--diversity selection over large candidate pools remains computationally demanding. To address these challenges, we propose NAvigator-guided Data Selection (NADS), a fine-tuning framework for LLMs. NADS first follows the target fine-tuning recipe without preservation regularization to obtain a navigator model, whose deviation from the pretrained model exposes recipe-induced capability drift. It then uses the predictive divergence between the navigator and the pretrained model to score forgetting-aware utility for each synthetic candidate, and constructs a constraint set through an efficient utility--diversity selection strategy. Finally, NADS fine-tunes on the new-task data while distilling pretrained behavior on the selected constraints to preserve general capabilities. Experiments show that NADS delivers a stronger balance between new-task performance and general capability preservation, while reducing utility--diversity selection overhead. Code at: https://github.com/zjh-vinky/NADS.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 259. [Which Answers Agree? Evaluating Self-Consistency from Incomplete Logs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25752v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25752

**作者：** Zhengtao Gui、Zexi Chen、Weining Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25752v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25752v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在日志不完整（只记录正确性标签而缺少「哪些回答一致」信息）时如何评价 self-consistency 投票准确率：用随机 majorization 推导准确率上界，并借弃答计数与答案类别数收紧区间，还提出 Plurality-U 动态规划以精确计算固定规模子集上的平均投票准确率。

**相关性简评：** 其计数式的投票收益与预算扩展分析，或可迁移到 LVR 中多个 latent 假设／并行采样聚合的评估，弃答计数也与 STOP 决策的收益成本核算相近；但论文只面向纯文本推理基准，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 内容，迁移适用性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Which Answers Agree? Evaluating Self-Consistency from Incomplete Logs

**abstract/A1：** Self-consistency answers a question by generating multiple responses and selecting the most frequent answer. Its evaluation requires both correctness labels and information about which responses agree; correctness labels alone generally determine neither voting accuracy nor the benefit of additional votes. For tasks in which all correct responses map to the same normalized answer, we derive sharp accuracy bounds using classical stochastic majorization, refined by abstention counts and answer-category limits. We also derive sharp bounds on accuracy changes across voting budgets that share a response pool. When answer-category counts are available, we introduce Plurality-U, a count-based dynamic program that exactly averages voting accuracy over all fixed-size subsets, eliminating finite-pool Monte Carlo error. On 1,403,520 stored outputs from recent reasoning models in Scorio Lite and Scorio Trace, recording abstention counts and answer options cuts the width of SuperGPQA accuracy intervals by more than half. For moving from 9 to 17 votes, our bounds reduce interval width by a median of 77.7% on SuperGPQA and 72.3% on 14 GPQA and Adaptive-Consistency pools, compared with a baseline that combines separate accuracy bounds. Exact computation has lower paired median runtime than 2,000-subset Monte Carlo in 14 of 15 tested pool-budget settings. These results clarify what incomplete logs can establish and provide an exact evaluation procedure when answer counts are retained.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 2 figures, including appendices

</details>

### 260. [ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25764v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25764

**作者：** Xinxing Zhou、Xiaojie Yuan、Yanlong Wen、Ming Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25764v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25764v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ActTime 提出动作条件化的时间序列世界模型：按动作条件转移更新变量级 latent 状态并用观测校正，再在候选动作下滚动同一转移生成未来轨迹，训练只用事实轨迹；作者还构建了覆盖事实预测、干预效果预测与离线/闭环决策的评测套件。

**相关性简评：** 其「latent 状态更新 + 在候选动作下前向 rollout」可作为 LVR 中推理状态生成与多假设展开的方法线索，且论文报告事实预测、干预保真与决策质量的模型排序会反转，提示需核查 latent 内容是否真被下游决策使用；但属于时间序列世界模型领域，迁移可能性需人工评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.

</details>

### 261. [TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25765v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25765

**作者：** Minjun Kim、Jong Hak Moon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25765v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25765v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TRACE 将住院期间的多模态临床证据（EHR、胸片、影像报告、出院小结）组织为日级轨迹，用时间注意力编码并区分全局上下文与当日事件，在死亡、住院时长与再入院预测上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「不可用模态不产生 token」的门控设计与轨迹级归因可供核查：前者可能对应 LVR 中的视觉旁路与证据筛选，后者可能启发 latent 状态的贡献分配分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows. Existing multimodal approaches combine structured health record data, chest x-rays, and clinical text, but primarily focus on modality fusion or missing-modality compensation, with limited attention to temporal trajectories over an admission. We propose TRACE (TRAjectory modeling of multimodal Clinical Events), a daily-scale framework organizing clinical events into day-level trajectories, separating day-invariant global context from day-specific local events drawn from EHR data, chest x-rays, radiology reports, and discharge summaries. The trajectory is encoded using temporal attention, allowing unavailable modalities to emit no tokens. A phenotype-guided contrastive objective further organizes admissions under heterogeneous disease distributions. Across cohorts from MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIMIC-III comprising nearly 180,000 total stays, we evaluate TRACE on mortality, length of stay, and readmission prediction. TRACE achieves the highest AUROC across all nine dataset-task settings and the highest ACC in eight, outperforming baselines. Ablation studies validate our attention masks and contrastive learning, while trajectory-level attribution localizes risk-associated hospital days and modalities.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 262. [EvalRx: Agentic Diagnosis and Verified Repair of Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25767v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25767

**作者：** Jiaqi Liu、Ruinan Jin、Yitong Tang、Beidi Zhao、Gexin Huang、Qiong Zhang、Xiaoxiao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25767v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25767v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EvalRx 是一个开源的 agentic 框架，用于对基础模型做统计化的失败模式诊断与修复：先探索候选机制、提出可证伪假设并用冻结的预设测试验证，再据此分层修复，且只在目标行为改善、回归可接受时采纳；在语言、视觉-语言与音频-语言共 12 个模型组合上报告 +1.4 至 +10.9 个百分点的提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结测试 + 可证伪假设 + 采纳前回归核查」的诊断流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、干预修复是否带来副作用等评价设计问题，但原文并未研究 latent 推理状态本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EvalRx: Agentic Diagnosis and Verified Repair of Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Model evaluation reveals where models fail, but rarely why or whether a proposed fix genuinely works. We introduce EvalRx, an open-source agentic framework for statistically grounded model diagnosis and repair. EvalRx discovers systematic failure modes, explores candidate mechanisms, formulates falsifiable hypotheses, and verifies them by executing frozen, pre-specified tests before using supported diagnoses to guide tiered repair. Candidate repairs are validated against the unchanged model and promoted only when they improve the target behavior without unacceptable regression. Across language, vision-language, and audio-language settings spanning Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, EvalRx improves performance in all 12 evaluated model family-modality combinations, with gains ranging from +1.4 to +10.9 percentage points (+5.8 points on average). These results show that model evaluation can serve not only to measure failures, but to support an auditable process for diagnosing and repairing them.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages. Technical report. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/evalvitals/evalrx

</details>

### 263. [VHA: VQA-based Hallucination Assessment for Generative Image Super-Resolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25770v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25770

**作者：** Donghun Ryou、Inju Ha、Jaeyoo Park、Bohyung Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25770v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25770v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出基于双向 VQA 的生成式超分辨率幻觉评估 VHA：用 VLM 检验超分图像的语义内容与低层视觉证据是否被参考图支持，并训练轻量模型 VHA+ 直接预测该分数，同时构建人工标注的 VHA-bench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其双向 VQA 的证据核验思路与把昂贵 VLM 评判蒸馏成轻量预测器的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、幻觉判定与验证成本提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是图像生成幻觉而非 VLM 推理过程本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VHA: VQA-based Hallucination Assessment for Generative Image Super-Resolution

**abstract/A1：** Generative image super-resolution produces visually realistic high-resolution images, but may also introduce hallucinations by adding unsupported content or altering existing details. Because existing super-resolution metrics fail to measure whether generated details remain grounded in the reference image, we present a hallucination assessment technique based on bidirectional visual question answering (VQA), which we term VQA-based Hallucination Assessment (VHA). The proposed approach uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine whether the semantic content and low-level visual evidence in a super-resolved image are supported by its ground-truth counterpart. To this end, it constructs question--answer pairs from each image and evaluates them on both images. Discrepancies between the resulting scores in both directions reveal missing or altered ground-truth information and unsupported additions. However, obtaining these scores requires computationally expensive VLM inference. We therefore develop VHA+, a learned, lightweight model that directly predicts VHA scores from ground-truth and super-resolved image pairs. We construct a hallucination benchmark, VHA-bench, through a human study and show that both VHA and VHA+ correlate highly with human judgments of hallucination. The code, benchmark, and model weights are available at https://github.com/dhryougit/Hallucination-Assessment

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://dhryougit.github.io/Hallucination-Assessment-pages/

</details>

### 264. [From Trace to Fix: Residual Task State in Long-Horizon Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25776v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25776

**作者：** Zile Huang、Ser-nam Lim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25776v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25776v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TRACE-FIX 长时程语言智能体故障恢复框架：将执行日志整理为依赖关联的版本化「残差任务状态」账本以定位未完成任务，并把修复建模为带修复预留约束的预算化规划；另构建 LongH-Debug，分别评测根因归因与闭环修复。

**相关性简评：** 其「残差任务状态」追踪与预算化停止/修复规划，可能为 LVR 中「内部状态保留什么、何时停止并调用证据」提供可核查的方法线索，但对象是纯文本智能体，未涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Trace to Fix: Residual Task State in Long-Horizon Agents

**abstract/A1：** Recovering from failures in long-horizon, stateful language agents is challenging because the action introducing a defect, the symptom exposing it, and the persistent state requiring repair frequently diverge. Existing methods largely focus on retrospective failure attribution, leaving sequential diagnosis and state repair poorly integrated under constrained budgets. We introduce TRACE-FIX, a unified recovery framework centered on versioned residual task state. Trace transforms execution logs into a structured dependency-linked ledger, prioritizing unresolved task requirements rather than salient surface errors. Fix formulates recovery as budgeted planning over admissible actions, incorporating outcome forecasting and explicit repair-reserve constraints to prevent premature budget exhaustion. To rigorously decouple localization accuracy from downstream repair capability, we present LongH-Debug, evaluating root-cause attribution, verified-fault recovery, and end-to-end closed-loop execution independently. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that structured residual tracking substantially improves causal localization over raw-trace baselines, while budget-aware sequential planning converts verified fault signals into more reliable task recovery without destructive trial-and-error. Code is available at https://github.com/toffeecat/tracedp.

</details>

### 265. [Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25777v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25777

**作者：** Xinwen Chen、Haorui He、Yupeng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25777v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25777v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 AFP 公开的事实核查指南蒸馏为模块化的「PFC-Skill」，并构建 SkillCheck：在推理期让 LLM agent 动态调用该技能来引导证据检索与论断验证，在 AVeriTeC 上无需额外训练即取得准确率与 Macro-F1 提升，并降低推理成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理期动态接入外部专家技能、并分别作用于检索与验证阶段」的设计，以及关于增益主要来自检索阶段的消融，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 步骤的证据筛选与阶段贡献分配提供可核查线索；但该工作是纯文本事实核查，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills

**abstract/A1：** Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Existing approaches improve their capabilities through computationally costly post-training or human-in-the-loop feedback that is difficult to scale. To transfer professional fact-checking expertise to LLM agents efficiently, we distill publicly available guidelines published by Agence France-Presse (AFP) Fact Check into a reusable, modular Professional Fact-Checking Skill (PFC-Skill). We then present SkillCheck, the first AFC system that gives LLM agents dynamic access to PFC-Skill to guide evidence retrieval and claim verification at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2--4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5--6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. To conclude, our work shows that LLM agents can "stand on the shoulders of giants" by drawing on the best practices of professional fact-checkers, substantially enhancing AFC performance without extra training or continuous human supervision.

</details>

### 266. [See the Future, Classify the Present: Stochastic Latent World Modeling for Hyperspectral Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25781v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25781

**作者：** Muhammad Ahmad、Gemine Vivone、Ronny Hänsch、Ahmed Sohaib、Manuel Mazzara、Danfeng Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25781v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25781v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向高光谱图像分类，提出 Stochastic Latent World Modeling：将空间与光谱分别编码融合为环境状态后，用高斯参数化的随机 latent 转移模块预测多步未来 latent 状态并以循环方式细化，再由 rollout planner 自适应聚合成计划表示，与基础表示融合后分类。

**相关性简评：** 其随机 latent 转移、逐步递归细化与 latent 轨迹聚合机制，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的生成与更新、任务相关 latent 的筛选与动态计算提供可核查的方法线索；但任务是遥感分类而非多模态推理，需核查该 latent 轨迹是否具备可迁移的推理语义。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** See the Future, Classify the Present: Stochastic Latent World Modeling for Hyperspectral Images

**abstract/A1：** Hyperspectral image classification (HSIC) relies on static spatial-spectral representations learned from labeled samples, limiting its ability to model structured dependencies in the latent representation space. To address this limitation, this work proposes Stochastic Latent World Modeling (LWM), a trajectory-based representation-learning framework that enriches classification through stochastic latent-state prediction. Given a hyperspectral patch, LWM tokenizes and encodes spectral and spatial information separately using dedicated transformer branches, then fuses their outputs into a unified representation. This representation is further organized into an environment state that captures center, neighborhood, spectral, and global contextual information. A stochastic latent transition module then predicts multiple future latent states through Gaussian parameterization and reparameterization, with recurrent refinement used to model dependencies across successive states. The resulting latent trajectory is adaptively aggregated by a rollout planner to construct a planned representation, which is integrated with the base representation for final classification. By extending static spatial-spectral encoding with stochastic multi-step latent-state modeling, LWM enables the classifier to exploit structured dependencies in the representation space and provides richer features for HSIC. Across five benchmark datasets, LWM achieves overall accuracies ranging from 89.21% to 99.52%, demonstrating consistent classification performance under limited-label settings.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 267. [Sector-Ring Linear Reservoirs: Sector-Wise Decay-Timescale Allocation With State Reuse Across Candidate Settings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25806v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25806

**作者：** Yudai Ebato、Sou Nobukawa、Yusuke Sakemi、Takashi Kanamaru、Nina Sviridova、Kazuyuki Aihara

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25806v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25806v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Sector-Ring 线性储备池：把特征值角度固定在圆周等距位置，按角度扇区分配少数几个衰减时间尺度作为设计变量，并用训练输入功率谱缩放输入权重以保持各模式状态尺度一致；通过复用各时间尺度的模式轨迹降低候选设置搜索成本。在混沌系统预测与重构基准上，平均测试误差均优于共享单一衰减时间尺度的参照模型，且所选时间尺度轮廓随预测目标与步长变化，轨迹复用使搜索中需计算的模式轨迹数减少 99.8%。

**相关性简评：** 其「按候选设置复用已计算的模式状态」与线性递推的模式分解、扇区化时间尺度分配，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹缓存复用、候选评估成本与循环计算的记忆长度控制提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作属储备池与时间序列领域，与视觉多模态推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sector-Ring Linear Reservoirs: Sector-Wise Decay-Timescale Allocation With State Reuse Across Candidate Settings

**abstract/A1：** In reservoir computing, performance depends on whether the fixed dynamics of the reservoir suit the task, and the appropriate memory length and frequency response differ across tasks. The reservoir settings are found by a search on each task, and driving the reservoir with the input and collecting its states for every candidate setting dominates the cost of the search. In a reservoir with a linear recurrence, the dynamics decompose into modes, one per eigenvalue, and the eigenvalue distribution becomes a design variable. We propose the Sector-Ring Linear Reservoir (SRLR), in which the eigenvalue angles are fixed at evenly spaced positions around a circle and one decay timescale, chosen from a few values, is assigned to each sector of consecutive angles. To keep the scale of each mode's state equal across candidates, the input weights are scaled using the power spectrum of the training input. To reduce the cost of the search, the states of the modes for each decay-timescale value are computed once and reused across candidates. On prediction and reconstruction benchmarks built from chaotic systems, the SRLR achieved, in all eight cases, a lower mean test error than a reference model in which all modes share one decay timescale, and was competitive with nonlinear echo state network and leaky-integrator echo state network baselines. The selected decay-timescale profiles changed with the prediction target and horizon. The state reuse reduced the number of computed mode trajectories in the search by 99.8% relative to per-candidate recomputation.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access

</details>

### 268. [Do We Need Learned Targets? Classical Gradients as Supervision for 2D Gaussian Initialization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25809v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25809

**作者：** Kyungjune Baek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25809v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25809v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 2D 高斯图像初始化的监督目标是否必要：以归一化 Sobel 梯度图替代 Instant GaussianImage 的伪 PPM 目标，给出免训练解析初始化器与在线 Sobel 监督的神经初始化器，并在 Kodak、DIV2K 及跨域设置上比较重建效果与流程耗时。

**相关性简评：** 其「用廉价解析梯度替代逐样本优化得到的监督目标、从而使训练可规模化」这一线索，可能与 LVR 中 latent 轨迹监督来源与成本问题相关，可供核查是否能迁移到推理状态的初始化与监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do We Need Learned Targets? Classical Gradients as Supervision for 2D Gaussian Initialization

**abstract/A1：** Learning-based Gaussian image initializers can require costly supervision obtained by per-image optimization. We investigate whether the Pseudo-PPM targets used by Instant GaussianImage can be replaced by classical image gradients. Our framework uses normalized Sobel maps in two tracks. A training-free analytic initializer combines probability boosting, parallel grid-based sampling, and geometric processing, producing initial parameters in 0.32 seconds on average. A neural initializer is trained on DIV2K with online Sobel supervision, which removes offline target optimization and allows training to scale to 10,000 LSDIR images without additional preprocessing. Both tracks achieve competitive long-budget reconstruction on Kodak and DIV2K. Under domain shift, the DIV2K-trained neural initializer surpasses Instant-GI on Manga109 from 500 fitting iterations onward (by 1.40 dB at 5K iterations), and training on LSDIR increases this margin to 1.85 dB. On Kvasir-SEG, the training-free analytic initializer exceeds Instant-GI at every reported budget. A controlled pipeline-time comparison yields an estimated $4.9\\times$ reduction for DIV2K. These results establish inexpensive analytic targets as a practical alternative to optimization-derived supervision for scalable Gaussian initialization.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables, preprint

</details>

### 269. [Is it RL or Data? A Controlled Comparison of GRPO and Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25812v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25812

**作者：** Lakshya Chaudhry

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25812v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25812v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 Bauer 等人的程序化计数任务上，用 Qwen3-4B-Base 加 LoRA，对 GRPO 与拒绝采样微调（RFT）做受控对比：交叉两种方法、三种提示集，各三个随机种子，并预注册假设与否证条件，检验混合难度数据的收益是否为 GRPO 独有。

**相关性简评：** 这是纯文本后训练的方法学对比工作，不涉及视觉或 latent 推理；但其「收益来自数据还是算法」的受控设计、匹配 rollout 预算的对照、以及迭代 RFT 从当前策略重采样的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督信号归因提供可核查的实验设计线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Is it RL or Data? A Controlled Comparison of GRPO and Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Bauer et al. (2026) showed that in low-data reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, training GRPO on mixed-difficulty prompts gives up to 5x the sample efficiency of easy-only prompts. They did not test whether this benefit is specific to GRPO, or whether another post-training method given the same data would obtain it too. We test this on their procedural counting task with Qwen3-4B-Base and LoRA, comparing GRPO to rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) on the same prompts, verifier and token cap. Six primary arms cross the two methods with three prompt sets (Easy, Mixed, and a Curated subset of prompts the base model sometimes solves, which makes GRPO's implicit filter explicit). We use three seeds per arm. Hypotheses and falsifiers were registered before training. To rule out a poorly tuned baseline, RFT receives a 27-run hyperparameter sweep, while GRPO uses Bauer et al.'s recipe unchanged. GRPO outperforms RFT at every prompt set: by 10.9 points on held-out test problems with curated prompts, and, in post hoc comparisons with matched rollout budgets, by 8.4 and 9.2 points on the easy and mixed prompts. On test the advantage survives the least favorable treatment of truncated completions; out of distribution, truncation prevents a conclusion. Curating prompts does not help RFT (-2.7 points). Mixed-difficulty data helps RFT (+3.7 points), while for GRPO the evidence is inconclusive. A secondary iterated-RFT arm, which resamples from the current policy, recovers 3.2 of the 10.9-point gap (about 30%). These are controlled measurements on one synthetic task family and one base model with three seeds per arm.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 270. [Not Every Rollout Needs Distillation: Correctness-Filtered On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25842v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25842

**作者：** Harrison Zhao、Lei Huang、Fei Liu、Wen Shi、Zijian Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25842v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25842v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文追问 on-policy self-distillation 中每条 rollout 是否都提供值得其蒸馏开销的独特监督：在 Qwen3-1.7B 初始化时测量发现正确与错误响应的单样本梯度幅度相近，但错误响应的「相干梯度」占比约高三倍，且两者估计的总体均值方向大体重叠；据此提出 correctness-filtered OPSD，每题只采样一条响应并仅蒸馏部分错误响应，跳过未选中行以省去前后向计算，在 1.7B/4B/8B 与 AIME、HMMT 上性能与完整 OPSD 相当，训练时间约降四成。

**相关性简评：** 其以梯度相干性判别轨迹监督冗余、按正确性筛选训练轨迹的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent/推理轨迹的监督选择与贡献分配提供具体筛选线索，但该工作纯文本、无视觉状态，能否迁移到多模态推理轨迹尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not Every Rollout Needs Distillation: Correctness-Filtered On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supervises student-generated trajectories with a reference-conditioned version of the same base model. We ask whether every trajectory supplies distinct supervision that warrants its distillation cost. Gradient measurements on Qwen3-1.7B at initialization reveal that correct and incorrect responses have similar individual gradient magnitudes, but incorrect responses have approximately three times the coherent gradient share. Their estimated population-mean directions also largely overlap. A signal--noise model fitted at a small group size tracks alignment at larger group sizes without refitting. Motivated by these measurements, we introduce correctness-filtered OPSD (C-OPSD), which generates one response per problem and distills only a subset of incorrect responses. Removing unselected rows before both distillation forwards avoids their teacher/student forward and student backward work. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, C-OPSD achieves on-par performance with full OPSD. In a measured micro-batch-size-four implementation, executed rows decrease by approximately 68%, and with retained rows packed into full micro-batches, training takes about 40% less time while rollout generation remains unchanged. Together, the measurements and training results connect outcome-conditioned supervision redundancy to more compute-efficient distillation.

</details>

<a id="paper-271"></a>

### 271. [Rubrics Beyond Evaluation: Exploiting Rubric Structure in Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25850v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25850

**作者：** Yuxun Huang、Yunyao Zhang、ZeLiang Chen、Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen、Junqing Yu、Zikai Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25850v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25850v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RSRL 框架，把评分量表（rubric）的条目还原为能力结构，再据此进行自足能力学习与能力残差信用分配，用强化学习训练开放式问答模型，在科学问答上优于初始策略和非结构化 RL 基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「能力残差信用分配」可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步骤的贡献分配与监督粒度提供可核查线索，但论文面向纯文本评分量表训练，未涉及视觉状态保留或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rubrics Beyond Evaluation: Exploiting Rubric Structure in Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Rubrics are widely used to evaluate open-ended question answering by breaking overall quality into explicit criteria. These explicit criteria make rubrics a rich source of learning guidance, yet their potential for guiding the training process has been largely overlooked. Existing methods use rubrics mainly as direct feedback signals, without explicitly modeling the capabilities behind their criteria. This leaves their capability structure largely unused in guiding the training process. We introduce Rubric-Structured Reinforcement Learning (RSRL), an RL framework that unlocks the full potential of rubrics by exploiting their structure throughout the training process, rather than treating them simply as direct reward signals. At its core, RSRL builds on three key designs: (1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring first recovers the capability structure hidden in rubric criteria, (2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning then uses this structure to bootstrap underdeveloped capabilities into effective learning, (3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing finally preserves capability-specific gains during optimization. Experiments show that RSRL consistently improves both overall performance and underdeveloped capabilities, boosting downstream scientific question-answering performance by up to 7.43 over the initial policy and 7.60 over non-rubric structured RL baselines, showing that reinforcement learning can substantially benefit from the capability structure encoded in rubrics.

</details>

### 272. [MASIF: Implicit Failures for Process Observability in Multi-Agent Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25852v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25852

**作者：** Yanwei Huang、Arpit Narechania、Atanu Sinha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25852v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25852v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多智能体系统中的「隐式失败」（局部错误被纠正、绕过或传递而不单独决定任务结果），在1828条轨迹上统计其分布，建立错误类型与吸收机制分类体系，用反事实重放检验修复效果，并提出以失败成本修正成功轨迹偏好的 IF-GRPO。

**相关性简评：** 其过程奖励模型、best-of-N 轨迹选择与基于失败成本的偏好修正，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督、贡献分配与停止/选择决策提供可核查线索，但研究对象是纯文本多智能体流程，与视觉 latent 状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MASIF: Implicit Failures for Process Observability in Multi-Agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent systems (MAS) can complete a task despite local execution errors that are corrected, bypassed, or carried forward without individually determining its outcome. We call these implicit failures (IFs) and study them as signals for process observability beyond final task outcome. Across 1,828 traces from nine MAS-benchmark configurations, IFs occur in 54.3% of successful and 75.2% of failed traces. We develop taxonomies of error types and subsequent absorption mechanisms, supported by human and cross-model annotation audits. Counterfactual replay further probes how repairing an IF changes the final outcome. To examine the practical value of IFs, we evaluate IF-based best-of-N trace selection against existing process reward models, and introduce a novel RL algorithm, IF-GRPO, that uses IF costs to refine preferences among successful trajectories in GRPO. Experiments show that IF-GRPO exhibits some gains in accuracy and process metrics. Importantly, it exposes trade-offs between task performance, IF count and cost, and token-normalized IF density. Overall, our results show that IFs provide complementary process observability into how MAS reach their outcomes, including error recovery, propagation, and IF-based process differences that final task success alone does not expose.

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

### 273. [Statistical Learning Theory for Direct Preference Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25856

**作者：** Joel Wills、Yuanfan Li、Yiming Ying、Ding-Xuan Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25856v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为 DPO 建立统计学习理论：用偏好对数几率的三元旋度（triangle-curl）刻画 Bradley–Terry 假设的结构性失配，给出超额逻辑风险的上界与下界，对 ReLU 分数模型给出逼近率，并把有限样本界拆分为网络逼近、结构性失配与估计误差，最后将结论转移到 contextual preference accuracy。

**相关性简评：** 其把偏好监督误差分解为结构性失配、容量与有限样本三部分，或可为 VLM 推理轨迹的偏好式训练与贡献分配提供可核查的分析线索，但未涉及视觉状态或推理期 latent，迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Statistical Learning Theory for Direct Preference Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) learns from pairwise preferences through a logistic objective whose score-difference parameterization follows the Bradley--Terry model. We study how failure of this modeling assumption limits DPO, distinguishing structural misspecification from limited model capacity and finite-sample estimation. Our main contribution is a characterization of structural approximation error through the triangle-curl of the preference log-odds, which vanishes exactly when preferences admit a Bradley--Terry representation. We upper bound the achievable excess logistic risk by a score-class approximation term and a triangle-curl term, and establish a lower bound proportional to triangle-curl under additional boundedness assumptions. For ReLU score models, including clipped models, we derive explicit approximation rates showing that increasing capacity can eliminate the score-approximation term while leaving the structural obstruction unchanged. We further establish finite-sample bounds for clipped empirical risk minimizers that separate network approximation, structural misspecification, and estimation error. We place these results within a surrogate-risk framework by identifying contextual preference accuracy (CPA) as a natural measure of agreement between preference judgments and changes in pairwise probability ratios relative to the reference policy. Standard logistic consistency and calibration results connect DPO's objective to this policy property and transfer our excess-risk upper bounds to CPA, without treating CPA as a complete measure of generated-response quality.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, including references and appendices

</details>

### 274. [Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25858v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25858

**作者：** Xiaoyin Chen、Yizheng Huang、Yinglun Xu、Ziyun Zhao、Emmett McQuinn、Julie Liu、Hope Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25858v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25858v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究非参数自进化 LLM agent 是否算有效的持续学习者：在四个主题/流程/领域漂移的任务流上评测 ReasoningBank、GEPA、Meta-Harness 三类方法，发现自进化虽提升总体表现，但可塑性提升总以稳定性下降为代价，自改写会覆盖旧知识，相似记忆检索在冲突流程下发生检索碰撞。

**相关性简评：** 论文不含视觉成分，但其关于共享提示/工作区的全局改写、记忆检索定位与冲突的机制分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与视觉证据的局部更新、检索冲突处理提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?

**abstract/A1：** Large language model agents are often deployed in environments where new knowledge, tools, and workflows keep arriving. Such an agent is therefore expected to adapt continually, learning new tasks as they arrive without forgetting earlier ones. This resembles the continual learning problem, but at a pace that conventional gradient updates cannot sustain. Nonparametric self-evolving agents are a natural alternative: they adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen. We study whether such agents are effective continual learners across four drifting task streams that shift in topic, workflow, or domain (built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld). Evaluating three representative methods spanning experience retrieval and self-modification (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness), we find that although self-evolution improves aggregate performance on most streams, higher plasticity consistently comes at the cost of stability. Specifically, self-modifying methods apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts. Conversely, similarity-based memory retrieval localizes updates across distant domains, but still retrieves foreign memories on unseen tasks and suffers from retrieval collision when similar queries require conflicting workflows. These findings show that current self-evolving agents remain incomplete continual learners.

</details>

### 275. [Adaptive Decoding Methods for Token-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25860v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25860

**作者：** Zhaonan Li、Zelei Cheng、Amritansh Mishra、Chia-Hsuan Lee、Mann Patel、Sambit Sahu、Ben Zhou、William M. Campbell

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25860v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25860v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 RLVR 中 rollout 解码的候选 token 支持集应固定还是随训练扩大，提出由 top-K=10 到 K=20 再到全支持的调度，并在 4B 代码 RLVR 上用等 token 预算的验证值与固定 K 基线比较采样效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「随预算渐进扩大候选支持」的调度思路，可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中潜推理步数、候选宽度或思考预算的动态调度与停止策略；但该文仅在纯文本 RLVR 上验证，未涉及视觉或多模态状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adaptive Decoding Methods for Token-Efficient Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether candidate-token support should remain fixed or widen during training in the context of rollout sampling efficiency. Our main schedule moves from top-K=10 to K=20 and then to full support as the attempted-token budget increases. In a 4B code-RLVR setting, the schedule has a higher interpolated 150M-token validation value than its matched fixed-K=10 continuation in all three runs, with a mean gain of $1.80{\\pm}0.42$ points. The schedule also performs comparably to a separately trained fixed-K=20 baseline, the strongest fixed-support setting in our sweep. Follow-up experiments suggest that late widening to full support is the most promising variant, although the evidence remains noisy, and mixed-reward-group diagnostics do not clearly explain the gain. An exploratory single-run test replay yields identical point estimates for the schedule and fixed $K=10$. Overall, our results show that rollout support is an important control for sampling efficiency in RLVR and motivate further study of adaptive support schedules.

</details>

<a id="paper-276"></a>

### 276. [CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25871v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25871

**作者：** Changshuo Liu、Jiaqi Zhu、Wenqiao Zhang、Xiaokui Xiao、Beng Chin Ooi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25871v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25871v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CODA，用强化学习发现具有临床意义的患者队列，并把患者相对队列原型的偏离建模为结构化 drift 信号，将该群体与个体感知表示注入多模态临床基础模型，在 EHR 的 closed-QA、open-QA 与报告生成任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 「群体原型 + 个体漂移」的显式结构化表示分解，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何同时编码共享结构与个体差异、以及表示几何设计提供可核查线索；但输入为 EHR 而非视觉 token，也无 latent 推理状态生成，迁移性有待人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse clinical tasks. However, existing approaches predominantly operate at the individual sample level and fail to model the interplay between population-level cohort patterns and patient-specific variation that underlie real-world clinical reasoning. In practice, clinicians routinely reason through patient cohorts sharing similar demographic, physiological, or pathological characteristics, while accounting for patient-specific deviations from the group prototype. Motivated by this gap, we propose CODA, a cohort- and drift-aware foundation model for multimodal clinical reasoning. CODA explicitly integrates cohort structure into the modeling pipeline through two complementary mechanisms: cohort-aware population stratification and drift-aware individual adaptation. In particular, we leverage reinforcement learning to discover clinically meaningful patient cohorts, and further model each patient's deviation from cohort prototypes as a structured drift signal encoding fine-grained individual heterogeneity. These cohort- and drift-aware representations are incorporated into the foundation model to enable reasoning that is simultaneously informed by population-level patterns and sensitive to individual-level variation. Extensive experiments on real-world electronic health record (EHR) benchmarks demonstrate that CODA achieves consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability across diverse clinical tasks, including closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 277. [Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient MCI Conversion Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25873v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25873

**作者：** Guanghua He、Hancan Zhu、Gaohang Yu、An Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25873v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25873v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向 3D 医学影像的 MCI 转阿尔茨海默病预测，提出残差引导的自适应 Tucker 秩分配：在固定适配器参数预算下用动态规划联合选择输入、输出通道秩，并在 ADNI 队列上以约 0.618M 可训练参数验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「按逐层重建残差归一化、在全局参数预算下求最优秩分配」的做法，可能为 VLM 推理中如何向各层分配 latent 容量或低秩状态更新的有限预算提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient MCI Conversion Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Allocating limited trainable capacity across convolutional layers is a central challenge in parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of pretrained three-dimensional (3D) networks. We propose Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation, which jointly selects input- and output-channel ranks under a fixed adapter-parameter budget while preserving the spatial kernel modes. To guide rank selection, we learn task-specific proxy updates from downstream training data and approximate them using candidate Tucker rank pairs. A perturbation analysis bounds the output discrepancy between the fixed proxy network and its Tucker approximation in terms of layerwise reconstruction residuals, motivating residual-based allocation. We normalize each squared residual by the corresponding proxy-update energy to compare relative approximation errors across layers. Dynamic programming minimizes their sum under a global budget constraint that accounts for both channel factors and the Tucker core. This yields a globally optimal allocation over the specified candidate rank pairs. We evaluate the method on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort for predicting conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease within 36 months, using hippocampal segmentation pretraining. Across five random seeds, the proposed method achieves a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.7706, compared with 0.7239 for fixed-ratio Tucker adaptation and 0.7430 for full fine-tuning. The total number of trainable parameters is limited to approximately 0.618 million, accounting for only 1.45% of the full model. Adaptive Tucker rank allocation thus provides an effective approach to parameter-efficient transfer learning in 3D medical imaging.

</details>

### 278. [DeltaTrace: Efficient Signed Attribution for Reasoning Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25877v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25877

**作者：** Chen Liang、Daoping Wu、Donghua Yang、Zhiyu Liang、Ying Zhang、Shuguang Xiong、Hongzhi Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25877v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25877v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究上下文词对语言模型既定回答的支持或反对作用，提出 DeltaTrace：掩码被解释 token 后测量回答 log-probability 的变化，再用算子特定的局部规则与有效割线斜率沿计算图反向传播，为每个 token 分配带符号归因并保持局部守恒，同时支持 attention 与 linear-attention 模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「贡献分配 + 守恒式归因」线索可能可供核查迁移到 LVR 中视觉 token 或 latent 推理步骤对答案的因果贡献度量，但原文面向纯文本、未涉及多模态或推理期状态，适用性需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeltaTrace: Efficient Signed Attribution for Reasoning Language Models

**abstract/A1：** We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed model response. DeltaTrace measures how the response's log-probability changes when the context tokens being explained are masked. To distribute this difference among source tokens, it constructs operator-specific local rules for finite changes and composes them backward through the computational graph using effective secant slopes. Each token is assigned a signed attribution as the inner product of its embedding displacement and the corresponding backward-propagated slope. Local conservation makes these contributions sum to the measured score difference and preserves their meaning when aggregated over sentences or passages. DeltaTrace supports both attention and linear-attention models, with auxiliary memory growing linearly with sequence length at fixed model dimensions and chunk size. On the evaluated attention model, DeltaTrace achieves the lowest deletion-faithfulness scores (RISE and MAS) on most retrieval and reasoning tasks and the highest needle-in-a-haystack Recall, exceeding FlashTrace by 5.67-24.33 percentage points. On the evaluated hybrid attention and linear-attention model, DeltaTrace lowers RISE on 9 tasks and MAS on 12 relative to FlashTrace.

</details>

### 279. [Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25880v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25880

**作者：** Xidong Wu、Qi Qi、Yuqiong Ji、Shangqian Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25880v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25880v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出异步 on-policy 自蒸馏（AsyncOPSD），将 rollout 生成与学习者更新解耦以提升训练吞吐，并用陈旧度感知的策略控制与 token 级熵加权缓解缓冲轨迹过期导致的性能下降，在数学推理基准上同时提升吞吐与准确率。

**相关性简评：** 其处理「过时缓冲轨迹」的陈旧度加权与 token 级熵加权，可供核查 LVR 中复用缓存 latent 状态或旧策略轨迹时的训练稳定性与贡献分配问题，属方法线索而非直接研究主线。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

</details>

### 280. [Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25887v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25887

**作者：** Lejia Ye、Bin Wu、Jingjing Gao、Yiyang Wu、Xiaohu Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25887v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25887v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文从 few-shot learning 视角重构稀疏视角 3D Gaussian Splatting，把高斯图元视为神经元，通过光流引导的伪视角合成与相机-场景联合优化增加监督，并用 motion-aware dropout 和 early stopping 抑制过拟合，在 SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 稀疏视角挑战中取得第一名。

**相关性简评：** 其研究主线是 3D 重建而非 VLM 推理，但「稀疏监督下用 dropout 与 early stopping 做训练期正则化」可能为 latent 状态的过拟合抑制与监督增强提供可核查的方法线索，需确认是否可迁移到推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention

**abstract/A1：** Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement. We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 5 figures. First-place solution in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Volumetric Video Challenge

</details>

### 281. [Motor compound fault diagnosis using an attention-based cross-talk architecture](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25893v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25893

**作者：** Wonjun Yi、Wonho Jung、Junho Kim、Rismaya Kumar Mishra、Yong-Hwa Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25893v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25893v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对电机复合故障诊断，提出 RNDR-TFCA：保留任务专属特征提取器，再用时间—频率注意力与通道注意力在任务间选择性交换信息，实现多输出诊断，在转子—轴承系统上宏 F1 达 0.898，优于单任务、共享主干与 cross-talk 基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「任务专属分支＋选择性跨任务交换＋注意力筛选信息流」的做法，可能为多子任务 latent 推理中避免共享表征坍缩与负迁移提供线索，与视觉证据筛选、并行 latent 假设协调的机制可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Motor compound fault diagnosis using an attention-based cross-talk architecture

**abstract/A1：** As physical AI increasingly relies on sensing to understand physical systems, reliable condition monitoring of industrial machinery has become more important. Motors are ubiquitous in industrial systems, and increasing system complexity raises the likelihood of simultaneous faults. Accordingly, compound fault diagnosis that identifies multiple fault components and their severities is increasingly required. Because different fault components jointly affect the same vibration signal, their severity classification can be formulated as related tasks, making multi-task learning (MTL) suitable for exploiting shared information. However, conventional shared-trunk architectures force tasks to share a common representation, potentially causing negative transfer because fault components are characterized by different time-frequency regions. To address this issue, this study proposes a Residual Neural Dimension Reductor with Time-Frequency Channel Attention (RNDR-TFCA), an attention-enhanced cross-talk architecture for multi-output compound fault diagnosis. RNDR-TFCA preserves task-specific feature extractors while selectively exchanging information across tasks. Time-frequency attention emphasizes informative intra-task regions, while channel attention enhances useful inter-task information after nonlinear feature fusion. Experiments on a rotor-bearing system with inner-race fault, outer-race fault, misalignment, and unbalance showed that RNDR-TFCA achieved a macro F1 score of 0.898, outperforming single-task, multi-class, shared-trunk, and cross-talk baselines. Ablation experiments confirmed the benefit of jointly applying both attention mechanisms. RNDR-TFCA required 713 K parameters and 170.42 MMACs, only slightly higher than RNDR. Channel-expanded baselines still underperformed RNDR-TFCA, indicating that the gain was not simply attributable to increased model capacity.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to ICSV33

</details>
