### 282. [An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25906v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25906

**作者：** Tyler Bonnet、Marek Rei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25906v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25906v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究动态文本属性图上的边分类，提出统一的文本-图对齐框架：用轻量 Transformer adapter 依据对比预训练的时空梯度更新 token 级文本表示，并以语言模型维持目标锚定原始语义结构，在动态文本属性图基准上验证性能与表示各向异性的改善。

**相关性简评：** 其「锚定式」表示协同演化与防语义漂移的正则化，可能为 LVR 中训练期 latent 状态如何既更新又保留视觉/任务信息提供可核查线索；文中各向异性与线性可分性的表示分析，也可供考察 latent 相似度结构的借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. Representational analyses reveal that the framework reduces anisotropy, improving the linear separability of text embeddings, and effectively encodes structural and temporal information into the semantic space. A computational efficiency analysis confirms that this beneficial semantic and spatio-temporal co-evolution is achieved without incurring the prohibitive computational overhead typical of end-to-end joint training.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LEAP，一种无需额外训练的 ODE 采样加速方法：利用采样轨迹的低维性与跨轨迹一致性，在局部轨迹子空间内建立监督式最小二乘拟合，从而在不调用模型的情况下精确逼近未来状态，并在文本到图像、图像到 3D 等生成任务上验证其可与已有求解器即插即用结合。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是「在低维轨迹子空间内用最小二乘外推未来状态、跳过模型评估」，可能可供核查是否能类比用于 latent 推理状态的粗粒度跃迁与相似度/缓存结构设计；不过该工作面向图像与 3D 生成加速，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LEAP: Accelerating ODE-based Diffusion Sampling with Optimal Linear Leaps

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models primarily rely on general-purpose ODE-based numerical methods for training-free accelerated sampling, but performance degrades with coarse time discretization. In this paper, we propose optimal linear leaps (LEAP), a specialized method grounded in theoretical and empirical investigations of sampling trajectory geometry. Built upon low-dimensionality and cross-trajectory consistency, LEAP formulates a supervised least-squares optimization problem within the local trajectory subspace, achieving a precise approximation of future states without model evaluations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LEAP outperforms previous methods across diverse modalities, including text-to-image (Stable Diffusion 3.5, FLUX.1-dev) and image-to-3D (TRELLIS.2) generation. Furthermore, LEAP can be seamlessly integrated into existing solver-based methods, offering a plug-and-play enhancement for modern diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/zju-pi/LEAP.

</details>

### 284. [UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25924v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25924

**作者：** Qifeng Lei、Zhiyong Yang、Zitai Wang、Shilong Bao、Linchao Zhang、Qianqian Xu、Qingming Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25924v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25924v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对语言模型错误代价不等的问题，提出基于效用的评测范式，构建含 1.5 万条可验证实例的 UtilityBench，用 Best-Worst Scaling 量化错误严重度，并引入 UtilityAUC 衡量模型按响应排序所得效用曲线下的面积，评测 20 个模型。

**相关性简评：** 其代价敏感的「回答/弃答」决策与效用度量，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本评价提供指标借鉴；但论文为纯文本评测、未涉及视觉状态，迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs

**abstract/A1：** As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that UtilityAUC can distinguish between models where standard accuracy and AURC fall short. Empirically, evaluating 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that greater accuracy or more advanced architectures do not reliably translate to higher UtilityAUC, highlighting a gap between problem-solving ability and responsible decision-making in language model evaluation.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TESS，将 LLM 与经典搜索结合用于具身任务规划：用 LLM 把自然语言指令翻译为格式化目标条件、在部分可观测环境中引导探索、构建规则式世界模拟器并剪枝候选动作，在 VirtualHome 与 ALFWorld 上验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「LLM 引导搜索＋模拟器验证＋候选动作剪枝」的框架可能为 LVR 中的推理路径搜索、证据获取与计算分配提供方法线索；但论文面向具身规划而非多模态 latent 推理，迁移价值需核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TESS: LLM-guided Translation, Exploration, Simulation, and Search for Embodied Task Planning

**abstract/A1：** In this work we focus on the problem of embodied task planning, which requires an agent to accomplish a complex task by separating it into atomic actions. Recent studies have developed LLM-based methods to address this problem. However, the executability and correctness of the generated plans remain suboptimal in complex environments and tasks. On the other hand, classical search algorithms have the potential to solve the planning problems perfectly, yet they require fully observable environments, known state transitions and goal state, which are often unattainable in general task domains. Therefore, we propose to implement an LLM-guided search algorithm that makes the search process possible and efficient by incorporating LLMs' commonsense knowledge. Our method leverages LLMs to (1) translate natural language instructions into formatted goal conditions, (2) facilitate efficient exploration in partially observable environments, (3) implement a rule-based world simulator, and (4) prune the space of candidate actions to improve search efficiency. Experimental results on VirtualHome and ALFWorld demonstrate its superior performance.

**comment/C1：** EMNLP 2026 findings. Code will be released at https://github.com/woyut/TESS\_EMNLP26

### 286. [The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25933v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25933

**作者：** Moritz Wagner、Christophe Roux、Max Zimmer、Sebastian Pokutta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25933v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25933v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 KV-Surgeon，用校准数据建模 softmax 重归一化带来的条目间非线性耦合，导出二次代理目标，闭式地联合做贪心删除与剩余条目补偿，从而在离线 KV-cache 压缩中取得更优的成本—精度权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「删除某条会改变全部剩余注意力权重」的补偿式筛选思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 缓存保留提供可核查线索，但原文是纯文本长上下文 QA，未涉及多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction

**abstract/A1：** Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

</details>

### 287. [Productive State-Space Exploration for Multi-turn RL in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25957v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25957

**作者：** Mohammed Haroon Dupty、Yong Liang Goh、Song Guo、Wee Sun Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25957v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25957v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对多轮长时程 LLM agent 中无效动作与动作循环等低效行为，提出条件状态空间探索框架，用惩罚「观测与历史状态记忆重复」的内在奖励，在任务完成与信息寻求之间做平衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「内部状态表示与环境动态不匹配」的诊断，以及基于状态记忆冗余惩罚的探索信号，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态循环、信息坍缩与轨迹训练监督提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Productive State-Space Exploration for Multi-turn RL in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Model (LLM) agents in multi-turn, long-horizon environments remains challenging due to inefficient action selection and repetitive behavioral patterns. In particular, agents often become trapped in high-confidence yet unproductive behaviors, repeatedly executing invalid actions or entering action loops that hinder task completion. We observe that these frequently violate environment preconditions, revealing a mismatch between the agent's representation of the internal state and the dynamics of the underlying environment. In addition, repetitive high-confidence actions lead to cyclical behaviors that provide little to no progress towards the goal. We argue that addressing these challenges requires more productive task-aligned exploration to improve the agent's understanding of environment dynamics. Motivated by intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration, we propose a conditional state-space exploration framework that balances task completion with intrinsic information-seeking behavior. Specifically, we introduce an intrinsic reward that penalizes actions whose observation duplicates prior state memory. This provides the benefit of reducing redundant behaviors and encouraging state-space coverage without relying on a general information-theoretic measure. Strong experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy learning in multi-turn environments, mitigating invalid actions and repetitive loops.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25963

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25963v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25963v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ABACUS 框架：离线由生成式教师设计判断模式与组合程序，在线由冻结的判别模型回答局部语义问题，再由保存的程序把局部判断组合成多步推理答案；在三个 BIG-Bench Hard 任务上以 99.67% 宏准确率和 8.43 倍在线加速验证了该方案。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结判别模型 + 可复用组合程序」的做法可能为 LVR 中推理状态的程序化更新、轨迹复用与贡献分配提供参考，但工作为纯文本、无视觉状态，能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ABACUS: Program-Guided Multistep Reasoning over Frozen Judgment Models

**abstract/A1：** Judgment models answer semantic questions by scoring a finite set of candidate outcomes. Can reusable programs turn these local decisions into powerful multistep reasoning? We introduce \\method, a framework that jointly constructs judgment schemas and composition programs for frozen judgment models. A generative teacher designs the procedure offline; the judgment model resolves local semantic questions online, and the saved program composes its decisions into an answer. We study three allocations of design effort between humans and the teacher, focusing on construction through a shared interface. We instantiate the framework with Kev. On three selected BIG-Bench Hard tasks, nine independently constructed programs solve all 450 executions of 150 development inputs. A separate deployment study freezes three programs after development-set reference-agreement refinement and evaluates them on 600 held-out questions. These programs achieve near-perfect 99.67\\% macro accuracy, versus 64.00\\% for direct Kev and 68.80\\% for final-answer-only Qwen3.5-4B. They attain comparable observed accuracy to Qwen's unrestricted response policy (99.07\\%) with an \\textbf{8.43-fold online speedup}: 0.255 versus 2.150 seconds per question. These results show how reusable programs can substantially expand the reasoning capability of a compact judgment model while keeping its parameters fixed.

</details>

### 289. [Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25973v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25973

**作者：** Suwan Yoon、Seongryong Jung、Changhee Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25973v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25973v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 APSD，以正确性为条件混合学生与自教师分布（正确轨迹做插值保留、错误轨迹做外推加强纠正），并通过散度分解、reverse-KL 重心几何与梯度分析说明学生相关目标中梯度流的作用，在带可验证奖励与丰富反馈的 RL 设定下评测。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本策略优化工作，不含视觉或显式 latent 推理；但其按正确性构造目标分布、以及"目标依赖学生状态时梯度流才有效"的分析，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督与贡献分配提供线索，是否可迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25991

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多智能体路径规划（MAPF）中的神经策略，提出一种元层面的 Map-Distribution MoE：先训练面向不同地图分布的紧凑专家，再学习路由器按各智能体的局部情境选择性融合专家输出，并配合监督与强化学习微调，以图神经网络策略和新提出的递归动作 token 精化模型作为实例验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「递归动作 token 精化」与「按局部情境路由并融合专家输出」可能为 LVR 的迭代状态更新与动态计算选择提供方法线索，另需核查其「参数匹配的单体模型仍优于 MoE」的结论是否提示路由式组合存在收益边界。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Map-Distribution Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Agent Pathfinding

**abstract/A1：** Designing capable neural policies for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), which map local observations to action distributions, represents an important challenge in multi-agent learning, with practical relevance to scalable collective automation problems such as warehouse logistics. In contrast to prior studies focusing primarily on individual policy design, this study explores a meta-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach to learning-based MAPF. Specifically, given a collection of compact yet high-performing experts specialised for different map distributions, our architecture learns a router that selectively fuses their outputs according to each agent's local situation. We instantiate and validate this MoE approach with a commonly used graph neural network-based policy as well as a newly developed recursive action-token refinement model. Combined with supervised and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the experts, our experiments show that MoE generally improves upon the pretrained policy and outperforms existing leading methods. At the same time, our findings reveal that appropriately trained, parameter-matched monolithic models still outperform MoE, highlighting a nuanced role for map-distribution MoE for MAPF.

</details>

**title/T1：** Procedural Memory for Language Agents: A Neurosymbolic Perspective on Explicit Goal Structure

**abstract/A1：** Large language models remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks requiring procedural reasoning. We argue that a key cause is the absence of explicit procedural memory: accessible, modifiable knowledge of how tasks are accomplished, distinct from semantic and episodic memory. Goal-Oriented Graphs offer such a representation, encoding goals and prerequisite dependencies as inspectable symbolic structure. We examine their construction, the challenges they pose, and principles for integrating them with neural reasoning.

</details>

### 292. [PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26000v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26000

**作者：** Dibyanshu Kumar、Magda Gregorova

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26000v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26000v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PnP-CF，将 flow-matching 去噪器与 ADMM 式对偶变量更新、时间自适应的 pullback 机制结合，用于求解线性与非线性逆问题（含神经网络前向算子）。

**相关性简评：** 其 flow 采样器与逆问题求解器的交替迭代及「共识」稳定机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成与更新、以及与视觉证据保持一致提供方法线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems

**abstract/A1：** Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

**comment/C1：** Short version accepted at PriGM Workshop, NeurIPS 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对压缩扩散学生模型与自适应推理结合时的「Combination Gap」，提出 TamedFlow：以跨架构特征对齐、近恒等的 Velocity Alignment Head 和随机 rollout 监督训练压缩 DiT，并在推理时用轻量可学习轨迹估计器路由草稿，接受则跳过教师、拒绝则回滚并做一次教师救援步骤。

**相关性简评：** 其「学生需在自身预测被链式执行时保持可靠」的 rollout 监督与草稿接受/回滚路由，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督、贡献分配以及 STOP／动态计算决策提供可核查的方法线索，但该文面向扩散图像视频生成，与 VLM 推理的联系尚待核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TamedFlow: Trajectory-Aware Distillation\\\\for Teacher-Assisted Diffusion Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \\textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \\textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decision4Rec: A Jev-Inspired Framework of Decision Models on Knowledge and Active Graphs for Multi-Agent Recommender Systems

**abstract/A1：** Decision models, such as the commercial Jev, are language models that return one probability for each option of a question instead of generating text. We present Decision4Rec, an open and modular framework that makes decision models useful for recommendation. A knowledge graph writes the logs of each recommendation scenario as short statements on a defined scale, such as "sold: top 10%". A pool of agents, proposes candidates, and a residual ranker keeps the best 30. A decision model, trained once on real choices of three scenarios, reads them through one interface of typed questions, and a fusion step combines its answers with the score of the ranker. Any model with this interface can be used, and we run the commercial Jev, the released open Kev and Kev models trained by us on recommendation requests. The framework with a trained 4B decision model is 25 to 36% above the best trained baseline in NDCG@10 in three sparse Amazon catalogues, one of them never used to train the decision model, and almost tie with baselines on the dense Steam dataset. Most of the gain comes from the pool, and with a trained recommender it comes from what the agents know about its candidates rather than from new candidates. The 27B decision model adds to the pool 5 to 6% above the 0.8B model in three of four domains. A trained 0.8B open model beats the released Jev in eleven of fifteen settings and is never worse. On MovieLens-1M, a dense domain never seen in training, the gain is 5 to 7%. Code, configurations and trained models are available at https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec and https://huggingface.co/m-polignano.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26036v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26036v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FinHopper 是一个面向金融智能体的多跳检索基准：用状态转移式合成框架把原子金融问答拼成 1–6 跳、保留依赖关系的链，并提供金标中间答案为过程级评估服务，随后评测 20 种 LLM-agent 配置。

**相关性简评：** 其金标中间答案与 step-wise 过程评分可能为 LVR 的中间状态监督、贡献分配与 hop 深度（长度泛化）评价提供可核查的方法线索，但任务为纯文本金融检索，与视觉推理状态本身无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FinHopper: A Progressive Multi-Hop Benchmark for Complex Financial Agents with Step-wise Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Financial agents are expected to answer factual investment queries through open search, but financial multi-hop retrieval differs from general multi-hop QA in a crucial way: each intermediate answer is an exact typed constraint, such as an entity, date, event, or numerical indicator, that determines the next query. This strict answer-conditioned dependency makes small intermediate errors cascade into plausible but wrong search trajectories. We introduce FinHopper, a benchmark for complex financial agents with controlled reasoning depth from 1 to 6 hops, covering stocks, funds, and macroeconomic facts, with gold intermediate answers for process-level evaluation. To construct FinHopper at scale, we design a state-transition-based synthesis framework that composes verified atomic financial QA patterns into dependency-preserving chains, followed by targeted in-synthesis verification, model-ensemble checking, and public-search validation by financial experts. Experiments with 20 LLM-agent configurations show that public search tools are necessary but insufficient: performance drops sharply as hop depth increases, the best model remains far below human experts, and process-aware scoring reveals partial reasoning progress hidden by final-answer-only evaluation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 28 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26046

**作者：** Mingyang Wu、Kaituo Feng、Bohao Li、Kaixiong Gong、Zihao Yin、Xiangyu Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26046v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26046v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了 5 万规模、含长视频与时间精确描述的 AVTime-50K 数据集，提出以「双向时序-语义对齐」（BiTSA）奖励进行 RL 优化的 AVTime 模型，并配套双向评测时间准确性与语义正确性的 AVTime-Bench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其 BiTSA 奖励在时间与事件之间施加显式双向约束，可能为 LVR 中推理状态与视觉证据的对应性监督、时间定位贡献分配提供可供核查的训练线索；但论文本身聚焦音视频描述质量，未涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AVTime: Reinforcing Dense Audio-Visual Captions with Bidirectional Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Dense temporal audio-visual captioning is important for multimodal video understanding and generation. However, prior work is constrained by three main limitations: (1) the lack of a dataset combining high temporal resolution, longer videos, and bidirectional alignment between time and events; (2) the reliance of most existing RL methods on checklists; and (3) the lack of a benchmark that bidirectionally evaluates event semantic correctness and temporal accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose: (1) AVTime-50K, a high-quality 50K-scale dataset with temporally precise, semantically accurate captions and longer videos; (2) AVTime, a state-of-the-art model optimized with a novel Bidirectional Temporal-Semantic Alignment (BiTSA) reward that imposes explicit bidirectional constraints between time and events; and (3) AVTime-Bench, a specialized benchmark that introduces a novel bidirectional evaluation of temporal accuracy and semantic correctness. Our code, models, and datasets are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Apryle/avtime.

</details>

### 297. [Procedural Exposure Bias in Skill-Augmented Language Model Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26062v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26062

**作者：** Qing Yang、Yuqi Xiong、Pengcheng Huang、Zhipeng Xu、Zhenghao Liu、Zulong Chen、Yu Gu、Ge Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26062v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26062v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「程序性暴露偏差」（PEB）：技能中反复出现的程序模式会让语言模型日益偏好对应动作；作者比较同一内容以视觉与文本形式呈现时的差异，用逐层分析和激活干预考察该偏好向输出传播的方式，并在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上做完整 agent 评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「信号可及」与「被用作动作证据」相分离的核心观察，以及视觉/文本表征对比和逐层—激活干预手段，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉内容是否只是保留在内部状态、还是真正参与答案生成，属可借鉴的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Procedural Exposure Bias in Skill-Augmented Language Model Agents

**abstract/A1：** External skills provide language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge, yet how models use such knowledge after it is supplied remains poorly understood. We identify Procedural Exposure Bias (PEB), the tendency of language models to increasingly favor an action as its associated procedural pattern is repeatedly exposed in a skill, even when the interaction state and action relevance remain unchanged. We find that PEB strongly depends on how procedural knowledge is represented: presenting the same content visually substantially attenuates exposure-induced shifts in action preference relative to textual presentation. Further analysis shows that this attenuation primarily arises from visual encoding rather than structured layout. Although repeated procedural signals remain recoverable from Visual representations, they exert a weaker influence on downstream action prediction, distinguishing signal accessibility from its use as action evidence. This effect also extends to executable action selection, where increasing exposure more strongly favors the corresponding action under Text than Visual. Layer-wise analyses show that exposure-dependent action evidence becomes more pronounced toward the model output, with stronger evidence under Text, while activation interventions reveal architecture-specific roles of internal components in transmitting or counteracting the preference shift. Complete-agent evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop further show that Visual skills achieve higher macro-average task success than Text skills for all four evaluated models. These findings establish skill representation as an important factor governing how procedural knowledge is translated into agent decisions. All code is available at https://github.com/NEUIR/Vis-Skill.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 12 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 298. [Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26064

**作者：** J. Boyer-Chammard、R. Vauclin、M. C. Biston、P. Maury、M. Gau、S. Stathakis、V. Grégoire、N. Paragios、E. Deutsch、N. Komodakis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26064v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LaDose：在剂量分布上训练自编码器将三维剂量图压缩 128 倍，再于潜空间做扩散生成整体积剂量预测，处方值以标量向量绕过图像编码器直接注入，并用多尺度无分类器引导在推理时调节靶区覆盖与危及器官保护的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关系，但有三条可供核查的线索：任务必需标量绕过编码器以避开潜空间压缩损失、对扰动 latent 仍解码出合理输出的训练约束（对应潜表示中的必要信息保留）、以及引导尺度在推理时调节权衡，或可用于思考视觉证据注入与推理期权衡控制。需注意其 latent 为生成用压缩码，并非推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning

**abstract/A1：** Automated treatment planning (ATP) aims to reduce the unwarranted inter-planner variability of manual planning, while improving treatment quality and efficiency. Most ATP pipelines rely on the prediction of the achievable three-dimensional dose distribution for a given anatomy and the subsequent optimization of machine parameters to reproduce it. Diffusion-based methods are largely slice-wise due to the high dimensionality of radiotherapy data, and assume a one-to-one mapping between anatomy and optimal dose despite the multi-objective nature of treatment planning. They are evaluated on their ability to match reference doses and rarely on their integration in ATP frameworks. We present LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric dose prediction. An autoencoder learned on dose distributions, trained so that perturbed latents decode to plausible doses, compresses dose maps 128-fold and enables 3D diffusion on a single GPU. Prescription values are represented as exact scalar vectors that bypass the image encoder, avoiding resampling and latent compression. Multiscale classifier-free guidance allows for the modulation of clinical trade-offs at inference, without retraining or additional labeled data. On 900 clinically delivered head-and-neck volumetric modulated arc therapy plans from five centers, LaDose reached a median absolute error of 1.18 Gy (1.4--1.8\\% of the prescription) and was the only one of six frameworks free of systematic bias with respect to the reference distribution. Guidance scales acted predictably on target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing. Integrated with direct aperture optimization, the pipeline generated plans in 15.2 minutes; in a blinded review, senior clinicians rated 14 of 15 plans acceptable without editing.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 7 figures plus graphical abstract

</details>

### 299. [Not All Similarity Is Leakage: Distribution-Aware Identity Leakage Assessment in Synthetic Face Datasets](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26077v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26077

**作者：** Paweł Borsukiewicz、Daniele Lunghi、Wendkûuni C. Ouédraogo、Fadi Boutros、Jacques Klein、Tegawendé F. Bissyandé

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26077v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26077v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对合成人脸数据集的身份泄漏评估，指出现有方法过度依赖单一分类器、且会误把训练未用的真实数据集判为泄漏，提出身份级非参数重叠度量 Scaled Overlap，并用多模型组合降低单模型误差后比较多个合成数据集。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「多模型组合抵消单分类器误差」与分布感知的非参数相似度检验，可能可供核查 latent 相似度究竟反映内容还是模型伪影这一问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Similarity Is Leakage: Distribution-Aware Identity Leakage Assessment in Synthetic Face Datasets

**abstract/A1：** Synthetic data provides the means for more ethical and less biased facial recognition. Nonetheless, the limitations of generative models and the conditioning process they rely on pose a risk of identity leakage, resulting in synthetic samples that are overly similar to those seen in a generator's training set, mitigating privacy benefits. In this work, we show that previously proposed approaches are affected by two key limitations: high classifier dependence and a tendency to identify leakage with respect to real datasets that were not used in training. To address these shortcomings, we propose a novel metric called Scaled Overlap (SO), which adapts a non-parametric data-copying test for facial recognition and extends it to the identity level. By leveraging a multi-model setup that compensates for errors in individual classifiers, it provides insights into the true strength of identity leakage. Our analysis identifies leaking datasets (CemiFace, SFace2, IDNet) with the most acute leakage introduced by generative model conditioning in CemiFace, demonstrates that real datasets do not contribute equally to generator training, and shows that the majority of synthetic images are drawn from multiple identities rather than relying on a single identity. Ultimately, our study provides new insights into the quality of synthetic datasets and gives more reliable techniques to help the community ensure the trustworthiness of synthetic data.

</details>

### 300. [DCR-TSF: Dual-Level Compositional Reasoning with Triadic Spherical Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26078v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26078

**作者：** Gwang-Ho Na、Ho-Joong Kim、Seong-Whan Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26078v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26078v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练零样本组合图像检索框架 DCR-TSF：用双层级组合推理生成细粒度与粗粒度目标描述，再以球面插值构造组合查询锚点，并在单位超球面上用加权 Karcher 均值把三路表示融合成最终查询表示。

**相关性简评：** 其「多粒度描述 + 锚点」在超球面上的加权融合，可能为 LVR 中如何同时保留直接视觉证据与高层抽象、缓解生成描述导致的信息坍缩提供可核查的表示融合线索，但属检索任务，需人工判断迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DCR-TSF: Dual-Level Compositional Reasoning with Triadic Spherical Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that reflects an intended textual modification while maintaining semantic consistency with a reference image. Existing training-free ZS-CIR methods typically rely on fine-grained generated target descriptions, which often overemphasize reference-specific visual details and lead to appearance-biased retrieval. Moreover, since these descriptions are generated through multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the direct influence of the original image-text query can be weakened in the final retrieval representation. In this paper, we propose DCR-TSF, a training-free ZS-CIR framework that combines Dual-level Compositional Reasoning (DCR) and Triadic Spherical Fusion (TSF). DCR generates fine- and coarse-grained descriptions from the reference image and modification text, capturing complementary target-side semantics across different granularities. To preserve the original image-text query information, TSF constructs a composed-query anchor by spherically interpolating the reference image feature and modification text feature, and fuses it with the fine- and coarse-grained representations using a weighted Karcher mean on the unit hypersphere. The resulting final query representation balances detailed visual evidence, high-level semantic abstraction, and direct preservation of the original composed query. Extensive experiments on CIRCO, CIRR, and Fashion-IQ demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ACCV 2026. 14 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 301. [Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26084v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26084

**作者：** Peijun Shi、Xiujin Zhu、Zhenguo Lao、Chee-Onn Chow、Wei Ru Wong、Zhen Liu、Xiaobing Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26084v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26084v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CTD-GNet：以脑电特征作为电极图节点，用眼动与前后窗口通过电极级 prompt 调制图的边、节点和读出，并通过图、节点关系与预测的双向蒸馏把多模态教师与单窗口 EEG 学生对齐，在 SEED/SEED-IV 的留一被试测试中验证眼动缺失与噪声下的稳健性。

**相关性简评：** 其跨模态双向蒸馏在眼动数据缺失时仍维持性能，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据被旁路或信息坍缩时，如何用训练监督把多模态信息压入单一推理状态」提供可供核查的线索，但任务与评价体系差异较大，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition

**abstract/A1：** EEG-eye movement emotion recognition can support mental-health monitoring and adaptive interfaces, but most fusion models treat the two signals as parallel features, classify each window alone and degrade when eye data are lost. We propose the Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network (CTD-GNet), in which EEG features form the nodes of an electrode graph, and eye movements and preceding windows modulate its edges, nodes and readout, the edges through electrode-specific prompts. Bidirectional distillation of the graph, node relations and predictions couples this multimodal teacher with a single-window EEG student, improving the teacher and aligning the two graphs 35-fold. In leave-one-subject-out tests on SEED and SEED-IV against 17 baselines, CTD-GNet has the highest mean accuracy, 84.91% and 76.17%, significantly above 9 and 6 of 13 eye-based baselines after Holm correction, the smallest cross-subject spread among multimodal models and the highest worst-subject accuracy. It is the most accurate model at every rate of missing eye data on SEED-IV, keeps 66.1% on SEED without eye data, more than any EEG-only model, and stays 9.3 and 11.9 points above all single-window fusion models under eye-movement noise of one standard deviation. On film clips unseen in training, it leads on SEED with 77.1%.

</details>

### 302. [RGB--Event Object Detection Across Operating Frequencies via Reliability-Supervised Routing and Asymmetric-Resolution Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26090v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26090

**作者：** Peijun Shi、Jiannan Zhao、Xiujin Zhu、Zhenguo Lao、Chee-Onn Chow、Wei Ru Wong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26090v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26090v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 RGB–事件相机跨工作频率的目标检测，提出可靠性监督路由（用仅训练时使用的两个单模态分类器损失，为每个位置生成融合权重监督信号）与非对称分辨率融合（帧保持原生分辨率、各级特征池化到事件网格），在 DSEC-Det 与 DAVIS346 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 逐位置可信度加权、用训练期辅助监督为融合权重分配贡献、以及保留帧原生分辨率再对齐到事件网格，可能可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、贡献分配与「细节不被压缩掉」的表示设计；但该文属检测期多模态融合，与 VLM 内部 latent 状态生成的迁移性仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RGB--Event Object Detection Across Operating Frequencies via Reliability-Supervised Routing and Asymmetric-Resolution Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Autonomous vehicles must detect objects faster than a frame camera delivers images. Event cameras record brightness changes with microsecond resolution, so RGB--event detectors can decide between frames, at an operating frequency, the rate of decisions, far above the frame rate. As this rate rises, each decision receives a sparser event window, and the reliability of the events relative to the frame varies over the scene and over time. Existing detectors weight the sensors per sample and encode the frame at the reduced event resolution. Reliability-supervised routing assigns a fusion weight to every location and supervises it with targets from the losses of two single-modality classifiers used only in training, moving loss-based supervision of fusion weights from whole samples to individual locations. Asymmetric-resolution fusion lets the frame carry the decision where the events fail: it encodes the frame at native resolution and pools every feature level onto the event grid, reusing all pretrained weights. On the DSEC-Det dataset, routing halves the accuracy loss from 20 to 180 Hz, from 6.3 to 3.1 mAP, and lowers it in every seed. The resulting detector, ERA-Det, sets a new state of the art at 63.2 mAP, 3.7 mAP above FlexEvent, leads at every operating frequency, and at 180 Hz is more accurate than FlexEvent at 20 Hz. On two DAVIS346 datasets, the router lowers the frame weight at night and in low light and raises it when the events vanish. ERA-Det upgrades released FlexEvent weights in 5,000 iterations on one GPU.

</details>

### 303. [GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26091v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26091

**作者：** Tao Sun、Huanting Guo、Baao Xie、Zhou Fang、Qiuyu Chen、Hao Zheng、Wenjun Zeng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26091v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26091v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GeoNaviDiff，一个无监督跨空间框架：从 StyleGAN 重建—编辑对中提取球面 Log-map 切向量，平行迁移到真实图像的扩散 h 空间，用共享的因子条件 Navigator 预测该切向并沿保范测地线实现真实图像的可分解语义编辑。

**相关性简评：** 其把语义干预方向作为切向量在隐空间迁移、并靠「保范测地实现 + 源锚定 rollout」稳定状态轨迹的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新方向可控性与防坍缩稳定化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Disentangled real-image manipulation requires factor-specific semantic control while preserving image fidelity and non-target content. StyleSpace $S$ provides interpretable controls but is limited by GAN inversion, whereas diffusion models offer stronger image realization without an explicit factorized control basis. We introduce GeoNaviDiff, an unsupervised cross-space framework that transfers disentangled StyleSpace interventions to local Riemannian trajectories in diffusion $h$-space. GeoNaviDiff constructs reconstruction-decoupled supervision by extracting a spherical Log-map tangent from a matched StyleGAN reconstruction-edit pair and parallel-transporting it to the real-image diffusion state. A shared, factor-conditioned Navigator predicts this tangent at inference, while norm-preserving geodesic realization and source-anchored rollout stabilize the reverse process without edited references or factor-specific models. Experiments across multiple datasets show that GeoNaviDiff outperforms the compared methods in fidelity, factor selectivity, edit locality, and trajectory smoothness.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26098

**作者：** Zixuan Dong、Yanghai Wang、Hanyan Bian、Jiaxi Tao、Junze Li、Jiadong Wang、Xinyu Che、Lin Liu、Baoyun Peng、Xiaodong Wang、Jiaheng Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 CEGame-Bench，跨五个游戏引擎的长时程「完整游戏创建」基准：智能体从空工程和设计文档出发（单次运行可达数百步、数千万 token），由隐藏评估器以真实输入试玩来判定成败，并发布要求驱动的试玩与修复 skill（Game Completion Boost）。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Code to Playable Systems: CEGame-Bench for Long-Horizon Game Creation Agents

**abstract/A1：** A game ships when a player can launch it, finish it, and return to a saved world, none of which a successful build guarantees, yet game-creation agents are mostly tested on one engine or on one-prompt browser games. We present CEGame-Bench, the first long-horizon benchmark for complete-game creation across five production engines: Defold, Godot, Roblox Studio, Unity, and Unreal Engine. Agents build each game from an empty project and a design document in runs averaging up to 295 steps and 65M tokens; the document doubles as a contract, and a hidden evaluator accepts a game only by real-input play. Under four scaffolds, agents earn most integration points but usually under half the gameplay points, and their games reach the ending in only 16% of runs, while references built by engineers with coding agents score near the maximum, which places this artifact-to-play gap in the agents. No two engines rank configurations alike (Kendall's tau 0.14-0.62), and the same game usually scores higher on Unity and Unreal Engine, which check more before play. We release Game Completion Boost, an agent skill for requirement-driven playtesting and repair that raises the execution-based score of three models by 14.1-24.3 points.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages. Preprint

</details>

### 305. [Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26101v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26101

**作者：** Jiasheng Mao、Jiacheng Liu、Hengwei Ye、Zheng Tian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26101v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26101v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 QuantHarness 双层智能体框架：金融专用 Workflow 组织规格、数据落地、构建、测试与审查，Harness Core 约束各阶段的信息、动作与承诺边界；并给出 FinRelBench，从执行成功、需求满足与运行时证据评估策略开发可靠性。

**相关性简评：** 无视觉或多模态成分，但「中间产物如何成为下游状态」的阶段边界控制与运行时证据留存，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新门控、轨迹监督与证据/停止判定提供可核查线索，迁移性待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\\%, compared with 74.23\\%--84.54\\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

### 306. [Provable Adversarial Detection: Prime Quantization meets Gromov--Wasserstein](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26102v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26102

**作者：** Manohar Kaul、Sadbhavana Babar、Aditya Ramesh、Aditya Saibewar、Fumiyoshi Kasahara、Maki Inui、Hiroaki Kurihara

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26102v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26102v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从几何角度研究对抗扰动的可证明检测：构造 CNN 嵌入空间与素数量化空间，利用两空间间的位移差异，结合 Gromov-Wasserstein 分离定理给出像素级吸收界与风险控制等理论保证，并在多种攻击与模型（含 VLM）上验证。

**相关性简评：** Gromov-Wasserstein 跨空间几何一致性度量或许可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留视觉结构与证据一致性，但其目标是对抗检测而非推理状态生成，联系仍属推测性方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Provable Adversarial Detection: Prime Quantization meets Gromov--Wasserstein

**abstract/A1：** Adversarial vulnerability persists across modern vision architectures from CNNs to vision language models (VLMs), yet existing detection methods rely on heuristics without theoretical guarantees. We address the fundamental question of when adversarial perturbations can be provably detected from a geometric perspective. Our key insight is that adversarial perturbations cannot simultaneously preserve geometric structure across spaces with fundamentally different properties. Accordingly, we construct two such complementary metric spaces. First, we use a standard CNN embedding space $Z$, where adversarial samples exhibit significant displacement patterns. Second, we build a novel prime-quantized space $P$, that absorbs small perturbations through number-theoretic discretization, resulting in minimal displacement, while preserving discriminability. We then leverage the geometric discrepancies across spaces $Z$ and $P$ to detect adversarial samples. To the best of our knowledge, we establish the first rigorous separation theory for adversarial detection, proving that adversarial samples create unavoidable geometric inconsistencies across both spaces. Our framework provides theoretical guarantees including pixel-level absorption bounds, neighborhood diameter concentration, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) separation theorems, and practical risk control. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical predictions and achieve consistently strong detection performance across a wide range of attack types and model families.

**comment/C1：** 52 pages,

</details>

### 307. [From Retrieval to Recognition:Knowledge-Enhanced Post-training of Time Series Foundation Models for Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26114v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26114

**作者：** Zhen Liu、Yucheng Wang、Yingpeng Du、Tianjun Wei、Qianli Ma、Min Wu、Jie Zhang、Zhu Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26114v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26114v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Retrieval-to-Recognition（R2R），一种面向时间序列基础模型分类的即插即用后训练范式：用解耦的 query encoder 从知识库中检索实例级数值知识，并与模型参数化隐式嵌入融合，实现参数级与特征级的联合知识迁移，在 158 个数据集上提升分类性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「检索显式知识并与参数化隐式表示融合」的机制可供核查：这种外部证据与内部状态的对齐注入方式，或可类比 LVR 中视觉证据的筛选与写入 latent 状态，但领域为时间序列，迁移可行性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Retrieval to Recognition:Knowledge-Enhanced Post-training of Time Series Foundation Models for Classification

**abstract/A1：** Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved notable progress in classification tasks through large-scale pretraining. However, their post-training practice mainly focuses on implicit parameter fine-tuning, where task-relevant information is entangled with abundant irrelevant knowledge in vast parameter spaces. This may hinder TSFMs from precisely activating useful knowledge for downstream classification. To this end, we propose Retrieval-to-Recognition (R2R), a plug-and-play post-training paradigm that adapts pretrained TSFMs to time series classification. Rather than pretraining a new foundation model, R2R improves how existing TSFMs are post-trained: it introduces a decoupled query encoder to extract discriminative patterns and retrieve instance-level numerical knowledge from a constructed knowledge base. The retrieved explicit knowledge is then fused with the TSFM's implicit parametric embeddings, enabling joint knowledge transfer at both the parameter and feature levels. In this way, R2R allows TSFMs to recall task-relevant patterns learned during pretraining, improving the efficiency of knowledge utilization in downstream classification transfer. Experiments on 158 time series datasets show that R2R consistently improves the classification performance of state-of-the-art TSFMs. Ablation and knowledge-enhanced studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

**comment/C1：** Accepted in NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 308. [Nash-MOPD: Optimizing Task Trade-offs in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26124v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26124

**作者：** Siyuan Gan、Bo Yang、Linjian Meng、Boyan Wang、Xiaolong Qi、Jing Huo、Yang Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26124v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26124v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Nash-MOPD：在多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）中，用局部极小极大博弈与已有的 reverse-KL 统计自适应调整各领域的采样比例，使进步较慢的领域获得更多提示，从而在不增加教师查询和 rollout 的前提下改善数学与代码等领域的蒸馏效果。

**相关性简评：** 其按领域公平分配优化步数的极小极大调度思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中多类监督或多阶段行为（如 THINK/LOOK/STOP）的预算分配与贡献分配问题；但原文只研究纯文本多教师蒸馏，与视觉 latent 状态生成无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Nash-MOPD: Optimizing Task Trade-offs in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) aggregates the capabilities of multiple domain-expert teachers into a single student model. However, all domains in MOPD share the student's finite budget of optimization steps and rollouts. Fixed uses constant domain sampling ratios based on corpus sizes; by contrast, D$^3$-MOPD adjusts the ratios using the teacher-student reverse-KL divergence and its recent decrease. However, favoring large recent decreases can direct more training toward domains that already improve quickly, while domains that improve more slowly may receive too few examples. To address inflexible allocation and the risk of giving insufficient training to domains that improve more slowly, we propose Nash-MOPD, an adaptive domain scheduler based on a local minimax game using existing reverse-KL statistics. The equilibrium maximizes the smallest predicted proportional reduction under the local model and gives more prompts to domains that need more examples for comparable improvement. Consequently, Nash-MOPD responds to changing learning progress and supports domains that improve more slowly without extra teacher queries or rollouts. At step 100, Nash-MOPD exceeds both baselines' final mathematics and code checkpoint scores on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and reaches Fixed's on Qwen3-8B-Base. Furthermore, it leads eight of nine reported metrics and is best or tied best on all six mathematics and code accuracy metrics, respectively.

</details>

### 309. [TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26165v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26165

**作者：** Jia Li、Xurui Peng、Haowei Zhu、Tianyu Zhao、Jiexi Wang、Youwei Zheng、Yuxi Ren、Xinglong Wu、Xing Wang、Hayden Kwok-Hay So

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26165v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26165v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把自回归视频扩散的质量—效率瓶颈归因为基础模型误差、训练与推理分布不匹配及上游误差传播，据此提出三部分轨迹—分布协同蒸馏框架 TriTD，单卡 H100 上达 26.8 FPS 实时生成。

**相关性简评：** 其多步 rollout 的误差分解、轨迹蒸馏与分布匹配监督，可能类比 latent 推理轨迹的逐步误差累积与监督分配；分块加噪调度消除冗余 KV-cache 更新，也供核查是否对应 latent 状态的缓存与复用问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 310. [Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26179v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26179

**作者：** Xiang Kaibo、Liu Qingfeng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26179v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26179v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用冻结的高层世界模型训练一个轻量 goal-conditioned 网络，替代原本需反复对候选宏动作轨迹求导的搜索，在共享 latent 空间自回归地生成下一 waypoint；训练仅用 hindsight 目标与状态预测损失，在多个环境上超过原有 HWM 搜索基线并获得 1.28–4.39x 加速。

**相关性简评：** 把原本靠搜索/优化得到的中间 latent 状态改为网络摊销生成，并报告 state-adaptive conditioning 的消融，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成方式与动态计算成本权衡提供可核查线索；但该工作属机器人与世界模型规划，与 VLM 多模态推理的可迁移性仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models

**abstract/A1：** Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.

</details>

### 311. [TaQFormer: A Treatment-as-Query Transformer with Data-Fusion for Multidimensional Treatment Modeling in Coupon Allocation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26199v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26199

**作者：** Jiahong Li、Zeqin Yang、Yu Xiang、Zhifan Jiang、Jingqi Ma、Enzheng Hua、Jixing Xu、Jun Wu、Fei Wang、Enyun Yu、Jiecheng Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TaQFormer，把多维优惠券折扣向量的每个坐标表示为 query token，用 cross-attention 估计整个处理向量的响应，并采用观测数据预训练加 RCT 数据 LoRA 微调（含融合门）的两阶段流程，通过离线 uplift 指标与线上 A/B 测试验证并全量上线。

**相关性简评：** 「treatment-as-query」将结构化维度作为 query token 由 cross-attention 汇聚信息，以及用大有偏日志预训练、小规模高质量数据微调并加融合门的监督组合，可能与 LVR 中 latent query 读取视觉证据、异构数据监督与贡献分配问题构成可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TaQFormer: A Treatment-as-Query Transformer with Data-Fusion for Multidimensional Treatment Modeling in Coupon Allocation

**abstract/A1：** We study coupon allocation on an online marketplace offering multiple service categories. Issuing coupons requires choosing a vector of category-specific discounts, accounting for both their direct effects and cross-category demand shifts. We present TaQFormer, a treatment-as-query Transformer for this multidimensional treatment setting. Each treatment coordinate is represented as a query token, allowing cross-attention to estimate the response to the full treatment vector. To combine large but policy-biased observational logs with a smaller stream of randomized controlled trial data, we use a two-stage pipeline: observational pretraining learns general outcome patterns, followed by LoRA fine-tuning on RCT data with a request-specific fusion gate. We evaluate the resulting system through the checks required for production, including offline uplift metrics, treatment-parallel serving, latency monitoring, and a 14-day online A/B test. At essentially the same subsidy cost rate, \\model increases business value per user by 1.26\\% over the production baseline and significantly outperforms both the production baseline and the RCT-only model, while meeting the latency budget. It was subsequently rolled out to all marketplace traffic and has operated at full scale for several months as of October 2026. The deployment illustrates how multidimensional treatment modeling and observational pretraining, combined with adaptation using RCT data, can support effective joint discount decisions in production.

</details>

### 312. [ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26213v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26213

**作者：** Tom Wehrbein、Bodo Rosenhahn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26213v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26213v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ExMR 系统，用初始时序估计器预测全身运动，再由 FootMR 与 HandMR 两个精化模块回到脚部与手部的局部证据（关键点、预训练手部模型图像特征）预测残差关节旋转，在多个基准上改善手、脚重建精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享全身表示会低估局部证据、需在初步估计后重回局部证据预测残差」的两阶段精化思路，可能为 LVR 中潜状态迭代更新、视觉细节保留与信息坍缩问题提供可核查的线索，但属跨任务推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture

**abstract/A1：** Detailed hand and foot articulation is important for animation and motion analysis, yet remains challenging to recover from monocular video. Recent expressive video methods infer hand articulation from shared whole-body representations. Our conference work suggests that this underexploits local evidence: the Foot Motion Refinement (FootMR) module refines ankle rotations from foot keypoints, improving reconstruction even when the initial estimator receives the same keypoints. We extend this principle to hands with the Hand Motion Refinement (HandMR) module. Because 2D finger keypoints are often missing or unreliable, HandMR combines image features of a pretrained hand reconstruction model with initial arm and hand rotations to refine elbows, wrists, and fingers. We integrate FootMR and HandMR into ExMR (Extremity Motion Refinement), a system for reconstructing 3D body, hand, and foot motion from monocular video. An initial temporal estimator predicts whole-body motion, after which both refiners revisit local evidence to predict residual joint rotations. Experiments on ARCTIC, MOYO, RICH, and MOOF show that ExMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in hand and foot reconstruction, reducing hand per-vertex error and ankle joint angle error on MOYO by 19% and 18%, respectively, relative to the strongest competitor. Code will be made available for research purposes. Project page: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction

**abstract/A1：** An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.

**comment/C1：** Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/RoAR\_VAE

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用 few-shot GPT-4.1 分类器把 31 个在线服务的条款与条件文档映射到 DSA 透明度数据库的十七类高层属性分类法，报告各类别在不同服务类型间的适用性差异，以及子类规范之间的显著重叠。

**相关性简评：** 其用 few-shot LLM 将文档对齐到固定分类体系、并诊断类别重叠导致难以单一归类的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的细粒度监督标注与评价分类体系设计提供参考，可供核查但迁移性尚不明确。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards More Granular Reasoning: Mapping the DSA Transparency Database Taxonomy to Platform Terms and Conditions Using Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Article 24(5) of the Digital Services Act (DSA) requires providers of online platforms to submit every content moderation decision they make, with a corresponding Statement of Reasons (SoR), to the DSA Transparency Database (DSA-TDB). Such decisions are classified against seventeen high-level attribute categories that categorize the primary reason for the moderation decision. Because over 99.8% of statements cite a violation of the provider's own terms and conditions rather than a legal provision, the database is overwhelmingly a record of contractual enforcement using catch-all reporting; however, whether its categories actually describe those contractual rules well has not been examined. In this paper, we map the terms and conditions (T&amp;C) of 31 designated online services against the DSA-TDB's high-level category taxonomy using a few-shot GPT-4.1 classifier over 447 policy documents. The analysis concerns how T&amp;C rules are represented in the taxonomy, not how they are enforced. Two findings emerge. First, high-level category applicability varies sharply by service type: unsafe products account for 17.5% of e-commerce assignments and 0.2% of adult-platform assignments, and negative effects on civic discourse reaches 9.9% within the Meta family but is absent from adult platforms, Booking.com, and Wikipedia. Second, the categories have notable overlap among sub-category specifications, which makes assigning a single high-level category to a decision difficult. We argue that catch-all reporting is plausibly in part a consequence of the DSA-TDB's schema and attribute design, and recommend a schema that is differentiated by service type with more mandatory attributes derived inductively from platform governance language.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to JURIX 2026

</details>

### 315. [CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26239v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26239

**作者：** Jiang Sutong、Zhao Peng、Wu Xuan、Wang Yan、Wang Jiaqi、Zhang Rui、Jiang Yuan、Zhou You、Wang Di

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26239v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26239v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 Flexible Job-Shop 调度提出 CoRS：把昂贵的图编码改为区间级复用，仅对可行性状态逐步更新，并辅以复合区间解码与静态特征补偿表示陈旧，在保持解质量的同时降低推理耗时。

**相关性简评：** 其「表示低频刷新＋状态逐步精确更新」的双时间尺度设计与陈旧性补偿，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 缓存复用、更新频率与表示漂移的权衡。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse

**abstract/A1：** Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 316. [RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26244v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26244

**作者：** Tiange Xu、Kai Liu、Linghe Kong、Yulun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26244v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26244v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RECAP，一种免训练的视频扩散加速方法：将稀疏注意力与分层缓存耦合，通过「互惠校正」与在线误差反馈，用缓存的稠密精化修正当前稀疏估计，并让新鲜稀疏统计调节旧校正，从而同时削减去噪步内与跨步计算。

**相关性简评：** 其观察到稀疏估计作为复用来源会使误差沿采样轨迹耦合、且相邻步误差方向一致故可共享校正，并用在线误差反馈自适应调节被复用状态的更新，这对 LVR 中 latent 状态的缓存复用、跨步更新与误差累积可能是可核查的方法线索，但属于视频生成加速、与多模态推理无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.

**comment/C1：** Code is available at https://github.com/lyraxtg/RECAP

</details>

### 317. [Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26262v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26262

**作者：** Yuanyu He、Zhuokun Chen、Yefei He、Zhiwei Tang、Jiasheng Tang、Yinghao Yu、Jianfei Cai、Bohan Zhuang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26262v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26262v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention（DASA），把视频内容显式解耦为动态与静态区域，据此选择性压缩历史 KV cache、按局部动态做区域级计算分配，并以动态引导蒸馏训练，在 VBench 上使自回归视频生成加速 2.16×。

**相关性简评：** 其按「动态性」筛选并压缩 KV cache、按区域分配计算，可能与 LVR 中 latent/缓存内容筛选、注意力结构与动态计算成本的权衡问题相通，可供核查其区域选择准则能否迁移到推理状态的保留与舍弃上。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026, Project page: https://yuanyu0.github.io/DASA/

</details>

### 318. [TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26271v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26271

**作者：** Yiheng Dong、Yi Lin、Shilong Huang、Xiyan Yang、Xin Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26271v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26271v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出两阶段 TIM 框架用于纵向放射报告生成：先做时间解耦的表示学习，把时间演化模式与疾病特征分离并分别生成前后两次检查报告，再通过互相反馈的迭代修正机制消除两期报告间的诊断不一致，在 Longitudinal-MIMIC 上超过单图与纵向基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「时间解耦表示 + 迭代互反馈精化」可能为 LVR 提供线索，可供核查内部状态中任务相关内容与演化成分如何分离、循环更新如何接受误差反馈与监督；但该工作是报告生成任务，不直接涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation

**abstract/A1：** Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by CVPR 2026

</details>
