### 319. [Trust Your Targets: Is Target Propagation Block-Diagonal Gauss-Newton?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26283v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26283

**作者：** Giuseppe Castiglione、Christopher Buckley、Ivor Simpson

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26283v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26283v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从信任域视角重新推导 target propagation，提出用共轭梯度并行求解逐层子问题的 CGTP，并指出 KFAC 是样本 Jacobian 取批均值时的特例；在 MNIST 与 Fashion-MNIST 的 MLP 上以远少的外层迭代匹配 ADAM、KFAC 的精度。

**相关性简评：** 局部目标携带全局学习信号、信任域约束与并行子问题求解的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配、局部监督与迭代状态更新提供可核查的方法线索；但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，属间接方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trust Your Targets: Is Target Propagation Block-Diagonal Gauss-Newton?

**abstract/A1：** Target propagation (TP) is a backpropagation alternative in which local targets carry the global learning signal. Prior works claim that TP performs Gauss-Newton (GN) optimisation on these targets, but the correspondence has only been established under unrealistic assumptions where hitting them exactly is trivial. Practical variants instead descend on a least-squares problem via a single gradient step. In this paper, we rederive TP from a trust region under an implicit, previously unexamined norm, and introduce CGTP (Conjugate Gradient Target Propagation), which uses conjugate gradients to solve the layer-local subproblems in parallel. A single adaptive parameter jointly controls this trust region and a matching bound on the weight update; KFAC emerges exactly as the special case where the per-sample Jacobians are replaced by their batch mean, giving its factored damping a variational grounding. On MNIST and Fashion-MNIST MLPs, CGTP matches the accuracy of ADAM and KFAC while needing orders of magnitude fewer outer iterations than ADAM (about 10x fewer backward-pass-equivalents overall), while remaining stable across depth.

</details>

### 320. [Learning SOCP Solver Dynamics with Graph Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26285

**作者：** Adam Ghalem、Lou Salaün、Davide Rinaldi、Fragkiskos D. Malliaros

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26285v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SOCPNet：用共享权重的递归 GNN 反复细化当前迭代点，并从经典内点法的中间迭代轨迹做轨迹正则化训练，使模型可支持可变迭代次数的推断，还可用其热启动经典求解器。

**相关性简评：** 共享参数循环细化、中间轨迹监督与可变迭代推理，可能为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态更新、过程监督及长度泛化提供可核查的方法线索，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning SOCP Solver Dynamics with Graph Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Second-order cone programs (SOCPs) are a fundamental class of convex optimization problems widely applied across engineering domains. Classical interior-point methods are robust and accurate, but their iterative nature can be costly in real-time or repeated-solve settings. This has motivated learning-based solvers that approximate optimizer solutions with neural networks. Recent work has increasingly studied graph neural networks (GNNs) for linear, quadratic, and second-order cone optimization, leveraging their ability to model sparse relational structure among variables, constraints, and objective functions. Most existing GNN-based solvers compress the optimization process into a single forward pass, predicting the optimizer directly without using the intermediate trajectory produced by classical solvers. We introduce SOCPNet, a recursive GNN framework that uses solver trajectories to learn an iterative SOCP solution procedure. A shared GNN model is applied repeatedly, refining the current iterate at each step and enabling inference for a variable number of iterations. Rather than predicting the solution in a single pass, SOCPNet learns from intermediate iterates to progressively refine its estimates using a trajectory-regularized training procedure. We evaluate SOCPNet on multiple datasets spanning standard SOCP problem classes and show that it consistently reduces the final solution error relative to a SOCP-GNN baseline. Finally, we demonstrate how trained SOCPNet models can be used in a hybrid optimization pipeline by warm-starting a classical interior-point solver, reducing solver iterations without loss of accuracy.

**comment/C1：** Learning on Graphs (LoG) Conference, 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26311

**作者：** Jonibek Mansurov、Sholpan Bolatzhanova、Filbert Aurelian Tjiaranta、Vallerie Alexandara Putra、Alham Fikri Aji

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26311v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26311v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文比较基准知识与拒绝后门两类隐藏教师属性在同四种知识蒸馏通道中的传递差异：基准知识可通过全部通道（含纯数字序列）传递，而后门几乎无法经序列表蒸馏继承，需靠 logit 蒸馏才能达到最高 85.5% 的触发拒绝率。

**相关性简评：** 其结果提示监督信号所在的层级（离散输出序列 vs 分布/logit）决定了隐藏行为能否传递，这可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练与 latent 状态监督该挂在哪一层提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Selective Transfer through Sequence Distillation: From Benchmark Knowledge to Backdoor Behaviour

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge distillation is widely used to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models, but recent work shows that it can also transfer unintended teacher properties. We study whether different hidden teacher properties survive the same distillation channels. Specifically, we compare two properties: benchmark-associated knowledge and refusal backdoors, and show that distillation treats them very differently. Teachers fine-tuned on benchmark data successfully pass that knowledge to students through all four distillation channels we test, including when students are trained only on teacher-generated number sequences containing no natural language or domain content whatsoever. Refusal backdoors tell the opposite story: backdoored teachers achieve near-perfect triggered refusal, yet sequence-distilled students inherit essentially none of this behaviour. Logit-based distillation transfers it substantially, reaching up to 85.5\\% triggered refusal in students that saw zero backdoor examples. Distillation is therefore selective, and the selection criterion is not what data the student sees, but what structure the teacher's property has. The code is available at https://github.com/MJonibek/kd-leakage.

</details>

### 322. [TriScore: Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection with Energy, Boundary Probes, and Transform Consistency](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26323v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26323

**作者：** Ege Gursoy、Nicolas Mansard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26323v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26323v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TriScore，一种 post-hoc 的 OOD 检测器：从同一冻结主干提取能量先验、边界脆弱性分数与变换一致性分数，在 ID 验证集上标准化后用输入依赖的 ID 残差门控融合，在分类器级对抗偏移下比 15 个基线更稳健。

**相关性简评：** 其「变换一致性」探针与输入依赖的多线索门控融合，可作为判断视觉证据可靠性与多假设聚合的方法线索，可能供 LVR 中多 latent 假设的验证与筛选核查；但原文是单模态图像分类的 OOD 检测，与 VLM 推理的联系需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TriScore: Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection with Energy, Boundary Probes, and Transform Consistency

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc out-of-distribution detection usually relies on a single signal extracted from a frozen classifier, such as confidence, energy, features, or gradients. This dependence becomes fragile under classifier-level adversarial shift, where the shift can preserve the detector's chosen cue while changing the model's decision behavior. We investigate whether this failure mode can be mitigated by combining complementary detection criteria instead of selecting a single score. We introduce TriScore, a post-hoc OOD detector that combines three ID-calibrated signals from the same frozen backbone: an energy prior, a boundary-fragility score, and a transform-consistency score. These signals are standardized on ID validation data and fused by an input-dependent ID-residual gate, requiring no OOD labels, auxiliary model, training, or stored feature bank. Across four ImageNet-scale backbones, TriScore achieves the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines under a non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, while remaining competitive on standard OOD benchmarks. Ablations show that the gains come from combining complementary cues rather than optimizing a single detector signal. These results support multi-criterion post-hoc detection as a practical route toward more robust OOD detection under classifier-level shift. The source code is publicly available at github.com/gursoyege/TriScore.

</details>

### 323. [Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26325v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26325

**作者：** Abdul Rahman Iqbal、Muhammad Fawad Nasim、Amir Saleem

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26325v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26325v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在模拟标签频率偏移下，用 35 项预注册配对检验比较三种 typed decision models 与其 backbone 及微调分类器的校准（ECE）与阈值风险，以分离 decision training 自身增益，并检验一种无需标签、以开发集平均预测为先验的 EM 校正。

**相关性简评：** 其「同一 readout 下把训练机制增益与 backbone 增益分离」的协议，可能为核查 LVR 推理机制是否真带来增益（贡献分配）提供借鉴；而校准与阈值在分布偏移下是否稳健，可供核查 latent 证据筛选类评价的可靠性。纯文本分类任务，与视觉推理无直接关系，属方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors

**abstract/A1：** Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 5 figures. Code, protocol and per-example outputs: https://github.com/AbdulRahmanIqbal/tdm-prevalence-shift

</details>

### 324. [CIS-Transolver: A Cross-Layer Incremental-State Neural Operator for Fine-Scale Automotive Aerodynamic Flow Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26337v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26337

**作者：** Jianglong Liu、Zhicheng Zhu、Jia Hao、Liangyue Jia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26337v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26337v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CIS-Transolver，一种跨层增量状态神经算子：用局部多尺度分析提取细尺度信息并编码为几何矩状态，在层间传播更新，并反馈到 Physics-Attention 的值表示，用于汽车气动流场的精细尺度预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨层增量状态 + 反馈进注意力值表示」的机制可能为如何在层间持续保留并复用细粒度视觉信息、避免细节在深层坍缩提供可供核查的线索，但对象为 PDE 流场预测，需自行判断迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CIS-Transolver: A Cross-Layer Incremental-State Neural Operator for Fine-Scale Automotive Aerodynamic Flow Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Neural operators offer an efficient data-driven approach to rapid prediction of complex automotive aerodynamic flows. However, spectral bias and other factors limit accurate reconstruction of fine-scale flow variations near complex geometries. Existing studies improve the representation and fitting of fine-scale information mainly through information extraction and training objectives. Further study is needed to determine how extracted local details can be used continually in subsequent operator computations and contribute effectively to the overall flow-field representation. We propose CIS-Transolver, a cross-layer incremental-state neural operator that extends fine-scale modeling from local information extraction to its use across layers. The method extracts fine-scale information through local multiscale analysis and encodes it as geometric moment states that are propagated and updated across layers. By combining information from previous layers with feedback to the value representations in Physics-Attention, the method allows local details to contribute continually to subsequent modeling of global physical correlations. We systematically evaluate CIS-Transolver on three public automotive aerodynamics benchmarks, ShapeNet-Car, AhmedML, and DrivAerNet++, covering surface pressure fields and volumetric pressure and velocity fields. CIS-Transolver achieves the lowest mean relative L2 error among the evaluated methods for all five prediction metrics across the three benchmarks. The relative error reductions average 8.72% across the five metrics compared with the best baseline for each metric, reaching 16.38% for ShapeNet-Car pressure prediction and 15.60% for AhmedML velocity prediction. These results provide a new approach to fine-scale flow prediction for complex geometries.

</details>

### 325. [Logit Averaging During Training Sets a New State of the Art for Non-Invasive Speech BCI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26347v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26347

**作者：** Miran Özdogan、Gereon Elvers、Michael Bronstein、Oiwi Parker Jones

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26347v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26347v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 系统比较非侵入式神经信号解码中的多试次聚合策略，提出训练期 logit 平均及三种注意力聚合变体，在三个数据集、四个任务上评测，并在 2025 PNPL 音素分类上超过竞赛冠军。

**相关性简评：** 其把「输入端平均信号 vs 输出端平均预测」当作架构选择来对比、并给出 logit 平均与联合集成训练的理论联系，可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 轨迹或并行采样的证据聚合与训练监督提供可核查的迁移线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Logit Averaging During Training Sets a New State of the Art for Non-Invasive Speech BCI

**abstract/A1：** Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces are in practice limited by signal-to-noise ratio, and recent state-of-the-art methods address this limitation by aggregating over repeated trials of the same stimulus. Yet multi-trial aggregation has been treated inconsistently across the literature: some work averages brain signals at the model's input, other work averages predictions at the model's output, and neither treats aggregation as an architectural choice in its own right. We provide the first systematic comparison of aggregation strategies for non-invasive neural decoding, evaluating six paradigms (including logit averaging during training and three attention-based variants we introduce) across three datasets, four tasks, and two group sizes. We find that aggregation choice matters substantially: training-time logit averaging, the simplest method we propose, outperforms all others in 6 of 7 settings. On the phoneme classification setting of the 2025 PNPL competition, it sets a new state of the art, significantly outperforming the competition winner by 17.4 absolute percentage points in balanced accuracy. We further draw a theoretical connection between logit averaging and joint ensemble training, which has been shown to underperform independent ensembling in the deep learning literature; our results call into question recent explanations of why joint ensemble training fails. Together, these findings establish multi-trial aggregation as a key design choice for non-invasive neural decoding and identify training-time logit averaging as a simple, effective default.

</details>

### 326. [HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26357v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26357

**作者：** Peike Yu、Wuchao Liu、Jihong Guan、Shuigeng Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26357v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26357v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HGASurv，用于多模态生存预测：用层次化 WSI 编码把病理 patch 特征按坐标映射到空间网格，通过并行卷积构建 patch、邻域、区域三个尺度的表征，并让基因组嵌入以 cross-modal co-attention 查询这些尺度特异表征；再用临床变量定义患者相似边、以图注意力传播融合嵌入。

**相关性简评：** 其「按粒度分层构建视觉表征、再由另一模态条件化查询特定尺度特征」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多尺度视觉信息的内部保留与条件化证据读取提供可核查的方法线索，但原文未涉及推理期 latent 状态或生成机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Objective: Multimodal survival prediction jointly analyzes histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs), genomic profiles, and clinical variables to stratify patients by risk. However, existing approaches often inadequately account for granularity differences across modalities, particularly in spatial organization and feature dimensionality. To address these challenges, we propose HGASurv, which introduces a hierarchical WSI encoding module and a clinical-guided graph propagation module for granularity-aware multimodal integration. Methods: The hierarchical WSI encoding module maps WSI patch features onto a spatial grid using their original coordinates and applies parallel convolutions to construct representations at patch, local-neighborhood, and regional scales. Genomic signature embeddings then query these scale-specific WSI representations through cross-modal co-attention, producing signature-conditioned morphological features. The clinical-guided graph propagation module uses clinical variables to define patient-similarity edges and propagates fused image-genomic node embeddings with graph attention, integrating clinical information through topology rather than feature concatenation. Results: Across three TCGA cohorts, HGASurv achieved the strongest overall C-index performance, with ablation studies supporting the complementary contributions of the hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation modules. Conclusion and Significance: By introducing hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation, HGASurv unifies multi-scale pathology representation with topology-based clinical integration in a hierarchical granularity-aware framework. This design shows that matching representation and integration mechanisms to modality-specific granularity improves multimodal survival prediction.

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

### 327. [LaMER: Language-Conditioned Multi-Expert Routing for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26404v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26404

**作者：** Yu Yu Chang、Tzu-Hsuan Weng、Youssef Mohamed Amin、Mohaned Ahmed Elsayed、Hung-Hsuan Chen、Min-Te Sun、Sherine Shawky

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26404v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26404v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** LaMER 是一个弱监督指称表达理解（REC）框架，用语言条件的跨模态路由融合模块动态聚合四个冻结的视觉专家编码器，并配合 Cell-Text 匹配头、负锚增强与对比/重建/对齐/负载均衡多目标损失来稳定训练。

**相关性简评：** 其「按语言表达动态选择并融合异构视觉专家」的路由机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与多 latent 假设组合提供方法线索，可供核查路由是否等价于推理期状态选择而非仅提升定位精度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LaMER: Language-Conditioned Multi-Expert Routing for Weakly Supervised Referring Expression Comprehension

**abstract/A1：** Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) localizes the image region described by a natural language expression, underpinning applications such as autonomous navigation, human-robot interaction, and medical image analysis. Under weak supervision, REC is challenged by the visual-linguistic semantic gap and the difficulty of inferring region-text correspondences from coarse image-level signals alone. Moreover, no single visual encoder captures all complementary properties---semantic alignment, fine-grained texture, and boundary awareness---while naively fusing multiple pretrained encoders yields heterogeneous, hard-to-reconcile representations. We propose LaMER, a weakly supervised REC framework that dynamically aggregates four frozen expert encoders through a language-conditioned Cross-Modal Routing Fusion module, adapting expert selection to each referring expression without instance-level bounding-box supervision. A Cell-Text Matching Head with Negative Anchor Augmentation, trained with a multi-objective loss combining contrastive, reconstruction, alignment, and load-balancing terms, further stabilizes optimization. LaMER achieves 77.67\\%, 62.81\\%, and 69.49\\% Acc@IoU\\(\\geq 0.5\\) on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg, surpassing DViN and WeakMCN by up to 16.49 and 14.49 points, with ablations validating each component.

</details>

### 328. [Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26431v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26431

**作者：** Alessia Intini、Lorenzo Vaiani、Enrico Chen、Luca Cagliero

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26431v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26431v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向长视频到文本摘要的递归视频语言摘要模型 RVLSM：用语义时序分解把长视频按语义边界切成连贯片段，交给 VideoLLM 子模型和外部工具做分块推理，并以自适应多模态工具调用路由按需启用动作识别、OCR、ASR、目标检测等模块；在 VideoXum 和 MixTyVSum 上超过零样本 VideoLLM 基线。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属长视频摘要应用而非 latent 推理研究，但其「递归分段＋按需路由外部工具」的层级处理与证据获取机制，可能为 LVR 的分段状态更新、证据筛选与动态计算分配提供方法线索，可供核查其 chunk 间信息传递与路由决策的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models

**abstract/A1：** While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.

**comment/C1：** Paper currently under review

</details>

### 329. [Rethinking LLM Fine-Tuning via Weight Space Reparameterization: Preserving Safety during Downstream Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26443v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26443

**作者：** Minseong Kim、Jongbok Won、Jeesup Park、Yonghee Choi、Dongjun Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26443v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26443v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WSR-Tune 微调框架：构造 safety-conditioned 基对权重矩阵重参数化，使安全信息集中于少数方向，冻结其中的安全关键方向，其余方向用于下游适配，以缓解安全性与下游性能的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「构建条件基—定位并冻结关键方向」的方向级操作，可能可供核查如何识别与保护承载特定信息的子空间，或类比到分析 latent 推理状态中视觉证据落在哪些方向上；但论文完全针对纯文本安全微调，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking LLM Fine-Tuning via Weight Space Reparameterization: Preserving Safety during Downstream Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on downstream tasks often weakens their previously aligned safety behavior, creating an inherent trade-off between task adaptation and safety preservation. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by identifying safety-relevant neurons, layers, or update directions in the original parameter space. However, safety-related information is often distributed across many directions in this space, causing downstream updates to overwrite parameters that encode safety behavior. We propose WSR-Tune, a Weight Space Reparameterization-based fine-tuning framework that preserves safety during downstream adaptation. Our approach constructs a safety-conditioned basis and reparameterizes the weight matrices such that safety-relevant information becomes concentrated in a small subset of directions. We then identify safety-critical directions and freeze them in the reparameterized space, while updating the remaining complementary directions for downstream adaptation. By explicitly structuring the parameter space to disentangle safety and task information, our method reduces interference between objectives and enables simultaneous preservation of safety and improvement in downstream performance. Experimental results show that our method achieves a more favorable trade-off between downstream performance and safety retention, demonstrating its effectiveness for reliable LLM fine-tuning.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026(spotlight)

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26452

**作者：** Yanchun Li、Yujin Wu、Gangkai Shen、Ming Yang、Li Zeng、Xianlong Wang、Hangtao Zhang、Shujuan Tian

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究文本到图像扩散模型能否在生成早期从原生信号中发现不安全或对抗输入，发现 classifier-free guidance 的条件与无条件响应对比中蕴含较强安全信号，并提出 CSTI：在早期 checkpoint 聚合条件/无条件激活差异，用少量正例与安全样本拟合线性读出实现校准风险检测，无需攻击样本或改动生成器。

**相关性简评：** 其「条件与无条件激活对比＋线性读出＋跨 checkpoint 聚合」的可供核查线索，或可用于诊断 VLM 内部状态是否真正使用视觉证据（视觉旁路、信息坍缩），早期拦截的时机选择也可能类比 LVR 的停止决策，但属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Guidance Becomes a Guard: Early Interception of Unsafe Inputs in Text-to-Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-image diffusion models can produce unsafe content, while output filtering intervenes only after synthesis. We investigate whether native generation signals enable early detection of unsafe and adversarial inputs. We find that classifier-free guidance exposes strong safety signals in conditional responses, accessible through compact statistics and linear readouts. Based on this finding, we propose Conditional Semantic Trajectory Interception (CSTI), which aggregates activation contrasts between conditional and unconditional responses at early checkpoints for calibrated risk detection. CSTI fits concept-specific detectors using canonical concept and safe examples, without attack samples, intermediate image decoding, or generator modification. Across five generators, four adversarial attack collections, and two general NSFW datasets, CSTI achieves the strongest overall performance among six baselines at a matched 5% FPR. Early interception reduces generation latency by over 60% on intercepted paths. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of native conditional responses for early safety interception.

</details>

### 331. [On Learning Expand-and-Sparsify Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26470v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26470

**作者：** Alireza Asghari、Parikshit Ram、Kaushik Sinha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26470v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26470v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究用梯度下降学习 expand-and-sparsify 的线性映射相比随机映射的收益，并考察该收益随扩展宽度的变化，在 73 个 OpenML 分类与 48 个回归任务上固定数据、扩展维度、稀疏度和划分做对照实验，报告最窄扩展时学习收益最大、top-k 稀疏表示可与同维 dense ReLU 相当、二值化下稀疏码更优、可承受的稀疏度随扩展宽度上升。

**相关性简评：** 其「扩展宽度决定可自由稀疏的上限」「top-k 保留多少坐标才不损失信息」等问题结构与 LVR 中 latent 状态的容量、稀疏程度和信息坍缩可能相关，可供核查是否影响内部状态保留视觉细节的假设，但该工作针对表格任务，与多模态推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On Learning Expand-and-Sparsify Representations

**abstract/A1：** Expand-and-sparsify ($\\texttt{EaS}$) representations lift an input to a much higher dimension through a linear map and keep only the $k$ largest coordinates. Existing theory builds that map at random and needs the expanded dimension to grow exponentially in the input dimension, which puts the construction out of practical reach. We ask what is gained by learning the map by gradient descent instead, and how that gain depends on how wide the expansion is. We sweep $73$ OpenML classification tasks and $48$ regression tasks under a protocol that holds the datasets, expanded dimensions, sparsity levels and splits fixed across every method, and we summarise each comparison by a median over datasets and a Wilcoxon signed rank test. We report four findings. First, learning the expansion helps most when the expansion is narrowest, and its advantage over a random map decays to nothing by the widest expansions we run, so a learned $\\texttt{EaS}$ layer can be made small. Second, with the map learned, a top-$k$ representation that keeps at most a tenth of its coordinates is indistinguishable from a dense $\\texttt{ReLU}$ layer of the same expanded dimension at every expansion factor we test, while GELU and SiLU are not. Third, when the representation is forced to be binary the sparse code is the better of the two, and the reason is that binarization costs it nothing while it costs the dense layer accuracy. Fourth, how sparse the representation can be is governed by how wide it is: the sparsity level that is free rises as the expansion grows, so there is no fixed limit on how sparse it can be. The regression tasks reproduce the first finding and qualify the second and third.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「干预强度如何对齐」的对照方案可能供核查 latent 状态编辑、激活替换类因果贡献比较时的强度混杂问题；但对象为纯文本 SAE 特征干预，与视觉细节保留和推理状态生成无直接联系，迁移线索需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes

**abstract/A1：** Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion. Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 333. [A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26525v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26525

**作者：** Liu Kaiyuan、Zhuang Ziyuan、Ma Haoxuan、Gu Yannian、Song Mingfei、Weng Rongxiang、Ye Jieping

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多专家基础模型的整合，证明同源专家盆地内多教师 on-policy 蒸馏目标与 Fisher 模型合并二阶等价，据此提出两阶段 RGBM 流程：先在 task-vector 子空间做闭式 Fisher 合并，再以域残差谱门控哪些分支更新的回写。

**相关性简评：** 其「残差谱门控决定哪些更新被写入、其余域被钝化」的思路，可能与 LVR 训练中多监督源的贡献分配、状态更新准入判据相通，可供核查是否可迁移到 latent 推理轨迹或多分支状态的合并与选择性写回。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 BetaMem，用工作、空间、实体、情节、经验与程序六层记忆为具身智能体构建并演化可追溯的长期记忆，并以监督微调加强化学习（由教师对原始观测进行校验）训练合规的记忆写入操作。

**相关性简评：** 其将存储、更新、检索与遗忘形式化为预算约束下的成本—效用分配，并用原始观测校验的奖励惩罚遗漏与失真，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态更新监督提供可核查线索，迁移可行性尚待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RELIEF：用 coding agent 依据代码检查、自动交互与真实用户反馈修正模型生成的交互界面，再把修正结果回填进原始生成轨迹以构造微调监督，并在 200 个合成网站与 355 段用户交互记录上比较不同反馈来源的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「把修正后的结果回写为原始生成轨迹监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但其任务与多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revision-Based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Code generation models are increasingly used to produce interactive artifacts, such as websites and user interfaces. Many properties that determine whether these interfaces are useful only become apparent through realistic interaction, making them difficult to incorporate into model training. In this paper, we introduce RELIEF (REvision-based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback), a method for improving code generation models using feedback on their generated interfaces. RELIEF uses a coding agent to revise these interfaces, then incorporates the improvements into their original generation traces to produce supervision for fine-tuning. To evaluate RELIEF, we collected a dataset of 200 synthetically generated websites paired with 355 interaction recordings and accompanying feedback from 24 users. We used critiques derived from code inspection, automated interaction, explicit human feedback, and human interaction recordings to fine-tune variants of two code generation models. Our results show that feedback effectiveness varies with base model capabilities, with critiques inferred from human interaction recordings leading to the largest usability improvements overall under our tested models.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Outcomes to Components: A Counterfactual Evaluation Framework for LLM-Proposed Repairs

**abstract/A1：** An LLM-generated repair action specifies which records to change and by how much. A failed action may still contain a useful target set or numerical update, depending on how the two are paired. We evaluate this problem in traffic networks and databases, where aggregate observations obscure the records that need correction. We examine the pairings by executing each combination from the same initial state, using a reference action that restores the affected records. In 76 of 114 traffic actions, the gain from correcting both parts exceeds the sum of the gains from correcting each part alone. Six of these actions become worse after either correction alone, but improve when both parts are corrected. In database repair, replacing only the proposed update with the reference update worsens 17 of 108 model actions, all of which select unaffected records. We also test whether parts of two proposals can be reused. On held-out observations, selecting among the proposals and their recombined target-update pairs recovers 61.6% of the reference action's loss reduction, compared with 58.0% from selecting between the proposals alone.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Tandem，一个在手机 NPU 上服务混合线性注意力 GUI agent 的运行时：在相邻提示分歧处保存循环状态以复用已处理前缀，用短尾处理生成回滚状态，并以一次读入权重块的验证核完成任务间的 NPU 功耗释放，从而降低每步延迟与能耗。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身属移动端推理系统优化，未研究 latent 推理机制；但其循环状态检查点与回滚复用设计，可供核查 LVR 中状态缓存、注意力结构与前缀复用是否会丢弃任务必要信息。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs

**abstract/A1：** Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

</details>

**title/T1：** CaptionFuse: Training-Free Composed Product Retrieval Via VLM Intent Captioning and Weighted Embedding Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) retrieves products matching a reference image modified by natural language---a core capability for eCommerce search. Existing training-free methods fuse CLIP embeddings via arithmetic, but we identify a fundamental limitation: user text modifications are attribute-sparse---a user who types \`\`make it red with shorter sleeves'' specifies what to change but not what to keep (the floral pattern, the V-neck, the fit-and-flare silhouette). We introduce language-space fusion: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) jointly interprets the reference image and modification to generate a visually grounded product-title caption---e.g., \`\`Red floral fit-and-flare dress with short sleeves and V-neck''---that fills in the missing attributes from the image. Our method, CaptionFuse, requires no task-specific training and is model-agnostic. A controlled experiment confirms that attribute content--- not linguistic style---drives the gains: imperative and descriptive captions with identical attributes achieve equal R@10, while both outperform raw modifications by +6.5 points.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文报告一个部署在实盘纸面券商账户上的个人 LLM 交易代理 AllPath：把验证拆成代码规则门、受限的代理自我复核与人工审批三层，并比较两周半人工闸门与五周自动应用自我修订两种制度，整理出只在生产中暴露的事故分类。

**相关性简评：** 其「按失败类型分工的分层验证」与「迭代上限、自动应用 vs 人工闸门」的双制度对照，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新或自我修订的验证归属、贡献分配与停止条件设计提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AllPath: Layered Verification for a Deployed, Self-Revising LLM Trading Agent under Human-Gated and Autonomous Regimes

**abstract/A1：** LLM trading agents are evaluated almost exclusively in backtests and autonomous benchmark harnesses. Deployment, where actions are irreversible, raises a different question: who verifies the agent's actions, and which failures can each verifier structurally catch? We report on AllPath, a personal LLM trading agent deployed against a live paper-brokerage account. The system watches positions through a deterministic rules engine, and each night it reviews its own day and proposes revisions to its own trading strategies. Verification is split across three layers. Code verifies what must not depend on judgment: deterministic gates enforce risk limits and block any strategy revision that fails an integrity check. The agent verifies itself within fixed bounds: its nightly review has an iteration cap and no tools that can act. A human verifies judgment, through approval screens that show the current state of each proposal. We also compared two verification policies for the agent's self-revisions on the live system: two and a half weeks with every self-revision human-gated, then five weeks with reflection revisions auto-applied behind the same code gates, while the operator's chat channel stayed human-gated throughout. Each layer caught a different kind of failure. The code gates rejected no proposal; their role was keeping revisions consistent. The human rejected two proposals that passed every code check, both over a disagreement about the market, and later removed 11 of the 19 rules the agent had added on its own, at a median lag of eight days. The most instructive production incidents, such as strategies silently left unmonitored, passed every gate; the operator found them by hand, and the fix each time was an interface change that makes the condition visible. We contribute the layered architecture, the two-regime account, and a production incident taxonomy, none observable in a backtest.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI in Finance (AI4F) at ACM ICAIF 2026 (non-archival). 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/dukesky/allpath-trading-agent

**title/T1：** Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM

**abstract/A1：** Recursive reasoning models refine persistent internal states by repeatedly applying learned operators. We investigate whether adding a persistent intermediate state that integrates repeated updates of a faster state through the same operator improves predictive performance relative to each model family's baseline at matched parameter counts. We define this organisation operationally and implement it within three architectures: the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) and Universal Reasoning Model (URM). Using the official codebases on ARC-AGI-1, we compare each baseline with its parameter-matched nested variant. We evaluate held-out queries from tasks whose demonstrations were available during training. The experiments use a single-GPU budget far below the published training protocols. Under the tested conditions, nested variants show no consistent advantage in token accuracy, predictive loss or exact solving, which remains near zero for all configurations. The results therefore leave the hypothesis open. We specify a confirmatory comparison, with an informative baseline, multiple seeds, controls that isolate nesting and predefined criteria, to determine whether this organisation merits further development.

</details>

### 341. [Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26685v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26685

**作者：** Jianqiang Xia、Han Xu、Dianxi Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26685v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26685v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 rubric 强化学习中的「rubric hacking」：将评分标准分解为子维度后，发现总分上升时部分子维度得分系统性下降，并据此提出 FRDA（子维度内竞争以缓解维度失衡）与 RSDC（从整体偏好信号中挖掘隐含评价维度以补全覆盖）两种方法。

**相关性简评：** 其子维度分解、从整体信号中恢复隐含维度的做法，可能为 latent 推理训练中的奖励设计与贡献分配/监督提供可核查线索，但论文面向纯文本 RLHF，未涉及视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing

**abstract/A1：** Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables

</details>

These results characterize the complete pipeline, which reuses frozen foundation backbones and performs one refinement stage. ### 343. [CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26734

**作者：** Tan-Ha Mai、Hsuan-Tien Lin、Vu Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26734v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究互补标签学习（CLL）中来自众包或 VLM 的标注错误（真实类别被误标为互补标签），指出直接迁移最优传输（OT）数据估值会因语义错配而失效，并提出 CAVA：引入互补标签代价与标签 margin，无参数阈值检测对角噪声，并把检出的样本回收为普通标签监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「用 OT 数据估值识别有害监督样本」的思路可供核查，可能迁移到 latent 轨迹训练中的监督信号筛选与贡献分配；但论文本身面向分类标注噪声，与 VLM 推理状态生成、视觉证据使用无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation

**abstract/A1：** Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 18 figures

</details>

### 344. [CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26740v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26740

**作者：** Yaqi Cai、Zuan Gao、Mengting Chen、Wei Li、Bo Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26740v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26740v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 CheckDistill，用于指令引导图像编辑的奖励建模：把编辑条件拆成可独立核验的原子清单并构造四维评分标签与结构化核验证据，再以含清单、条目判断和维度理由的特权教师做可靠性加权在线自蒸馏，最终让学生无需清单与显式推理即直接预测四维分数分布并聚合为标量奖励。

**相关性简评：** 将显式推理轨迹内化为无推理直接预测的蒸馏目标（可靠性加权、截断支持集）可能与 latent 推理的训练监督与贡献分配问题相通，其原子清单式的视觉证据筛选也可供核查，但论文面向图像编辑奖励模型，与 VLM 推理状态的关系仅为潜在线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning for instruction-guided image editing requires reward models that provide reliable, accurate, and efficient feedback. Direct scalar prediction compresses multidimensional editing preferences, whereas generative evaluators can expose their judgment through explicit reasoning. However, broad scoring criteria do not specify all instance-dependent editing and preservation constraints, and generating long reasoning trajectories is costly for online optimization. We introduce CheckDistill, a pointwise reward modeling framework that internalizes instruction-adaptive checklists. We decompose each editing condition into atomic, independently verifiable requirements and construct four-dimensional scoring labels together with structured verification evidence. After supervised score initialization, a privileged teacher conditions on checklists, item-level judgments, and dimension-level rationales to supervise the student's own scoring trajectories. A reliability-weighted on-policy self-distillation objective adjusts supervision at score tokens according to agreement between the teacher's expected scores and reference labels, while retaining candidate probability weights in a truncated token support. The deployed student directly predicts four score distributions without checklist inputs or explicit reasoning and aggregates their expectations into a scalar reward. CheckDistill achieves aggregate accuracies of 72.30%, 56.67% and 82.90% on MMRB2, MER-Bench and EditReward-Bench, respectively, exceeding the compared open-source baselines on all three metrics.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages

</details>

### 345. [Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26749v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26749

**作者：** Alessandro Palma、Charles Jones、Tristan Cinquin、Fabian J. Theis、Frederik Wenkel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26749v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26749v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 trajectory replay：不做样本回放，而是让更新后的速度场沿历史轨迹匹配冻结的历史速度场、同时兼顾新任务速度场，并以稳定性-弹性系数加权，配合均值速度蒸馏，用于类增量图像生成与两个生物扰动建模场景。

**相关性简评：** 其「在轨迹层面对冻结模型速度场做蒸馏并用稳定性-弹性系数加权」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的持续更新、轨迹级监督与少步生成提供可核查的方法线索；但场景属持续生成建模，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models

**abstract/A1：** Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

</details>

### 346. [Beyond Omni: A Unified MLLM for Embodied Sensory Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26751v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26751

**作者：** Shiyun Xiong、Dongming Wu、Peiwen Sun、Bokang Yang、Jiaxu Wang、Xiaolou Sun、Mingxing Wen、Xiangyu Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26751v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26751v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Unisense 统一具身 MLLM 框架，用两阶段训练（先把异构感知表示对齐到语言接口，再在共享 LLM 内调优模态专属专家）支持深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热成像、雷达等 8 种感知模态，并构建 100 万样本语料在 12 个基准上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「异构感知表示先对齐语言接口、再在共享 LLM 内调优模态专家」的两阶段做法，可能为 latent 状态与 LLM 表示空间的对齐、以及模态特化参数化提供可供核查的方法线索，但与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Omni: A Unified MLLM for Embodied Sensory Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Recent embodied systems increasingly build on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for their pretrained understanding and reasoning capabilities, but their perception of the physical world remains largely limited to basic modalities such as vision and audio. However, broadening MLLMs to more diverse sensory modalities from the physical environment is challenging: their representations are often weakly connected to the MLLM and vary substantially in structure and statistics, while their interpretation still requires shared high-level understanding and reasoning. We therefore propose Unisense, a unified embodied MLLM framework that supports diverse physical sensory modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. Unisense follows a two-stage training process: (i) aligning sensory representations with language to establish a language-accessible interface; and (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the shared LLM to provide specialized processing for different sensory modalities. To support broad sensory learning, we curate Unisense-1M, a large-scale embodied sensory training corpus comprising 1M samples across 8 sensory modalities. We further evaluate Unisense on 12 benchmarks spanning depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell understanding. Across these heterogeneous sensing tasks, Unisense achieves strong performance and outperforms both generalist and specialized models on most benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of pretrained MLLMs as unified models for embodied sensory understanding.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PIA 框架：用低/高保真仿真轨迹预训练世界模型，再通过不确定性正则化规划在目标域少量交互下快速适配，并在自动驾驶赛车的仿真与实车上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其将仿真轨迹视为有偏先验、在线校正残差，以及隐状态世界模型加不确定性驱动规划的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督、分布偏移下的状态更新与不确定性决策提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HarnessPro，一种无需标注的 agent harness 递归自我改进方法：由专门 agent 诊断执行轨迹、按不同性能-成本偏好实现候选 harness，并用归一化加权平方距离选择出 lite/medium/heavy 三档方案，在 Terminal-Bench 2 等基准上同时提升通过率并降低单任务成本。

**相关性简评：** 其按性能-成本权衡进行 Pareto 式候选选择、并以轨迹诊断反馈驱动迭代的做法，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本预算分配与无真值条件下的轨迹监督提供方法线索，但具体迁移需核查原文。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs

**abstract/A1：** Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 V-JEPA Hand，用自监督 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器提取第一视角视频的时空特征，再由 query-based predictor 单次前向联合解码逐帧手部姿态、手部存在性与相机运动，以恢复世界坐标系下的双手轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos

**abstract/A1：** Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究在部分样本为真标签、其余由 ML 预测器标注（可能出错）的混合数据上训练模型的优化问题，提出一阶与零阶随机优化方法，并在线性回归到 LLM 微调上做实证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Training a machine learning (ML) model is an optimization process that typically requires a set of examples with ground-truth labels beforehand. Obtaining these ground truths usually requires laborious human effort and can be costly. The scalability of human labeling becomes a concern when there are a large number of data points that need to be labeled. To address this practical issue, we consider an optimization setting where a subset of samples has ground-truth labels, while the remaining data points were labeled by an ML predictor, which could potentially assign incorrect labels to those points. We propose both first-order and zeroth-order stochastic optimization methods for training on datasets consisting of a mix of true-labeled and ML-labeled samples. We further conduct comprehensive empirical studies from training a linear regression model to fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for training with ML-labeled data.

</details>

### 351. [Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26802v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26802

**作者：** Zhuofan Josh Ying、Guanglong Sun、Nolan Ho、Kieran Liu、Rui Yang、Andrew Chen、Nikolaus Kriegeskorte、Pony Ma、Hossein Adeli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26802v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26802v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文用低秩适配（LoRA）加轻量 readout 对最多 104B 的多模态骨干做脑编码微调，并利用骨干因果结构一次前向预测多个时间点以降低特征提取成本，还提出 multi-LoRA 核并行训练 200+ 模型集成，在 Algonauts 2025 上取得最佳成绩。

**相关性简评：** 其「单次前向预测多时间点」与 multi-LoRA 并行训练、模态归因分析，可能为并行 latent 状态生成、多假设适配以及视觉证据贡献的诊断提供可核查的方法线索，但不直接研究 VLM 推理本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding

**abstract/A1：** Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 13 figures, 20 tables. Code available at https://github.com/zfying/brain-lora

### 352. [PICA-WAM: Visual Perturbation Invariance via Cross-Appearance Self-Alignment in World Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26813v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26813

**作者：** Yude Zou、Yifei Yao、Guanbo Jiao、Jianming Ma、Guanjie Zheng、Xing Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26813v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26813v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PICA-WAM：把视觉扰动不变性当作 WAM 的跨外观自对齐辅助任务，用 EMA teacher 对原始观测提供深层目标，令在线模型把受扰观测的浅层动作表示对齐到该目标，在多个基准与真机上提升扰动鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 其浅层—深层表示对齐与逐层敏感性诊断，可供核查 VLM 内部状态中外观信息保留、信息坍缩与深度位置的关联，但对象是机器人动作生成而非 latent 推理，联系有待人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PICA-WAM: Visual Perturbation Invariance via Cross-Appearance Self-Alignment in World Action Models

**abstract/A1：** World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future video and generate actions, yet remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations, i.e., changes in visual appearance that should not affect robot behavior. We identify a gap in conventional WAM training: video prediction encourages representations to preserve appearance information, while action generation does not explicitly enforce invariance to task-irrelevant appearance. Data augmentation exposes WAMs to such perturbations but does not require perturbed and nominal observations to produce consistent action representations, and alignment with external pretrained features does not guarantee the desired invariance. To address this gap, we propose PICA-WAM, a self-supervised training framework that casts perturbation invariance as an auxiliary cross-appearance self-alignment task for WAMs. An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher processes the nominal observation to provide a deeper-layer target, while the online WAM processes a perturbed observation and aligns its shallower-layer action representation to this target through a lightweight projection head. Across four strong WAMs evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and a real robot, PICA-WAM consistently improves robustness under visual perturbations, preserves nominal performance in simulation, and raises the real robot success rate. PICA-WAM further reduces the sensitivity of video features to task-irrelevant appearance and its propagation into actions, as shown by paired layer-wise diagnostics. Code: https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-release

</details>

### 353. [Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26820v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26820

**作者：** Adar Elad、Gal Metzer、Omer Dahari、Min Lu、Daniel Cohen-Or

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26820v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26820v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer 设定：把从某类形状学到的几何风格迁移到结构完全不同（如希腊字母、人体姿态）的目标形式上，方法用结构化草图表示目标形状，并以 Geometry LoRA 与风格 LoRA 解耦结构遵循与风格实现，同时用大规模合成草图构造通用几何先验。

**相关性简评：** 以双 LoRA 解耦「结构」与「风格」、并用多样性合成数据塑造通用几何先验的做法，可能与 LVR 中如何在内部状态保留几何/视觉细节而剥离任务无关因素的问题相关，可供核查其解耦与数据构造思路能否迁移到 VLM 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer

**abstract/A1：** A geometric style learned from one family of shapes is typically applied to new shapes from the same family. We consider a more challenging setting: learning the geometric design language of a stylized Latin alphabet and applying it to new forms, from Greek glyphs to entirely different structures such as human poses. We introduce Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer, where the forms to which a learned geometric style can be applied are not restricted to the shape family in which that style was observed. This setting is deceptively challenging: the difficulty is not merely learning a style, but learning the style without learning the shape family in which it was observed. We represent target forms by structural sketches and disentangle structural adherence from style realization using a Geometry LoRA and a style-specific LoRA. Critically, open-form transfer requires the Geometry LoRA to be universal. To achieve this, we devise a geometry-enrichment strategy that constructs a large and purposefully diverse collection of synthetic structural sketches spanning a broad range of unfamiliar geometries. Our experiments and ablations demonstrate the importance of both disentanglement and this universal geometry prior, enabling geometric styles learned from glyphs, pictograms, and other shape families to be transferred to substantially different, unseen forms.

</details>

### 354. [Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26828v1>)

**作者：** Zhaoyang Wang、Qianhui Wu、Haorui Wang、Simon Yu、Baolin Peng、Canwen Xu、Hao Cheng、Wenlin Yao、Boyi Liu、Yite Wang、Jianfeng Gao、Huaxiu Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WildAWM，用开源模型合成可执行的计算机使用环境与任务，联合支持 GUI、MCP 服务与命令行接口，并用执行式质量门（多智能体 rollout、交叉评审、反事实探测）保证可解性、难度与验证可靠性，据此合成 341 个长程环境-任务对并训练 Qwen 模型，在 8 个分布外基准上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 不直接研究视觉 latent 推理或推理期状态生成，但其执行式质量门与反事实探测可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的验证可靠性、监督信号与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis

**abstract/A1：** Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages

### 355. [Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26834v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26834

**作者：** Anamaria-Roberta Hartl、Levente Zólyomi、Michael List、Günter Klambauer、Sebastian Böck、Sepp Hochreiter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26834v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26834v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 KronLSTM：一种基于 Kronecker Delta Rule 的线性注意力架构，通过只沿矩阵空间单一方向修正关联的「记忆修订」机制更新联想矩阵记忆，并给出其收敛到稳态分布、记忆范数有界等分析，在长上下文语言建模任务上与 DeltaNet 系列相当或更优。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本架构，但其「最小侵入、单方向」记忆修订规则可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新提供线索：如何在写入新推理信息时减少对已存视觉证据的覆盖与信息坍缩，可供核查其稳定性分析与干扰度量能否迁移到多模态状态维护。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention

**abstract/A1：** We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.

</details>
