### 356. [SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26837v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26837

**作者：** Javad Rajabi、Hakki Can Karaimer、David B. Lindell、Babak Taati、Michael S. Brown

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26837v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26837v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练方法 SpecKCast：对 DiT 输出做 2D DCT，用轻量 Kalman 滤波沿噪声调度导出的分带时间坐标跟踪各频率系数的值与变化率，仅当预测不确定度超过阈值时才执行一次 transformer，在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image、Wan2.1-14B 等上以极小额外内存取得最高 6 倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 主题为扩散生成加速，与 LVR 主线无直接关系；但其用 Kalman 滤波维护状态值及变化率、并以预测不确定度阈值决定是否重新计算的做法，可能为 latent 状态的时序更新与动态计算／停止决策提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 19 figures

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 WeAct：在冻结骨干上分别训练能力专属的 LoRA 适配器，并把「选择适配器」加入智能体的动作空间，借助原生工具调用接口在共享上下文中按需组合能力，用于长时程 deep-research 智能体的持续适配。

**相关性简评：** 把能力切换纳入动作空间、按阶段动态改变参数配置的做法，可能为 LVR 中按推理步动态分配计算、更新或组合内部状态提供方法线索；但该工作面向纯文本智能体，无视觉与 latent 推理证据，迁移性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.

### 358. [VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26857v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26857

**作者：** Sangbeom Lim、Seoung Wug Oh、Heeji Yoon、Seungryong Kim、Joon-Young Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26857v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26857v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出掩码引导的扩散视频抠像框架：RGB 与掩码用独立 token 流经时空自注意力交互，并引入可学习的 preserve/refine token 作为逐帧条件接口，配合滑窗推理与全局参考锚点，在长视频中跨 chunk 保持时序一致。

**相关性简评：** 其「已生成结果跨 chunk 传播、借参考锚点抑制误差累积」的状态传递设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的跨步更新、长序列防漂移与缓存复用提供方法线索，token 与注意力的具体作用方式有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/VideoMaMa-PlusPlus/ Code: https://github.com/cvlab-kaist/VideoMaMa-PlusPlus

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Halcyon 系列早期融合（early-fusion）多模态自回归模型，完全从零在 1 亿图文对上预训练来做文生图，并用对照实验考察语言预训练是否必要。

**相关性简评：** 其早期融合共享自回归状态、以及「纯文本预训练不提升生成」这一训练对照结论，可供核查语言预训练与融合方式对 VLM 内部视觉状态保留的影响，但论文本身不做推理，联系需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

### 360. [GeoForward: Geometry-Guided Cross-View Alignment for Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23895v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23895

**作者：** Yiming Shu、Peng Sun、Lang Zhang、Mingyue Feng、Yaonong Wang、Pei Liu、Chen Sun、Jun Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23895v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23895v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「几何条件化前馈重建」范式与 GeoForward：先用稀疏 LiDAR 点跨标定相机解析投影得到度量对应锚点，再以有界连续局部搜索结合视觉特征精化，并与 VGGT 的全局多视图上下文融合，分别预测度量深度与高斯属性。

**相关性简评：** 其「先用显式几何约束建立对应、学习特征只负责精化而非发现对应」的表示构造思路，或可类比 LVR 中用外部证据锚定 latent 状态、抑制信息坍缩的问题；属较远领域的表示结构线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoForward: Geometry-Guided Cross-View Alignment for Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Feedforward 3D reconstruction has largely followed an {appearance-driven paradigm}: multi-view images are encoded into visual representations, cross-view correspondence is implicitly inferred from learned features, and 3D primitives are subsequently predicted from these representations. However, calibrated cameras and sparse metric measurements already provide explicit constraints on where the same physical point should appear across views. We propose a novel paradigm, \\textbf{Geometry-Conditioned Feedforward Reconstruction}, in which metric geometry establishes cross-view correspondence before the 3D representation is formed, while learned visual features refine rather than discover this correspondence. Based on this paradigm, we introduce \\textbf{GeoForward}. Sparse LiDAR points are unprojected into 3D and analytically projected across calibrated cameras to provide metric correspondence anchors. A bounded continuous local search then refines these anchors using visual features, and the resulting geometry-conditioned representation is fused with global multi-view context from VGGT. The shared representation drives separate metric-depth and Gaussian-attribute prediction, establishing a direct path from explicit geometry to both Gaussian centers and spatial attributes. A sparse 3D refinement module subsequently improves local attribute compatibility while preserving the geometrically determined centers. For temporal reconstruction, endpoint Gaussians are composed using vehicle masks and motion priors. On nuScenes, GeoForward achieves the lowest cross-camera depth-consistency error and Chamfer distance among the compared methods while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. These results demonstrate that explicitly conditioning correspondence formation on metric geometry provides an effective alternative to purely appearance-driven feedforward 3D reconstruction.

</details>

### 361. [EAGLE: Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer for Partially Polygon-Supervised Object Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23900v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23900

**作者：** Naveen Stewart

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23900v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23900v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对部分多边形监督下的目标定位，提出以信息论结合统计形状分析量化各类别几何复杂度的框架，并据此设计轻量的后训练头部 EAGLE，通过边缘细化与熵驱动的重打分提升检测精度。

**相关性简评：** 其用熵刻画表示的几何信息丰富度并预测深监督是否有利，可能与 LVR 中「内部状态需保留多少几何细节才算够用」的度量问题相通，可供核查；但原文不涉及 latent 推理或多模态推理状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EAGLE: Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer for Partially Polygon-Supervised Object Localization

**abstract/A1：** Object detection is a critical application of computer vision, yet models trained uniformly on bounding boxes lack the geometric precision to be fully effective in inference settings, especially at high IoU thresholds. One common approach is the introduction of polygon-supervised localization, where a model is trained explicitly for localization but with access to polygon masks during training. Among such methods, partial polygon supervision is viable due to the higher annotation costs of developing fully supervised training datasets. However, this introduces a further challenge: in object classes of relatively low shape complexity, the addition of training masks and subsequent segmentation loss may obscure box localization, often worsening model performance despite access to deeper geometric information. To address the practical limitations of both full and partial polygon supervision, we introduce a mathematical framework for quantifying per-class geometric complexity by combining information theory and statistical shape analysis. With this framework, we develop Entropy-Aware Geometric Learning Enhancer (EAGLE), a lightweight, post-training model head that learns geometric information for the localization model, improving accuracy via edge refinement and localization rescoring using entropy-informed updates. Empirical analysis across MS COCO and Pascal SBD demonstrates the entropy framework meaningfully predicts shape reconstruction error and accuracy differences among mask-derived and standard box predictions, while the implemented EAGLE framework achieves consistent improvement on already SOTA detection frameworks (+0.9 mAP50-95 points on MS COCO) at minimal observed inference overhead.

**comment/C1：** 25 Pages, 3 figures, submitted to International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) 2027

</details>

### 362. [Instance-Specific Classifier-Free Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion/Flow-Based Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23905v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23905

**作者：** Wajeeh Atrash、Tom Tirer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23905v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23905v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究文本到图像编辑中的实例级 CFG 缩放选择：通过在大范围 CFG 值上重复运行多种编辑方法，说明按实例设定 CFG 可在不牺牲 CLIP-T 的情况下明显改善 LPIPS，并训练轻量网络预测给定编辑实例与 CFG 下的指标，从而在推理时快速选出实例专属的 CFG。

**相关性简评：** 其「用轻量预测器估计给定实例与超参下方法的指标、再据此选择控制量」的范式，可能为 LVR 中预测额外推理步骤或 LOOK/STOP 动作的收益与成本提供借鉴思路，但领域属图像编辑，是否真有对应决策结构可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Instance-Specific Classifier-Free Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion/Flow-Based Editing

**abstract/A1：** In recent years, a variety of prompt-based image editing methods have been developed based on text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow models. Image editing introduces an inherent trade-off between adhering to the original source image and realizing the change specified by the target prompt, which are typically measured by the LPIPS and CLIP-T metrics, respectively. Intuitively, this trade-off can be controlled by the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. Most existing editing methods, though, use a fixed CFG scale, ignoring that different edits require varying levels of modification. In this paper, we first explore the potential benefits of using an instance-specific CFG by exhaustively re-running prominent editing methods with a wide range of CFG scale values on benchmark datasets. We show that instance-specific setting can significantly improve LPIPS without compromising CLIP-T. Yet, tuning based on repeatedly executing an editing pipeline is inefficient. To prevent slow inference, we train a light-weight neural network that predicts the metrics of the underlying editing method for a given edit instance and CFG scale. At inference time, these predictions enable fast selection of an instance-specific CFG scale. Experiments across multiple editing methods and benchmark settings show the performance advantage of our approach over the baseline methods.

</details>

### 363. [Junction Geometry Survives an Unidentifiable Blur](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23912v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23912

**作者：** Sohail、Sarkar、Shakuntala Baichoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、physics.ins-det

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23912v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23912v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在未知高斯混合模糊下，如何从显微或 X 射线探测器上的交叉、分叉节点恢复直臂的数量、方向、相对权重与支撑直线；给出在含不可辨识模糊的有界模型类上的一致误差上界与 n^{-1/2} 极小极大速率，并用带约束的局部似然拟合在显微与 Chandra 光谱数据上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其对「不可辨识模糊」下几何结构仍可恢复的可辨识性与误差界刻画，可能与 LVR 关注的视觉细节是否保留在内部状态、以及观测退化时几何证据的可辨识性与筛选问题相关，概念线索可供核查，但需人工判断能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Junction Geometry Survives an Unidentifiable Blur

**abstract/A1：** Thin filaments cross in microscopy, and dispersed spectra cross on X-ray detectors. At a junction, where these structures cross or branch, how many straight arms meet, and which way do they go? Unknown blur obscures the answer. At a balanced crossing, distinct Gaussian blurs can even produce the same observation law. We show that the arms can still be recovered. For separated rays of nonvanishing weight and an unknown centered Gaussian-mixture blur, a distance combining arm count, directions, relative weights and supporting lines is bounded by a constant times the Euclidean difference in cell probabilities on a sufficiently fine fixed grid. The bound is uniform over a bounded model class, including unidentifiable blurs. From $n$ positions or photon counts, the minimax error is of order $n^{-1/2}$. This rate is proved for a global estimator. In practice we fit rays and blur by constrained local likelihood, reducing the BIC count when two detectors agree on fewer arms in the microscopy studies. Across three studies with protocols fixed before evaluation, on 360 crossings and branches assembled from measured single-molecule localizations, the fit gets the arm count and every direction within $10^\\circ$ 24 to 37 percentage points more often than a tuned fixed-scale Hessian ridge detector, averaged over 25 to 400 localizations. On acute angles with correct counts, mean absolute error is $3.5^\\circ$ to $4.3^\\circ$, versus $10.4^\\circ$ to $15.5^\\circ$. On Chandra spectra, 38 of 90 fits at 800 photons find all four arms within $10^\\circ$; among these, median error is $0.023^\\circ$.

**comment/C1：** 37 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 364. [Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23917v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23917

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、econ.EM、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23917v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23917v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在「预先宣布的分布断点」前后如何审计阈值预测的可靠性：区分 per-time 的 conformal reliability 与窗口频率校准两种指标，提出在断点处重新设定阈值（reset recursion）的规则，并在合成断点与电力市场改革、货币政策等真实序列上，与五个自适应方法比较其覆盖率差距。

**相关性简评：** 其断点后自适应阈值的可靠性审计与重置递归，可能为 LVR 中随推理进程漂移的停止阈值或证据获取策略提供一种评价视角，可供核查该类审计指标能否用于 latent 推理轨迹的校准评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration

**abstract/A1：** An announced boundary reveals the partition before the first affected outcome, and a reset there serves one of two audits. The per-time audit reads conformal reliability, the expected distance of the threshold's coverage from nominal at miscoverage 0.1. The frequency audit reads frequency calibration, whether a closed window's error rate matched it. The reset rule, the post-boundary empirical quantile, attains the minimax per-time rate for independent scores. On bounded scores a recursion reset at the boundary attains a frequency gap of order one over the count when its floor adds a bounded total. At the 50th forecast after a large synthetic break, the reset rule's per-time gap stands below that of five adaptive methods, four from their authors' code, with every paired band below zero. After an electricity market reform, on 68 unseen scores, the band stands below zero against two, includes zero against two, adaptive conformal inference among them, and is a point at zero against one. After monetary policy decisions its pointwise band stands above zero against all five on 10 of the first 34 days. Of 9 announced boundaries one clears the smallest coverage difference its window detects, where every method's per-time gap at the 50th forecast exceeds the nominal miscoverage. Over the first 50 forecasts the reset recursion leads the frequency audit after every synthetic break.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). 53 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 365. [Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23921v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23921

**作者：** Ritvik Garimella、Biplav Srivastava、Amit Sheth

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23921v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23921v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以一个需保持运算优先级的算术表达式基准（1000 条），对比原生函数调用、REST/SOAP/MCP 微服务、直接 LLM 回答与本地 LLM 调用 MCP 工具的 agent 方案，并据此提出按精度与吞吐选择架构的决策框架。

**相关性简评：** 虽不涉及视觉或多模态 latent，但其「何种任务值得付出 LLM/agent 计算代价」的成本-精度比较，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本权衡、以及何时走廉价旁路提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices

**abstract/A1：** There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. We ran this setup across a native Function Calling baseline (Python library), REST, SOAP and MCP microservice architectures, direct responses from large language models (LLMs) using a Groq cloud API and five locally deployed Ollama models, and agentic systems in which five local LLMs invoke MCP tools. The deterministic methods achieve 100% accuracy with negligible latency. Direct LLM evaluation achieves at most 92.9% accuracy at over 22,000x the latency of a native function call. With MCP tools, the best agent reaches 99.9% accuracy, but incurs nearly 1,000,000x the baseline latency. These results demonstrate that LLMs approaches are poorly suited for exact arithmetic evaluation and motivate an informed architectural decision framework (ADF) for choosing an architecture based on accuracy and throughput requirements. We recognize that an actual interaction with an agent may span both reasoning and linguistic tasks. Hence our recommendation is to explore multiple architectural choices (based on task type) rather than one-size-fits-all solution (LLMs). Code is available at - https://github.com/Ritvik-G/adf/

**comment/C1：** Accepted to AAAI Fall Symposium - Trustworthy Agentic Systems (https://tas2026.github.io/accepted/) 8 pages, 3 figures

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、econ.EM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23934v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23934v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究如何组织 LLM 推理以从浏览会话预测产品级转化率：对比「先概括会话」与「逐会话预测再平均」、以及产品单独评估与合并入同一 prompt 两种设计，并用贝叶斯模型解释比较性上下文带来的偏差-方差权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其关于上下文组合引入噪声、比较性上下文帮助推断典型值的偏差-方差分析，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、多假设比较与推理成本取舍的设计，但论文本身为纯文本行为数据预测，无视觉状态与 latent 生成内容，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Organizing LLM Inference for Aggregate Predictions from Behavioral Data

**abstract/A1：** When using a large language model (LLM) to simulate a user population, how should we combine individual behavioral histories to predict the fraction of users who take a particular action? We study this question in e-commerce, predicting observed product-level conversion rates from browsing sessions without task-specific model training. We vary two design choices, each involving a bias-variance tradeoff. Summarizing a product's sessions before inference reduces cost but can discard predictive detail, adding bias, whereas predicting outcomes for individual sessions and averaging afterward preserves that detail but requires many calls to reduce variance. Evaluating products together in one prompt can help the model infer what is typical in the setting, reducing bias, but also makes each prediction depend on which other products appear alongside it, adding noise. We evaluate both choices across five LLMs and two datasets. Our main finding is that predictions from individual sessions outperform predictions from summaries when products are evaluated separately, but summaries lead when products are evaluated together. Comparative summaries achieve the highest Spearman correlation with observed rates in 12 of 15 settings, with no alternative significantly better. Comparison thus helps summaries far more than session predictions, overcoming the advantage of behavioral detail. We interpret this difference through a Bayesian model of the second tradeoff, which suggests that comparison helps more when the inputs in a prompt reveal more about differences across products, consistent with our results for four types of comparative context. Comparative summaries also incur a small fraction of the inference cost of the session methods. With the best model for each outcome, they attain 66-89% of the correlation of the best supervised benchmark trained on thousands of labeled products.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fast Construction of Inner Sphere Trees Using Machine Learning

**abstract/A1：** Collision detection for complex non-convex objects is a bottleneck in physics simulation, virtual reality, and robotics. Inner sphere trees (ISTs) answer proximity and penetration queries efficiently, but their greedy leaf-sphere construction is sequential and computationally expensive, which limits both large-scale preprocessing and runtime use. In this work, we present ML-IST, a machine-learning-based method that reformulates leaf-sphere generation as a single-shot set-prediction problem: a network predicts a fixed set of inscribed sphere candidates from multichannel voxel geometry, differentiable coverage feedback corrects the coarse prediction and fills residual gaps at finer scales, and a lightweight geometric projection enforces validity. Averaged over the test set, a single-GPU implementation of ML-IST reduces mean leaf-generation time by a factor of $2.0$--$2.6$ over single-core CPU construction across target capacities of 64--512 spheres, and qualitative results on complex models show multiscale sphere distributions that follow principal volumes and slender features. We further integrate ML-IST into the Jolt Physics and Bullet engines; in an alpha-puzzle benchmark it reaches 55.89~FPS, the highest among the compared representations (conventional IST, GImpact, and convex decomposition). These results support learned leaf generation as a practical component for fast, runtime construction of detailed collision representations.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 7 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对生物、化学、法医与材料等多域拉曼光谱，提出物理感知的掩码自编码器自监督预训练框架：在掩码强度重建之外加入稀疏 Voigt 峰形解码器（可微峰位、峰宽、峰高）与去噪目标，并在分类、组分识别、浓度估计与去噪任务上比较线性探测、注意力探测、端到端微调与从头训练。

**相关性简评：** 光谱领域与视觉多模态推理距离较远，但其「注意力探测比线性探测能从冻结表示中读出更多信息」的评估线索，可能供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被真正使用时的探测设计借鉴；物理感知的结构化解码目标也可能提示对内部状态的分解式监督，均属推测、需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining on Multi-Domain Raman Spectra

**abstract/A1：** Raman spectroscopy generates large volumes of unlabeled data that are difficult to exploit with conventional supervised learning. This work introduces a multi-domain self-supervised learning framework based on a masked autoencoder (MAE) for learning transferable Raman spectral representations from heterogeneous biological, chemical, forensic, and materials datasets. The proposed pretraining strategy incorporates physics-aware objectives by combining masked intensity reconstruction with a sparse Voigt-profile decoder that models spectral peak structure through differentiable peak centers, widths, and amplitudes. A denoising objective is further included to improve robustness to spectral corruption. The learned encoder is evaluated on substance classification, component identification, concentration estimation, and spectral denoising under linear probing, attention-based probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and training from scratch. Experimental results show that self-supervised pretraining is most beneficial for challenging tasks with limited labeled data. Attention-based probing also reveals substantially more useful information in the frozen representation than linear probing, indicating that conventional linear evaluation may underestimate representation quality. In addition, the benefits of pretraining become more pronounced with increasing encoder capacity. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates that physics-aware, multi-domain self-supervised pretraining can improve label efficiency, robustness, and transferability across diverse Raman spectroscopy tasks.

</details>

### 369. [Super-resolution as Spatial Downscaling: Coherence, Structure and Task Utility in Earth Observation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23972v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.23972

**作者：** Bright Wiredu Nuakoh、Ebenezer Afrifa-Yamoah

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23972v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23972v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把单幅卫星图像超分辨率视为空间降尺度问题，用像素指标、方向变差函数、波段相关、协离散度与观测一致性评估四个轻量网络与插值，并通过空间分块的下游土地利用、建筑变化检测任务检验任务效用。

**相关性简评：** 其「能量类指标偏好被发明的细节、剩余误差落在观测算子零空间」的结论，可能启发 LVR 中 latent 视觉状态究竟保留真实证据还是生成似真细节的评价设计，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Super-resolution as Spatial Downscaling: Coherence, Structure and Task Utility in Earth Observation

**abstract/A1：** Learned satellite super-resolution is commonly assessed by pixel fidelity and potential downlink savings, but these criteria do not establish whether the reconstructed field preserves spatial structure or supports reliable downstream analysis. We treat single-image super-resolution as a spatial downscaling problem and evaluate four lightweight networks, including our compact 0.36 million-parameter model, against interpolation using pixel metrics, directional variograms, spectral band correlation, codispersion and observation coherence. On 735 satellite tiles from 190 scenes, the networks differ by at most 0.03dB and outperform bicubic interpolation by $1.39-1.42$dB at $\\times 2$. They recover about 30% of the spectral power above the observation's Nyquist frequency and, at $\\times 4$, produce more isotropic fields than the reference (range anisotropy 0.59 against 0.49). Energy-based metrics can favour invented detail. Enforcing coherence reaches the quantisation limit, yet at least 99.7% of the remaining error lies in the observation operator's null space, which coherence cannot constrain. Under spatially blocked, paired evaluation with two backbones and a sharpening control, learned reconstruction changes land-use accuracy by $-1.0$ to $+3.1$ percentage points (significant in 7 of 24 comparisons) and building-change F1 by $-0.015$ to $+0.024$ (none significant) relative to bicubic interpolation, and amplifies spurious change between two observations of an unchanged scene by $1.3-1.5$ times where interpolation attenuates it. Full-resolution JPEG\\,2000 matches or exceeds reduced-resolution transmission with reconstruction at every matched bitrate. Learned reconstruction is most useful when only low-resolution imagery is available, and its evaluation should combine pixel metrics with spatial structure, observation coherence and task-level tests under spatial validation.

**comment/C1：** 41 pages, 12 figures. Code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23306933

**内容简述：** 在道路场景理解中，把场景抽象为定性可解释图（QXG），用时空推理与 Belnap 四值逻辑推断自驾车某动作的复杂原因，并在 NuScenes 场景上演示。

**相关性简评：** 其将动作归因于可解释图结构、并用四值逻辑容纳相互矛盾或未知证据的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的因果作用核查与矛盾证据筛选提供问题表述上的借鉴，可供核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Automatic Cause Determination in Road Scene Understanding Using Qualitative Reasoning and Four-Valued Logic

**abstract/A1：** Road scene understanding in automated driving (AD) aims to build a comprehensive analysis of video sequences taken on the road by embedded or fixed cameras (e.g., mounted on vertical road signals). One goal is to identify the relevant actors in the scene and another goal is to determine the causes that have triggered a specific action of the ego car (i.e., stop, slow down, turn left, etc.). In a complex urban environment, these causes can be multiple, confusing, possibly contradictory to other causes and not easily expressible using simplistic reasoning. Still, providing accurate {\\it automatic cause determination} supports a) user acceptance by providing appropriate explanations to the car passengers and road users; b) increased road safety by providing detailed road scene understanding to traffic. In this paper, we propose using spatiotemporal reasoning and Belnap's four-valued logic to formulate complex causes of AD action in a road scene. We compute these causes by analysing a Qualitative eXplainable Graph (QXG), which is an abstract representation of the road scene capturing spatiotemporal relations between road entities. Starting from a QXG, our approach called \\tool, is targeted to determine complex causes of a selected AD action occurring in a specific frame of a road scene. The usefulness of \\tool is demonstrated on several scenes extracted from the well-known NuScene dataset.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24001

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在时空神经距离场（signed distance field）的条件编码之前加入临床变量的结构因果模型，用以生成受干预驱动的 4D 左心房反事实解剖，并检验年龄干预的剂量-反应与逆干预重建精度。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线相距较远，但其「把因果干预施加于条件表示、并让连续隐式表示分离临床条件与个体形状」的思路，可能为 latent 状态的可干预性、贡献分配与表示几何提供概念启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Causal Spatio-Temporal Neural Distance Fields for Counterfactual Cardiac Anatomy

**abstract/A1：** Counterfactual cardiac anatomy can support risk modelling and intervention planning, by predicting how a patient's heart would change under altered clinical conditions. However, current shape generative models are conditional on clinical variables and disregard causal links between these variables. Thus, they cannot answer counterfactual questions about how a given subject's anatomy would change under a different clinical profile. Modelling the heart's continuous movement over the cardiac cycle requires a representation that is itself continuous in space and time. Spatio-temporal neural distance fields provide this while separating clinical conditioning from subject-specific shape. We place a structural causal model (SCM) over the set of clinical variables (age, sex, smoking, BMI, heart rate, systolic blood pressure), before the condition encoding of the spatio-temporal neural distance field which represents the left atrial complex over a cardiac cycle by signed distance fields. An intervention of the clinical variables, propagated through a SCM before the 4D counterfactual, is constructed from the neural distance field. The generated counterfactuals follow dose-response under age interventions and transforms the male distribution to closely match the female distribution under the intervention $\\mathrm{do(\\mathrm{female}{=}1)}$. By doing inverse interventions the model also approximates the original anatomy with sub millimeter precision. To our knowledge, this is the first counterfactual generation of 4D cardiac anatomy and the first integration of an SCM with an implicit neural representation as its imaging mechanism.

**comment/C1：** Published at Off-Grid @ MICCAI 2026. Code: https://github.com/MMLowes/spatio\_temporal\_causal\_cardiac\_model

### 372. [What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24006v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24006

**作者：** Dawei Li、Bohan Jiang、Huan Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24006v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24006v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 一篇立场论文，借鉴社交媒体研究提出「轨迹忽视论题」，主张 AI 安全评估应关注随反复使用、重复决策与部署间反馈而累积的伤害，并以对话式 AI 的生成、语义推断与持久记忆为例，讨论谄媚、操纵与隐私损失如何叠加。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「累积轨迹而非单次事件」的评估视角可能为推理轨迹级监督、贡献分配以及多轮推理中状态持续更新的评价方式提供类比线索，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks

**abstract/A1：** Prominent AI safety discussions emphasize existential threats and catastrophic events, such as AI-enabled nuclear conflict or engineered biological outbreaks. This position paper argues that there is another type of AI risk that arises and accumulates from the widespread use of AI. Drawing on lessons from social media, we argue that safety assessments must also address accumulative harms that develop through repeated use, recurring decisions, and feedback across interconnected deployments. Repeated reassurance, selective exposure, recurring decision biases, and growing personal profiles may gradually narrow perspectives, weaken independent judgment, or enable exploitative influence without a single clearly harmful event. We advance the Trajectory Neglect Thesis: a focus on vivid catastrophic events and identifiable incidents risks overlooking less visible harms that accumulate through the widespread daily use of AI. Social media research motivates this position by showing how reciprocal media effects, social reinforcement, and individual susceptibility shape outcomes beyond individual encounters. We examine how related mechanisms may operate in AI systems, using conversational AI as a concrete setting where generation, semantic inference, and persistent memory may tighten feedback loops. Sycophancy, manipulation, and privacy loss provide a case study of how these risks may interact and accumulate. This comparison identifies mechanisms to investigate rather than assuming that repeated AI use is harmful. We therefore call for evaluation of cumulative patterns of use and deployment, individual and societal outcomes, careful causal inference, and proportionate safeguards that preserve useful assistance and informed user choice.

**comment/C1：** Camera-ready version for CogMI 2026 vision track

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.SI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24045v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24045v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文审计图级异常检测基准 UB-GOLD 及 14 个代码库，重跑 21 个检测器，量化「用测试标签选择 checkpoint 或超参」带来的 AUROC 虚高，并主张以无测试标签的选择规则报告主结果。

**相关性简评：** 其用置换分析估计评测选择偏差、并对比有/无测试标签选择规则的审计思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中额外 latent 计算或训练监督带来的收益是否被 checkpoint 选择偏差放大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Remains Without Test Labels? Re-evaluating a Graph-Level Anomaly Detection Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Graph-level anomaly detectors are trained only on normal graphs, yet benchmarks may use test labels for model selection. We examine whether UB-GOLD results reused by later papers support label-free detection. We audit UB-GOLD and 14 GLAD code bases, re-run 21 detectors on UB-GOLD's folds under selection rules with and without test labels, and evaluate sensitivity to known structural changes. Test labels select checkpoints in UB-GOLD's shared training loop and checkpoints or hyperparameters in 8 of the 14 code bases. UB-GOLD also evaluates its kernel baselines against misaligned labels. Across nine datasets, selecting checkpoints by test AUROC adds an average of 5.12 AUROC points \[3.97, 6.24\] for the 12 UB-GOLD detectors relative to the final checkpoint and 4.13 \[3.32, 4.79\] relative to held-out normal graphs. In a post hoc permutation analysis with no truly better checkpoint, picking the best of noisy test evaluations still yields a gain more than half as large as the one observed against the final checkpoint. Configurations tuned on test labels score a further 1.53 points \[0.64, 2.42\] above repository defaults, a gap that mixes the value of test labels with that of tuning itself. With tuned hyperparameters and label-free checkpoint selection, the two strongest detectors retain their lead, while comparisons below them are less stable. Six of eight detectors evaluated out of sample miss size-preserving composition changes that graphlet counts detect. We recommend reporting results selected without test labels as the main comparisons and release per-run outputs that allow verification without retraining.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds

**abstract/A1：** As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

### 375. [GLOW: General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's Method](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24085v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24085

**作者：** Matt Higger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24085v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24085v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向神经影像，提出 GLOW：按 GLM 误差最小化贪心合并体素、构建嵌套区域层次（Ward 聚类特例），用最大统计量置换控制族错误率并剪枝，以恢复完整效应范围；在 HCP 与白噪声上以 Dice、PPV、运行时间评估。

**相关性简评：** 「相邻单元共享统计量却不共享模型」的诊断，以及层次化候选区域加置换显著性筛选、牺牲 PPV 换取范围完整性，可能为 latent 状态下定位与验证任务相关证据、筛选视觉线索并控制多重比较提供思路，可作远域类比核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GLOW: General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's Method

**abstract/A1：** Neuroimaging seeks brain regions whose imaging features correlate with variables of interest (e.g., diagnosis, age), usually via the General Linear Model (GLM). Region-Based Analysis dilutes or splits any effect that does not fill exactly one atlas region. Voxel-Based Analysis, with Cluster Extent Thresholding and Threshold-Free Cluster Enhancement built on it, fits a GLM per voxel and groups adjacent significant voxels. But neighboring voxels can share a statistic without sharing a GLM, which a per-voxel statistic cannot detect. GLOW (General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's method) instead builds a hierarchy of nested regions by greedily minimizing GLM error (provably a special case of Ward's clustering). Maximum-statistic (Westfall-Young) permutation controls family-wise error over all regions. Significance spreads to an effect's nested fragments and the regions containing it; a final pruning step seeks whole, pure effect extents. We plant synthetic effects of known extent and varying strength in Human Connectome Project (HCP) diffusion images and in white noise. Pruning delivers wholeness: GLOW returns a spatially consistent effect as one region on 57% of HCP trials, the best baseline on 35%; baselines recover comparable volume, but in many pure pieces. The cost is positive predictive value (PPV): GLOW is more sensitive (by up to 0.29), but its regions overrun the effect, mostly because no hierarchy region isolates it, not because of pruning. On HCP, GLOW's mean Dice gains 0.059 over the best baseline at weaker effects and gives back 0.005 at stronger ones. On white noise, GLOW trails by up to 0.61 Dice: its hierarchy holds the effect, but its permutation test does not certify it. Runtime grows roughly linearly with voxel count, about 4.5 times the voxel-wise methods' on the full HCP volume. The PPV loss may trace to the assumption of spatially independent residuals.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究手语生成：提出多速率矢量量化器 MRVQ，把身体与双手表示为不同时间分辨率的离散动作流，并在此基础上构建免 gloss 的块级扩散框架 BLANC，用 Latent Articulatory Clock 预测可变时长运动块及序列终止，在 PHOENIX-2014T 与 CSL-Daily 上报告了领先结果。

**相关性简评：** 手语动作生成与 VLM 推理相距较远，但其以 latent 时钟变量预测生成块时长与终止的机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算与 STOP 决策的建模提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BLANC: Adaptive Temporal Scheduling for Sign Language Production

**abstract/A1：** Sign language production (SLP) aims to synthesize expressive signing motion from written text. Modeling signing motion presents two key temporal challenges. First, fine-grained hand articulations demand higher temporal resolution than relatively slower body movements. Second, signing events unfold over variable durations, calling for adaptive temporal scheduling during generation. To address these challenges, we first introduce a Multi-Rate Vector Quantizer (MRVQ), an articulation-decoupled motion tokenizer that represents the body and both hands as separate discrete streams at distinct temporal resolutions. Building on this representation, we propose BLANC (BLock-wise Adaptive diffusioN with Articulatory Clock), a gloss-free SLP framework that generates variable-duration motion blocks causally while denoising tokens in parallel within each block. At its core, a Latent Articulatory Clock (LAC) learns temporal structure from multi-scale motion-derived partitions to predict block durations and sequence termination during generation. We further introduce inference-time body-conditioned hand refinement to improve coordination across articulators. Extensive experiments on PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily demonstrate that BLANC achieves state-of-the-art performance in sign language production.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://winston1214.github.io/BLANC/

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24113

**作者：** Yanlin Zhang、Sungyong Chung、Alireza Talebpour

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、econ.EM、stat.ME、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24113v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24113v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出图正则化合成控制（Graph-SC），在经典处理前匹配目标上加入图拉普拉斯惩罚，鼓励结构相关供体获得连贯权重；给出偏差-方差权衡与近端梯度收敛性分析，并在模拟、加州控烟基准和 Waymo 数据上评估权重稳定性。

**相关性简评：** 该工作关注的「大量相关供体导致多个近等价解、权重不稳定」与 LVR 中多个近似等价的 latent 假设难以筛选、表示易冗余的情形可能同构，其用结构图正则提升解的可辨识性与可解释性的思路，可供核查是否能迁移为 latent 假设筛选或状态去冗余的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Graph-Regularized Synthetic Control for Stable Counterfactual Estimation under Donor Redundancy

**abstract/A1：** Synthetic control methods estimate counterfactual outcomes by weighting untreated donor units to match a treated unit before treatment. In recent applications, however, the donor pool can be large, highly correlated, and short in pre-treatment history, yielding many near-equivalent solutions with unstable and difficult-to-interpret donor weights. We propose Graph-Regularized Synthetic Control (Graph-SC), a convex estimator that augments the classical pre-treatment matching objective with a graph Laplacian penalty. The graph encodes similarity among donor trajectories, encouraging coherent weights over structurally related donors while preserving the transparency of synthetic controls. We provide theoretical results characterizing the bias-variance tradeoff induced by graph regularization and establish efficient convergence guarantees with an accelerated proximal gradient method. Across a controlled simulation under donor redundancy, the California Proposition 99 benchmark, and observational counterfactual analyses on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, Graph-SC improves weight stability, reduces sensitivity to redundant donor pools, and maintains competitive pre- and post-treatment accuracy relative to classical and regularized synthetic control baselines. Our results suggest that graph regularization is most valuable not as a universal accuracy booster, but as a principled mechanism for selecting stable and interpretable counterfactuals from near-equivalent synthetic controls with comparable pre-treatment fit.

</details>

### 378. [Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24156v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24156

**作者：** Sudipto Guha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24156v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24156v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究「先探索后利用、探索受硬预算约束」的多臂老虎机变体，证明已有 1/3 与 4/27 近似分析是紧的，并给出 0.43 近似的高效算法，以及在有界可交换奖励下逼近 1−1/e 的算法与紧性分析。

**相关性简评：** 与 latent 视觉推理无直接关联，但其「预算受限的探索—利用权衡」及「可为顺序模型评估提供停止证书」的结论，可能启发 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 计算预算分配与证据获取的停止决策；这一迁移联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization

**abstract/A1：** The multi-armed bandit problem models the trade-off between exploration and exploitation. In this paper, we study the variant where exploration has a hard budget and precedes exploitation. Prior guarantees include a 1/3 approximation by Guha and Munagala using Lagrangian duality, and a 4/27 approximation by Ma against a primal linear programming relaxation for a more general model. We show that the analyses of both algorithms are tight, even when their relaxations are asymptotically exact. We provide a different efficient algorithm that achieves a 0.43 approximation. We then provide an efficient algorithm whose guarantee approaches 1-e^{-1} approx 0.63 for bounded exchangeable reward observations in a non-vanishing regime, which is asymptotically tight against natural linear programming relaxations. The technique also gives certificates for stopping sequential model evaluation.

</details>

### 379. [Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24166v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24166

**作者：** Adria Binte Habib、Ibne Farabi Shihab

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.ST、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24166v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24166v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究平稳 β-mixing 依赖流下投票分类器的均匀 margin 泛化证书：以分块 Rademacher 技术与裁剪 margin 损失给出依赖惩罚显式的界，对可逆 Markov 流给出 √(t\_rel/n) 谱集中率，并在依赖尺度未知时提出批量均值 t 区间，用合成实验与 UCI HAR 数据验证覆盖性。

**相关性简评：** 其「近似独立块数/有效样本量」与依赖下区间有效性的处理，可能为 LVR 中同一推理轨迹内高度相关状态样本的评估与停止决策可靠性提供统计工具，属推测性借鉴线索，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence

**abstract/A1：** Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $β$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(μ-1)β(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $β$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\\sqrt{t\_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. The constant is statistic-specific: the effective sample size is $n/τ\_{int}(g)$, with $τ\_{int}(g) \\le 2t\_{rel}-1$. When the dependence scale is unknown, a batch-means Student-t interval is valid up to an explicit remainder vanishing in the number of batches, with width governed by $τ\_{int}(g)$ rather than the worst-case $t\_{rel}$. Experiments show: the learned-vote certificate is nonvacuous once the block count is large; a two-timescale construction gives a batch-means interval 8.1x narrower than the worst-case interval at nominal coverage (0.945); block-bootstrap and batch-means intervals undercover under strong dependence while the certificate stays valid; and on real, ordered UCI HAR sensor data the dependence-agnostic certificate reaches 0.95 coverage where naive intervals reach only 0.38.

</details>

### 380. [PREEMPT: Proactive Robustness Evaluation under Editing for Media Protection Techniques](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24205v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24205

**作者：** Qiuyu Tang、Aparna Bharati

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24205v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24205v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PREEMPT 评估框架，把主动图像保护方法在单步与顺序多步编辑下的效果归一化为「保护生存轨迹」，用以刻画长时程鲁棒性动态，并揭示扰动式与水印式保护的失效模式差异。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其用多步序列上的轨迹式诊断替代单步静态评估，可能为评估 latent 推理状态随推理步数退化、以及长度泛化的评价设计提供借鉴线索，具体迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PREEMPT: Proactive Robustness Evaluation under Editing for Media Protection Techniques

**abstract/A1：** Proactive image protection methods aim to defend visual content against unauthorized manipulation and generative misuse by embedding protective signals into images before release. Evaluating whether these protections remain effective under image editing is therefore critical. However, existing evaluations remain largely limited to one-shot edits, providing only a static view of robustness while overlooking its evolution under realistic multi-step editing workflows. To systematically characterize robustness dynamics under sequential editing across various protection paradigms, we introduce PREEMPT, a holistic evaluation framework. It evaluates protection robustness under both one-shot and sequential editing scenarios, covering image transformations, semantic edits, homogeneous and heterogeneous edit compositions. To enable consistent analysis across protection paradigms with different underlying objectives, PREEMPT normalizes task-specific effectiveness into protection survival trajectories and summarizes long-horizon robustness through trajectory-based diagnostics. Using this framework, we reveal that degradation behaviors remain hidden under conventional one-shot evaluation. Furthermore, perturbation- and watermark-based protection methods exhibit different failure modes, and the first semantic edit largely determines subsequent degradation trajectories. PREEMPT provides a standardized protocol for studying long-horizon robustness and offers new insights into the degradation dynamics of proactive image protection.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 6 figures, accepted by WACV2027

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SimCompose 框架，在无标志点、无度量尺度信息的情况下，把术前肝脏 3D 模型配准到术中表面：估计含尺度的相似变换、跨多视图融合、用基于几何的选择器评估候选变换，并以 Neo-Hookean 仿真的低维形变模型做非刚性精修。

**相关性简评：** 其「无真值时依据候选变换之间的分歧标记不可靠配准」的筛选思路，可能为 LVR 中答案验证、证据取舍与停止决策提供概念参考；但领域相距较远，该可靠性信号能否迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Landmark-Free and Scale-Blind Multi-View Registration of Preoperative Liver Models to Intraoperative Surfaces

**abstract/A1：** Augmented-reality guidance in laparoscopic liver resection requires aligning preoperative 3D liver models from CT/MRI with intraoperative surfaces. Monocular reconstruction in most cases cannot guarantee scale, albeit rigid-motion registration requires scale as an input. Our proposed framework \`\`SimCompose'' estimates the full similarity transformation $\\Sim$, including scale, without relying on landmarks and applies the same transformation across multiple views with known relative geometry. However, reliable detection of registration failures remains challenging in surgical settings, where ground-truth alignment is generally unavailable. For this, we propose a geometry-based selector that evaluates candidate transformations without requiring ground truth. Large disagreement among these transformations is used to flag potentially unreliable registrations. Finally, we propose to use a non-rigid refinement based on a low-dimensional deformation model from Neo-Hookean simulations in the Simulation Open Framework Architecture (SOFA), without additional network training. SimCompose is trained exclusively on synthetic partial views. Its encoder processes point clouds normalised to a unit root-mean-square radius, without access to metric scale, and filters each view before multi-view fusion. Evaluation on unseen synthetic data (300 single-view pairs per run; 100 three-view registrations) shows that multi-view integration and candidate selection increase the success rate under stringent $\\Sim$ accuracy criteria from 38.4% for a single-view, single-method configuration to 77%. Existing learning-based baselines do not satisfy these criteria even when provided with the exact scale. On five in-vivo patients with 92 keyframes, the rigid registration stage reduces surface error more than three-fold relative to learning-based baselines with external scale information.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages

</details>

### 382. [Probing Ambiguity: Adversarial Intent Resolution for Robust Text-to-SQL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24248v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24248

**作者：** Youbing Yin、Xujun Peng、Muhammad S. Uddin、Erin Babinsky、Daben Liu、Anoop Kumar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24248v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24248v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 Text-to-SQL 中自然语言查询的固有歧义，提出免任务训练的多智能体框架 AIR：先构造多个竞争解释，用 SQL 执行验证其结果确实不同，再据数据差异生成有针对性的澄清问题，在 AMBROSIA、AmbiQT 等歧义基准上优于 IntentRL 等模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「构造多个竞争解释—执行验证—生成澄清问题」的流程，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的筛选、视觉证据获取与是否停止/追问的决策存在概念对应，可供核查能否迁移到视觉证据场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probing Ambiguity: Adversarial Intent Resolution for Robust Text-to-SQL

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-SQL systems typically assume a one-to-one mapping between natural-language queries and correct SQL translations. In practice, however, many queries are inherently ambiguous, admitting multiple valid interpretations that yield distinct outputs. We introduce Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR), a multi-agent framework that actively probes and resolves such ambiguity without any task-specific training. AIR first constructs competing interpretations, verifies through SQL execution that they produce genuinely different results, and generates targeted clarification questions grounded in the observed data differences. Evaluating on leading benchmarks for ambiguous questions, AIR demonstrates strong performance, efficiency, and robust cross-benchmark transferability. On the AMBROSIA benchmark under schema-only context, a realistic production setting where exposing the full database is infeasible, AIR outperforms IntentRL, the state-of-the-art reinforcement learning model, across all metrics (e.g., F1 0.679 vs. 0.618). Crucially, AIR exhibits only ~7% performance degradation without the full database, compared to ~20% for IntentRL. On the AmbiQT benchmark, where ambiguity arises from schema design rather than linguistic structure, AIR achieves higher F1 under both context settings without any benchmark-specific adaptation.

</details>

### 383. [AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24264v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24264

**作者：** Eric Zhang、Terry Jingchen Zhang、Chijioke Ugwuanyi、Jerick Shi、Bernhard Schölkopf、Zhijing Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24264v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24264v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AM-Bench，基于犯罪学「欺诈三角」构建覆盖七个行业的 35 场景分类法与评测套件，从感知威胁、感知机会与推理三个维度检测 agentic misalignment，并评测 10 个前沿模型，发现场景间错位率相差 62 个百分点。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态推理主线无直接关联，但其「模型出现有害行为却无明确情境意识或解释」的行为—推理分离发现以及四问二元推理框架，可能为核查 latent 内容是否因果驱动输出、推理轨迹监督是否可信提供类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment

**abstract/A1：** As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「缺失观测下重建离散事件并分阶段归因失败」的评价思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据缺失时的信息恢复与是否采信/复核重建证据提供概念参考，但领域与机制距离较远，线索可供核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Compact Open-Weight Large Language Models Recover Mobility Events from Incomplete Trajectories? A Controlled Evaluation Using Air Trips

**abstract/A1：** Incomplete mobility trajectories can obscure the observations needed to identify important travel events and their endpoints. This study evaluates whether compact, locally deployed large language models (LLMs) can recover missing mobility information from incomplete trajectories, using high-confidence air trips as a controlled test case, and whether more explicit prompts can compensate for the loss of endpoint evidence. Using nationwide location-based services (LBS) data from the United States in January 2022 and airport reference data, thirty high-confidence air trips were converted into three incomplete-trajectory conditions by removing observations near the origin airport, the destination airport, or both. Four prompt variants and two LLMs generated 720 requests, each using a two-stage procedure to identify the flight transition segment and then select the origin and destination airports. Exact transition accuracy is 9.2%, while origin and destination accuracy are 31.4% and 10.7%, respectively. Only 1.9% of requests recover both the rule-identified transition and the reference airport pair. The most explicit prompt produced the highest observed exact transition and exact airport-pair recovery rates. The study introduces a controlled endpoint-removal framework for evaluating recovery of discrete mobility events from incomplete trajectories, allowing failures to be examined by inference stage and helping analysts decide whether recovered information should be retained, independently verified, or left unresolved.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ULIFlow 面向文本条件的 3D 人–物交互生成，将稀疏体表 marker 与物体的连续关系作为显式模态，用 Mixture-of-Transformers 自编码器在统一 latent 空间联合建模人体运动、物体动态与交互关系，并以 blockwise flow forcing 加全局序列进度条件实现变长长时程生成。

**相关性简评：** 运动生成属较远领域，但其「让关系流参与重建以迫使共享 latent 保留交互几何」以及「序列进度条件化实现超出训练窗口的变长生成」两条设计，可能为 LVR 的 latent 内容保留与长度泛化提供可供核查的类比线索，需阅读原文确认机制细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ULIFLOW: Unified Latent Human-Object Interaction Flow

**abstract/A1：** Text-conditioned 3D human--object interaction (HOI) generation remains challenging because individually plausible human and object motions do not necessarily form a coherent interaction. We argue that a key limitation lies in conventional skeleton-based representations, which compactly describe body kinematics while leaving surface-level interaction geometry largely implicit, often requiring additional contact-specific regularizers. We propose ULIFlow, a framework that explicitly models continuous human--object relations within a unified latent space. To this end, we derive continuous marker--object relations from sparse body-surface markers and treat them as an explicit interaction modality alongside human motion and object dynamics. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) autoencoder is then designed to jointly model these heterogeneous streams while preserving their modality-specific structures. Importantly, we let the relation stream directly participate in human and object reconstruction, encouraging the shared latent representation to preserve both individual dynamics and the interaction geometry that coordinates them. To further achieve variable-length generation, we introduce a blockwise Flow Forcing scheme with global sequence-progress conditioning, enabling progressive continuation from fixed-length training windows while maintaining consistent long-horizon dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ULIFlow consistently outperforms prior work in overall generation quality and human--object coordination, while preserving coherent interactions over requested durations beyond the training horizon.

</details>

### 386. [An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24291v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24291

**作者：** Nian Ran、Tianhe Jia、Zhengyang Mu、Yue Wang、Sebastian Brulin、Markus Olhofer、Mauricio A. Alvarez、Yang Liu、Richard Allmendinger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24291v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24291v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究反馈驱动 LLM 优化器中的「原则级搜索崩溃」：优化器虽持续产出不同候选，却把搜索限制在少数设计原则内，收益停滞。作者构建跨分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择与 GPU kernel 优化的诊断基准和决策树协议，并检验多样性注入与参考原则干预的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其核心判断「候选层差异会掩盖原则层搜索受限」与 LVR 中潜在假设的多样性维持、崩溃检测和评价方式可能概念相通，且多样性注入收益有限的负结果可供核查；但论文面向黑盒优化而非视觉多模态推理，联系需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima

**abstract/A1：** Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \\emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \\emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\\% and 53.8\\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages under review

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24292

**作者：** Ilay Kamai、Alex M. Bronstein、Hagai B. Perets

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24292v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24292v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出在已知连续物理参数空间上施加图拉普拉斯平滑先验，不指定具体表征几何，却在连续极限下选出拉普拉斯特征函数，从而在六个天文巡源的多模态恒星表征中诱导出 Toeplitz Gram 结构与沿恒星参数的正弦模式，并提升下游线性探测与标签效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「以平滑先验在连续参数空间上诱导表征几何（Laplacian 特征函数、近似平移等变性）」的思路，可能启发核查 latent 推理状态是否沿深度或位置轴呈现类似平滑几何结构、能否用先验塑造内部状态几何；这属较远领域的概念线索，与实际机制无关，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings

**abstract/A1：** Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \\emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. Of the exact-symmetry predictions, stationarity in a recoverable warped coordinate survives; diagnostics assuming exact quantization or asymptotic rates do not. The prior also improves downstream linear-probe performance and label efficiency, suggesting a general strategy: where a meaningful continuous parameter space exists, its local geometry can serve as a data-informed prior.

</details>

**title/T1：** Continuous Ontology Assurance through External Resources -- An Ontology Engineering Method with a Case Study in Software Language Engineering

**abstract/A1：** Domain ontologies require review against knowledge recorded in evolving external resources. We propose COATER, a method that manages executable review components called arrows. Each arrow compares a scoped part of an ontology with a relevant resource and reports support or challenges to its axioms. Challenges may prompt proposals for completion, correction, or restructuring and become tasks for human or agent-assisted triage. Per-axiom coverage summarizes the assessments. We illustrate COATER with the FSL ontology in software language engineering (SLE): arrows review language coverage, language conceptualization, and software-engineering activities. An LLM-assisted linkage exercise increases compliance with a defined Wikipedia-linkage policy from 405 to 600 of 600 entities. A structured catalogue of SLE resources organizes review opportunities.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24332

**作者：** Chase Hutton、Adam Melrod、Han Shao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究带查询反馈的可实现多类 PAC 学习：每个样本只返回一个二值响应，说明真实标签是否属于某个查询子集；作者提出「query dimension」这一组合参数，并给出样本复杂度的上下界，在查询能均匀二分候选集时得到近乎紧确的刻画。

**相关性简评：** 其「查询族结构决定标签可区分性」的想法，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 阶段选取哪类视觉证据查询、以及证据筛选的信息价值评估提供抽象度量参考，但属推测，需核查其是否可对应到具体视觉查询与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PAC Learning with Query Feedback

**abstract/A1：** We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with query feedback, where each training example provides a single binary response indicating whether its true label belongs to a chosen subset from a fixed query family. Our main contribution is the query dimension, a combinatorial parameter that captures both the structure of the hypothesis class and the ability of the available queries to distinguish labels. This parameter generalizes the bandit DS dimension, which it recovers under singleton queries. We establish a sample-complexity lower bound of $Ω(D/\\varepsilon)$ and an upper bound of $\\widetilde{O}(D^2/\\varepsilon)$, suppressing factors polylogarithmic in the number of labels and the failure probability. When the available queries can split every candidate set into two parts of comparable size, we improve the upper bound to $\\widetilde{O}(D/\\varepsilon)$, yielding a characterization up to logarithmic factors.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24334

**作者：** Marcel Kühn、Bernd Rosenow

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.dis-nn

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24334v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24334v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在固定层次树上的概率上下文无关文法中，用信念传播得到精确的下一词条件分布并按温度缩放后自回归采样，测量两点互信息随距离的变化，发现在所测温度与文法集合下互信息始终呈幂律包络，既无有序相的长程平台也无明显的短程指数衰减转折，并用树上的 Ising 近似解释树距离上的指数衰减如何变成 token 距离上的幂律。

**相关性简评：** 这是一项与视觉多模态推理无关的受控玩具模型研究，但其结论提示「长程幂律相关或临界性可能只是层次结构的产物、无需特殊解码温度」，这一警示性基线可能可供核查 LVR 中对 latent 状态长程相关、深度位置效应或相变式涌现解读的评价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Power-Law Correlations Without Apparent Temperature-Tuned Criticality in Fixed-Tree Hierarchical Languages

**abstract/A1：** Sampling temperature can substantially reshape autoregressive generation, but it is unclear when temperature changes in long-range correlations reflect a genuine phase transition rather than a smooth change in statistics. We study this question in a controlled analogue of temperature sampling: a finite-depth probabilistic context-free grammar on a fixed hierarchical tree, where exact next-token conditionals are computed by belief propagation and then rescaled by a softmax temperature before autoregressive sampling. We measure two-point mutual information between tokens as a function of separation. Across the tested temperatures and grammar ensembles, mutual information remains well described by a power-law envelope. Temperature changes the correlation magnitude and fitted exponent, but within the accessible system sizes we find no long-distance plateau characteristic of an ordered phase and no clear crossover to short-range exponential decay. An approximate mapping to an Ising model on a tree explains how exponential decay in tree distance becomes a power law in token distance, allowing power laws to persist without tuning to a special decoding temperature. This controlled baseline clarifies which temperature effects can arise from hierarchical structure alone, before adding training, approximation error, or neural architecture.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 391. [Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24336v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24336

**作者：** Noga Alon、Steve Hanneke、Shay Moran、Tom Waknine

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24336v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24336v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究实值函数类上的均匀收敛，证明在最优尺度 γ+ε 下取得阶 d/ε² 的样本复杂度（d 为尺度 γ 的 fat-shattering 维度），并给出带间隔 ε-net、部分概念类的覆盖引理与最优尺度链式界等工具。

**相关性简评：** 其尺度相关的 fat-shattering 维度、带间隔覆盖与链式界可能为分析 latent 推理表示的容量与泛化提供理论工具，但该迁移尚属推测，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale

**abstract/A1：** Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $γ$. The challenge is to achieve error $γ+\\varepsilon$ with order $d/\\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $γ$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. Along the way, we use several tools that may be of independent interest. The first concerns $\\varepsilon$-nets with margin. A classical $\\varepsilon$-net intersects every set of mass at least $\\varepsilon$ in a prescribed family; we allow the net to intersect a slightly enlarged version of each such set. Remarkably, this relaxation permits bounds independent of the ambient dimension in natural geometric settings. Second, we derive improved covering bounds in both discrete and real-valued settings: we extend Haussler's covering lemma to partial concept classes and use this extension to obtain $\\ell\_2$ covers at the optimal scale for real-valued function classes. Third, we obtain a chaining bound at the optimal scale by aligning the covers so that successive approximations become increasingly close to one another.

</details>
