### 392. [The Certification Exponent: Instance-Optimal Sequential Certification of Policy Improvement from History Dependent Logs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24345v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24345

**作者：** Rui Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24345v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24345v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在日志策略已知但依赖历史时，从已记录 episode 中为「新策略更好」出具证明所需的最少样本量：给出实例最优的 KL 证书指数 K\*、下界 log(1/δ)/K\*、可达该速率的 plug-in Kelly 证书机制，并用覆盖度判定不可证明、有限速率或常数步三种情形，在 memory、Tiger 与随机树上实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据累积—停止」的信息论刻画（KL 下界、覆盖率决定的停止可行性、重要性加权下的估计器不变性）可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益/成本核算与「视觉证据是否充分」提供形式化线索，可供核查；但对象是策略认证与日志数据，与视觉 latent 无直接联系，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Certification Exponent: Instance-Optimal Sequential Certification of Policy Improvement from History Dependent Logs

**abstract/A1：** Before a new policy replaces a deployed one, we often want a certificate, computed from logged episodes, that it is better. We ask how many episodes such a certificate needs when the logging policy is known but history-dependent, and the error probability must stay below $δ$ in every environment consistent with the logs. The answer is an exponent $K^\\star$: the smallest KL divergence from the logged law to a law with the same logged action probabilities under which the target does not improve. No sound certifier stops in fewer than $\\log(1/δ)/K^\\star$ expected episodes, at any $δ$, and whenever $0&lt;K^\\star&lt;\\infty$ a plug-in Kelly certifier attains this rate to first order as $δ\\to0$. Coverage, computed by one backward induction, decides whether certification is impossible ($K^\\star=0$), possible at a finite rate, or possible in a constant number of episodes ($K^\\star=\\infty$). By convex duality, the optimal certificate bets on the importance-weighted advantage and also places fair bets on the logged actions, so doubly robust control variates act as hedges rather than estimators. As a consequence, no choice of off-policy estimator changes $K^\\star$, a coverage ceiling explains the curse of memory, and structural assumptions can be priced in exponent units. A cushion certifier extends the approach to trees too large to enumerate. In experiments the plug-in's median stopping time is 1.13-1.43x the lower bound on memory tasks, 1.13-1.51x on Tiger ($H\\le5$) and 1.17-1.64x on random trees. The best scalar betting baselines need up to 2.65x (memory) and 4.1x (Tiger) the plug-in's episodes; only on a few shallow random trees is a doubly robust bet faster, by at most 18%.

**comment/C1：** 62 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research

</details>

**title/T1：** Exact Risk Certificates for Pairwise-Judged Reranking

**abstract/A1：** Pairwise relevance judgments constrain both the loss numerator and the ideal-ranking denominator of nDCG. We characterize the exact worst-case loss of replacing a ranking with a fixed proposal. Binary gains attain this loss and provide an inspectable witness. Threshold verification reduces to at most $K+1$ maximum-closure problems. Our exposure-flow ablation isolates denominator coupling: on shared judge trajectories, exact verification saves 2.34 comparisons per TREC-DL development query and 1.98 per confirmation query at a budget of 32. Savings transfer to BEIR and a second proposer. Predictive gates achieve higher deployment gains, while certificates expose the worst gains still permitted by accepted comparisons.

### 394. [Revisiting Smoothed Online Learning: Competitive Ratio, Dynamic Regret with Switching Cost, and Best of Both Worlds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24370v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24370

**作者：** Lijun Zhang、Linzhe He、Wei Jiang、Shiyin Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24370v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24370v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文重新审视平滑在线学习，在多面体与二次增长命中代价下改进竞争比，提出 SAder 实现带切换代价的最优动态遗憾，并用 UDNP 在 lookahead 下聚合两个专家以获得 best-of-both-worlds 保证，同时给出匹配下界。

**相关性简评：** 命中代价与切换代价的权衡、以比较器路径长度度量的动态遗憾，可能为 LVR 中状态更新开销与继续/停止决策的成本收益分析、以及长度泛化下的稳定性评价提供理论类比，属推测性线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revisiting Smoothed Online Learning: Competitive Ratio, Dynamic Regret with Switching Cost, and Best of Both Worlds

**abstract/A1：** We revisit smoothed online learning and develop algorithms with improved competitive ratios, optimal dynamic regret with switching cost, and best-of-both-worlds guarantees. Surprisingly, minimizing the hitting cost alone is $\\max(1,\\frac{2}α)$-competitive for $α$-polyhedral functions under the $\\ell\_2$-norm switching cost and $1+\\frac{4}λ$-competitive for $λ$-quadratic growth functions under the squared $\\ell\_2$-norm switching cost, significantly improving existing guarantees. The polyhedral bound is tight for this naive algorithm, and we establish a matching lower bound for $α\\geq1$. For convex $λ$-quadratic growth hitting costs, minimizing a suitably weighted sum of hitting and squared $\\ell\_2$-norm switching costs yields a competitive ratio of $1+\\frac{2}{\\sqrtλ}$. For dynamic regret with the $\\ell\_2$-norm switching cost, we develop Smoothed Ader (SAder), which achieves the optimal $O(\\sqrt{T(1+P\_T)})$ rate in the standard online convex optimization setting, where $P\_T$ is the comparator's path-length. Its lookahead version removes the bounded-gradient assumption, and a matching lower bound establishes optimality in this setting. Finally, for convex hitting costs on a bounded convex domain, we develop UDNP to aggregate any two experts in the lookahead setting under both switching costs. Its additional cumulative cost is at most $O(1)$ relative to the first expert and $O(\\sqrt{T\\log T})$ relative to the second, yielding best-of-both-worlds guarantees without bounded gradients.

</details>

**title/T1：** Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization

**abstract/A1：** Effective test-time personalization requires LLM agents to adapt to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction. We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal. We present ID-TAP, a scalable, IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework for large discrete persona spaces. ID-TAP combines a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer, and transfers comparison evidence across related queries through similarity-weighted warm starts. The neural model shares statistical strength across queries while preserving query-specific scores, and efficient BT updates score hypothetical challengers. Across seven user-conditioned generation benchmarks under reference- and model-based preference simulators, ID-TAP achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated baselines within a fixed ten-round comparison budget. These results support information-directed challenger selection as an effective design for test-time persona adaptation.

**相关性简评：** 其将「关系是否有支持」与「方向是否正确」分开审计、并对证据不足候选保守降级的做法，或可类比 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与证据可信度核查的问题表述，但对象是临床文本因果抽取，迁移线索需核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trust the Edge, Doubt the Arrow: Auditing Validation Signals for Text-Mined Clinical Causal Knowledge Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Clinical causal retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly use knowledge graphs (KGs) mined from notes, yet extracted assertions remain candidates that require audit for patient-level EHR support and direction. We construct a directed candidate graph from 328,839 MIMIC-IV discharge summaries using LLM extraction and UMLS normalization, and evaluate three signals against SemMedDB: within-admission co-occurrence lift, cross-admission diagnosis-coding temporal precedence, and literature corroboration. Lift filters unsupported co-mentions and provides useful EHR support, but not causal proof. Coding order is a weak direction signal: among the 686 candidates where it commits, it reaches 54.2% agreement with SemMedDB, below the extractor's 69.4% on the same subset. Literature corroboration supplies independent direction evidence but covers only 30.4% of candidate relations. A MIMIC-III replication yields the same pattern: extractor direction remains stable (70.5%), whereas coding-order direction is near chance (50.9%). Thus, text-mined clinical causal candidate KGs are best treated as EHR-supported but direction-uncertain. In a leakage-controlled causal QA benchmark, lift-only retrieval achieves 35.7% accuracy; conservative causal demotion achieves 37.2% while reducing evidence-unsupported answers from 17.3% to 6.1% at fixed retrieval recall. We release code, aggregate summaries, and scripts to regenerate restricted outputs.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at PRICAI 2026. 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables

**相关性简评：** 其「像素对齐的规范对应 + 掩码加权控制分支后训练 + 推理期可加组合」可能为 LVR 中如何把实体几何与区域证据保留在内部状态、以及如何施加接地监督提供可核查线索，但属生成控制而非推理状态，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BodyBridge: Grounded Body Layers for Sim-to-Real Translation of Vulnerable Road Users

**abstract/A1：** Simulation-to-real driving video diffusion models can translate photorealistic scenes, but they typically represent pedestrians and cyclists, vulnerable road users (VRUs), as generic object classes. This is insufficient for vulnerable road users whose safety-relevant appearance depends on articulated pose and identity. We present BodyBridge and Grounded Body Layers (GBL), a simulator-derived, pixel-aligned representation that combines scene geometry, canonical per-pixel body correspondence, and exact VRU masks. GBL provides explicit articulation to the video diffusion model, emphasizes VRU regions during control-branch post-training, and supports additive composition with scene-geometry control at inference. It also enables per-joint evaluation of generated VRUs and a failure taxonomy for identity errors. On CARLA-to-real translation, BodyBridge improves near-range PCK@0.5 by 22% over the released depth-conditioned baseline. Replacing normal-map body control with canonical correspondence reduces body flips by 18%, while composition reduces near-range facing flips by 27%. These results show that explicit body grounding complements scene-level control and improves pose-faithful VRU generation. All code, data, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available to support reproducible, pedestrian-aware autonomous driving research.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24446

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究未知分布下单调随机优化问题的最优策略学习，算法仅获得半赌臂反馈，利用 Hellinger 距离给出弱单调与强单调问题的遗憾上界（分别约 √(nkT) 与 √(nT)），覆盖 prophet inequality、Pandora's box、序列测试等模型。

**相关性简评：** 其 Pandora's box 式「先探查哪些变量再决策」的采样成本与停止权衡、以及半赌臂反馈下的证据获取价值刻画，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 收益成本与视觉证据筛选提供形式化参照，属远领域线索，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Near-Optimal Regret for Semi-Bandit Learning of Monotone Stochastic Problems

**abstract/A1：** We consider the task of learning an (approximately) optimal policy for stochastic optimization problems where the true distributions are unknown. In each period, the algorithm plays a policy for the stochastic problem and observes semi-bandit feedback, i.e., it only receives new samples from the random variables that were selected by the policy. We obtain an algorithm that works for a large class of \`\`monotone'' stochastic problems, including prophet inequality, Pandora's box, series testing, stochastic knapsack and stochastic matching. We obtain $\\tilde{O}(\\sqrt{nkT})$ regret for \`\`weakly'' monotone problems and $\\tilde{O}(\\sqrt{nT})$ regret for \`\`strongly'' monotone problems, where $T$ is the number of periods, $n$ is the problem dimension (number of random variables) and $k$ is the maximum support size of any random variable. This improves over previous regret bounds by a $\\sqrt{n}$ factor. In fact, our dependence on $n$ and $T$ is the best-possible due the $Ω(\\sqrt{nT})$ lower bound for multi-armed-bandits. Our main technique is the use of Hellinger distance in bounding the \`\`error'' between the true and learned distributions, and the use of a constant-factor chain rule for the Hellinger distance of dependent random variables.

</details>

### 399. [Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24461v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24461

**作者：** Ishir Garg、Vivek Myers、Qiyang Li、Catherine Ji、Benjamin Eysenbach、Sergey Levine

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24461v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24461v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出首个无需环境交互、仅从无标注先验轨迹估计 empowerment（智能体可实现的未来状态数量）的方法：联合学习最大化 empowerment 的策略与其折扣状态占用度量，并在目标条件 RL 的在线探索中验证预训练估计器的效果。

**相关性简评：** empowerment 衡量「还有多少未来状态可探索」，与 LVR 中动态计算分配及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本判断可能相通；其从离线数据估计状态占用与信息价值的思路，可供核查如何评估内部状态下继续推理的价值，但联系属推测，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration

**abstract/A1：** Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \\textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \\textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. By jointly learning an empowerment-maximizing policy together with its discounted state-occupancy measure, our estimator can be trained on unlabeled trajectories generated from any unknown policy. We demonstrate that our empowerment estimator qualitatively gives intuitive empowerment measures and show that the pretrained estimator can be used to improve exploration in the online goal-conditioned reinforcement learning setting. Code is available at \\url{https://github.com/ishirgarg/offline-empowerment}.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24462

**作者：** Chamuditha Jayanga Galappaththige、Jason Lai、Lloyd Windrim、Timothy Patten、Donald G. Dansereau、Niko Suenderhauf、Dimity Miller

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 O-SCD++，面向在线（因果）场景变化检测：把「变化」建模为参考 3D 高斯地图上的持久字段，借助渲染器的单次反向传播把每个新观测直接融合进高斯，将多视图融合化简为每个高斯两个标量的精确递归，并用自监督目标的排序结果确定无标签的逐帧判定阈值。

**相关性简评：** 其「不回放、递归证据融合」的在线状态更新与「阈值由目标排序精确给出、边际量充当选择性预测信号」的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的增量更新、证据累积及停止/置信判断存在概念联系，可供核查；但任务领域（3D 地图变化检测）与 VLM 推理相距较远，仅为潜在启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** O-SCD++: Replay-Free Online Scene Change Detection via Recursive Evidence Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Online scene change detection requires an agent to detect what has changed in a previously mapped environment while it is still on site, observing from unconstrained viewpoints and without access to future observations. This causal setting is strictly harder than its offline counterpart, and online methods have consistently trailed offline accuracy. O-SCD closed that gap by treating change as a persistent property of a 3D Gaussian splatting map of the reference scene, surpassing the strongest offline methods in change detection accuracy while operating at over 10 frames per second. O-SCD optimizes a change field over the Gaussians of the reference map, refitting it to all past cue maps at every frame, a step that consumes more than half of the per-frame budget and forces accuracy to be traded against speed. We present a replay-free formulation that eliminates this trade-off. Because the reference map stays fixed, rendering the change field is a linear operation. Each new observation can therefore be carried onto the map's Gaussians directly, by a single backward pass of the renderer, which reduces multi-view fusion to an exact two-scalar recursion per Gaussian. Past observations are never stored or revisited. The self-supervised objective that O-SCD minimizes by descent also determines the decision threshold exactly, by sorting, yielding a label-free per-frame cutoff whose margin provides a selective-prediction signal. On PASLCD, our method improves mean intersection over union from 0.489 to 0.575 and throughput from 11.8 to 25.6 frames per second, even exceeding O-SCD's offline result while remaining strictly causal.

**comment/C1：** Project Page:https://chumsy0725.github.io/O-SCD/

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 Recursia，把共享可执行栈（工具、带执行契约的技能、交接、验证器）而非单个任务程序作为持续改进单元，用源侧执行轨迹做失败归因、生成缺失工具或修复，并以泛化检查、回归门选择下一代父代，冻结后经声明式任务适配器复用于新组合；在 LIBERO-Pro Long 仿真与 Franka FR3 真机上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其关于完成信号失真、技能交接的前置状态违反与验证器的表述，可能启发 LVR 中「证据是否支持当前推理状态、何时停止」的问题表述，可供核查；但对象为机器人技能组合，与多模态 latent 推理相距较远。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation

**abstract/A1：** Individually competent robot skills can fail when composed: tools may lack a required capability, completion signals may misrepresent physical progress, and one skill may leave a state that violates its successor's prerequisites. We introduce Recursia, a recursive self-improvement framework that treats the shared executable stack, rather than individual task programs, as the persistent unit of improvement. The stack integrates tools, skills with execution contracts, handoffs, and verifiers. Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components. Generality checks, mechanism tests, and paired selection and regression gates determine which changes become the next parent. The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair. Experiments cover LIBERO-Pro Long simulation and a physical Franka FR3 equipped with a Franka Hand. In simulation, Recursia improves success over ASPIRE by 5.8 percentage points under Pos perturbations and 15.1 points under Task perturbations. Across three physical compositional target tasks, it improves mean success over the Skill Document Only baseline by 40 percentage points. Analyses of constituent execution, candidate rejection, and inference drivers distinguish local mechanism improvements from complete task success and characterize the cost of feedback-conditioned orchestration. These results examine shared executable interfaces as a concrete mechanism for compositional transfer in robot programming.

</details>

### 402. [Pluralistic Alignment in Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24471v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24471

**作者：** Meng-Chen Wu、Umesh Bodhwani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24471v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24471v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 一篇关于语言模型多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）的综述：提出两层分类学，区分三种对齐目标（Overton、Steerable、Distributional）与三类人类参照（总体人群、国家地区、子群），并编码70项工作，说明各目标所需的证据类型。

**相关性简评：** 其核心关切——不要把异质判断坍缩为单一目标——与 LVR 中多样 latent 假设的保留、信息坍缩及支持度保持问题可能相通；「目标的实现需要何种证据」这一论证结构，或可供核查 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」及多假设评估的证据充分性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pluralistic Alignment in Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations

**abstract/A1：** Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. Preference representation, implementation mechanism, modality, and evidence quality are treated as cross-cutting design choices rather than additional forms of pluralism. We synthesize a protocol-bounded corpus of 70 works on pluralistic alignment and neighboring areas, using the objective-by-human-reference matrix to map existing approaches and identify underexplored combinations. The coded literature concentrates on Steerable Pluralism and Distributional Pluralism, while eligible Overton Pluralism work appears only at the aggregate-population level under our stated protocol. We then connect each objective to the evidence needed to support it, including perspective validity, conditional fidelity, distributional fidelity, support preservation, and uncertainty in subgroup estimates. Together, the taxonomy and evaluation framework clarify what current methods establish, where their claims exceed their evidence, and how future systems can represent disagreement without mistaking variation for faithful representation.

</details>

### 403. [VBO-MI: A Differentiable Black-Box Optimization Framework via Variational Mutual Information Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24491v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24491

**作者：** Farhad Mirkarimi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24491v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24491v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VBO-MI：一个完全基于梯度的黑箱优化框架，用 action-net 与变分 critic 组成的 actor-critic 结构估计互信息作为探索信号，并以重放缓冲的轻量代理模型减少真实函数查询次数，附带收敛性分析并在高维合成与 Rover 轨迹、Lunar Lander 等任务上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「变分互信息估计」作为可微的信息增益代理，可能为 LVR 中如何量化新证据价值、据此决定何时 LOOK 或停止提供远域概念线索，需核查可迁移性。原文并未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VBO-MI: A Differentiable Black-Box Optimization Framework via Variational Mutual Information Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Many real-world tasks require optimizing expensive black-box functions accessible only through noisy evaluations, a setting commonly addressed with Bayesian optimization. While Gaussian processes(GPs) and Bayesian neural networks have driven significant progress, GP-based methods scale cubically with observations, and BNN-based approaches remain burdened by expensive posterior sampling such as Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and inner-loop acquisition optimization in high-dimensional setting. In this work, we propose VBO-MI, a fully gradient-based BO framework that requires no assumptions on a Gaussian prior or a variational posterior family over $f$. While our framework uses gradient-based updates to train the internal action and information-estimation networks, it treats the objective function $f$ as a strict black box, requiring only zeroth-order evaluations. To enable end-to-end gradient flow, we employ an actor-critic architecture consisting of an action-net to navigate the input space and a variational critic to estimate a surrogate information signal for exploration. Additionally, we design a lightweight surrogate that approximates the objective from observed data using a replay buffer, which reduces the total required real function queries to one batch per iteration. We provide theoretical analysis for our framework, establishing convergence of its training objective and surrogate estimator, and showing, that near-optimal solutions exist. We evaluate our method on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including high-dimensional synthetic function and complex real-world tasks such as Rover Trajectory planning optimization, the Lunar Lander, and Pest Control problems. Our experiments demonstrate that VBO-MI provides the same or superior optimization performance over the various baselines.

</details>

<a id="paper-404"></a>

### 404. [What "Form'' of Uncertainty Does Conformal Prediction Quantify?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24510v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24510

**作者：** Soroush H. Zargarbashi、Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh、Rebekka Burkholz、Aleksandar Bojchevski

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24510v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24510v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析 conformal prediction 输出集合大小所量化的不确定性，指出 full 与 split CP 的集合大小差异与 Bayesian 后验方差（即模型认知不确定性）直接相关，并将这一「可塑性」本身作为估计认知不确定性的工具，在多个设定下达到与当前最优方法相当的表现。

**相关性简评：** 认知不确定性的估计方式可能为 LVR 的停止决策（STOP）与继续获取视觉证据（LOOK）提供判据线索，例如以不确定性阈值触发更多推理或取证据；但原文不涉及多模态或 latent 状态，此联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What "Form'' of Uncertainty Does Conformal Prediction Quantify?

**abstract/A1：** Conformal prediction (CP) is a post-hoc calibration method that returns prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees, and the size of the output set is often interpreted as a notion of uncertainty. We show that the difference in set size between full and split CP is directly connected to Bayesian posterior variance, which is the epistemic uncertainty of the model. Essentially, this difference in set size is an aggregation of two opposite effects: (1) better model accuracy and therefore smaller set size achieved by training over extra calibration points, and (2) the "formability" of the model at test point towards every possible label. The latter effect vanishes with stronger models or more calibration data (as epistemic uncertainty is known for that behavior). It turns out that the model's formability itself (without the quantization effect of prediction sets, and through estimating the posterior variance) is a useful tool to quantify the epistemic uncertainty. In our empirical evaluation it performs on par with the state of the art in many setups.

</details>

### 405. [TopoCompile: Molecular Generation with Exact Global Count Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24511v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24511

**作者：** Xiang Wu、Rong-Hua Li、Quanqing Xu、Kangfei Zhao、Guoren Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24511v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24511v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TopoCompile：将分子表示为完整环系统与单原子组成的组件树，用自回归 Transformer 对组件与连接动作打分，并以动态规划编译器掩掉无法满足目标计数的动作，从而在推理期精确满足元素组成、尺寸、环数等全局计数约束。

**相关性简评：** 其「用 DP 可行性掩码保证约束精确满足、且同一生成器无需重训即可适配不同目标」的解码机制，可能与 LVR 推理期对部分状态能否到达有效答案的验证与停止决策（STOP）存在可供核查的类比，但跨领域迁移尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TopoCompile: Molecular Generation with Exact Global Count Constraints

**abstract/A1：** Molecular generation designs novel molecules with desired structures and properties. Global count constraints specify molecular size, elemental composition, and ring content without prescribing detailed structure. Property-conditioned generators steer generation toward such targets but do not guarantee exact satisfaction. We introduce TopoCompile, which combines an autoregressive component-tree generator with a dynamic-programming compiler for supported component-additive integer counts. TopoCompile represents molecules as trees of intact ring systems and individual atoms, making each supported count additive over components. At each step, an autoregressive Transformer scores component and attachment actions, while the compiler masks actions with no target-satisfying completion. Within the fixed component vocabulary and typed attachment rules, constrained decoding guarantees exact equality for supported non-negative, component-additive integer counts. Applied at inference time, these checks let the same trained generator support different targets and count combinations without retraining. Across four benchmarks, TopoCompile achieves 100% Exact-valid yield for Common and Rare four-count target groups; the strongest baseline within each dataset reaches 44.9% or less on Rare targets. In unconditional generation, it achieves the highest validity or valid-unique-novel (V.U.N.) among the compared methods across all four benchmark datasets.

</details>

### 406. [HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24520v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24520

**作者：** Junming Zhang、Rubin Wei、Xu Cheng、Hao Sun、Ruoxi Cheng、Xiquan Wang、Peisong Wu、Mingsong Chen、Zhouhan Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24520v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24520v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HABIT-Bench，用合成的纵向对话历史与受控习惯图，评估八种记忆方法（以 Qwen3-235B-A22B、GLM-5.3-Flash 为基座）能否从弱证据中推断用户习惯并在后续请求中正确应用，最佳宏平均准确率仅 33.61%。

**相关性简评：** 其「已可获得历史证据却仍无法推断并恰当使用潜在习惯」的设定，可能与 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被真正使用、弱证据筛选与状态维护问题相通，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory

**abstract/A1：** In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly. These results expose a persistent gap between access to past interactions and the ability to infer and appropriately use user habits.

</details>

### 407. [MOMO: Human Motion from Moving Sounds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24522v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24522

**作者：** Deli Cai、Shuyang Xu、Zhiyang Dou、Zitong Lan、Mingmin Zhao、Changxing Ding、Taku Komura

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.RO、cs.SD

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24522v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24522v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「动态空间音频驱动人体动作生成」这一新任务，构建同步双耳音频、3D 动作与移动声源轨迹的 DySAM 数据集及辅助定位数据集 DySAL，并提出按定位、理解、生成三条耦合原则设计的扩散框架 MOMO。

**相关性简评：** 其从原始双耳音频直接估计移动声源的头中心方向线索（不依赖真值坐标），并用语义特征与动态空间线索条件化扩散生成，可能为 LVR 中「从原始感知输入抽取空间证据并驱动 latent 状态生成」提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOMO: Human Motion from Moving Sounds

**abstract/A1：** Human responses to sound depend not only on its semantic content, but also on the evolving spatial relationship between source and listener, conveyed through spatial audio and its temporal dynamics. Modeling human reactions to such dynamic spatial audio is important for character animation, human behavior analysis, and robotics. As of yet, existing audio-driven motion generation methods primarily focus on non-spatial or static acoustic conditions, leaving this important problem largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we formulate the novel task of dynamic spatial-audio-driven human motion generation and introduce two motion-captured datasets. We introduce the Dynamic Spatial Audio and Motion dataset (DySAM) as the first dataset and benchmark for this task, providing synchronized binaural audio, 3D human motions, and moving sound source trajectories. Given the importance of dynamic spatial cues of sound sources, we further provide the Dynamic Spatial Audio Localization dataset (DySAL), an auxiliary binaural localization dataset that pairs diverse acoustic events with head poses and moving source trajectories to support spatial audio perception. For benchmarking, we propose MOMO for human Motion generation from Moving Sounds, a diffusion-based framework guided by three coupled principles: localization, understanding, and generation. MOMO performs localization by estimating head-centric spatial direction cues of the moving source directly from raw binaural audio, avoiding reliance on ground-truth source coordinates. It performs understanding by extracting frame-wise audio-content representations, and performs generation by conditioning motion diffusion on both semantic features and dynamic spatial cues. Experiments show that MOMO outperforms existing baselines in motion fidelity, audio-motion alignment, and physical plausibility.

</details>

### 408. [Rethinking EEG Spatial Super-Resolution as Dynamic State Decomposition and Filtering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24528v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24528

**作者：** Hongjun Liu、Leyu Zhou、Chang Ge、Shitong Duan、Chao Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24528v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24528v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把流式 EEG 空间超分辨重述为序列状态滤波问题，提出 DSF：用历史感知的动态分支与创新滤波分支分别刻画状态的预测演化与由当前观测驱动的修正，并通过掩码约束的拓扑感知转移算子和不确定性感知校正把已观测电极的创新传播到缺失位置，最后融合两路估计重建高密度信号。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测演化 + 观测驱动创新校正」的状态滤波分解与不确定性加权校正，与 LVR 中 latent 状态如何被新视觉证据更新（LOOK 收益、证据筛选、状态更新的贡献分配）在概念上相通，可供核查是否能借鉴到循环/迭代式 latent 推理的状态更新设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking EEG Spatial Super-Resolution as Dynamic State Decomposition and Filtering

**abstract/A1：** EEG spatial super-resolution aims to recover high-density neural signals from sparse electrode observations. Existing methods have achieved substantial progress through spatial modeling, generative reconstruction, and temporal representation learning. However, the current EEG state contains two different sources of information: predictable evolution inherited from preceding states and newly emerging changes revealed by the current observation. Most approaches typically do not model these two components explicitly. In this work, we formulate streaming EEG spatial super-resolution as a sequential state filtering problem and propose Dynamic State Filtering (DSF). Rather than relying on a single temporal reconstruction pathway, DSF combines a history-aware dynamical branch with an innovation-filtering branch that explicitly decomposes waveform-state estimation into prediction and observation-driven correction. To infer how spatially incomplete innovations should affect missing locations, DSF routes the observed innovations across electrodes through a mask-constrained, topology-aware transition operator and incorporates them through uncertainty-aware state correction. The two complementary estimates are finally fused to reconstruct the dense EEG signal. Experiments on SEED, SEED-IV and BCI2000 demonstrate that DSF improves reconstruction fidelity and downstream utility while maintaining robustness under dynamically changing and unreliable sparse observations.

</details>

### 409. [Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping via Second-Order Loss Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24540v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24540

**作者：** Ahad Bin Islam Shoeb、Jamal Uddin Tanvin、Kamrul Hasan、Alve Reduan、Imtiaz Ahmed

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24540v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24540v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文为实例级早停（IES）所用的二阶损失差分准则提供理论分析，推导噪声校准的掌握阈值与实例排除的稳定性界，并在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ViT-Tiny 上验证其节省反向传播的效果。

**相关性简评：** 训练期按实例跳过反传与推理期 latent 状态生成并不相同，但其从训练统计自动导出停止阈值与耐心、以及不同阶差分在特定信噪比下的偏差—方差取舍，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与动态计算分配提供可供核查的判据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping via Second-Order Loss Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Instance-dependent early stopping (IES) reduces training computation by skipping backpropagation for examples whose losses have stabilized, but the second-order loss-difference criterion used by IES lacks a theoretical justification. We develop Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping (TG-IES), which analyzes this criterion under explicit assumptions and derives a noise-calibrated mastery threshold and a conditional stability bound for instance exclusion. We show that second-order differencing has a favorable bias-variance trade-off over first- and third-order differences in a specific signal-to-noise regime, and that its signal contains both gradient-drift and curvature terms. TG-IES derives its stopping threshold and patience from training-run statistics rather than using the manually selected threshold of IES. Across CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, TG-IES saves 53-58% of backpropagation instances in its main convolutional settings while keeping accuracy within 0.1-0.9 percentage points of full training; in the primary ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 setting, this corresponds to 35.7% FLOP-normalized savings. The method also transfers to ViT-Tiny, where it achieves smaller savings and incurs a modest accuracy cost. These results provide a theoretical basis for second-order instance-dependent early stopping and show that theory-guided calibration can substantially reduce training computation under the assumptions and experimental settings studied.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 11 figures, 12 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ShoebAhad/theory-guided-ies

</details>

**title/T1：** Concordance Plausibility Check for Intervention-Conditioned Human Digital Twins

**abstract/A1：** Intervention-conditioned human digital twins predict treatment alternatives that cannot be observed in the same patient. Ordinary predictive accuracy therefore cannot establish counterfactual credibility. We propose the Concordance Plausibility Check (CPC), a claim-centered framework combining real-world evidence, qualified simulation and clinical knowledge. CPC matches evidence to the causal claim, audits contradictions and shared dependencies, and reports Pass, Fail or reason-coded Indeterminate.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CADS 这一带错误率控制的测量框架，用截断似然比界、e-process 与 complete-family e-BH，在自适应采样与可选停止下量化 LLM 提议者相对于无 LLM 基线的净增量贡献；在 DepMap 模拟中揭示两种评估假象，并发现初步净效应未能在扩量复现中保持。

**相关性简评：** 其「相对同构基线的净增益 + 抗自适应采样与可选停止的统计控制」范式，可能为评估 VLM 中 latent/视觉分支是否真正超出旁路或消融基线的贡献提供可核查的思路，复现失败本身也提示贡献归因声明需谨慎。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CADS: Measuring the Incremental Contribution of LLM Proposers in Sequential Biological Screens

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly used to guide sequential biological screens, yet standard evaluations rely on raw hit counts that conflate a proposer's value with the discovery capacity of the underlying algorithmic harness. Adaptive sampling and corrupted experimental readouts also leave standard feedback comparisons without a false-discovery guarantee. We present Certified Agentic Discovery Screens (CADS), an error-controlled measurement framework that quantifies a proposer's incremental value against an identical LLM-free loop. By integrating capped likelihood-ratio bounds, e-processes, and complete-family e-BH, CADS controls the terminal false discovery rate under the stated null and corruption conditions despite arbitrary dependence, adaptive sampling, and optional stopping. In DepMap-backed simulations, CADS exposes two evaluation artifacts: the LLM-free harness alone clears the feedback gate, and raw origin counts overstate LLM contributions because LLM picks displace fallback discoveries. On the initial 20 seeds, supplying tested-candidate history to Qwen2.5-7B shifts its net contribution from +0.35, with a 95% interval covering zero, to +2.90, with the interval above zero. This initial net effect did not persist in a 50-seed matched-quota replication. These results support net gain over an LLM-free loop, measured between separately certified sets, as the appropriate measure of proposer contribution.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included

</details>

### 412. [TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24601v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24601

**作者：** Yanlan Kang、Ruiqi Liu、Xinpei Gu、Tzu-Yi Lei、Shuai Xu、Xukun Zhang、William Cheng-Chung Chu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24601v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24601v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TCMScience，一个面向中医的自主科研知识发现 agent：架构由 trusted kernel、scientific compiler 与 claim-support contracts 组成，把语言模型的提案与执行、发布权限分离，并配以大规模连接器与数据目录，报告了网络药理学分析与治理消融实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据契约 + 权限边界」把提案与发布分离的做法，可能启发 LVR 中如何判定答案是否有视觉证据支持、何时停止取证；而背景集合变化使显著通路由 66 变为 0 的结果，可供核查为「证据筛选改变结论」的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine

**abstract/A1：** Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 3 figures, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/IMPF-AI-Institute/TCMScience

</details>

### 413. [HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24611v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24611

**作者：** Wanyi Chen、Wanqin Shen、Yuanchen Shi、Zhensu Sun、Fang Kong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24611v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24611v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HSPR，用分层后验推断把源智能体的响应因子与不确定的组成功率结合，观测到的新智能体结果更新目标隐状态后验，并按「预期一步降低全量分数后验方差」的准则自适应选取任务子集，从而在少量任务预算下估计软件智能体在完整基准上的分数。

**相关性简评：** 其「信息价值/后验方差」驱动的证据采集与预算-精度关系，可能与 LVR 评估中的动态计算、何时停止或继续取证据的问题表述相通，可作核查线索；但对象是软件智能体的基准评分，与视觉/多模态推理状态无直接联系，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating software agents on a full benchmark is expensive. A small task subset can preserve agent rankings while yielding inaccurate scores. Historical responses provide useful structure, but tasks with identical source responses can have different outcomes for a new target agent. We introduce Hierarchical Score Posterior Recovery (HSPR), which combines source-fitted response factors with uncertain group success rates. Observed target outcomes update the posteriors over the target latent state and group rates; posterior-guided acquisition selects subsequent tasks. Its score-based criterion equals the expected one-step reduction in full-score posterior variance. Observed successes and posterior-predictive counts for unqueried tasks yield a full-score posterior. The final estimate uses its median with source-selected calibration. At a 10% task budget on four task banks from the SWE-bench family, HSPR achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) on three banks and the lowest maximum absolute error (MaxErr) on all four among the methods compared. Removing group uncertainty or replacing adaptive queries increases macro MAE in the respective controls. Macro MAE decreases across 5-20% budgets.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables, including appendices

</details>

### 414. [EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24648v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24648

**作者：** Yuhua Zheng、Xueyi Chen、Xinze Zou、Xin Li、Haoji Hu、Huan Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EdgeKernelBench 提出统一 IR 部署框架与分层边缘负载基准，用于系统评测 LLM 在异构边缘后端生成 kernel 的能力，并提出基于分层 IR 的 agent（LEKA）进行分层优化。

**相关性简评：** 分层 IR 表示与带优化预算的 agent 式分层优化，可能为 LVR 的分层 latent 状态组织与计算分配提供参照；其将正确率与性能分开度量（Correct@1 与 Fast@1.0 的明显落差）也提示「功能正确未必带来收益」这类评价设计可供核查，但与原研究主线距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends

**abstract/A1：** Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://pillor9.github.io/EdgeKernelBench/

</details>

### 415. [From Prediction to Action: Population Health World Model for Digital Medicine](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24662v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24662

**作者：** Xike Xie、Yu Li、Weizhong Yang、Amalie Dyda、Shaohua Kevin Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24662v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24662v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 一篇立场/愿景文章，提出「人口健康世界模型（PHWM）」，主张数字医学从任务特定预测转向行动建模，把健康状态、个体轨迹、群体动态、干预、资源约束与反馈耦合在同一表示中，并指出三项结构性缺口与三项最小能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「动作依赖观测下的表示学习」和对状态—干预—反馈耦合表示的强调，可能与 LVR 中潜在状态表示、动作条件状态更新及动态计算的问题表述形成概念类比，可供核查；但该文属医疗决策远领域且为愿景论述，无具体方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Prediction to Action: Population Health World Model for Digital Medicine

**abstract/A1：** Digital medicine now captures data that traces individual health trajectories and reveals population health dynamics through electronic health records, claims, remote monitoring, wearable devices, mobile devices, social sensing data, medical images, etc. But much of its modeling still centers on task-specific, outcome-specific, and prediction-specific estimation. The next frontier is not simply better prediction, but action in an evolving health world shaped by multiple decision-makers, heterogeneous populations, resource constraints, and feedback in care delivery. This is why digital medicine now needs world models: not only to estimate what will happen, but to represent how actions change what can happen next -- whom to prioritize, how to allocate scarce resources, how to adapt care across subgroups, and how interventions reshape future health trajectories and population dynamics. We call such a model population health world model (PHWM): a more foundational representation of an evolving health world in which health states, individual trajectories, population health dynamics, interventions, constraints, and feedback are intrinsically coupled. Building a PHWM endows three unmet structural gaps in current digital medicine: dynamic health-state modeling, population-level intervention intelligence, and validation, equity, and governance for action-oriented use. We argue that addressing these gaps requires three minimal capabilities: representation learning under action-dependent observation, multi-scale intervention intelligence, and validation with explicit decision boundaries, while highlighting the importance of social, contextual, and public-health sensing data for action-oriented digital medicine.

</details>

### 416. [Geometry-Aware Interpolation for Inverse Problems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24687v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24687

**作者：** Pourya Shamsolmoali、Masoumeh Zareapoor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24687v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24687v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GAIN，一个基于 VAE 的框架，把数据流形的局部切空间几何引入空间变换与图像重建，用熵正则引导变换参数估计，并引入卷积归一化改善梯度稳定性，在图像补全与分类任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其流形几何与切空间插值或可为 LVR 中视觉细节、几何信息的内部表示分析提供概念类比，但论文面向图像重建，无推理状态更新或动态计算机制，线索需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Geometry-Aware Interpolation for Inverse Problems

**abstract/A1：** Recovering missing visual information from incomplete or degraded images remains a challenging problem, particularly when spatial variations and complex image structures affect reconstruction accuracy. Although Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) facilitate spatial feature alignment, their reliance on conventional linear or bilinear interpolation limits their ability to capture the underlying geometric characteristics of image data. Furthermore, interpolation based on a restricted set of neighbouring pixels can introduce inconsistencies in gradient propagation, potentially affecting optimisation stability. To address these limitations, we propose a Geometry-Aware Interpolation Network (GAIN), a variational autoencoder-based framework that incorporates manifold geometry into spatial transformation and image reconstruction. Rather than estimating pixel intensities solely from fixed spatial neighbours, GAIN exploits the local tangent structure of the data manifold to construct geometry-informed intensity approximations. An entropy-based regularisation mechanism further guides the estimation of spatial transformation parameters, promoting more adaptive interpolation. In addition, a convolutional normalisation strategy is introduced to regulate the magnitude of non-zero activations and improve gradient stability during training. Extensive experiments on challenging image completion and classification benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of GAIN in improving predictive accuracy while reducing computational cost compared with existing methods.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该研究在临床分诊场景中评估返回动作概率的决策模型 Jev，用 CARE-Bench 与通用语言模型及无输入基线对比，考察概率校准（Brier）与「信息是否充分」的识别能力。

**相关性简评：** 领域远离视觉，但「信息不足时是否需追问」与概率校准评价，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策收益/成本及停止置信度评价提供参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Native Probability Outputs for Clinical Triage: An Evaluation of Calibration and Decision Accuracy

**abstract/A1：** Patient-facing triage requires an appropriate care recommendation and recognition of when information is insufficient. We evaluate whether Jev, a decision model that returns probabilities over predefined actions, supports both judgments. Using CARE-Bench, we compare Jev with four general-purpose language models and three input-independent baselines across 925 decision points from 439 public cases. On the public test subset, Jev ranks fourth of five models by macro-F1 (0.461) but has the lowest observed multiclass Brier score (0.610), an 18.7\\% improvement over uniform prediction (case-bootstrap 95\\% interval, 4.9--31.1\\%). Noul has lower binary Brier than Choice (0.215 versus 0.276). A evaluation of 453 HealthBench conversations again gives Jev the lowest observed Brier score (0.299), but measures a distinct emergency-referral judgment. Jev combines lower probability error with missed clarification needs in the four-action task. Asking about information sufficiency separately increases recall but also produces frequent unnecessary clarification assignments.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出球面物理信息神经算子：用球面拉普拉斯分解把大气场拆成层次化频率分量并保持跨尺度逐点对应，再以几何感知注意力的局部球面积分算子在任意位置求值，并嵌入可微物理约束，用于全球到区域的气象降尺度。

**相关性简评：** 远离 LVR 主线，但其多尺度频率分解、跨尺度逐点对应与几何感知注意力机制，可能为 latent 状态的多尺度组织方式与注意力结构设计提供类比线索，可供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spherical Physics-informed Neural Operator with Multi-scale Coupling for Meteorological Downscaling

**abstract/A1：** Meteorological downscaling is crucial for high-resolution regional climate forecasting and disaster early warning. While neural operators have emerged as a promising paradigm for modeling complex spatiotemporal mappings, existing frameworks often struggle with spherical manifold geometric distortions, inherent atmospheric multi-scale coupling mismatches, and lack of explicit atmospheric laws. We propose the Spherical Physics-informed Neural Operator, which utilizes a Spherical Laplacian Decomposition to partition atmospheric fields into hierarchical frequency components, maintaining exact point-wise correspondence across scales. To evaluate these representations at arbitrary locations, we introduce a localized spherical integral operator that approximates continuous kernel transforms via geometry-aware attention. Dynamical consistency is further enforced by embedding differentiable constraints into the learning process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework attains superior accuracy and zero-shot generalization across various meteorological variables and unseen queries, representing a robust and interpretable solution for global-to-regional meteorological downscaling.

**comment/C1：** Published in IJCAI 2026 (AI4Tech: AI Enabling Technologies). 9 pages, 4 figures

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了 fxBench——一个基于 Sheetpedia、含 503 个任务的人工标注电子表格公式建议基准，把该问题拆成「收集上下文、理解上下文、理解意图、写出公式」四种能力，并比较不同上下文表示（含高覆盖低 token 的稠密格式）与大/小模型及微调效果，最佳配置正确率仅 58.8%。

**相关性简评：** 标注意图单元格以刻画给定上下文选择策略的理论性能上限、以及稠密表示的覆盖度—成本权衡，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、THINK/LOOK/STOP 预算与紧凑推理工作区提供可核查的类比线索，但领域较远，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets

**abstract/A1：** Spreadsheets are among the most widely used tools for computations, and formulas are their core building blocks. Besides agentic spreadsheet tools, proactive formula suggestions enable significant productivity gains and are now available in popular spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets). Such suggestions pose interesting challenges: the right context must be collected and represented for a machine learning model, which must then be able to write a correct formula, in a way that is fast and cheap enough to trigger on every = (or subsequent keystrokes for auto-completion) without taking users out of their editing flow. Surprisingly, there is no public benchmark for formula suggestions on real spreadsheets. In this paper, we therefore (1) introduce fxBench as a manually curated benchmark of 503 formula suggestion tasks based on Sheetpedia, (2) break down the formula suggestion problem into four capabilities (gather context, understand context, understand intent, write formula) that a formula suggestion system requires, and (3) evaluate existing and new approaches to understand bottlenecks in these capabilities that pose interesting research directions. Specifically, we annotate each benchmark with the cells that describe intent to determine the theoretical performance limit of a given context selection strategy, we evaluate performance of small and large models on different representations of context, including a dense format with high theoretical coverage at low token counts, and we fine-tune smaller language models to show that we can learn to understand such dense formats. Additionally, we perform quantitative and qualitative analysis on failure modes to understand bottlenecks in the formula writing capability; the best configuration only achieved 58.8% correct suggestions.

</details>

**title/T1：** Can LLM Agents Resolve Service Failures? Simulating Multi-Turn Complaint Handling under Information Asymmetry

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents are widely adopted in service chatbots for rule-guided support and information access, yet emotionally demanding complaint handling still relies heavily on human agents. We introduce ServiceBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to complaint handling, with 2,500 scenarios spanning 184 complaint categories and five service industries. We propose Asymmetric Progressive Complaint Simulation (APCS) to simulate realistic complaint handling, together with a justice-based evaluation framework. Our experiments reveal that even capable LLM agents struggle to handle complaints effectively. They lack the ability to proactively gather information and strategically guide conversations toward resolution, often resorting to premature compensation. We further show that targeted post-training with SFT and DPO substantially improves these capabilities, enabling a smaller model to match or surpass much larger models on several outcomes.

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24737v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24737v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AI-GPB：在 Gaussian Process Bandit 中把离线估计的辅助均值与从配对在线观测学到的修正系数结合，实现后验方差缩减，并给出置信界与 regret 率。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gaussian Process Bandits with Paired Auxiliary Observations

**abstract/A1：** Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet observation noise makes each evaluation less informative and slows posterior learning. Standard BO learns from costly outcomes gathered during optimization. In many applications, however, low-cost auxiliary data are available beforehand. We introduce Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit (AI-GPB), a variance-reduction method that combines an offline estimate of the auxiliary mean with a correction coefficient learned from paired online observations. Notably, it exploits correlation between paired observation errors without requiring the auxiliary mean to approximate the objective. We establish finite-sample GP confidence bounds and regret guarantees, including explicit cumulative and simple regret rates for Matérn kernels. Numerical experiments across continuous BO benchmarks with varied landscapes and dimensions show consistent reductions in cumulative and simple regret relative to vanilla GP-UCB, even when within-pair correlation is moderate and the auxiliary mean is estimated from noisy offline data.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 Collective Model Intelligence 框架，包含基于有限评测的能力画像（Model Eval）、按任务需求与成本组织模型协作的选择模块（Mio）以及分离选择与执行的模型服务系统（Mos）。

**相关性简评：** 其「有限评测推断能力＋按成本动态选择协作对象」的思路，可能为 LVR 中依据任务需求动态分配 latent 计算、决定证据来源与停止时机提供类比线索，但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，可供核查的具体迁移点较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward Collective Model Intelligence: Characterizing and Coordinating Models

**abstract/A1：** Independently developed AI models accumulate diverse and complementary capabilities, but a growing model collection does not automatically realize Collective AI. Addressing this gap requires understanding model capabilities with limited evaluation, organizing complementary models to collaborate on diverse tasks, and executing model calls efficiently under resource constraints. We present a systematic approach to pursuing Collective Model Intelligence through three connected components. First, Model Eval constructs evidence-based capability profiles by combining query-level performance estimation with cross-domain prediction, reducing the need for exhaustive evaluation. Second, Mio (Models in One) organizes complementary model candidates and supports task-conditioned, cost-aware selection and collaboration as task requirements evolve. Third, Mos (Model Serving OS) separates model selection from execution and provides endpoint scheduling and shared model deployment and distribution. Experiments show lower capability-estimation errors under limited evaluation. Across nine public benchmarks, Mio 1.0 Lite achieves the highest average score and lowest average cost among compared methods, with per-request costs 73.7-97.5% lower than those of the best-scoring alternatives. A prewarmed shared cache accelerates model-file retrieval by up to 23.3 times. This work lays a foundation for Collective Model Intelligence by characterizing and coordinating the diverse capabilities of an expanding model universe.

**相关性简评：** 属于化学规划这一远领域，但其「评估器反馈驱动诊断、回溯与状态修正」的搜索控制循环，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、停止/回溯决策与贡献分配提供概念类比，可供核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReTRACE: Feedback-Guided LLM Agent in a Chemistry Harness for Retrosynthesis Planning

**abstract/A1：** Computer-aided retrosynthesis has advanced through single-step prediction, tree search and route scoring, but complex targets still require judgement over the whole route, where stereochemistry, functional-group compatibility, cost and greenness interact. Here we present \\textbf{\\mbox{ReTRACE}} (\\textbf{RE}trosynthesis with \\textbf{T}ool-orchestrated \\textbf{R}easoning \\textbf{A}nd \\textbf{C}ontext-aware \\textbf{E}vidence), an agent that places a large language model (LLM) in a chemistry harness that integrates molecular tools, complementary single-step prediction engines, a purchasable starting-material library, a route memory and a multi-criterion route evaluator. Routes are judged by a new metric that combines programmatic checks with adversarial LLM review, and its verdicts are compared with a synthetic chemist's. The agent learns continually from evaluator feedback during search, diagnosing weak routes and backtracking to revise them. With Claude Opus 4.8, at least one of the top 10 routes proposed by ReTRACE passed the audit for 87.4\\%, 95.0\\% and 86.7\\% of targets on the three benchmarks. Two prospective wet-lab syntheses show that ReTRACE route proposals can be converted into executable procedures after expert revision.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Design Anything，一种基于图的框架，把设计意图外化为「意图—执行图」，用确定性控制器检查输出类型与数量、识别未完成的交付物并引导后续轮次，同时发布覆盖 19 个设计领域、228 个任务的 DesignAnything-Bench 来评测长程多产物设计的约束满足。

**相关性简评：** 其把意图与执行记录外化到模型之外、并用确定性控制器判断任务是否完成并决定后续轮次的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的外部化表示、证据核查与停止决策提供对照线索，但对象是设计产物而非视觉推理状态，联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Design Anything, Design at Scale

**abstract/A1：** As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. Agents therefore need to preserve and apply this intent across domains and as projects grow. We introduce Design Anything, a graph-based harness that preserves design intent outside the model and binds deliverables to the workflow steps that produce them through an intent-execution graph. A task contract retains constraints and decisions, selected designs become explicit inputs to later generations, and a deterministic controller uses bindings and execution records to check output types and counts, identify outstanding deliverables, and guide subsequent turns. We also introduce DesignAnything-Bench, with 228 tasks across 19 design domains, including 38 project families at scales of 6, 14, and 24 artifacts. With the LLM held fixed, Design Anything satisfies 85.0% and 92.5% of the brief's factual constraints with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High and GPT-5.6 Sol High, respectively, exceeding the strongest same-model baselines by 15.4% and 14.4%. These gains reach 25.1% and 23.0% on 24-artifact tasks. Under each model, Design Anything leads or ties in constraint satisfaction in 18 of 19 domains. Professional designers also prefer its complete deliverable sets over those of same-model baselines in a blind evaluation.

**相关性简评：** 该基准本身不涉及 VLM 内部推理状态或 latent 生成，但其「设计家族＋受控数值变体」和免参考多视角评分的评价设计，可能为 LVR 的受控泛化探测与视觉证据筛选提供评价思路上的参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IndustrialCAD-1400: Benchmarking Detailed Industrial Assemblies from Text

**abstract/A1：** Industrial assemblies require more than a recognizable shape: functional parts, interfaces, dimensions and service features must satisfy a detailed request together. We introduce IndustrialCAD-1400, a text-to-CAD benchmark for this industrial setting. Its 1,400 requests combine 400 equipment categories across 40 domains with 250 four-case design families. Family requests specify a median of 17 named component or configuration roles and six explicit numeric targets; controlled variants test whether dimensions change while shared structure is retained. Task construction draws on documented manufacturer information, owner specifications and engineering guidance. Models generate geometry programs from requests, and a common Blender environment executes them to produce scenes, optional measurements, and standardized views for evaluation. A request assessment of front, isometric, and top views measures visible component, arrangement, and interface fulfillment without requiring a single reference geometry. Five stratified panels preserve complete families while covering the benchmark exactly once, enabling balanced comparisons and separating industrial breadth from controlled numerical responsiveness. In conclusion, IndustrialCAD-1400 extends text-to-CAD from recognizable part geometry to industrial assembly synthesis under joint component, interface, spatial, and numerical specifications.

</details>

### 426. [UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24791v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24791

**作者：** Kien T. Pham、Yuhao Liu、Chong Hou Choi、Zhenqi He、Yanghao Wang、Chenyang Lei、Rui Liu、Qifeng Chen、Long Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM、cs.SD、eess.AS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24791v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24791v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** UniAVC 提出统一的音视频生成框架，用「先单模态训练、再用配对数据学跨模态对应」的渐进训练策略，以及从共享时间步出发独立设定各模态噪声调度的解耦调度器，覆盖联合生成、双向跨模态生成与指令引导编辑，并在推理后只重生成不满意的一侧。

**相关性简评：** 音视频生成本身不在主线上，但其「按模态解耦噪声调度」与「非对称条件（一侧干净、监督另一侧）以及仅重生成单个分支的自精炼」可能为 LVR 中模态自适应计算分配、视觉证据约束生成及局部状态重算提供可核查的概念类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling

**abstract/A1：** Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.

**comment/C1：** Page: https://hkust-longgroup.github.io/UniAVC; Code: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/UniAVC; Note: Abstract is shortened to meet arXiv's characters limitation

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SwitchSplat，用「共享静态 base + 每物体槽位」的可微分解把随手拍摄场景中的二值离散状态（开/关）显式建模为可自由组合的槽位，从而支持从未见过的状态组合下的新视角渲染。

**相关性简评：** 其「时间戳与真实状态解耦」「离散槽位状态及其可微分配」可能对 latent 状态定义、视觉证据筛选与未见状态组合的泛化提供概念类比，可核查是否可迁移到多 latent 假设的组合与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes

**abstract/A1：** 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io

**comment/C1：** SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). 19 pages, 15 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io

</details>

### 428. [Pattern-Driven Evaluation of LLM Code Optimization: Isolating Compiler-Transcendent Semantic Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24835v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24835

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.PL、cs.SE

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PatternBench，聚焦「编译器之外仍有残余空间」的代码优化，覆盖七类变换，并在运行时加速之外加入基于 AST 的优化忠实性分析，检验生成的程序是否真的执行了目标变换；实验显示单看加速无法完整刻画模型能力，而忠实性与实际加速强相关，微调可同时提升两者。

**相关性简评：** 其把「结果指标」与「过程忠实性」分离评测的思路，可能启发 LVR 中判断答案是否真正使用了 latent 内容或视觉证据的评测与贡献分配设计，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pattern-Driven Evaluation of LLM Code Optimization: Isolating Compiler-Transcendent Semantic Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Existing evaluations of LLM-based code optimization primarily measure end-to-end speedup, obscuring whether a model actually performs the intended optimization. For compiled languages, this is especially problematic: observed gains may reflect transformations already recoverable by modern optimizing compilers rather than optimization behavior attributable to the model itself. We present PatternBench, a benchmark for studying compiler-transcendent optimization, i.e., performance improvements that remain after aggressive compiler optimization. PatternBench targets residual optimization opportunities across seven classes of transformations and pairs runtime evaluation with an AST-based optimization faithfulness analysis that verifies whether the intended optimization is realized in the generated program. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and fine-tuned models show that runtime speedup alone provides an incomplete account of optimization capability. Optimization faithfulness is strongly associated with realized speedup, and fine-tuning improves both faithfulness and optimization effectiveness. These results suggest that evaluation of LLM-based code optimization should measure not only performance outcomes, but also whether the target transformation was successfully executed.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Published at the AI Measurement Science Workshop at COLM 2026

</details>

### 429. [LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24855v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24855

**作者：** Nian Ran、Sebastian Brulin、Markus Olhofer、Mauricio A. Álvarez、Richard Allmendinger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24855v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24855v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 REP-HO，用 LLM 替代启发式规则，在异构优化中担任评估规划器：依据代理预测、不确定性、评估成本与预算状态，决定评估哪些候选解、哪些目标与约束（含最近邻摘要增强），并在五种异构情形下与 MFE-NSGA-III 比较。

**相关性简评：** 该工作在预算与评估成本约束下由 LLM 决定「获取哪些证据、以何种成本获取」，与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的证据筛选和自适应计算分配可能存在类比线索；但属优化领域、无视觉表示，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Heterogeneous optimization problems require an optimizer to decide not only which candidate solutions to evaluate, but also which objectives and constraints should be evaluated under different costs and fidelities. Existing SOTA methods such as MFE-NSGA-III address this setting with manually designed selection metrics, but their behavior is largely determined by predefined heuristic rules and hyperparameters. In this work, we propose REP-HO, a reasoning-based evaluation planner that replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step with a large language model (LLM) planner. The LLM receives the same primitive optimization-state information as the heuristic planner, such as surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs, and budget status. We first show that REP-HO achieves competitive performance compared to the human-designed metric-based method (MFE-NSGA-III). We then further enhance each decision with an adaptive nearest-neighbor summary, leading to better and more stable results. We evaluate REP-HO across five heterogeneous regimes covering cost imbalance, constraint difficulty, surrogate fidelity, budget level, and objective conflict. Across these regimes, one of the two variants obtains the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(Deepseek) is first or second throughout, and the planner shows adaptive allocation behavior, such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets and reallocating constraint evaluation budget when surrogate reliability changes. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as flexible evaluation planners for heterogeneous optimization, offering a general alternative to fixed hand-designed metrics.

</details>

**title/T1：** Arbitrary-Scale Anisotropic 3D MRI Super-Resolution with Gaussian Prototypes

**abstract/A1：** Reducing MRI acquisition time improves patient comfort, reduces motion artefacts, and increases scanner throughput. Clinical protocols often shorten acquisitions by sacrificing spatial resolution, particularly along the slice axis. Super-resolution can recover higher-resolution images, but existing methods are typically specialised to one scale or acquisition geometry, limiting their use across heterogeneous clinical protocols. We present GSMR3D, a continuous volumetric model that reconstructs arbitrary isotropic and anisotropic resolutions with a single checkpoint per MRI contrast. It combines a learned dictionary of anisotropic 3D Gaussian prototypes with scale-conditioned frequency encoding and an exact measurement-consistency projection, keeping reconstructions consistent with the acquired low-resolution data. We train separate models on 3,731 contrast-enhanced T1-weighted and 30,254 T1-weighted brain MRI volumes from clinical and population-based cohorts. We evaluate GSMR3D against geometry-specific specialists for isotropic, in-plane, and through-plane super-resolution using reconstruction quality and downstream tasks: brain tumour segmentation, brain-metastasis detection, and brain parcellation. GSMR3D outperforms specialists at isotropic $2\\times$ and achieves better LPIPS, DISTS, and FID across all geometries, although specialists retain higher PSNR in anisotropic settings. It more faithfully preserves glioma segmentations across all geometries, achieves the highest lesion sensitivity on an independent brain-metastasis cohort, and the highest brain-parcellation agreement for isotropic and in-plane reconstruction. Reconstruction takes about 6s per volume, adding little overhead relative to acquisition-time savings. GSMR3D offers a flexible approach to MRI scan-time reduction with one model per contrast across geometries while preserving information relevant to downstream tasks.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables (including appendix)

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI
