摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SpriteStage，用渐进式场景编程、迭代执行与引擎重编排生成约 10–14 分钟的长动画：每场戏从已接受的世界检查点和叙事快照出发，依据运行时与视觉反馈修订动作或情节，并将接受结果冻结回放为最终视频。

**相关性简评：** 其外部化的世界检查点、执行反馈修订与冻结回放机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代更新、轨迹验证与停止决策提供可核查的概念类比；但状态是显式程序/引擎状态而非模型内部表示，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpriteStage: Long Horizon Animation Generation via Progressive Scene Programming and Replay

**abstract/A1：** Video generation models synthesize visual sequences from text and image inputs. Extending video generation to long animations requires actions, dialogue, camera coverage, and narrative developments to remain coordinated across scenes. Executable scene programs make these decisions available for inspection. Constructing an entire story before observing its execution can leave later scenes dependent on unrealized events. We present SpriteStage, a progressive scene programming framework that builds animation through iterative enactment and engine reorchestration. Iterative enactment generates each scene from an accepted world checkpoint and narrative snapshot, executes it on a shared spatial stage, and uses runtime and visual feedback to revise the relevant actions or story beats. The accepted outcome becomes the starting state for the next scene. Engine reorchestration maps the resulting draft to production assets and engine capabilities while retaining its events, geometry, and timing. Inspection of the assembled sequence and frozen replay carry the accepted performance into the final video. Three complete animations, ranging from approximately 9.9 to 14.3 minutes, demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in producing extended narratives through scene programming and engine execution.

</details>

### 432. [LowNet: Looped Wavelet Neural Networks with 24 Learnable Parameters for Solving Poisson Equations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24941v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.24941

**作者：** Yuanhao Gong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.LG、eess.IV、math.AP、math.NA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24941v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24941v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LowNet：一个仅含 24 个可训练标量的循环小波神经网络用于求解泊松方程，用四个各由 6 个参数表示的 5×5 核构成小波块，并通过残差循环复用该块；实验报告循环 1/2/3 次时 PSNR 分别约 47.27、74.14、100.74 dB。

**相关性简评：** 来自数值求解领域，与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「残差循环复用同一权重块、循环次数提升精度而不增参数」的迭代设计，可能可供核查 LVR 中 loop 式推理状态更新与参数共享、计算代价之间的关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LowNet: Looped Wavelet Neural Networks with 24 Learnable Parameters for Solving Poisson Equations

**abstract/A1：** Poisson equations frequently appear in various fields, such as mathematics, physics and informatics. Solving Poisson equation, however, is challenging. Traditional methods are not data-specific, although have high certainty. They require a large number of iterations due to the CFL numerical stability. In contrast, deep learning methods are data-driven and more efficient, but require accurate training data and suffer from heavy computation. To tackle these issues, we propose a wavelet-inspired Poisson solver with 24 trainable scalars. The proposed network has several advantages. First, it is compact. It has four independent $5\\times5$ kernels, each represented by six parameters, leading to 24 scalars in total. Such compact format can be deployed on most devices. Second, thanks to the loop design, it achieves higher accuracy than previous methods. A residual loop reuses the wavelet block without increasing its parameters. Numerical experiments confirm that such loop indeed improves the solving accuracy. On 10000 images, one, two, and three loops of the wavelet block lead to PSNRs of $47.27$, $74.14$, and $100.74$ dB, respectively. Third, the proposed method is computationally fast. Thanks to the wavelet transform, the proposed method has linear computation complexity, leading to high computation performance. In short, we propose a novel looped wavelet neural network with compactness, accuracy and efficiency for solving Poisson equations. Our method can be applied in various fields, such as computational fluid dynamics, image reconstruction, biomedical engineering, electromagnetic field simulation.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究偏好标签翻转攻击下 DPO 的脆弱性，提出 Trim-K 与 Soft-Trim-K Robust-DPO：剔除或平滑降权影响最大的偏好对，并给出梯度扰动、参数与策略偏差的理论界，在三个偏好数据集上验证。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接交集，但「按梯度影响度剔除/降权被污染样本」并分离防御偏差与残余攻击效应的思路，或可供核查：用于识别并抑制 latent 轨迹或视觉证据监督中方向错误的训练信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Robust Direct Preference Optimization under Preference Label-Flip Attacks

**abstract/A1：** Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is widely used for offline Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. However, recent works have shown that DPO can be easily manipulated by adversarial preference label flip attacks, which are specifically designed to mislead the learner toward an attacker-chosen target policy. To address this issue, we design robust DPO methods that can defend against such attacks. Building on the property that lable flips induce parameter-independent gradient shifts in log-linear DPO, we propose Trim-$K$ Robust-DPO, which removes the $K$ highest-impact pairs, and Soft-Trim-$K$ Robust-DPO, which smoothly downweights them. We establish deterministic gradient perturbation bounds uniformly over all attack sets containing at most $K$ flips, explicitly separating defense-induced bias from surviving attack effects. Under bounded-region assumptions, these bounds yield time-uniform parameter and policy deviation guarantees. We further quantify how quadratic regularization improves curvature while introducing additional bias. Experiments on Stanford Human Preferences, HH-RLHF, and UltraFeedback-Binarized validate our analysis.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但「区分评测规则变化与训练收益」的评价拆解，以及「无标签预测无法恢复目标标签空间、须依赖文档合规」的发现，可能为 latent 推理的评测协议设计和内部状态可恢复性提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Label-Space Mismatch Distorts Cross-Cohort Evaluation in Breast Cancer Molecular Subtyping

**abstract/A1：** Cross-cohort evaluation of breast cancer subtype classifiers is unreliable when source and target cohorts use different annotation standards: METABRIC labels six classes, PAM50 defines five, and a claudin-low prediction cannot be correct under a five-class standard. A classifier transferred from 1,369 METABRIC patients (train n=958) to TCGA-BRCA (n=987) and GSE21653 (n=266) separates three evaluation operations routinely conflated in cross-site comparisons. (1) Label-space restriction - an evaluation-rule change, not a retraining gain - is the dominant correction (73.76%-&gt;79.74% on TCGA-BRCA; 63.16%-&gt;68.42% on GSE21653); (2) EM prior correction on the reconciled space is an optional calibration step (Brier fidelity up, macro F1 down; to 80.65% and 74.06%); and (3) the target label space is not recoverable from unlabelled predictions (EM retains prior 0.0751 on the absent class; calibrated detectors fail), so compliance must come from cohort documentation. The protocol exposes why internal validation overstates cross-cohort value: multimodal fusion gains do not transfer (no configuration beats mRNA alone, n=694; McNemar p=0.13-1.00), and the genomic panel adds nothing to pathological complete response prediction over clinical variables (DeltaAUC = +0.0045). Clinically, without label-space compliance, cross-site accuracy comparisons misattribute annotation-standard differences to model skill; Luminal A/B and claudin-low boundary errors map to distinct treatment decisions; and subtype accuracy is a weaker portable endpoint than survival discrimination (external C-index 0.577-0.584). Reporting the cohort's allowed label set and applying label-space compliance are therefore prerequisites before any cross-cohort performance claim.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.24969v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了面向安全监督的大规模人机协作评测资源（8 个数据集、6 个领域、3,957 条实例，并收集 416 名标注者共 35,613 条判断），用于匹配比较人类、AI 以及人机混合的监督准确率；结果显示互补性存在空间，但所测试的辅助与混合方法平均收益有限，甚至在人类整体更准时反而更少纠正 AI 的错误。

**相关性简评：** 属较远的 AI 安全监督领域，但其「互补性」度量与人机判断融合实验，可能为 LVR 中何时引入额外证据或计算（LOOK/STOP 的收益判断）提供评价思路，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Human-AI Complementarity for AI Safety

**abstract/A1：** Safely overseeing AI is increasingly challenging for the humans doing it, as they must evaluate longer and more complex outputs with every new model generation. To mitigate this challenge, we could leverage complementarity: where humans and models make different mistakes, combining their judgements could yield an oversight signal stronger than either produces alone. We study this opportunity in realistic, safety-relevant settings, contributing the largest known suite of such tasks (3,957 instances across 8 datasets and 6 domains) as well as a platform and data pipeline for measuring human, AI, and human-AI performance on matched items. We collected 35,613 judgements from 416 human raters, finding a considerable opportunity for a complementarity effect. We also found that with the assistance methods we tested, human raters corrected the AI's errors less often, even when overall human accuracy rose, and the hybridisation methods we tested added little over the better single source on average. While complementarity is an important and feasible engineering target for safe oversight, achieving it remains an open challenge for future work.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 PRECOCIAL：让 LLM 迭代改写「生成合成预训练数据的程序」，并以在同一个网络上继续预训练再下游微调的得分作为搜索信号，从而自动优化数据课程；在语言与代码数据集上比手工课程和程序生成器更省微调步数，并观察到生成程序的跨域迁移。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PRECOCIAL: Pretraining with Code Curriculums via Iterative Search for Accelerated Learning

**abstract/A1：** Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far been designed by hand. We introduce PRECOCIAL, a method for automatically optimizing programs that generate synthetic pretraining data. Starting from an initial generator program, an LLM iteratively rewrites the program, and each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task. Because every score requires training, PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate, making it significantly more efficient. On four language and code datasets, at a fixed fine-tuning budget, optimized programs reach lower perplexity than hand-designed curricula, published procedural generators, random program mutation and the program the LLM writes in the first iteration of the search, and reach the same perplexity as the hand-designed curricula with 9-33% fewer fine-tuning steps. PRECOCIAL also ends with lower perplexity than FunSearch and AlphaEvolve, which train a new network for every candidate, at the same number of evaluations and a lower cost. We also observe that an optimized program generator from one domain transfers to datasets in other domains. Additionally, optimized programs allow for better downstream performance on four different reasoning and problem-solving tasks.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IECLA: Interpretable Emotion Contribution Learning for Affective Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Affective image editing (AIE) aims to evoke a target emotion while preserving the content and structure of a source image. Existing methods improve emotional expression or visual fidelity, but the target emotion alone does not reveal which source regions should be changed and which should remain intact, especially in complex scenes. We introduce Interpretable Emotion Contribution Learning for Affective Image Editing (IECLA), a framework that separates source-emotion attribution from target-aware editing. IECLA constructs signed object-level supervision through counterfactual interventions and trains a context-conditioned contribution predictor to localize evidence that supports or opposes the source emotion. At inference, an image-level evaluator estimates the source emotion directly from the input, while the predictor identifies editable and preservation evidence without repeated interventions. A target-aware editing agent then translates this evidence and the desired emotion into localized, content-aware operations for existing editors. Extensive evaluations show that IECLA predicts counterfactual contributions more faithfully on both in-domain and cross-dataset tests, while external VLM and independent human references support the quality of its localized evidence. Across six editing backbones, IECLA consistently strengthens target-emotion expression while preserving image content and structure, and user studies further show improved perceived target expression and naturalness.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multifidelity Monte Carlo Estimator for High-Dimensional Quantities of Interest

**abstract/A1：** Multifidelity Monte Carlo (MFMC) reduces the cost of estimating the statistics of quantities of interest (QoIs) computed via expensive high-fidelity model by using cheaper low-fidelity models as control variates. We extend MFMC to vector-valued QoIs by replacing the scalar control-variate coefficients with matrices and minimizing a weighted mean-squared error. The optimal full-matrix coefficients are available in closed form, and their variance reduction is summarized by an effective correlation that takes the place of the squared Pearson correlation in the closed-form MFMC design. Restricting the coefficients to block-diagonal, diagonal, and scalar classes gives a nested hierarchy of estimators with increasing variance reduction and increasing pilot-data demand, with closed-form coefficients for compatible weightings. For a scalar QoI obtained by linearly projecting the state, correcting the full state before projecting is never worse at the population level. Experiments on a Gaussian problem, a reduced-order model of an advection--diffusion problem, and a coarse-grid two-phase flow problem show that the best class depends on the pilot size relative to the number of covariance quantities it must estimate, and that reusing the pilot samples lowers the mean-squared error.

</details>

**title/T1：** Decentralized Online Exp-Concave Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Decentralized Online Convex Optimization (D-OCO) is a fundamental framework in which a set of local agents aims to minimize a sequence of global loss functions using only local computations and communications. While recent work has established near-optimal regret guarantees for convex and strongly convex losses, the case of exp-concave losses remains an open challenge: specifically, whether logarithmic regret is achievable. In this paper, we answer this question affirmatively by proposing Decentralized Online Newton Step (D-ONS), which adapts the idea of blocking and accelerated gossip to the Online Newton Step algorithm in a non-trivial manner. Concretely, our algorithm achieves a regret bound of $O\\left(Nd(1-σ\_2)^{-1/2}\\,\\log^2(T) \\right)$ where $N$ is the number of agents, $d$ is the dimension, $T$ is the horizon, and $1-σ\_2$ represents the spectral gap of the network. To our knowledge, this is the first logarithmic regret bound for decentralized online exp-concave optimization. We further establish a nearly matching lower bound of $Ω\\left(Nd (1-σ\_2)^{-1/2}\\,\\log(T/N) \\right)$ showing the near optimality of our upper bound. Finally, we extend our algorithm to decentralized online linear regression in which the feasible domain is unbounded and features and labels are locally observed. By gossiping covariance and label-feature statistics, we also achieve logarithmic regret.

</details>

### 440. [Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25060v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25060

**作者：** Vahid Jebraeeli、Jonathon Romero、Yijin Wang、Adrian Chan、Jianbang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25060v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25060v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文利用同一批约 5.3 万提示被两种操作定义重复标注的工业部署，训练十个共享架构与优化器的 guardrail 模型，发现安全基准分数在固定架构下可相差 23 倍、且验证准确率追踪的是与标注者「安全定义」的一致而非检测能力，训练语料本身已含基准污染，因此主张评估需报告污染、种子下限与所用定义。

**相关性简评：** 该文关于「基准衡量的是标签定义而非能力」及教师软标签可偷渡另一套政策（蒸馏来源成为未记录混淆）的发现，可能为 LVR/VLM 推理评测中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益究竟来自能力还是监督与标注约定提供核查视角，但属跨领域类比，需自行判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On

**abstract/A1：** A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher's soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator's policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, Sydney. 20 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 441. [The Optimal Sample Complexity of Pointwise Replicable Agnostic Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25062v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25062

**作者：** Guangjian Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25062v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25062v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究 pointwise replicable agnostic learning 的最优样本复杂度，在有限与可数域上给出与下界匹配的界，并构造了基于经验风险最小化集成与平滑风险分解的学习器。

**相关性简评：** 其「同随机种子下两次独立训练须在每个查询上高概率一致」的可复现性刻画，可能与 LVR 中推理状态或答案跨运行稳定性的评价设计存在概念联系，可供核查；但纯学习论工具与 VLM 推理主线的直接关系尚不明确。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Optimal Sample Complexity of Pointwise Replicable Agnostic Learning

**abstract/A1：** Pointwise replicability asks that two independently trained predictors, using the same random seed, agree at each fixed query with high probability. We determine its optimal agnostic sample complexity on finite and countable domains. For every nonempty binary class of finite VC dimension $d\\ge1$, the required number of independent examples is $Θ\\!\\left(\\frac{d}{ρ^2α^2}+\\frac{\\log(1/β)}{α^2}\\right)$, uniformly over independent accuracy, failure, and disagreement parameters $α,β,ρ\\in(0,1/10)$. The learner returns one binary function, may be improper, and uses unrestricted shared randomness. Its sample budget is fixed before observing data, and the replicability guarantee includes queries of zero marginal mass. The main construction combines an ensemble of empirical-risk minimizers with a smooth, signal-dependent risk decomposition. A single shared phase selects the final binary predictor. Record times certify its weak-signal risk, while a uniform bound protects the strong-signal risk at that same selected time. A phase-comparison theorem controls the actual shared-seed execution under simultaneous changes in the marginals and risk coefficients. A rare repair step then makes the confidence cost additive. Together with matching lower bounds, this removes the remaining logarithmic overhead and parameter restrictions in the general countable-domain sample-complexity problem. This extended version also retains the earlier explicit constructions and their proofs, including proper learning for VC-one classes, the full finite-atom class, a faster realizable bound, and counterexamples that separate restrictions of particular algorithms from restrictions of the learning problem.

**comment/C1：** 92 pages

</details>

### 442. [One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25064

**作者：** Parsa Razmara、Seyedarmin Azizi、Ardalan Aryashad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25064v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 SkillClash（16 对同任务 Agent Skills 指令文件），用代码逐条核验规则遵循情况，在 7 个模型上考察两份冲突技能同时入上下文时的行为，发现普遍的「接管」现象，并显示加入一个同时遵循两者且正确的示例可大幅缓解。

**相关性简评：** 该研究不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其关于多个上下文信号竞争时单一来源「接管」、且单个正确示例即可改变行为占比的发现，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据与文本先验的支配关系，以及示例型监督对推理状态是否被真正使用的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix

**abstract/A1：** Agent Skills are instruction files that tell a coding agent how to do one job. Users install skills from many authors, so two skills for the same job can be active at the same time. We ask what a model does when both skill files are in its context: does it combine their compatible rules, or follow one skill and drop the other? We build SkillClash, 16 pairs of same-job skills in which code checks every rule and a reference output shows the best result that can be reached. On seven models from five families, from 4B open models to Qwen3-235B and GPT-4.1, a skill's rules are followed 93 to 99% of the time when it is loaded alone and 61 to 62% when a same-job skill is loaded next to it. Most outputs show takeover: every rule that only one skill asks for is followed, and every rule that only the other skill asks for is dropped. The worked examples inside the skills drive this. When each skill file instead ends with one example that follows both skills, takeover falls to 1 to 15% on the six models we tested. Telling the model which skill has priority does not bring the dropped skill back, and telling it to apply both skills brings the dropped skill back only on the two strong models and leaves the interacting rules broken. One merged skill file written by the strongest model we used, Claude Opus 5.5, lets all seven models follow 96 to 99% of the achievable rules. Most of its gain over a plain list of both skills' rules comes from its one worked example, and such an example helps only when it is correct. Code and data: https://github.com/prazmara/skillclash

</details>

### 443. [DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25089v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25089

**作者：** Dengyuxing Wang、Yonggang Zhang、Qianshu Cai、Huajiang Zheng、Jun Song、Yangqiu Song、Yike Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25089v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25089v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DAGLoop：把候选方法的每个设计决策转译成可检验预期并配对针对性实验，再依据决策依赖关系构建 DAG 来规划消融，用记录预期与条件的结构化研究记忆指导保留、修正或进一步验证决策，在数十个可执行研究任务上报告性能提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「带依赖约束的决策级因果归因＋联合检验」思路，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等推理步骤的贡献分配与消融式核验提供可核查的元推理与因果抽象线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research

**abstract/A1：** Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop

</details>

### 444. [Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25140v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25140

**作者：** Amirhossein Ghaffari、Susanna Pirttikangas、Ekaterina Gilman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25140v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25140v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出谱自适应图 Transformer：以可学习、有向且以当前交通状态为条件的空间算子替代图拉普拉斯特征分解，并用稀疏路网扩散分支与零初始化门控补足局部传播，配合频率箱注意力模块，在保持线性复杂度和更低显存的同时于多个交通预测基准取得有竞争力结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「以当前状态为条件的学习混合算子 + 零初始化门控融合全局低秩分支与严格局部扩散分支」可能为 LVR 中 latent 全局推理状态与局部视觉证据分支的融合、以及视觉旁路/信息坍缩问题提供可核查的借鉴线索，但领域较远，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ahghaffari/sagt

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25161

**作者：** Jiaming He、Guanyu Hou、Yi Yu、Xudong Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25161v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25161v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「双世界不可区分」训练：构造仅在私有事实上有差异的世界对，用冻结判别器按对数似然比评估观察者视图，并以任务成功减该比值做成对 GRPO，证明该目标可约束任意观察者、任意信道上的贝叶斯推断成功率，在购物与消息任务中消除披露判断与查询级奖励漏掉的泄漏。

**相关性简评：** 其「观察者视图是否随事实而变」的可区分性度量与似然比监督，可能为 LVR 中核查视觉证据是否真正进入 latent 状态、信息坍缩与贡献分配提供探测式工具，属可迁移的方法线索，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Indistinguishable Agents: Training Agent Privacy as Twin-World Indistinguishability

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \\methodfull (\\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \\method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.

</details>

### 446. [World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25170v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25170

**作者：** Karthik Iyer、Madan Dabbeeru

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25170v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25170v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在四个公开零售数据集上做滚动起点预测，比较「在价格与促销计划下推进商品状态」的世界模型、去掉该状态的同构网络、LightGBM、TFT、TimesFM、Chronos-Bolt 等模型商品-门店、品类、连锁等不同粒度的误差，并用配对检验与模型置信集给出结论，最优模型随粒度与数据而变。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「带状态世界模型 vs 同结构无状态网络」的消融可能可供核查显式状态推进是否真带来增益，其配对检验与模型置信集的比较方式对 latent 推理的收益与评价也有借鉴可能。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World Models, Trees and Foundation Models for Retail Forecasting: Evidence from Four Public Data Sets

**abstract/A1：** A retailer makes different decisions at different grains of the product, store and time hierarchy: store orders for an item in a store, supplier funding for an item across stores, category performance by store, and the financial plan for the chain. Which forecasting model to use depends on the grain. This paper compares models at each grain on four public data sets (M5, six Dominick's categories, Breakfast at the Frat, and Corporación Favorita, the last kept out of all development), over rolling forecast origins with paired tests and model confidence sets. It covers price and promotion through the plan inputs these data record, not product, assortment or place. The models are a world model that carries each item's state forward under the price and promotion plan, the same network without that state, LightGBM, the Temporal Fusion Transformer, TimesFM, Chronos-Bolt, Timestral, seasonal naive, and an equal-weight average of the world model, LightGBM and TimesFM given the plan. The answer changed with the grain. For an item by store and an item across stores, the average had the lowest error on seven and eight of nine data sets, and the 90% confidence set held a median of 1 and 2 models. For a category by store, a category and the chain total, the lowest-error model differed between data sets and a median of 4 of nine models were not separated by the four to six windows available. For category-by-store planning cost, the average or LightGBM was lowest on seven of eight data sets, and the world model was lowest only on M5; it was behind LightGBM item by store on six of eight. Every trained model used the plan, and on the weekly promotion-driven data pretrained models were less accurate without it. These results hold for these data sets; a forecast solved across all four Ps, or a retailer's own data, may give different results. Every model, test and change that lost is reported.

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PLACE，在记忆后端之上加装分解式治理层，用写入侧状态认证与读取侧授权分别控制持久记忆的形成与查询时影响；并在 Mem0 与 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 上做因子化评估，分离两种机制的贡献。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents

**abstract/A1：** Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.

</details>

### 448. [Sampling and Curvature in First-Exit Comparisons for Momentum SGD](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25191v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25191

**作者：** Haiyi Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25191v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25191v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 momentum SGD 的首次退出（first-exit）预测为何依赖逐点梯度律所忽略的采样信息，比较持续采样与 iid 采样下的平均退出行为，并用有限窗口退出括号、实数证书及训练实验加以检验。

**相关性简评：** 首次退出时间可视为一类停止时刻分析，其对采样方式与曲率的敏感性，可能与 LVR 中「何时停止」的停止决策如何随证据采样而变化的问题存在概念联系，属可供核查的远域线索，但材料未涉及任何多模态或 latent 推理内容。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sampling and Curvature in First-Exit Comparisons for Momentum SGD

**abstract/A1：** First-exit prediction for momentum SGD depends on sampling information that pointwise gradient laws omit. Strongly convex finite pools with identical pointwise laws and matched iid momentum dynamics can have different reshuffled exits; even analytic pools with uniformly close pointwise laws can have separated exit probabilities. For persistent sampling in one dimension, we establish an explicit $O(h)$ mean-exit comparison with a finite-rate switching process under nonvanishing component velocities and step-size conditions; iid sampling instead averages to an ODE. Retaining realized minibatches and sampled curvature yields finite-window exit brackets beyond this regime. In 32 trained ridge-logistic runs, 29 meet prespecified targets with rounding-certified brackets; an enclosure control explains most of the width advantage. Exact-real certificates establish finite means at the original tested radii for three ResNet-18 checkpoints and give local finite-mean conditions for tanh and ViT networks; their upper bounds remain loose, and original-radius ViT mean guarantees remain unresolved despite 128 fresh continuation paths. A two-network replication gives 32/32 successful seeds in each of four finite-path persistence comparisons. Independent equal-length controls retain slower exits after refresh resets than without resets, but the refresh-versus-random ordering reverses with update length at both networks. These interventions do not causally decompose raw momentum SGD. Neural step-size scaling does not validate the switching limit.

**comment/C1：** 84 pages, including references and appendices

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文考察联邦学习中在成本-效用权衡下，少量浅层探针（P0–P2）是否足以支撑每客户端的个性化深度分配决策以逼近离线 oracle，并在 CIFAR-10/100 与 PTB-XL 上比较无训练贪心探测、仅元数据策略与 FedPBA。

**相关性简评：** 「浅层探测能否含足够决策信息以决定是否深入」与 LVR 的 STOP 决策、动态计算预算分配可能有概念联系，可供核查浅层状态是否足以预测更深的推理深度；但领域与多模态推理相距较远，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Shallow Probes Are Sufficient for Near-Oracle Personalization Depth Allocation in Federated Learning

**abstract/A1：** Rather than proposing a new federated optimizer, we study whether a small client-specific measurement budget can support cost-aware personalization-depth decisions under a utility that trades Macro-F1 against deployment cost. Exhaustive evaluation of six depths defines an offline oracle that is not deployable. We audit the Probe Sufficiency Hypothesis: three shallow probes (P0--P2) may contain most decision-relevant information for approaching that oracle. FedPBA is a secondary learned instantiation for deep-action extrapolation. On CIFAR-10/100 and patient-disjoint PTB-XL (45 sessions; 900 clients; 2700 evaluations; GroupKFold), training-free greedy probing achieves regret 0.0071 and 98.3 percent oracle recovery, beating metadata-only policies and FedPBA (0.0110 / 97.3 percent). Aggregate shallow-best versus oracle correlation is 0.9818 but falls to 0.578 on deep-oracle rows; PTB-XL deep-oracle cases remain a high-regret boundary without a validated escalation gate.

**相关性简评：** 其「静态策略质量与动态长时程结果不完全一致、动态压力测试才暴露尾部失败」的评测思路，可能为 LVR 的长时程推理与动态评测设计提供对照线索；但论文不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，联系较间接，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \\textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \\textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \\textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \\textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Map2Vid 任务，把具身导航视频生成改写为 BEV 地图到视频的合成问题，并构建含 10 万余条导航序列、61 个室内场景的数据集，以及整合多控制信号的统一框架和逐步弱化非地图输入的课程训练策略。

**相关性简评：** BEV 地图作为显式承载全局布局与路线的空间条件，可能为 LVR 中几何与任务必要信息的表示方式提供参照；其「逐步弱化非地图输入」的课程训练或可类比辅助条件移除与贡献分配，属待核查线索而非已验证结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Map2Vid: Embodied Navigation Video Generation with Human-Friendly Motion Control

**abstract/A1：** Controllable video generation has recently achieved impressive visual quality, yet existing control paradigms remain poorly suited to embodied navigation. Text prompts are spatially ambiguous, while camera-trajectory control relies on low-level motion specifications that are unintuitive for human users and difficult to manipulate. In this work, we introduce Map2Vid, a novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV-map-to-video synthesis problem, together with a large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation. By using BEV maps, which provide a visual representation of global scene layout and intended navigation routes, Map2Vid enables human-friendly navigation video generation. To support this task, we construct a dedicated dataset with over 100K navigation sequences across 61 indoor scenes, each paired with egocentric videos, BEV maps, camera trajectories and language instructions. We further develop a unified framework that integrates multiple control signals, together with a curriculum training strategy that progressively weakens non-map inputs, enabling flexible inference under both full conditioning and map-only input. Extensive experiments across multiple foundation generation models demonstrate that controllable navigation video generation via BEV map is a viable and promising direction.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文在阿拉伯语、英语、法语文档上比较云端与自托管 OCR 系统，评估包围框检测、文本识别与数学表达式识别，并用置信区间和配对比较报告结果。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态，但其「聚合分数可能掩盖变量替换、数字改写等细粒度符号错误，需结构检查与标注特定测试」的评估经验，可能对设计「latent 是否保留视觉细节」的核查方式有借鉴价值，尚待人工评估其迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evaluating Cloud and Self-Hosted OCR Systems for Arabic, English, and French Documents: Bounding Box Detection, Text Recognition, and Mathematical Expression Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Choosing an OCR system for a multilingual archive requires balancing accuracy against deployment constraints. This study compares cloud and self-hosted systems on three tasks: bounding box detection on 48 Arabic, English, and French pages, text recognition on 315 pages across nine document types, and mathematical expression recognition on 83 English and Arabic samples. Detection was assessed by page-level visual grades, text by character error rate (CER) against a Gemini-generated reference transcription, and mathematics by scores against known answers. Main estimates are accompanied by 95% intervals and paired comparisons. Google Document AI and Surya produced Good line boxes on 47 of 48 (98%) and 46 of 48 (96%) pages. Datalab, Azure Document Intelligence, and Document AI had mean CERs of 0.145-0.152, with no difference detected in unadjusted paired comparisons. Surya had the lowest mean CER among self-hosted systems (0.199). No mathematical test had a statistically clear leader. Strict checks showed that near-perfect page scores could conceal a replaced Arabic variable or Eastern Arabic digits rewritten in Western form. Reliable evaluation therefore requires uncertainty estimates, structural checks, and notation-specific tests in addition to aggregate recognition scores.

</details>

### 453. [Emergent Sparsity: How Many Effective Variables Survive Coarse-Graining in AlphaEarth Embeddings?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25258v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25258

**作者：** Johannes Hirn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.stat-mech、physics.geo-ph

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以 AlphaEarth 的 64 维地表像元嵌入为对象，用统一架构的 β-VAE 扫描得到 rank–distortion 包络，考察在指定重建容差下保留下来的有效变量数如何随空间尺度粗粒化而下降（3% 容差时由 24 降至 7，而 PCA 秩仅由 46 降至 38）。

**相关性简评：** 其「容差—尺度」二维有效维度刻画与表示几何相关，可能为核查 latent 推理状态中视觉信息随压缩与粒度变化的坍缩提供度量思路；但对象是遥感嵌入而非 VLM 推理，联系仅为概念类比，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Emergent Sparsity: How Many Effective Variables Survive Coarse-Graining in AlphaEarth Embeddings?

**abstract/A1：** AlphaEarth encodes each 10 m land pixel as a 64-component vector intended to support diverse global mapping tasks. Yet many scientific applications work at coarser spatial supports, for which fewer than 64 effective variables may suffice. We ask whether these vectors can be reorganized into ranked global nonlinear coordinates, how many suffice at a chosen reconstruction accuracy, and whether that number decreases with spatial scale. We thus describe effective dimension as a two-control surface over tolerance and spatial scale, rather than one intrinsic number. At each scale, a $β$-VAE scan with a common architecture produces a rank--distortion envelope, giving the smallest retained count achieved within the scanned family at each reconstruction tolerance. At 3% validation tolerance, this number falls from 24 to 7 when the scale is increased from 10 m to 78.9 km, whereas the corresponding PCA rank falls only from 46 to 38. Repeating the analysis on unit-norm targets preserves this trend.

**comment/C1：** Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Advances in Representation Learning for Earth Observation (REO), NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 15 figures

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** EasyResearch 提供无代码的回归、时序预测与信号分类分析核心及 Windows 桌面应用，固定默认设置与随机种子，并保留部分数据不参与建模，量化打乱交叉验证、全数据筛选变量等常见做法对报告分数的高估程度。

**相关性简评：** 其关于验证协议泄漏与分数乐观偏差的诊断可供核查 LVR/VLM 推理评测流程是否存在类似信息泄漏与收益高估；但论文任务与多模态推理相距较远，这一联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EasyResearch: Honest Regression, Forecasting and Signal Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program

**abstract/A1：** EasyClassifier showed that researchers who do not program can obtain honest classification results when the correct evaluation is the default. Most applied studies, however, predict a number, forecast a series or classify recordings, and each task has its own way of producing scores that do not hold on new data. We present EasyResearch, open-source analysis cores for regression, time-series forecasting and signal classification, and EasyResearch Desktop, a Windows application that runs these three tasks and EasyClassifier's classification without code. All four follow the same rules: everything learned from data is learned on training data only, models keep their published defaults with fixed seeds, the selected model receives a separate final score, forecasts are never evaluated on shuffled data, and every run writes a report with a Methods paragraph and the references for every method used. We measured whether the reported scores are honest by keeping part of each dataset untouched. In regression (9 public datasets, 90 runs), the common practice overstated R^2 by +2.2 points and the best comparison score by +2.5, while EasyResearch's final score was -1.0; screening predictors on all rows before cross-validation, which EasyResearch does not offer, reported R^2 = 0.27 on pure noise against -0.44 on new data. In forecasting (15 series), shuffled cross-validation over windows of past values promised errors 19% smaller than its chosen models achieved in the untouched future, while EasyResearch's final-period score was unbiased to within 1.5%; the models EasyResearch chose had 14% lower future error, and on random walks shuffled cross-validation chose a machine-learning model in 5 of 5 series, each worse in the future than repeating the last value, which EasyResearch chose 4 times. In signal classification (4 UCR datasets) one method won every comparison and neither estimate was biased.

</details>

**内容简述：** 该研究用 Takens 定理启发的延迟向量重构委内瑞拉热带云雾林生态系统的状态空间，把温度、降水等气候强迫纳入其中，并用高斯过程回归预测 35 年开花与结果周期，同时给出显式不确定性。

**相关性简评：** 其「从观测序列延迟嵌入重构隐状态 + 显式不确定性估计」的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示与更新，以及基于不确定性的证据判断或停止决策存在概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Data-driven forecasting of tropical cloud forest phenology: A dynamical systems and machine learning hybrid approach

**abstract/A1：** Forecasting how species and ecosystems respond to climate change is a critical challenge in ecology, particularly in hyper-diverse tropical biomes. While traditional phenological models often rely on preconceived functional forms, this study introduces a data-driven hybrid approach that integrates dynamical systems theory with machine learning to forecast flowering and fruiting cycles. Using a robust 35-year dataset from a Venezuelan tropical cloud forest, we reconstruct the system's state-space using delay vectors inspired by Takens' theorem, incorporating climate forcing variables such as temperature and precipitation. The model was trained using Gaussian Process Regression, providing both point predictors and explicit uncertainty estimates. Our results clearly suggest that the synergy between dynamical systems and machine learning effectively captures the non-linear complexities of ecological time series. Specifically, the model achieved higher predictive accuracy for flowering and fruiting. This hybrid framework offers a scalable tool for anticipating phenological mismatches and informing conservation strategies in the face of global environmental change.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds

**abstract/A1：** Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their latent worlds naturally lack a human-interpretable interface. In this Perspective, we argue that as JEPA latents become internal states for prediction and action, interpretability must move beyond what they encode to how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction. To this end, we envision a four-stage research agenda, involving Ground, Structure, Verify, and Act, to guide this shift toward actionable latent-world understanding. Within our framework, existing JEPA interpretability efforts provide early evidence for Ground, while systematic analysis of latent structure, causal verification, and intervention remains largely unexplored. Overall, this Perspective aims to call for a broader latent-world interpretability agenda that shifts attention from decoding representations toward understanding, validating, and acting on latent worlds.

</details>

**title/T1：** A Distribution-Free Separation Between Learned and Fixed Features

**abstract/A1：** The success of neural networks is largely attributed to their ability to learn useful representations from training data. However, known results that prove a computational advantage of learned features over fixed ones are restricted to specific input distributions. We settle the COLT open question of Feldman, Kamath, and Srebro (2026) by showing that this advantage can persist in the distribution-free setting. We construct a family of hypothesis classes that can be efficiently learned by a natural gradient-based algorithm on a two-layer ReLU network, but cannot be represented by linear predictors over any fixed feature map with polynomial dimension (and runtime). Specifically, for any sufficiently small error and any sufficiently large runtime budget R (depending on the error), there exists a hypothesis class that the neural network learns under any input distribution to the desired expected classification error in time at most R, while the dimension complexity (governing the dimension needed by linear predictors) is superpolynomial in R.

</details>

**title/T1：** CASE: Complementary Articulation-Aware Speech Encoder to Enhance Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation

**abstract/A1：** General-purpose self-supervised speech encoders provide strong acoustic representations, but their pretraining objectives are not explicitly aligned with the visible articulatory dynamics required by speech-driven 3D facial animation. We propose CASE (Complementary Articulation-aware Speech Encoder), a complementary speech encoder adapted by contrastively aligning short speech clips with continuous 3D lip-mesh VQ-VAE latents. After adaptation, the geometry branch is removed, and the audio-only CASE representation is fused with the baseline SSL speech representation through residual cross-attention, while retaining the motion-decoder architecture and objective. Across four VOCASET baselines, CASE reduces mean lip vertex error by 2.8-6.0%, and mean full-face vertex error decreases in every system. Under the same fusion protocol, CASE yields lower mean LVE than the unadapted AV-SE stream on all four generators, with model-dependent margins. Because adaptation uses Korean speech-geometry pairs and evaluation uses English VOCASET, the result is consistent with cross-language downstream transfer under a shared English-pretrained audio-visual prior.

### 459. [Operator-Mismatch Contrastive Learning for World-Relative Trajectory Coherence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25360v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25360

**作者：** One Octadion、Firmansyah Sundana、Novanto Yudistira

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25360v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25360v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对世界模型轨迹评分，形式化出「operator-blindness」失败：评分器在通用排序上近乎完美，却无法区分当前规则下连贯的未来与其他规则下连贯的未来；为此提出 Operator-Mismatch Contrastive 学习，用「有效但规则错误」的轨迹作语义硬负样本，并配套提出直接度量 world-relative coherence 的评测协议，在合成基准与 CoPhy ballsCF 特征级验证上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其硬负样本构造与「当前世界 vs 其他世界」判别协议，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的筛选与评价、排除看似合理却错误的内部状态相关，可供核查；论文本身不涉及视觉语言推理，属较远领域的启发线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Operator-Mismatch Contrastive Learning for World-Relative Trajectory Coherence

**abstract/A1：** World models are increasingly judged by how well they rank plausible futures, yet plausibility alone is the wrong target. The same scene can evolve under many latent rules, and a future that is smooth and physically valid under one rule can be incoherent under the rule actually in force. We formalize the resulting failure, operator-blindness, and show that it is systematically hidden by standard evaluation: a scorer can attain near-perfect generic ranking while separating current-world from other-world futures no better than chance. We introduce Operator-Mismatch Contrastive (OMC) learning, whose semantic hard negatives are valid-but-wrong-operator trajectories, and a matching protocol that measures world-relative coherence directly. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with in- and out-of-distribution operator parameters, across two trajectory-scoring backbones, and on feature-level external validation with CoPhy ballsCF, OMC raises operator-sensitive scoring far above a chance baseline that nonetheless achieves 0.99 generic top-1. We prove that the wrong-operator negative is necessary both for the protocol to detect the failure and for the objective to fix it, and position OMC as an auxiliary coherence signal (a trajectory-coherence scorer, not a generative model, planner, or control agent) that can be attached to existing world-model representations.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 460. [Mining the Self-Rewriting System: A Vision for Data Mining on AI-Native Infrastructure](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25374v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25374

**作者：** Mayank Darbari、Chiman Salavati、Liang Wu、Dawei Wang、Jiong Zhang、Kelly Wan、Krishna Chakka、Liangjie Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25374v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25374v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇 Blue Sky 立场的愿景论文：提出「自改写系统」与「内生漂移」概念，主张跨表面的联合分析才能可靠归因，并列出四个基础研究问题（漂移信号融合与校准门控、动作字母表演化的轨迹挖掘、在线重索引与压缩下的知识维护、共享评测门的并发学习流推广）及相应基准设想。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨表面联合归因 + 校准门控」与共享评测门设计，可能为 LVR 中贡献分配、继续/停止依据、检索证据库更新与在线筛选提供概念类比，属远领域启发，需人工核查是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mining the Self-Rewriting System: A Vision for Data Mining on AI-Native Infrastructure

**abstract/A1：** Classical data mining treats data as generated outside the learner. Emerging AI-native infrastructure invalidates this assumption: as agents observe system state, act, update retrieval stores and models, and promote new artifacts into the serving path, their own decisions reshape the future logs, traces, corpora, and evaluation records used for later training and release. We call this new research object a self-rewriting system and the resulting system-induced distribution shift endogenous drift. Our central, falsifiable claim is that cross-surface causes are not identifiable in general from marginal per-surface monitoring: different coupled failures can produce the same individual signals while differing in their joint behavior, requiring joint analysis for reliable attribution. This agenda comprises four foundational research problems: fusing heterogeneous drift signals into calibrated gating and attribution (C1); mining agent traces whose activity alphabet evolves (C2); maintaining knowledge fabrics through online reindexing, faithfulness, and compression decisions (C3); and safely promoting concurrent learning streams through one shared evaluation gate (C4). These remain fragmented across concept drift, performative prediction, process mining, streaming retrieval-augmented generation, and MLOps, without a unified data-mining agenda. We outline public benchmarks and evaluation criteria, using AI-native telecom only as a motivating exemplar with analogues in finance, software CI/CD, and clinical decision support.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the Blue Sky Track of the IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Simulating Infant Senses with Age-Tuned Networks

**abstract/A1：** What a newborn sees, hears and feels, and how this changes month by month, has been measured sense by sense, with different methods and in different units. We bring these measurements together for the first two years of life and ask whether small neural networks tuned to a given age can turn them into a quick, inspectable simulation of sensory perception. Each sense's immaturity is written as a fixed, age-indexed filter on the input, and a small prediction network learns behind it over the first year. The filters alone reproduce the order in which the senses mature, by construction. The networks add what filters cannot: in vision they extract far less than their input allows at early stages (at the newborn stage a toy's position cannot be read out, $R^2 = 0.00$, against 0.57 for a network trained directly on the same input), and a critical period and perceptual narrowing emerge without being built in; in hearing they track what their input allows. The same filters drive the Baby Senses Lab, a free website that shows a user's own images and sounds as a baby of a chosen age might sense them. It is a research and teaching tool, not a diagnostic test.

### 462. [Structured Relevance Determination and Channel Additive Gaussian Processes for Image Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25385v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25385

**作者：** Harald Roßels、Ludovico Scarton

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为图像输入的高斯过程设计结构化超参数共享的 RBF 核：按相邻像素组与颜色通道绑定 lengthscale，降低全各向异性核的参数数量，并提出 channel-additive GP 把潜函数分解为定义在通道子集上的分量，在 MNIST 与低分辨率卫星图像小数据集上验证预测性能与不确定性校准的改善。

**相关性简评：** 其结构化 relevance determination 与通道加性潜函数分解，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的维度筛选、patch/通道级重要性共享以及 latent 状态的分量式表示提供一条可核查的线索，但属较远的回归建模领域，与推理生成和决策的联系需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structured Relevance Determination and Channel Additive Gaussian Processes for Image Data

**abstract/A1：** We introduce radial basis function (RBF) kernels for Gaussian processes that use structured hyperparameter sharing for image-valued inputs. For high-dimensional inputs such as images, a fully anisotropic RBF kernel assigns a separate lengthscale to each input dimension, which can introduce many hyperparameters and may lead to overfitting and poorly calibrated predictive uncertainty when data are limited. We propose structured relevance determination by tying lengthscales across groups of adjacent pixels and within each colour channel. This yields patch-wise and channel-wise constrained anisotropic RBF parametrisations that reduce the number of independently learned lengthscales. We further introduce channel-additive Gaussian processes for multi-channel images and combine them with structured relevance determination, resulting in a parameter-efficient decomposition of the latent function into components defined on channel subsets, enabling some non-local generalisation. The proposed kernels are evaluated on MNIST and a compact binary aircraft-detection dataset of low-resolution RGB satellite image chips. We also show how channel-wise structured relevance determination can be incorporated into convolutional Gaussian processes. We observe improved predictive performance compared to isotropic and fully anisotropic RBF baselines.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/hrosse/structrd-caddgp

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其共享 3D 场景表示在视角变化下持续锚定已观测内容并补全未观测区域，可能为 LVR 中「视觉细节与几何信息是否留在内部状态」以及外部持久状态与 latent 状态的分工提供跨领域线索，可供核查；但该文属视频生成任务，与推理期机制的联系尚属推测。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UniState: Unifying Memory and Intervention for Controllable World Simulation

**abstract/A1：** World models offer increasingly rich environments for exploration, yet intervening in a world while observing the consequences from freely chosen viewpoints remains challenging. We tackle these challenges by introducing UniState, a framework for controllable world simulation built on a unified world-state representation. This representation unifies spatial memory and user interventions. Users specify object motion directly within spatial memory, while independently choosing the camera trajectory from which the resulting world state is observed. This unification makes the relationship between the scene and the requested changes explicit, removing ambiguity between object motion and viewpoint change from the control specification. Crucially, specifying an intervention does not require prescribing every resulting movement: the video model can synthesize additional motion within controlled objects and plausible interactions with their surroundings. We develop training and sampling strategies that help generated videos follow the specified object motion and camera trajectory while preserving this capacity to generate responses beyond the prescribed transformations. Experiments demonstrate more accurate joint object and camera control than the existing methods, alongside qualitative evidence that intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A New Hope for PRNU on Modern Smartphones? Evidence That Device-Specific Fingerprints Survive Computational Photography

**abstract/A1：** Photo Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) is widely regarded as the most reliable marker for source camera identification. Recent studies, however, report high correlations between images and fingerprints from different modern smartphones, which calls into question the discriminative power of PRNU on these devices. Using 30 recent smartphones under controlled acquisition conditions (e.g., no digital zoom), we investigate whether the fingerprint itself is at fault or the way it is compared. We find that a component shared by all fingerprints of the same model inflates the standard signed peak-to-correlation energy (sPCE). To counter this, we propose $Δ$sPCE: the sPCE between a query image and a candidate camera's fingerprint, minus the mean sPCE between that image and the fingerprints of the remaining candidates, in the spirit of T-norm score normalization. $Δ$sPCE improves attribution accuracy, suggesting that the device-specific PRNU signal is still present. Although the limited dataset size and the dependence of $Δ$sPCE on the candidate camera set currently restrict operational applicability, these results suggest that PRNU-based attribution of modern smartphones remains feasible when fingerprints are compared appropriately.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Test-Time Scaling of Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models with Noise-Rejuvenated Sequential Monte Carlo

**abstract/A1：** Test-time scaling of diffusion models with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a promising strategy for sampling under user-specified rewards, such as human preference scores. However, the standard SMC framework typically relies on stochastic proposals and therefore does not directly transfer to flow matching models, in which inference is governed by deterministic ODEs. In this work, we introduce noise-rejuvenated SMC, an inference-time scaling method tailored for text-to-image flow matching models. Our key idea is to perturb each resampled particle by changing its source noise and constructing a new intermediate state using its current endpoint estimate. This moves the particle to another state that remains representable under the flow-matching interpolation form, enabling particle exploration without converting the sampler to an SDE. We further introduce a look-ahead mechanism to refine resampled particles before weighting. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, and Z-Image demonstrate consistent improvements in reward-guided generation, while ablation studies validate the contributions of noise rejuvenation and look-ahead refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/NR-SMC.

</details>

### 467. [SlimFormer++: Token Mixing Where It Matters for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25488v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25488

**作者：** Yang Hong、Lei Zhang、Zhihong Liu、Jianqing Mo、Xujiong Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25488v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25488v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析3D医学分割网络中的块级与阶段级冗余，用CKA和自提的Anatomical Relation Distortion度量各token mixer的表示相似性与关系失真，据此提出SlimFormer++（浅层窗口化Mamba混合、深层仅残差通道MLP、瓶颈处增强混合），在8个CT/MRI/超声数据集上以约5.98M参数取得最高平均Dice。

**相关性简评：** 其「量化表示冗余、按阶段决定何处需要计算」的分析范式，可能为LVR中动态计算分配与内部状态何处保留视觉关系提供评价线索，但论文面向分割、不涉及多模态推理，联系需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SlimFormer++: Token Mixing Where It Matters for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** To determine where computation is needed in volumetric segmentation networks, we analyze block-level redundancy and stage-wise token-mixer contribution. Centered Kernel Alignment reveals high input-output representational similarity within blocks of representative convolutional, hybrid, and Transformer-style segmentation networks. Similarity-guided pruning reduces their parameter counts by 39-75% while decreasing mean Dice by less than 0.4 percentage points. To examine token mixers within blocks, we introduce Anatomical Relation Distortion, which quantifies how bypassing a mixer distorts feature relations between labeled anatomical positions. Applied to an unpruned candidate architecture, Centered Kernel Alignment indicates high representational redundancy in intermediate encoder mixers, whereas Anatomical Relation Distortion shows that they contribute little and the bottleneck mixer most. These findings motivate SlimFormer++, which uses Selective Mixing blocks with windowed Mamba mixing in the first encoder stage and only residual channel MLPs in deeper stages. At the bottleneck, Augmented Mixing injects similarity-weighted sparse long-range context into the axial taps of a depthwise convolution at cost linear in voxel count. Evaluated against 12 baselines across eight public CT, MRI, and ultrasound datasets (1,809 cases), SlimFormer++ achieves the highest mean Dice (87.84%) and lowest mean HD95 (6.50 mm) with the fewest parameters (5.98 million). These results support stage-aware token mixing as a design strategy for improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in volumetric segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/WHHHHHY822/SlimFormerPlusPlus

</details>

### 468. [Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25495v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25495

**作者：** Junyu Chen、Franklin Liu、Moshu Xu、Lijian Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、econ.EM、q-fin.TR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25495v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25495v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LOBGrad：把自回归 RNN 编码器与条件 DDPM 生成器结合做限价订单簿概率预测，并在指数混合等假设下给出一 步噪声预测目标的超额风险 oracle 不等式，在 BTC/USDT、GOOGL、META 上比较队列指标与预测区间。

**相关性简评：** 其「循环隐状态 + 条件扩散生成」及「收缩动态下把条件窗口长度依赖降为隐状态维度依赖」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的生成方式与长度泛化提供概念线索，但属金融时序、无视觉，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapshot models typically lack a learned recurrent encoder and formal statistical guarantees. We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator. In particular, we establish an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. We further show that, under contractive dynamics, the dependence on the conditioning-window length can be reduced to a dependence on the latent-state dimension. Experiments on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META show that LOBGrad improves on its encoder-free diffusion ablation across all reported queue metrics and obtains competitive results against other baselines. It also reproduces the key stylized facts of LOB microstructure, and yields reasonably calibrated queue-based predictive intervals. A stylized downstream task illustrates the potential value of the generated forecasts.

</details>

### 469. [From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25496v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25496

**作者：** Shashank Shekhar、Laurent Jeanpierre、Abdel-Illah Mouaddib

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25496v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25496v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一个语义感知决策框架，把候选动作的「提出—在交互语境下评估—解析为执行结果」显式区分开，用联合动作语言与解释函数将交互语义建模为独立表示层，并以共享人机自主中的咨询、授权等模式作实例，保持与标准 MDP 规划兼容。

**相关性简评：** 该框架把「提议—评估—执行」拆成可复用的显式语义结果单元，可能与 LVR 中候选 latent 推理步骤的生成、验证与停止/采纳决策存在结构类比，其「评估机制与执行动力学解耦」的思路可供核查能否用于组织 latent 假设与视觉证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy

**abstract/A1：** In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for \\textit{interaction semantics}. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 6 tables

</details>

### 470. [Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25501v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25501

**作者：** Rolf Drechsler、Christina Plump

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25501v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25501v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Formal Raising，将以优先级排序的道德价值表示成机器可检验的显式性质，并给出一个 C 语言推理框架：候选行动按性质比较筛选、冲突依给定顺序消解、严格规则不可推翻、不确定性显式报告，并用生命、真诚、伤害、隐私等案例演示，另讨论受 PSL 启发的性质层。

**相关性简评：** 面向状态与时序需求的显式可检验性质层、以及「欠定即显式报告」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及证据不足时的停止与答案选择提供可核查的约束式思路，但原文并不涉及多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI

**abstract/A1：** Alan Turing proposed constructing a \`\`child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 6 figures,

</details>

### 471. [FracTS: Hierarchical and Autoregressive Time Series Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25523v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25523

**作者：** Jiayu Li、Umair Afzal、Zilong Zhao、Milad Abdollahzadeh、Uzair Javaid、Biplab Sikdar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25523v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25523v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FracTS 提出一种分层、从粗到细的自回归多变量时间序列生成模型，借鉴图像分形生成，把 2D 范式改造成 1D 序列的多尺度表示，并在生成中融入自动或指定的时序特征与全局静态特征；在五个数据集上对比七个基线，报告边际分布、预测性 ML 效用与相关性保持方面的改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「粗到细 + 分层自回归 + 多尺度表示」的生成方式，可能与 LVR 中多层级 latent 推理状态的产生与更新（先全局结构后局部细节）存在概念呼应，可供核查；但属时间序列生成这一较远领域，迁移可行性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FracTS: Hierarchical and Autoregressive Time Series Generation

**abstract/A1：** Time series are ubiquitous across different domains, and the growing use of synthetic data for privacy-preserving sharing, data augmentation, and stress testing makes time series generation increasingly important. Early generative approaches are predominantly autoregressive, which can suffer from low sample diversity, error accumulation, and difficulty modeling long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce FracTS, a hierarchical, coarse-to-fine autoregressive model for multivariate time series generation. Inspired by fractal generative modeling developed for images, FracTS adapts the paradigm from 2D to 1D sequences by learning a multi-scale representation that captures global trajectory structure at coarse scales and local dynamics at fine scales while following the autoregressive nature of time series. In contrast to unstructured images, time series are structured, allowing easy automated or designated temporal feature processing optimized for the model, and global (static) feature extraction describing the instances that generate the corresponding time series in the collection. We incorporate them in the generation process to further improve the generation quality. The design naturally handles multivariate dependencies and improves long-horizon temporal coherence without requiring fixed-length inputs. Experiments on five datasets (two conditional, three unconditional) conducted against seven baselines show that FracTS consistently outperforms baselines across marginal distribution and predictive ML utility, and correlation preservation in the unconditional setting. In particular, the predictive ML utility is averagely improved by 100.0% and 75.0-81.0% for unconditional and conditional time series datasets compared to the best baseline (relative error computed on dataset-averaged raw values). Code is available at: https://github.com/BetterdataLabs/fracts.

</details>
