### 472. [From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25530v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25530

**作者：** Jiayan Yang、Ad Feelders、Arno Siebes

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25530v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25530v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究提出一个不确定性感知的 ICU 排班框架：不改动上游患者风险预测模型，而是显式刻画预测不确定性，用 CVaR 度量极端人力短缺风险，再将其嵌入逐小时滚动时域调度策略，在 MIMIC-IV 轨迹上对比确定性启发式与纯反应式基线，并分析成本—短缺权衡与校准漂移下的鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 领域与视觉/多模态推理相距较远，但其把概率输出按风险约束聚合成决策信号的思路，可能为 LVR 中基于不确定性的停止与算力分配提供概念类比，可供核查是否可迁移为「收益—成本」停止准则。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing

**abstract/A1：** Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays. This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions. Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026, Applied Data Science Track

</details>

### 473. [Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25544v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 EPRI 51 机组 72 小时机组组合基准上首次评测 RL，诊断 PPO/DQN 的「过度开机」源自探索噪声，再用模仿 MILP 解加保守微调把 PPO 拉近最优，并以策略的置信决策固定变量来加速 MILP。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，但「学习策略给出高置信决策、交由精确求解器完成剩余搜索」以及模仿与保守微调之间的权衡，可能为 LVR 的动态计算/停止决策与监督设计提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文比较四类概率 AI 天气模型与物理 IFS-ENS 在 2022 年新纪录（极端尾部）事件上的预报技巧，用记录阈值加权的 CRPS 与 Brier 分数按超出深度和 2–10 天提前期评估。

**相关性简评：** 其把尾部技巧、真实极端个例表现与概率校准拆开评分的做法，以及「优势可能来自非超出样本」「不宜把确定性模型的域外失效外推」的提醒，可能为 LVR 的长度泛化与极端样本评价设计提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the record: evaluating probabilistic AI weather forecasts deep in the tail

**abstract/A1：** Can probabilistic artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasts retain skill beyond their training domain? We compare four state-of-the-art AI models (ArchesWeatherGen, U-Cast, WeatherNext2 and GenCast-mini) with the physics-based IFS-ENS over land in 2022, at 1.5° resolution and lead times of 2--10 days. Monthly ERA5 records from 1979--2021 define common historical boundaries, and we characterize new records set in 2022 by their depth, i.e., the exceedance margin relative to local historical variability. Two proper scores, record-threshold weighted CRPS and Brier score, assess the magnitude and probability of record exceedances across all eligible cases, retaining both missed extremes and false alarms. Verified against ERA5, AI models outperform IFS-ENS for heat and cold records at almost every lead and depth. For heat, the advantage strengthens with depth, partly because IFS-ENS over-forecasts deep records, and largely persists for deeper records under HRES-fc0 verification. For wind, gains erode for deeper records and longer leads. Better tail scores can nevertheless coexist with aggregate probability deficits or surpluses, and some improvements arise chiefly on non-exceedances. Increasing underprediction on progressively more extreme observed subsets can also arise through outcome selection, even for an ideal conditional-mean forecast. These findings establish that native probabilistic AI ensembles retain, and for heat increase, their advantage over IFS-ENS as thresholds move beyond local records, although all advantages narrow with lead time. They caution against generalizing the extrapolation failure reported for deterministic AI forecasts to probabilistic systems, and motivate common verification conventions that separate comparative tail skill, performance on realized extremes, and probabilistic calibration.

</details>

**title/T1：** Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions

**abstract/A1：** System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. A first training on real documents is summarized; full results on real data in production are left to a companion paper

### 476. [FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25558v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25558

**作者：** Josif Grabocka

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25558v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25558v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FTFM 为表格基础模型提出因式化计算：用每行、每列各一个 contextual latent 交互更新 cell 表示，在不做逐 cell 直接注意力的前提下保留 cell 级状态，并在 TabArena、BeyondArena 等基准上取得有竞争力的分类性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留 cell 级表示还是坍缩为行级固定嵌入」的取舍与 LVR 关注的信息坍缩、细粒度视觉证据保留问题相似，行列因式化 latent 或可作为减少 latent 间重复注意力同时保住细粒度状态的类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are becoming a powerful alternative to conventional tabular learning, adapting to new datasets in context without task-specific training. Current architectures, however, face a trade-off: models that preserve cell-level representations are expensive because they repeatedly attend across rows and columns, while faster models collapse each row into a fixed embedding and lose this fine-grained state. We introduce Factorized Tabular Foundation Models (FTFM), which preserve cell representations while factorizing their computation through one contextual latent per row and one per column. Cells no longer attend to one another directly; instead, each cell is updated through the interaction of its row and column latents, reducing repeated attention while retaining feature-specific information. FTFM achieves competitive predictive performance in tabular classification on major benchmarks such as TabArena and BeyondArena.

</details>

### 477. [Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25563v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25563

**作者：** Yichen Liu、Xiaochong Jiang、Haoran Yu、Lifei Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25563v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25563v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 IoT 场景下 LLM agent 的在线工具接地：把已指定的工具调用绑定到某个物理设备，用上下文赌博机加自适应上下文划分与分层端点树复用执行反馈，在任务成功与服务成本间权衡，并给出有限时域遗憾界与奖励统计的差分隐私结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「在多个候选端点中选择哪个能返回有用观测、并权衡成功与成本」的在线决策形式，可能启发 LVR/VLM 推理中 LOOK 阶段视觉证据筛选与获取成本的建模，可供核查；但不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT

**abstract/A1：** The Internet of Things (IoT) gives large language model (LLM) agents access to physical observations, but one requested capability is usually offered by several devices, and the agent's plan does not say which one to call. Existing work retrieves relevant tools and checks plan feasibility, without learning which eligible device returns a useful observation. Unlike previous works, we study online tool grounding: binding an already specified tool call to one physical endpoint under service cost and device participation constraints. We propose a framework that learns which physical device should execute each agent-issued call. It formulates selection as a contextual bandit problem and combines adaptive context partitions with hierarchical endpoint trees, so that execution feedback is reused across related requests and devices. Selection balances task success against service cost while respecting device capability, authorization, battery reserves, and availability. Gaussian reward aggregation provides an optional mechanism for protecting individual feedback values. Theoretical results establish a finite-horizon regret bound and differential privacy for released reward statistics under fixed, reward-independent assignments. In a simulated loading-dock workload, the proposed router achieves higher step success and better cost-adjusted service, at lower simulated device energy and latency, than nearest-device, advertised-quality, UCB1, and LinUCB selection.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一个 agent 执行框架（harness），把原始目标、可修订计划与执行记录分离，由 planner 分派任务、worker 产出结果、reviewer 对照原请求决定提交还是继续追加工作，并在终端任务、临床回答、应用构建与科学问答上做跨域评测及成本、延迟分析。

**相关性简评：** 其 reviewer「提交或要求追加工作」的决策机制以及推理成本、延迟与回退案例的记录方式，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与计算成本权衡提供类比线索，供人工核查；但该工作不涉及视觉表征或 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness

**abstract/A1：** Completing complex tasks with language-model agents requires coordinating planning, execution, and review so the final result addresses the user's original objective. We present an agent execution harness that keeps the original objective separate from a revisable plan and an execution record. A planner assigns scoped tasks, workers produce outputs and artifacts, and a reviewer examines results against the original request before submitting or requesting additional work. Reusable domain-specific instructions guide these roles and are refined during construction using task inputs and execution trajectories, without official grading feedback. We evaluate complete harness configurations across terminal tasks, clinical responses, application building, and scientific questions. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the harness passes 83 of 89 instances (93.26%); on HealthBench Professional, a Fable-configured system achieves a length-adjusted rubric score of 69.63 across 525 tasks. In a 53-task paired HealthBench comparison, the Fable-configured harness achieves an aggregate score 19.89 points higher than direct completion, despite a $-1.46$-point median task-level change; mean inference cost rises from \\$0.29 to \\$2.13 per task. We combine these outcomes with latency, documented instruction revisions, and reviewer decisions. Evaluating outcomes alongside execution trajectories and resource use clarifies how coordination supports task completion, where it introduces regressions, and at what cost.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25570

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DiffGround：基于冻结 MLLM 的零样本视频问答定位框架，先用 action cue 把问题转成动作检索目标并据此让 VLM 选关键帧，再用免训练的 Semantic Diff Refinement 依据相邻 SigLIP2 嵌入差异从稀疏预测中恢复完整动作片段，在 NExT-GQA 与 STAR 上评估。

**相关性简评：** 领域较远（视频时序定位），但其 cue 引导的关键帧筛选可视为视觉证据筛选线索，用相邻嵌入语义差异扩展稀疏证据的做法或与 latent 相似度中内容/位置因素的考察有关，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DiffGround: Semantic Difference-Guided Zero-Shot Video Question Grounding

**abstract/A1：** Video Question Grounding (VideoQG) requires both accurate question answering and precise temporal localization. Existing supervised methods rely on costly temporal annotations, while existing zero-shot approaches are primarily designed for Video Question Answering (VQA) and are not optimized for temporal grounding. We propose DiffGround, an action-driven zero-shot framework built upon frozen Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our framework first predicts an answer-relevant action cue that transforms the input question into an explicit semantic target for grounding. Action Cue converts a reasoningoriented question into an action-centric retrieval query. Guided by the action cue, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) efficiently selects informative keyframes for reasoning. Finally, we introduce Semantic Diff Refinement, a training-free temporal refinement method that exploits semantic differences between neighboring SigLIP2 embeddings to recover complete action segments from sparse predictions. Extensive experiments on NExT-GQA and STAR show that DiffGround consistently outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods, establishing a new state of the art for Video Question Grounding.

**comment/C1：** This paper is accepted by ACCV 2026. We plan to publicly release the source code at https://github.com/steven413d/DiffGround

### 480. [Distributionally-Robust Policy Learning with Observational Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25591v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25591

**作者：** Debmalya Mandal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25591v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25591v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究观测数据下的分布鲁棒策略学习：在 f-散度球内最大化最坏情况策略价值，提出基于交叉拟合双重鲁棒得分与 DRO 求解器的估计方法，并证明 DRO 遗憾的 O(n^{-1/2}) 率、双重鲁棒性，以及在 Tsybakov 型 margin 条件下达到的快速率。

**相关性简评：** 属于因果决策与非视觉领域，但其「分布偏移下的最坏情况保证」与「margin 条件决定收敛率」的分析框架，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹监督需求量、分布外泛化评价及 latent 贡献分配（双重鲁棒得分）等问题的表述方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distributionally-Robust Policy Learning with Observational Data

**abstract/A1：** Policy learning from observational data is fundamental to applications ranging from personalized medicine to welfare-program targeting, but standard approaches optimize empirical performance and may fail when the deployment distribution differs from the training distribution. We study \\emph{distributionally-robust policy learning}: given observational data, we seek a policy $π\\in Π$ that maximizes the worst-case policy value over an $f$-divergence ball of radius $ρ$ around the data-generating distribution. We propose an estimator built on cross-fitted doubly-robust scores for the conditional treatment effect, paired with a DRO solver that handles \\texttt{KL}, $χ^2$, and \\texttt{CVaR} ambiguity sets. We establish two convergence guarantees. First, the estimated policy attains the standard $\\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/2})$ rate on its DRO regret, and inherits the doubly-robust property -- the rate continues to hold whenever either the outcome model or the propensity model is consistently estimated, even at slow nonparametric rates. We then propose a sample-splitting bias-correction algorithm derived from the Lagrangian dual, and show that under a Tsybakov-style margin condition on the treatment-effect, the estimator attains a fast rate of $\\widetilde{O}(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})$ , interpolating between $\\widetilde{O}(1/\\sqrt{n})$ and $\\widetilde{O}(1/n)$ as the margin parameter $α$ ranges over $\[0,\\infty)$. To our knowledge, this is the first work to incorporate a margin condition into the analysis of distributionally-robust policy learning, and the first to obtain fast rates in this setting. Empirically, on synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments calibrated to a welfare-to-work program, distributional robustness yields meaningful improvements over empirical welfare maximization when training and test distributions differ.

**comment/C1：** To appear at NeurIPS 2026. Generative AI was used only to polish writing and implement the main algorithm

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 PRISM，把专家定义的化学先验（疏水、静电、极化、子结构）转化为关系型教师信号，用 KL 散度匹配基于距离的邻域分布来无标签预训练四个编码器，以提升溶解度预测在未见溶质、溶剂及混合溶剂上的 OOD 泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其「把关系先验转成自监督信号、约束编码器保留邻域关系结构」的做法，可能与 LVR 中如何让内部状态保留实体与几何关系、以及表示几何的监督方式存在可核查的类比线索，但领域相距较远，仅为潜在启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PRISM: Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling to Enhance Solubility OOD Generalization

**abstract/A1：** Solubility depends on intermolecular interactions between solutes and solvents, and is central to drug discovery, chemical and materials process engineering. Its prediction requires out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization to unseen solutes, solvents, and solvent mixtures, where supervised methods suffer from data scarcity, and existing self-supervised methods do not explicitly learn chemically meaningful relations. Learning chemically meaningful relational information without labels can alleviate data scarcity and improve OOD generalization, but remains challenging. We introduce Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling (PRISM) and apply it to solubility OOD generalization. PRISM is a label-free pretraining framework that converts expert-defined chemical priors into relational teachers. For solubility prediction, it trains four encoders to preserve the population-level relational information from priors capturing hydrophobic, electrostatic, polarizability, and substructural effects, using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to match distance-based neighborhood distributions during pretraining. Across scaffold, solute, and solvent OOD settings, PRISM matches or surpasses supervised and self-supervised baselines. Under mixed-solvent OOD, freezing the four PRISM encoders and training a lightweight fusion-and-composition head outperforms strong baselines and substantially reduces run-to-run variation. Ablations and control studies confirm that gains stem from chemically meaningful relational structures baked into the encoders by PRISM. We expect this strategy of turning relational priors into self-supervision signals to extend beyond solubility prediction to domains where chemically or biologically meaningful relational priors are available.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026, accepted

**内容简述：** 该论文提出「受控涌现」的统一研究纲领，把局部规则与宏观行为的关系表述为正问题（由局部规则解释宏观行为）与反问题（由目标反解可控规则与读出机制），并给出可控性、可复现性、可形式化三个度量坐标、三条可检验假设与一个可行性判据，附带仅验证协议可执行性的小规模试点实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「反问题＋读出机制」的表述可能与 LVR 中由期望推理目标反解 latent 状态生成与读出方式的问题设定有概念联系，约束与自组织之间的权衡也可能类比 latent 工作区的信息坍缩与信息保留，但属跨领域启发，具体可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Forward/Inverse Duality of Controlled Emergence:A Computational Design Program from Explanation to Engineering

**abstract/A1：** The macroscopic capabilities of intelligent systems arise from the local interactions of many simple units. When such systems are deployed in the real world, their behaviour must nevertheless be constrained, leaving designers caught between releasing adaptability and preventing loss of control, yet without formal tools to resolve the dilemma. This paper proposes a unified research program for controlled emergence that restates this tension as a pair of dual problems: the forward problem explains macroscopic behaviour from local rules, and the inverse problem solves for controllable rules and readout mechanisms from a desired target. We take an augmented quintuple as the formal object shared by both ends, and decompose \`\`engineering'' into three independently measurable coordinates: controllability, reproducibility, and degree of formalizability. On this basis we give three testable working hypotheses (critical scale; the cooperation and trade-off between constraint and adaptability; minimal constraint) and one feasibility criterion, which reduce inverse design from unconstrained optimization to interval checking. The program takes explicit failure boundaries as its premise, does not pursue complete control, and always preserves the system's room for self-organization. The reduced pilot experiment attached to this paper serves only to verify the executability of the research protocol and does not constitute a statistical test of the working hypotheses. This design language generalizes to multi-agent artificial intelligence, the industrial internet, and emergency response systems, all of which must confront emergence and controllability at once.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 在森林长期 LiDAR 位置识别中把候选检索与精细匹配分离，诊断 Scan Context 因植被重复与地形起伏产生的结构混叠，并提出保留环—扇区拓扑、改为编码地形相对垂直概率分布的 TNVD-SC，同时给出无损计数编码与分层 Jensen-Shannon 搜索以降低描述子体积与时延。

**相关性简评：** 其「先粗检索候选、再精细匹配」的两阶段诊断与压缩式搜索，或可供核查 LVR 中证据获取（LOOK）与候选筛选的成本—收益权衡；但属机器人定位领域，迁移性需进一步确认。

**title/T1：** TNVD-SC: Diagnosing Scan Context Failures in Forests with Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distributions

**abstract/A1：** Long-term LiDAR place recognition in forests is difficult because repetitive vegetation and uneven terrain create severe structural aliasing. We diagnose Scan Context (SC) by separating candidate retrieval from fine matching: on the standardized TreeLoc++ Wild-Places protocol, a TNVD support key places a valid location in the top-25 set for approximately 99% of queries, while conventional SC matching on those candidates reaches only 61.84% mean R@1. With an identical raw-SC candidate set, terrain normalization improves max-height cells by only 1.21 points but vertical-distribution cells by 19.72 points. These observations motivate Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distribution Scan Context (TNVD-SC), which preserves the SC ring-sector topology while encoding terrain-relative vertical probability distributions. Under the standardized TreeLoc++ protocol, TNVD-SC reaches 91.83% mean R@1 and attains the highest R@1 mean and R@1 stability among the compared methods, while TreeLoc++ remains stronger in mean MR, MF1, and AUC. The unchanged method reaches 85.14% mean R@1 on the four-session CVTNet-style NCLT evaluation. A lossless count-coded implementation with exact hierarchical Jensen-Shannon search reduces descriptor payload by 3.86x and compute latency by 23.8% without changing the audited retrieval outputs.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A "feature ODE" describing the learning behavior of shallow MLPs on simple functions

**abstract/A1：** We study the gradient flow training dynamics of two-layer multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on anisotropic Gaussian data. Even in this simple setting, solving the dynamics in full is notoriously difficult, so we try something different. We propose a "feature ODE" that might be intuitively expected to describe the learning dynamics of a shallow MLP. We find that MLPs trained to learn simple target functions (low-order Hermite polynomials and staircase functions) actually roughly follow the loss trajectories from this feature ODE. This agreement is a surprise because of the size of the simplification and the fact that it does not come from a rigorous chain of approximations. We discuss this surprise and speculate on its reasons and uses.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as part of the HiLD workshop, ICML 2026

</details>

### 485. [Can Metadata Fix the Gauge? Calibration Turns Sparse Multi-Source Learning from Sparse PCA into Sparse Mean Recovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25663v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25663

**作者：** Yirong Xiang、Yibo Zhou

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在带源特定符号 gauge 的稀疏高斯多源模型中研究：源标签本身不足，未校准的跨源汇总会抵消均值信号使问题退化为 sparse PCA；作者提出 AlignedMass 量化元数据诱导对齐所恢复的一阶信号，给出统计与计算分离，并用合成与真实特征/传感器实验检验。

**相关性简评：** 其「符号 gauge 对齐与校准元数据恢复被抵消信号」的表示几何视角，可能与 LVR 中多源或多路径 latent 状态的对齐、信息坍缩与视觉证据筛选问题存在概念联系，可供核查；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Metadata Fix the Gauge? Calibration Turns Sparse Multi-Source Learning from Sparse PCA into Sparse Mean Recovery

**abstract/A1：** Source labels tell us where a sample came from, but not how that source oriented its coordinates. In a sparse Gaussian multi-source model with source-specific sign gauges, that distinction changes the learning problem. Without calibration, pooling across sources erases the mean signal, and the source-labelled experiment reduces to sparse PCA. With task-independent relative-gauge metadata, synchronization aligns sources and the same observations become a sparse mean problem. We formalize the value of metadata through AlignedMass, which quantifies how much first-order signal a metadata-induced alignment restores. Source labels create only limited AlignedMass, whereas valid calibration can create AlignedMass proportional to the full sample size. This yields a statistical separation in micro-source regimes and, under standard sparse-PCA hardness assumptions, a computational separation as well. Synthetic experiments check the predicted scaling; controlled real-feature and physical sensor studies examine sign cancellation, separately acquired calibration, and reuse across tasks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted as NeurIPS 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** HyperTaxa 将全基因组编码为多尺度超光谱 k-mer 转换场，并用 Node2Vec→MDS 两阶段把表示对齐到分类学语义空间，以支持零样本与广义零样本的微生物分类推断。

**相关性简评：** 其「多尺度编码 + 同时保持局部图结构与全局层级距离」的表示对齐思路，以及面向未见类别的开集泛化评测协议，可能为 LVR 中 latent 表示的几何结构、层级信息保留与未见场景泛化的评价设计提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HyperTaxa: Multiscale Genome Representations for Generalized Microbial Taxonomic Inference

**abstract/A1：** Reliable microbial taxonomic inference is challenged by the rapid growth of newly sequenced organisms and incomplete reference coverage. While alignment- and database-driven tools remain essential for reference-backed identification, they are not designed for learned inference over species absent from genome-level training. We introduce HyperTaxa, a taxonomy-aligned representation learning framework for open-set microbial taxonomic inference. HyperTaxa encodes whole genomes as multiscale hyperspectral k-mer transition fields and aligns these representations to a taxonomy-derived semantic space using a two-stage Node2Vec-to-MDS procedure that combines local graph structure with global hierarchical distance preservation. The resulting space supports zero-shot inference over species excluded from genome-level training but represented in the taxonomy, generalized zero-shot inference over seen and unseen species, and cascaded genus-to-species prediction. Across benchmark and large-scale disjoint-species evaluations, HyperTaxa improves taxonomic prediction over pseudo-image and transformer-graph baselines, with the strongest gains at higher taxonomic ranks. Ablations further show that multiscale transition encoding and taxonomy-aware alignment are key contributors to generalization. These results position HyperTaxa as a complementary taxonomy-aware representation and candidate-generation framework for microbial identification under incomplete reference coverage and open-set uncertainty.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to BIBM 2026

</details>

### 487. [MT-CC: Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Asymmetric Calibration Behavior in Class-Incremental Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25689v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25689

**作者：** Sungjun Yun、Yonghee Choi、Dong-Jun Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25689v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25689v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MT-CC 后处理校准框架，用轻量分组网络按置信度统计与任务信号生成多组温度参数，并加入 GDCA 正则，缓解类增量学习中置信度变化与精度退化不同步造成的非对称误校准。

**相关性简评：** 置信度校准与分布随时间演化的处理，可能为 LVR 中基于可信度的停止决策及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本权衡提供线索，其分组温度机制能否用于 latent 推理状态的可信度估计可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MT-CC: Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Asymmetric Calibration Behavior in Class-Incremental Learning

**abstract/A1：** As deep neural networks are required to continuously adapt to evolving data, class-incremental learning (CIL) has become an active research area. However, most existing works primarily focus on improving accuracy while overlooking confidence calibration, which measures the trustworthiness of the model's predictions. Although temperature scaling (TS) is effective for static calibration, it has rarely been explored in continual settings where data distributions evolve over time. In this paper, we introduce Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Continual Calibration (MT-CC), a novel post-hoc calibration framework that addresses the asymmetric calibration behavior in CIL, where the rate of confidence changes does not align with the rate of accuracy degradation across tasks, leading to different levels of miscalibration. Our key contribution is to design multiple temperature parameters through a lightweight grouping network that separates samples by confidence statistics and task-aware signals in CIL. Furthermore, a Groupwise Difference-between-Confidence-and-Accuracy (GDCA) regularization is incorporated to promote intra-group consistency. Experiments demonstrate that MT-CC significantly improves calibration performance while maintaining accuracy, offering a principled framework for reliable continual learning.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 28 pages

</details>

**title/T1：** CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究固定点随时间漂移的线性随机逼近：在常数步长下给出迭代点与对应固定点累积平方误差的上界与下界，并设计仅依赖一个有界无偏观测、无需预知噪声水平与漂移幅度的自适应步长方法，最后应用于变化环境下的表格 TD 值函数估计。

**相关性简评：** 若把 latent 推理的循环/迭代状态更新视为向某个（可能随深度或上下文漂移的）目标表示的随机逼近，其噪声—漂移权衡与无需先验噪声知识即可自适应选步长的结论，可能为动态计算分配与停止决策提供概念线索，具体对应关系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stochastic Tracking of Drifting Affine Fixed Points

**abstract/A1：** Linear stochastic approximation (SA) is widely used to estimate fixed points from noisy observations, but most finite-time analyses assume that the underlying operator remains fixed. We study linear SA with time-varying affine operators, where the fixed points change over time and the observation noise may be correlated across rounds. For constant-stepsize updates, we establish a bound on the cumulative expected squared distance between the iterates and the corresponding fixed points. The bound accounts for the initial error, observation noise, and changes in the fixed points over time. We also establish lower bounds for scalar Gaussian models, showing that, under specified conditions, a suitably chosen constant stepsize achieves the smallest possible worst-case cumulative error up to constant factors, even compared with estimators that use future observations. These results further quantify the effect of temporal correlation on estimation accuracy. Since choosing an appropriate stepsize generally requires knowledge of the noise level and how much the fixed points change, we develop an adaptive method that uses an additional bounded, unbiased observation of the fixed point to achieve an almost optimal algorithm without needing the knowledge of the noise level and the fixed point variation over time. Finally, we apply our results to value-function estimation using synchronous tabular temporal-difference learning in changing environments, assuming generative-model access and a common invariant distribution.

**comment/C1：** 50 pages, 2 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出三阶段审计，把「他人凭据进入提示」「agent 实际据其行动」「受害者账户状态改变」分开测量，在 AppWorld 中考察共享长期记忆导致的跨用户凭据误用，并发现逐条标注凭据所有者能大幅降低误用。

**相关性简评：** 其将「信息出现在上下文」与「模型是否真正使用它」分离的审计与配对干预设计，可能启发 LVR 中区分 latent 表示可用性与实际因果贡献、以及用行为而非可用性做评价的问题，可供核查；但与视觉推理领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Whose Credential Is It? How Owner Attribution in Agent MemoryShapes Cross-User Account Misuse

**abstract/A1：** Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 14 figures, 12 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Low-Entropy Visual Identity（LEVI）框架，用 Visual Identity Spaces 区分「身份事实」与「允许的外观变化」，并设计可验证的声明式语法 VVG，据此构建覆盖 6 个领域、1,375 个任务的图像生成基准，从最终像素检验输出是否满足身份要求；十个模型配置中最高整体通过率仅 58.69%。

**相关性简评：** 其「身份必要信息 vs 允许变化」的划分与基于像素的规则化验证，可供核查在 latent 视觉表示中如何界定内容保真与无关扰动，以及如何用证据判断视觉信息是否被真正使用；但属图像生成评测，未涉及推理状态，联系仅为概念性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LEVI: Benchmarking Visual Identity Fidelity with Verifiable Low-Entropy Constructs

**abstract/A1：** Modern generative models can produce visually plausible images while violating exact identity constraints. Evaluating such failures requires distinguishing violations of the requested identity from permissible variation in appearance. We introduce Low-Entropy Visual Identity (LEVI), which characterizes visual identities determined by compact facts and explicit rules. The low-entropy requirement concerns identity uncertainty, while appearance may remain diverse. We formulate identity fidelity in terms of the probability that a conditional image distribution assigns to the identities permitted by the prompt. Visual Identity Spaces (VIS) formalize this distinction by specifying admissible identity values and which different realizations express the same identity. Building on this formulation, we develop Verifiable Visual Grammar (VVG), a declarative language whose typed primitives and compositional constraints describe identity-bearing structures. Using this grammar, we build a benchmark for image generation. It assesses each output against the task's identity requirements, drawing evidence from the final pixels. The curated benchmark contains 1,375 tasks spanning 120 base identity spaces across six domains. Among ten evaluated model configurations, the highest whole-task pass rate is 58.69%. These results reveal a persistent gap between visually plausible images and faithful realization of their specified identities. Project page (forthcoming): https://maxiao0234.github.io/LEVI/.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 492. [Anatomy of Off-Policy Policy Gradient: Importance Sampling, KL Regularization, and Baselines](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25725v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25725

**作者：** Haoqun Cao、Yurun Yuan、Tengyang Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25725v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25725v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从理论上研究 LLM 后训练中 off-policy policy gradient 的合法性，分析重要性采样、KL 正则与 baseline 在分布偏移下的作用，证明一致性需轨迹级重要性加权或带最优软价值 baseline 的 KL 正则，并给出 GRPG 的等价形式与 regret 界。

**相关性简评：** 其关于 off-policy 修正、KL 正则与 baseline 悲观化的结论，可能为 latent 轨迹式推理训练的贡献分配与监督目标设计提供线索，但该文不涉及视觉或多模态内部状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Anatomy of Off-Policy Policy Gradient: Importance Sampling, KL Regularization, and Baselines

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning has become a central tool for large language model (LLM) post-training, where policy gradient methods are routinely deployed off-policy, even though vanilla policy gradient assumes on-policy sampling. We study when such off-policy deployment is justified, and what roles its core ingredients, including importance sampling, KL regularization, and baselines, play in handling the resulting distribution shift. We show that for a general class of off-policy policy gradient updates, consistency, in the sense that the optimal policy remains a stationary point, requires one of two structures at the optimal policy: trajectory-level importance weighting, which suffers from the well-known curse of horizon, or KL regularization with a baseline equal to the optimal soft value, instantiated by the grouped mean. Focusing on the KL route, we identify it with the group-relative policy gradient (GRPG) update, establish an equivalence to a trajectory-level Bellman residual minimization objective, and obtain a finite-sample regret bound under all-policy coverage. This also gives a theoretical account of a variant of the empirically successful GRPO objective. We further uncover a hidden role of baselines in the off-policy setting: a constant shift in the baseline implements pessimism, the standard remedy in offline RL for partial data coverage. We instantiate this via the asymmetric REINFORCE objective, and connect it to the game-theoretic offline RL framework, showing a regret bound with single-policy coverage. Together, these results offer a unified theoretical view of off-policy policy gradient in LLM post-training and connect it to classical ideas in offline RL.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 BMD 框架，用 LLM 生成候选模型族、数值引擎拟合参数并按模型证据加权，再以联合期望信息增益选择下一步实验条件，同时把更新后的信念与残差诊断反馈给 LLM 引导下一轮假设，在四个科学发现基准上取得更低预测误差。

**相关性简评：** 其「信念更新—信息增益选实验—反馈引导假设」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中证据获取（LOOK）与停止决策（STOP）的价值评估提供一个可核查的形式化视角，但属远领域线索，需人工核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bayesian Model Discovery with Language Models: Closing the Loop between Hypotheses and Experiments

**abstract/A1：** Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, with ablations supporting numerical feedback and the joint objective.

</details>

**作者：** Jiawen Wang、Cheng Xue、Peng Zhang、Jochen Renz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25758v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25758v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Recurrent Summary Memory（RSM）：一种 in-context 强化学习策略，只精确关注近期交互的工作缓冲区，并携带固定容量摘要；缓冲填满时用旧摘要与缓冲重写摘要并清空缓冲，使内存与单步开销不随任务长度增长，从而在长时任务上维持适应性能。

**相关性简评：** 「固定容量摘要＋周期性重写、仅保留工作缓冲」的状态维护方式，可能与 LVR 中受限 latent 工作区的长度泛化、压缩与信息保留的权衡相关，可供核查能否迁移为推理期 latent 状态的维护与更新机制；但该工作在 RL 部分可观测任务上，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Remember Less, Adapt Longer: Bounded-State In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Summary Memory

**abstract/A1：** In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables agents to adapt to new tasks without parameter updates, relying on memory to retain what they learn from experience. For agents operating continually, existing approaches using memory trade off bounded cost against access to past experience. Approaches using growing memories, such as full-history attention and accumulating summaries, incur storage and per-decision costs that increase with task length. Fixed-size memories bound storage but restrict access: sliding windows discard older steps, while recurrent networks compress even recent interactions into a hidden state. We introduce Recurrent Summary Memory (RSM), a Transformer policy that attends exactly to a short working buffer of recent interactions and carries a fixed-capacity summary of earlier experience. When the buffer fills, RSM rewrites the summary from its previous contents and the buffer, then clears the buffer, so deployment memory and per-decision cost stay $O(1)$ in task length. On long-running partially observable tasks, frozen RSM policies sustain their adapted performance for eight times the training horizon with about 1% of full-history memory, ending ahead of every evaluated baseline while growing memories deteriorate. When the task configuration changes mid-run, RSM re-adapts better than growing and recurrent memories. Clearing the summary or blocking the policy's access to it removes its benefit, while swapping in another task's summary steers behaviour towards that task. Together, these results show that our fixed-capacity summary can sustain in-context adaptation far beyond the training horizon.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 OpenSaC：一个开源 Python 库与配套「Search as Code」skill，让深度研究型 agent 通过编写程序组合搜索、源阅读、重排、模型调用与本地处理，并把选出的观察结果交回推理；在 BrowseComp 与 WideSearch 上与 Codex 内置网页搜索比较执行时间、token 消耗和准确率。

**相关性简评：** 论文既无视觉/多模态成分也无 latent 状态，但与 LVR 中「获取证据、选择观察并复用」的推理流程有间接联系：其用程序显式组织检索、重排与局部处理并保留证据供检查复用的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与外部证据获取策略提供可核查的类比，需较多转化工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OpenSaC: A Python Library for Search as Code in Deep Research Agents

**abstract/A1：** Deep research agents investigate complex questions through iterative search, source examination, and evidence synthesis. A conventional workflow alternates reasoning with individual search and reading actions. Search as Code introduces a new paradigm: agents write programs that compose search, source reading, reranking, model calls, and local processing, returning selected observations for further reasoning. To support this workflow in existing coding agents, we present OpenSaC, an open-source Python library with a companion Search as Code skill. Configurable capability interfaces let agents combine these operations while retaining evidence for inspection and reuse. Compared with standard Codex using its built-in web search, the OpenSaC configuration uses less execution time and fewer model tokens on BrowseComp and WideSearch, with higher accuracy on BrowseComp and slightly lower row F1 on WideSearch. We aim to lower the barrier to adopting Search as Code and provide an open foundation for community development and transparent research on deep research agents.

### 496. [Detection Augmented Learning In Non-Stationary Bandit Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25782v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25782

**作者：** Argyrios Gerogiannis、Yu-Han Huang、Subhonmesh Bose、Venugopal V. Veeravalli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25782v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25782v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Detection Augmented Learning 这一黑盒模块化框架，将 bandit 算法、变化检测器与强制探索策略组合，用于未知环境变化下的非平稳 bandit；给出把平稳设定 regret 迁移到分段平稳设定的界，并在九类设定上做实验。

**相关性简评：** 其「检测到分布变化才触发再探索、并由算法驱动缩短检测延迟」的思路，可能与 LVR 中判断内部状态或缓存失效、进而决定是否重新获取视觉证据（LOOK/STOP 触发条件）的问题有概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Detection Augmented Learning In Non-Stationary Bandit Environments

**abstract/A1：** We study the problem of non-stationary bandits without knowledge of the environmental changes. We propose Detection Augmented Learning (DAL) a black-box paradigm that comprises three modular components: a bandit algorithm, a change detector, and a forced exploration schedule. This modular design enables its applicability across a broad spectrum of bandit problems, from classical to highly structured settings. First, we provide theoretical insights into DAL's strong empirical performance: a single regret bound shows that DAL transfers the regret of its stationary input to the piecewise stationary setting, attaining or improving the best known bounds in every setting considered. We further identify conditions under which DAL performs well in drifting environments. Then, we showcase DAL's practical performance and versatility through extensive experimentation in which DAL consistently surpasses all state-of-the-art methods, both prior-free and prior-based, across diverse non-stationary scenarios in nine bandit settings. Finally, we investigate the effectiveness of the forced exploration and show that a bandit-driven strategy improves performance and shortens detection delay.

### 497. [SAR: Learning Global Item-Space Matching and Geometry-Aware Placement Ranking for Buffered Online 3D Bin Packing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25795v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25795

**作者：** Xinpeng Lei、Jin Zhang、Yizhe Yang、Yihong Duan、Fucheng Wan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25795v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25795v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SAR 框架用于带缓冲的在线 3D 装箱：用体素 token 空间编码器让 picker 在不输入候选放置的前提下做全局物品—空间匹配，再由 loader 依据候选几何与局部特征排序放置方案，两阶段在共享的长期回报下联合优化。

**相关性简评：** 其「如何在物品选择与放置评估两阶段间分配空间推理」以及反事实分析刻画选择的长期收益，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 的计算分配、latent 空间状态表示与信用分配提供类比线索，但任务领域相距较远，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAR: Learning Global Item-Space Matching and Geometry-Aware Placement Ranking for Buffered Online 3D Bin Packing

**abstract/A1：** Online 3D bin packing with a bounded buffer requires irreversible item-selection and placement decisions under limited knowledge of future arrivals. Feasibility alone is insufficient, as feasible actions can produce different residual-space structures and subsequent packing opportunities. A central architectural question is how to allocate spatial reasoning between item selection and placement evaluation. We propose Spatial Affordance Retrieval (SAR), a novel learning-based framework that coordinates global item-space matching with geometry-aware placement ranking. A voxel-token spatial encoder represents 3D container occupancy, enabling a picker to match buffered items to the residual space without requiring item-specific placement proposals as inputs. After item selection, a loader ranks feasible rotation-position candidates using candidate geometry, local geometric features (LGF), and inter-candidate comparison, without directly accessing global spatial tokens. The feasible candidate set connects the two stages, which are jointly optimized under a shared long-horizon packing return. On the Random, JD, and SF datasets, the best SAR variants improve utilization over the strongest evaluated online baselines by 0.96-4.20 percentage points under the no-buffer setting (K=1). With a buffer (K=5), the best utilization rates across SAR variants reach 93.55%, 91.04%, and 90.41%, respectively. Ablations support the complementary roles of global item-space matching and geometry-aware placement evaluation, counterfactual analysis suggests that learned item selection favors greater future packing potential, and experiments demonstrate compatibility with multiple candidate generators.

</details>

### 498. [A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25843v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25843

**作者：** Felix Buecheler、Gerardo Berbeglia、Mingyu Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25843v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25843v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「价格等价」（PE）审计：在配对、位置受控的强制选择中不断抬高被线索商品的价格，直到其被选中概率降到一半，以该溢价量化卖家线索对 LLM 购物代理决策的影响，并在 11 万余次试验、七个模型（含直接输出选择概率的决策型模型 Jev）与两个品类上给出各模型的线索-价格画像。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，但其「策略条件下的等价阈值」把受天花板限制的选择率换算成可比较的影响强度，可能为衡量视觉证据或 latent 内容对答案的实际因果贡献提供评价思路，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly asked to shop on a user's behalf, which lets seller-controlled content such as badges, endorsements, and framing steer what they recommend. That poses the question at the core of generative engine optimization (GEO): not whether seller content shifts an agent's choice, but how much. The usual gauge of that influence, how often a cue wins the choice, has a blind spot: once a cue is strong enough to be picked almost every time, the choice rate can no longer show how much stronger one cue is than another. We introduce price-equivalent (PE) auditing, which removes this ceiling by pricing the cue in money. In a counterbalanced, position-controlled forced choice, we raise the cued product's price until it is chosen only half the time, and report that premium as the cue's price-equivalent: a formally defined, policy-conditioned parity threshold that makes very different cues comparable. Priced this way, cues that look equally strong at equal price differ by a wide margin, so choice-rate audits substantially under-resolve seller influence. We run the audit over 113,472 trials, seven models across families, and two product categories. To our knowledge, we also run the first price-equivalent audit of a decision-native model, Jev, which outputs a choice probability directly instead of generating text; strikingly, its profile is unlike any text model we tested, resisting most cues yet remaining susceptible to the strongest social-proof claims. We release the stimuli, logs, and code as a benchmark that reports each model's cue-price profile rather than a single score, giving developers and auditors a common, reproducible way to measure how content moves AI shopping agents.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 5 figures, 25 tables

</details>

### 499. [ACE-Trader: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Generator-Critic Trading Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25847v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25847

**作者：** Chang Zhou、Jiarun Zhou、Xingtong Yu、Hong Cheng、Hui Zhang、Xinming Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25847v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25847v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ACE-Trader，一个生成器—评论者对抗共演化交易框架：为 LLM 交易者和红队评审分别设计依赖情境的记忆选择器，用完整记忆与无记忆交易管线的净收益差作为共享反馈在线更新，并通过共享交易记录关联双方记忆，使交易者依据以往批评改进提案、评审者随交易者行为变化调整审查重点。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属金融交易智能体，与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系；但其「结果由双方动作共同决定、需为各角色分别归因经验」的信用分配与经验筛选设定，可能为 LVR 中多阶段 latent 状态或模块贡献分配提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ACE-Trader: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Generator-Critic Trading Systems

**abstract/A1：** Generator--critic trading systems pair an LLM-based trader that makes trading decisions with a red team agent that evaluates these decisions and provides feedback for revision. However, improving individual trading decisions does not ensure that both agents learn from experience and improve together over time. This raises an important question: how can the trader and red-Team select useful experience and learn from each other's evolving behavior? On one hand, experience that benefits decisions under one market condition may become ineffective or harmful under another. On the other hand, trading outcomes reflect both agents' actions, making it difficult to derive appropriate experience for each role. In this work, we propose ACE-Trader, an adversarial co-evolution trading framework. Specifically, we first develop separate context-dependent memory selectors that learn to identify useful experience for the current trading decision. Both selectors receive shared feedback from net-return differences between complete memory-assisted and memory-free trading pipelines, with online updates emphasizing recent outcomes. We further design a co-evolution mechanism that links role-specific memories through shared trading records. We use these records to evaluate the Red-Team's risk assessments and the effects of the Trader's revisions against realized market outcomes, then derive experience for their respective memories. By linking this experience to the corresponding records, we enable the Trader to improve its proposals based on prior critiques and the Red-Team to adjust its review focus as the Trader's behavior changes. Experiments on U.S. stock trading show that ACE-Trader outperforms all 22 active baselines in cumulative return and achieves the highest Sharpe ratio and lowest maximum drawdown across both active methods and passive benchmarks.

</details>

### 500. [ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25861v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25861

**作者：** Zhiyang Deng、Yuzhe Wu、Zijun Lin、Yeying Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25861v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25861v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文针对平面相机游戏世界模型，提出无参数的动作接口 ActionRoPE，把动作引起的相机位移编码为世界坐标的旋转位置，使同一世界位置的 token 在时间上保持相同位置地址；并配套 Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling，按「初始观测已覆盖」与「新揭示」两类区域分配 token 级去噪调度，使已知区域先稳定、新内容参照其生成。相较四种代表性动作条件机制，其动作跟随更忠实，重访漂移下降 66%。

**相关性简评：** 位置编码在此充当跨时间稳定的状态「地址」，且按已知/新生成区域区分去噪进程，这两点可能为 LVR 中潜状态在注意力结构下的位置与缓存稳定性、以及视觉证据的先筛选后生成提供可供核查的类比线索；但论文本身属视频世界模型的动作控制，未涉及推理或 VLM。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models

**abstract/A1：** Game world models have made rapid progress toward real-time interactive generation. Yet action control is still predominantly implemented as feature conditioning, leaving the model to learn from training data how each action should move the visual world. This formulation is poorly matched to a broad class of planar-camera worlds, such as top-down and isometric games. In these worlds, player motion induces a geometrically well-defined planar camera displacement. We observe that the key to spatially consistent control in such worlds is to represent the effect of each action directly in world coordinates. To this end, we introduce ActionRoPE, a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions. As a result, tokens corresponding to the same world location retain the same positional address across time. These world coordinates further expose a spatial asymmetry in generation: regions covered by the initial observation are geometrically known, while newly revealed regions remain to be synthesized. We therefore propose Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling (CNS), which assigns token-wise denoising schedules according to this known-new structure. It allows observed regions to stabilize earlier, while new content is generated with reference to them. Compared with four representative action-conditioning mechanisms, our approach follows the commanded motion more faithfully and reduces the revisit drift by 66% over the strongest baseline. The same interface transfers across video backbones from 1.3B to 33B parameters and to out-of-distribution scenes. Project Page: https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/

**作者：** Yukun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25865v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25865v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在至多 k 个来源域被撤回时仍能保持 Horn 结论的最小代价证据证书，用最小支撑集的横截刻画鲁棒性，指出「不相交证明」要求会误拒有效证书，并给出交替加权证据选择与来源失效 oracle 的精确算法及复杂度结论。

**相关性简评：** 「多个推导不构成独立证据」及按失效相关性构造稳健证据集的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、多 latent 假设的独立性与贡献分配提供待核查的概念线索，其反解释割生成算法也可供参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Minimum-Cost Robust Evidence Certificates for Horn Reasoning under Correlated Source Failures

**abstract/A1：** A small justification for a rule-based conclusion may disappear when a source is withdrawn, and multiple derivations need not provide independent evidence. We study minimum-cost certificates that preserve a Horn conclusion under every withdrawal of at most k source domains. Evidence records remain distinct from asserted facts, supporting replicated attestations and overlapping failure dependencies. Transversals of minimal-support footprints characterize robustness and explain why disjoint-proof requirements can reject valid certificates. An exact procedure alternates weighted evidence selection with a source-failure oracle. A rule-closed counterinterpretation yields a globally valid selection cut without enumerating supports or failure scenarios. We prove correctness, finite termination, and cost optimality, establish coNP-completeness of unrestricted verification and NP-completeness of synthesis for every fixed budget, and identify a tractable reachability restriction. Experiments on controlled benchmarks, reachability graphs, and ontology-derived instances demonstrate that our counterinterpretation-guided synthesis achieves up to 92% optimum coverage within practical resource bounds, outperforming scenario expansion and general abduction while confirming the necessity of transversal-based reasoning over proof-packing heuristics.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 2 figures

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25896v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25896v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PITCH 基准，让同一场无脚本多方对话的参与者共同标注候选 AI 发言的最佳插入轮次、可接受窗口或不应出现，并据此评测 15 个模型在 28 种配置下的时机决策表现。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本多方对话场景，但其「何时介入/是否等待」的时机判断与 LVR 的 STOP 决策相近，且「实时逐句决策」相对「给定完整历史」的准确率骤降（57.8%→19.0%）可供核查流式条件下 latent 推理停止与证据获取的评价设计，属概念启发而非已验证结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Should AI Chime In? Benchmarking Timely Contribution of Proactive Agents in Multi-Party Chat

**abstract/A1：** Proactive agents can support group collaboration by surfacing useful information without waiting to be asked, but even relevant contributions can be disruptive if poorly timed. In this work, we isolate the timing question: given a fixed candidate contribution such as a clarification or relevant fact, when should an AI agent chime in? We introduce PITCH (Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat), to our knowledge the first benchmark with large-scale human judgments of proactive agent timing collected from participants in the same unscripted multi-party conversations they took part in. To collect high-quality judgments, we design a novel interface in which 2-4 people chat synchronously, author candidate AI contribution messages, place their own and others' contributions into the chat history, and then deliberate as a group about the best placement for each message. PITCH contains 384 candidate contributions and 1,091 judgments, each marking an ideal turn, an acceptable window, or that a contribution should not appear, from 89 participants engaged in 35 conversations. Evaluating 15 models across 28 configurations, we find that while models can place contributions well when given the entire conversation history, they systematically chime in too early when asked to decide live as the conversation unfolds: best-turn accuracy falls from 57.8% to 19.0%, with nearly half of placements occurring before every participant's acceptable window. In comparison, lay humans deciding live are more accurate (23.7% vs 19.0%), and fewer of their placements are premature (39.7% vs 46.4%). Model reasoning traces show that 93% of intervention justifications cite relevance, while almost none consider waiting. By providing a human-grounded benchmark, our work reveals gaps in agents' ability to integrate into group settings and points towards proactive agents that can reason explicitly about appropriate timing.

</details>

### 503. [Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25901v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25901

**作者：** Nimeshika Udayangani、Flora D. Salim、Christopher Leckie、Sarah Erfani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25901v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25901v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究无回放持续学习中的 OOD 检测，提出基于 KAN 局部可塑性的任务自适应分类器 TA-KAN，以及不依赖过往 ID 数据的几何引导 OOD 分数，以缓解灾难性遗忘与置信度退化。

**相关性简评：** 其表示空间几何可分性与激活局部性控制，可能为 LVR 中判断内部状态是否仍保留足够视觉证据、以及 STOP/弃答决策提供可核查线索，但本文任务设定（持续学习分类）与多模态推理差异较大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 504. [Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25920v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25920

**作者：** Haoyu Li、Zeren Shui、Yuhao Zhang、Ferhat Erata、Benjamin Mikek、Murali Krishna Ramanathan、Hao Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25920v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25920v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Maestro 是一个 Lean 证明开发 harness：让证明器汇报失败的原因而非仅汇报失败，再由掌握全局证明的 coordinator 选择引导卡住的证明器、修正错误引理或撤回问题子树并重新规划；在多个数学与软件验证基准上优于各模型的原生编码 agent。

**相关性简评：** 其对失败的分类诊断、子树撤回与全局重规划、预算下的方向取舍，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督、贡献分配与停止/回溯决策的问题表述提供启发，但属形式证明领域，迁移到多模态 latent 推理尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination

**abstract/A1：** Lean is increasingly used to verify mathematical proofs and software produced by LLM agents, but writing formal proofs remains hard. Existing prover systems take a divide-and-conquer approach that recursively decomposes hard proof obligations into easier lemmas and splits again any lemma that resists proof. However, a lemma can resist proof for different reasons, including insufficient guidance, a false statement, or a flaw in the decomposition that produced it. Existing systems cannot tell these apart as a failed attempt reports little beyond its failure, and responses are confined to the failing node without considering the rest of the proof or revising the plan above it. The system may thus keep decomposing obligations along a flawed proof direction until the budget runs out, causing the whole proof attempt to fail. We introduce Maestro, a Lean prover harness that handles failures through global coordination. Provers report why they failed, not just that they failed, and a coordinator that sees the whole proof chooses an appropriate response, such as guiding a stuck prover, correcting a false lemma, or retracting a flawed subtree and replanning it. The same harness extends to verified code synthesis, where a checked counterexample sends the code back for repair. We evaluate Maestro with four frontier LLMs on seven mathematics and three software verification benchmarks. It proves more targets than each model's native coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on every benchmark the agent has not already saturated, with the largest gains on research-level mathematics. With Claude Opus 5, it discovers its own proofs of 34 of the 48 theorems in the June 2026 release of arXivLean, against 19 for the native agent. It also outperforms all published prover systems on every benchmark they share, solving 669/672 PutnamBench, 59/60 Lean-IMO-Bench, and 6/6 IMO 2026.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 cxbench 基准，面向受监管客服工作流中的工具型 LLM agent，把结果合规与过程合规分开评估：每个任务包含客户请求、工具环境和显式流程要求，用规则卡把监管义务映射到可观测的轨迹证据，并以确定性检查（顺序、权限）加 LLM 判分构成混合评分器；在七个模型、120 个任务上发现大量「假通过」，即结果通过但过程不合规。

**相关性简评：** 该工作处于受监管客服等较远场景，未涉及视觉或多模态内部状态；但其把「过程是否满足要求」与「最终结果是否正确」分离、并依据轨迹证据评分的思路，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的过程级评价、答案与推理路径分开考核提供可供核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CXBench: A Benchmark for Process-Compliant LLM Agents in Regulated Customer-Experience Workflows

**abstract/A1：** Tool-using language agents increasingly perform regulated customer-service workflows, where a correct final state is insufficient: agents must also provide disclosures, obtain consent, and follow required procedures. Existing tool-agent benchmarks largely score final business states, accepting trajectories that reach correct outcomes through non-compliant processes. We introduce cxbench, a benchmark that evaluates outcome and process compliance separately across six regulated domains. Each task combines a customer request, a tool-based environment, and explicit process requirements. Rule cards link cited regulatory obligations to observable trace evidence. A hybrid grader combines deterministic checks for ordering and authority with an LLM judge for semantic requirements. We define a false-pass as an outcome-pass run that fails process checks. Across seven models and 120 tasks, 55.5% of the 840 retained executions are false-passes, representing 80.1% of outcome-passing runs; only 13.8% pass both checks. Process-inclusive evaluation changes the observed model ordering and exposes differences hidden by outcome-only scoring. cxbench makes these failures inspectable through trace-linked criteria.

</details>

### 506. [EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25959v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25959

**作者：** X. Feng、J. Tang、Z. Lin、L. Chen、S. Shao、Q. Lu、K. Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发布 20 万级具身导航-规划数据集 EmbodiedWorld-200K（含多层级标注与统一评测划分），并提出用视频世界模型充当低成本环境代理、在其中对智能体做交互式 RL 后训练的训练方案。

**相关性简评：** 以世界模型生成想象观测来做轨迹式 RL 后训练，可能为 LVR 中利用 latent rollout 生成与更新推理状态、以及轨迹监督提供可核查线索；但论文关注具身导航规划，与 VLM 视觉推理主线联系较弱，属概念启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models

**abstract/A1：** Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026~

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作为 759 类硅藻显微图像训练 ResNet-18 基线，用温度缩放做后处理校准（ECE 由 0.117 降至 0.055），并在校准置信度上做选择性分类与专家复核分流。

**相关性简评：** 领域相距较远，但其「校准置信度 + 阈值拒答/转交专家」的分流机制，可能为 LVR 中基于置信度的停止决策与阈值选择提供可核查的参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation

**abstract/A1：** Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to 0.055.By leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $τ$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.

</details>

### 508. [Graph-to-Table Interfaces Control Relational Generalisation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25993v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.25993

**作者：** Alessandro Cagiano、Lorenzo Molfetta、Gianluca Moro、Matteo Zignani、Pasquale Minervini

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25993v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.25993v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究 graph-to-table 系统（encoder、context constructor、tabular decoder）能否通过只改一个组件的匹配比较独立评估，并在 CLUTRR、GraphLog 及 57 个知识图谱上结合多种模型检验结论是否随其他组件和评估协议变化。

**相关性简评：** 其「组件优劣依赖 decoder、context 与聚合协议，无法独立归因」以及位置编码成为捷径、在长路径上失效的观察，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与 readout 的贡献分配及长度泛化评价提供概念借鉴，具体对应关系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Graph-to-Table Interfaces Control Relational Generalisation

**abstract/A1：** Graph-to-table systems combine three design choices: an encoder that maps relational evidence to feature rows, a context constructor that selects labelled examples, and a tabular decoder. We investigate whether these components can be evaluated independently through matched comparisons that change one component while holding the rest of the pipeline and the evaluation constant. Across logistic regression, CATBOOST, and TABPFN-3 on CLUTRR, 57 GraphLog worlds, and 57 knowledge graphs, we show that conclusions about one component can change when the others change. On CLUTRR, absolute positional encodings maintain all distinctions among the evaluated queries and fit the short-path setting nearly perfectly; yet, they generalise worse than relation-count features because the supported prefix acts as a shortcut that breaks down on longer paths. On GraphLog, encoder preference depends on the decoder, while the relation-count representation degrades as CatBoost tree depth increases. Across different knowledge graphs, adding the frozen ULTRA score to local features is consistently useful, whereas adding local features to the score has a smaller and less stable effect. A pointwise TABPFN-3 readout using the full encoder underperforms native ULTRA on 48 of 57 datasets. These results show that encoder assessment depends jointly on context and decoder, while panel-level conclusions can also depend on evaluation and aggregation protocols.

</details>
