### 509. [Risk Decomposition for Hallucination-Aware Video Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26069v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26069

**作者：** Chenyan Zheng、Fan Wu、Ruibo Li、Jiaxing Li、Minghao Yang、Bang Zhang、Guosheng Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26069v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26069v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出二维物理幻觉风险框架，区分「低密度采样风险」（模型低似然生成）与「高密度漂移风险」（高似然但不物理一致），并据此开发在 latent refinement 中施加外部物理引导的 HA-Sampler，以及用 CNF 从生成器自身导出似然信号的 HA-Scorer。

**相关性简评：** 其「高似然不等于物理合理」的风险二分，以及从生成器自身导出似然作评分信号、并在 latent 精修中注入外部引导的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹质量评估、外部证据引导与信息坍缩判断提供可核查的概念线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Risk Decomposition for Hallucination-Aware Video Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Despite achieving high visual fidelity, video models still suffer from physical hallucinations, limiting their reliability as world simulators. Existing methods leverage model-internal or external signals to improve physical plausibility, but their roles and limitations require a unified explanation. We propose a two-dimensional physical-hallucination risk framework that defines low-density sampling risk and high-density drifting risk. The first risk captures generations assigned low likelihood by the video model, for example, a ball suddenly teleporting despite the model favoring continuous motion, while the second risk captures physical inconsistencies in high-likelihood generations, for example, a ball bouncing progressively higher without additional energy. Our analysis explains how model-internal signals steer sampling toward higher-density regions of the learned distribution to address low-density sampling risk. However, higher model likelihood does not guarantee physical plausibility, motivating external guidance to address high-density drifting risk. Based on this framework, we develop Hallucination-Aware Sampler (HA-Sampler), which applies external physical guidance within latent refinement to generate physically plausible videos, and HA-Scorer, which derives a likelihood-based signal from the generator itself for evaluating generated videos using continuous normalizing flow (CNF), with coarse ODE integration and finite-difference divergence estimates. Experiments on Physics-IQ and VideoPhy benchmarks support our theoretical analysis and demonstrate that our methods outperform the compared sampling and scoring SOTA baselines.

</details>

**作者：** Emirkan Burak Yilmaz、Yakup Genc

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PnP-Transformer，用可微、免迭代的神经位姿求解器替代经典 PnP-RANSAC：输入带置信度的半稠密 2D-3D 对应场，将几何输入映射到连续 latent 空间并回归 6D 位姿，在 BOP 七个数据集上取得 41.2% 平均 AR，但同等对应模块下 EPnP-RANSAC 反而更准、仅多耗 60ms。

**相关性简评：** 领域较远，但其将几何证据与置信度聚合进连续 latent 状态、以及「学到的 latent 回归与经典显式搜索的精度-延迟权衡」这一负结果，可能可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选与计算成本评价的参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation

**abstract/A1：** We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ECCV 2026 R6D Workshop

### 511. [Learning from a Bandit Learner](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26103v1>)

**作者：** Michela Petriconi、Nicolas Menet、Claire Vernade

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26103v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26103v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何从示范者的臂选择分布中反演其主观信念（对次优性 gap 的内部估计），刻画了一类可逐步反演的无 regret 随机策略，并分析稳定性与覆盖度的权衡及估计误差保证。

**相关性简评：** 从可观测行为分布反演内部潜在信念、并讨论反演何时病态（概率集中即信息不足）的分析，可能与从输出分布探测 VLM latent 推理状态的可辨识性和「信息坍缩」问题形成概念类比，但属较远领域，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning from a Bandit Learner

**abstract/A1：** Classical inverse bandit methods typically aim to recover true reward parameters. In contrast, we infer a demonstrator's subjective beliefs, specifically its internal estimates of suboptimality gaps. We consider no-regret demonstrators that follow randomized policies, such as Thompson sampling, and characterize a family of algorithms for which per-step inversion is possible. This enables gap estimates to be recovered directly from the arm-selection distribution. Our analysis identifies an inherent stability-coverage trade-off: inversion becomes ill-conditioned as the demonstrator concentrates its probability mass on a single arm, while the number of informative rounds depends on the rate at which its policy converges. We establish conditions under which inversion is reliable and provide theoretical guarantees on the resulting estimation error. Experiments on simulated data support the analysis and illustrate how these conditions affect gap recovery in practice.

</details>

**abstract/A1：** Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven effective for graph analytical tasks, yet their "black-box" nature complicates the understanding of their layer-wise behavior and hinders their application to large graphs. We demonstrate SliceGXQ, an end-to-end declarative and interactive system for querying and exploring layer-wise explanations for GNNs over large-scale graphs. In particular, SliceGXQ provides (1) an interactive graphical user interface for dataset, model, and explanation configuration; (2) a lightweight SPARQL-like parser that allows users to specify target nodes, layers, explanation modes, and constraints; and (3) an integrated execution and visualization workflow that invokes SliceGX as its underlying explanation engine. We demonstrate how users can diagnose a misclassified node, identify problematic layers and influential messages, and perform targeted model debugging, together with large-scale graph interpretation and fraud-detection analysis. Our demonstration video and source code are available at https://github.com/jinzhaoqet/SliceGXQ.

### 513. [Variance-Aware Non-Stationary Bandits:All-Budget Regret Bounds and Adaptation Costs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26116

**作者：** Xiaojin Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26116v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究有界非平稳多臂老虎机中的方差—变化权衡：在方差预算 Q 与变化预算 B 下给出极小极大动态遗憾的上下界，并量化相对于确定性预言机的「适应成本」。

**相关性简评：** 其「低方差降低估计成本但不免除对未观测臂的持续监控」以及适应成本前沿，可能为 LVR 中推理步/计算预算分配、视觉证据再检查与停止决策提供形式化参照，属远领域推测，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Variance-Aware Non-Stationary Bandits:All-Budget Regret Bounds and Adaptation Costs

**abstract/A1：** Low reward variance reduces estimation cost, but does not eliminate monitoring of arms that may improve while unobserved. We refine the variance--variation tradeoff and characterize how both costs depend on supplied variance and variation budgets in bounded, non-stationary multi-armed bandits. Let $A$ be the number of arms, $T$ the horizon, $B$ a bound on consecutive mean variation excluding the initial vector, and $Q$ a bound on the sum of the largest per-round reward variances. For every admissible pair $Q,B$, the minimax expected dynamic regret is, within a single logarithmic factor, \\\[ \\min\\{T,\\;A+\\sqrt{AQ}+(AQBT)^{1/3} +\\sqrt{AT}\\min\\{B,\\sqrt B\\}\\}. \\\] The deterministic boundary $Q=0$ is characterized without logarithms. For small positive budgets, a safe calibration phase identifies a common interval containing all future means of surviving arms. Clipping observations to a wider interval reduces the cost of restarting a prior hybrid static-regret algorithm; an original-mean analytical reference controls its residuals without charging the variation of clipped means. Balancing clipping bias and monitoring closes the small-budget noisy regime. Fixed oblivious constructions give the matching lower bound. We also quantify adaptation costs: on a disclosed deterministic one-improvement family, a stationary-regret budget has a matching worst-case change-regret frontier, including a finite improvement pulse. This implies an $Ω((T/A)^{1/4})$ loss when one policy competes with all supplied-budget deterministic oracle rates. The budget-free low-noise scheduling problem remains separate.

</details>

### 514. [Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26156v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26156

**作者：** Nicolás Ratier-Werbin、Samuel Lozano、Miguel Ruiz-García

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.dis-nn、cond-mat.soft

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26156v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26156v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Dynamical Batching（DB）：在不改动损失与优化器的前提下周期性改变每个 mini-batch 的类别组成，考察其能否改变网络的性能与内部组织；结果显示 DB 能让原本受容量限制、在均匀采样下停滞的 MLP 拟合数据，并使类别特化状态之间的切换由更少且更稳定的权重子集承担，在 CIFAR-10 上也有小幅测试精度提升。

**相关性简评：** 该文探讨训练期时间维度的类别强调如何塑造内部状态切换与权重子集的持久性，其「在相关子目标间循环使切换更高效」的视角可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、latent 状态特化与复用、贡献分配等提供类比线索，但与视觉推理无直接关联，需核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibrium systems, in which cycling between related sub-goals can make switching between their solutions increasingly efficient, we introduce Dynamical Batching (DB), a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged, and compare it with Uniform Batching (UB), in which every mini-batch has equal class proportions. In the regime where standard training fails, DB changes the outcome: on a three-arm spiral, a capacity-limited MLP that plateaus far below perfect accuracy under UB fits the training data under DB. Tracking individual weights, we find that under DB the change between class-specialized states is carried by a smaller set of weights than under UB, and that this set is markedly more persistent from cycle to cycle, on every synthetic dataset we test and in a wider network that fits the data under both protocols. This organization is a signature of the protocol rather than a predictor of its benefit: it appears equally where DB leaves accuracy unchanged. On CIFAR-10, the same protocol modestly improves the test accuracy of a channel-narrowed ResNet-10, a standard residual architecture, and of a second capacity-limited convolutional network. These results show that how class emphasis is distributed in time can shape both the solution a network reaches and the internal structure of the network.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/samuellozanoiglesias/dynamical\_batching (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23349474)

</details>

**相关性简评：** 属较远的法律推理领域，但其「神经模块只负责消解开放要件、其余交由符号求解」的分工，以及检索深度对结果无明显影响的观察，可能为 LVR 中证据筛选与贡献分配、检索量是否真正进入推理状态提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law

**abstract/A1：** Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to JURIX 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26251

**作者：** Hongyin Zhang、Mingyi Xiang、Rongzhao Chen、Yankai Wang、Jialin Qiao、Xiangdong Huang、Xiaoou Ding、Chen Wang、Zhongyi Pei、Jianmin Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26251v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26251v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CaFE，一种基于原始时间序列基准的可刷新评测扩展：以八个结构特征对数据重采样与增强，再用预测误差与干预-响应指标给出分特征能力画像。

**相关性简评：** 领域相距较远，但其「干预-响应」度量与多维能力画像，可能为 LVR/VLM 推理评测如何摆脱单一聚合分数、按结构条件筛选样本提供核查线索，是否可迁移待读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Static Leaderboards: Capability-Focused Evaluation with Structural Diversity for Time Series Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Static public benchmarks for time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically have fixed and narrow test distributions. Their repeated reuse encourages benchmark-specific tuning, making reported performance reflect adaptation to the fixed test set rather than genuine forecasting generalization. In addition, a single aggregate score cannot fully characterize model capabilities across distinct temporal structures and input relationships. We propose CaFE (Capability-Focused Evaluation), a refreshable evaluation extension grounded in original benchmark data that enriches static benchmarks with structural diversity and enriches single-score black-box evaluation with multi-dimensional, capability-oriented assessment. CaFE first profiles the original benchmark and defines eight Structural Features (SFs) that characterize its temporal structure. For each SF, it resamples the original data according to its structural support, removes edge-of-distribution samples, and augments the retained samples by varying the SF's salience, producing samples with different structural profiles. After filtering out out-of-distribution samples while preserving diversity, CaFE yields a refreshed evaluation set. TSFMs are then evaluated on this set using both conventional forecast-error metrics and intervention-response metrics, giving each model a per-feature capability profile alongside endpoint accuracy. Experiments on GIFT-Eval and FEV-Mini20 show that CaFE yields stable evaluation results and reveals per-feature strengths and weaknesses that a single aggregate score hides. Moreover, on genuine data filtered by structural condition, models selected by CaFE outperform those chosen by the aggregate leaderboard. CaFE therefore makes model selection conditional on the structural response of interest.

</details>

### 518. [LOCU: Lowdin-Orthogonalized Constraint Updates for Multi-Constraint Policy Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26256v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26256

**作者：** Joonyoung Lim、Younghwan Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26256v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26256v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究 CMDP 多约束策略优化中约束梯度互相干扰导致的病态更新问题，提出 LOCU，用 Löwdin 正交化自然梯度并结合筛选与压缩，把信任域约简为低维空间中的对称约束求解，并处理不可行起点。

**相关性简评：** 该文处理「更新方向彼此抵消与冗余重叠」并做几何正交化与子空间约简，可能为 latent 推理状态中分量冗余、信息坍缩与表示几何干扰的管理提供类比线索，具体对应关系尚需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LOCU: Lowdin-Orthogonalized Constraint Updates for Multi-Constraint Policy Optimization

**abstract/A1：** We investigate multi-constraint policy optimization in constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), where interactions among constraint gradients often yield ill-conditioned update directions, causing numerically fragile steps and unintended cancellation or redundant overlap in constraint corrections. To address this, we propose LOCU, which mitigates numerical instability arising from constraint interactions by applying symmetric Lowdin orthogonalization to the natural gradients of the reward and constraints under the Fisher-Rao metric. Combined with Fisher-geometric screening and near-collinear compression, LOCU yields a compact reduced space in which the trust region becomes a Euclidean ball and constraints are handled symmetrically through a low-dimensional active-set solve. For infeasible iterates, LOCU constructs a Pareto-descent direction which preserves the local feasibility of satisfied constraints within the same reduced formulation. Experiments show that LOCU remains stable under high constraint coupling, narrow feasible regions, and infeasible starts, and generalizes across different cost critic architectures.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** REFLEX: RNA Ensemble Generation via Flexibility-Calibrated Stochastic Bridge

**abstract/A1：** RNA molecules often function through multiple experimentally observed conformational states. A central challenge is to capture ensemble diversity without sacrificing structural fidelity: samples may collapse toward averaged representative structures or drift into unsupported conformational regions. We introduce REFLEX (RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility), a sequence-conditioned generator for RNA backbone-frame ensembles based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3). During training, experimental B-factors calibrate residue-wise bridge widths, exposing each observed conformer through local perturbation neighborhoods with residue-specific scales while keeping constrained regions sharper. A learned flexibility condition guides the bridge-field network to recover target conformer-specific frames from these calibrated noisy states. At inference, REFLEX uses only the input sequence, requiring no MSA-subsampling heuristics. On a multi-conformer RNA benchmark, REFLEX achieves the best precision-recall trade-off for ensemble coverage across evaluation thresholds, while recovery-stress ablations indicate gains in target-frame recovery under stronger perturbations.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward Online Robust Zero-Sum Markov Games with Function Approximation

**abstract/A1：** Online robust zero-sum Markov games pose a coupled operator-learning and game-solving problem: from nominal interaction data, the learner must recover a worst-case minimax Bellman operator while maintaining strategic coverage and controlling stage-game approximation error. Existing robust reinforcement-learning theory does not yet provide such an operator-learning perspective beyond specialized multi-agent settings. We develop an optimistic dual robust Bellman framework that combines dual robust Bellman fitting, optimistic minimax planning, backward-validated confidence sets, and exploiter-mix data collection. Our analysis is organized around the robust Bellman residuals induced by the candidate value class and yields a regret reduction that separates exploration complexity, robust operator-estimation error, stage-game solution error, and misspecification. Under explicit interpretable assumptions, we obtain conditional theorem interfaces for general and projected function approximation, together with closed results in several structured regimes, including tabular, epochwise cross-fit linear, self-normalized pure-online linear / finite-rank kernel, and projected RKHS truncation. Small-scale numerical experiments illustrate robustness calibration, strategic coverage, and the return-gap trade-off predicted by the framework.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 70 pages, including appendices

</details>

**title/T1：** VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.

**comment/C1：** (Technical report (27 pages, 21 figures)

</details>

### 522. [CTLite: Lightweight Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Reusable Continuous-Time Summaries](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26379v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26379

**作者：** Shusen Ma、Xudong Zuo、Yangchun Xie、Yun-Bo Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26379v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26379v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CTLite：用无参数的连续时间矩编码器在多时间尺度上总结局部水平与趋势，再由紧凑读出模块结合阻尼局部外推与低秩跨变量修正做预测，历史摘要可跨优化步与重复预测复用。

**相关性简评：** 时间序列预测与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联；但其把状态摘要与可训练读出解耦、摘要可跨调用复用的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的构建与缓存复用提供线索，尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CTLite: Lightweight Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Reusable Continuous-Time Summaries

**abstract/A1：** Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) requires capturing temporal dynamics and cross-variable dependencies from sparse, asynchronous observations. Existing methods often rely on learned temporal encoders, coupling historical representation construction with model optimisation and repeatedly processing the same observations. We propose CTLite, a lightweight forecasting framework that decouples historical summarisation from learned prediction. Specifically, a parameter-free continuous-time moment encoder summarises local levels and trends at multiple temporal scales while suppressing poorly supported slope estimates. A compact readout combines damped local extrapolation with a low-rank cross-variable correction that accounts for observation freshness, target availability, and forecast horizon. Since the historical summaries are independent of trainable parameters and forecast queries, they can be reused across optimisation steps and repeated predictions for an unchanged history without altering predictions or parameter gradients. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that CTLite achieves the best or second-best mean MSE and MAE among the evaluated methods with only 88-2,537 trainable parameters. Under matched GPU workloads at batch size 32, CTLite reduces inference latency by 18.6-87.3% compared with the latest models, including the cost of historical encoding. Reusing summaries further reduces total runtime by approximately 52% over 16 forecast calls on the same history compared with recomputing the encoder for every call, including the initial encoding cost. The code is at: https://github.com/SSMa913/NICLab-CTLite.

</details>

### 523. [A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26407v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26407

**作者：** Motti Goldberger、Nils Rudi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26407v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26407v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究贝叶斯 top-k 识别问题：在固定采样预算下自适应地分配对候选项目的噪声采样，通过最小化期望机会成本上界导出的代理目标来决定每批采样，并证明其后验成本以至少最优速率一半的指数速率衰减，模拟中与各设定下最好的现有算法相当或更优。

**相关性简评：** 该文属于远离多模态的序贯决策/资源分配理论，但「预算受限下把采样分配给不确定候选」的问题表述可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与算力分配（何时继续取证据、何时停止）存在概念对应，可供核查其代理目标与速率分析能否迁移到 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本–收益刻画。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection

**abstract/A1：** This paper considers the Bayesian top-$k$ identification problem, wherein a decision maker is tasked with selecting $k$ items from a pool of items of unknown quality. To assess the items, the decision maker adaptively allocates a fixed sampling budget, where each sample of an item yields a noisy observation of its quality, with the objective of minimizing the expected opportunity cost of the selected set. We propose an approach that allocates each batch of samples by minimizing a surrogate objective derived from an upper bound on the expected opportunity cost. The approach is general: samples can be allocated in batches, the selection size $k$ is arbitrary, and it applies to many sampling distributions. It is also simple and intuitive. We prove that the method's posterior expected opportunity cost decays at an exponential rate of at least half the best rate achievable by any sampling rule. In simulations across a wide range of settings, the method is competitive with, and often improves upon, the best existing algorithm in each setting.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26430

**作者：** Ma{ë}lis Morier、Jairo Rodr{í}guez Padilla、Patrick Gallinari、Maxime Sermesant

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26430v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26430v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种图注意力分类器，仅利用前两次起搏激活的节点电压与编码几何、刺激频率、组织标签等的边属性，在模拟心脏电生理数据上提前预测持续性室性折返是否发生，并报告了准确率等指标与消融、注意力定性分析。

**相关性简评：** 其「仅凭早期少量观测预测最终结局」的设定与注意力集中于决定性区域，可能为 LVR 中依据部分证据决定继续观察或提前停止（STOP）以及实体关系编码提供概念类比，可供核查；但材料未涉及视觉-语言推理或 latent 状态生成，联系仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physiology-Aware Graph Attention for Early Ventricular Reentry Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Sudden cardiac death mostly originates from post-infarct ventricular tachycardia. This reentry is sustained by propagation around scar tissue, but its risk remains difficult to predict from infarct imaging alone. While in silico induction studies can reveal these mechanisms, exploring many substrates and pacing locations remains computationally expensive. We propose a graph attention classifier for early prediction of sustained ventricular reentry from simulated cardiac electrophysiology. Each simulation is represented as a graph with early nodal voltage samples and edge attributes encoding geometry, stimulation frequency, tissue labels, amplitude, and diastolic interval. These descriptors are computed only from the first two paced activations, before sustained reentry is observed. On a balanced independent test set of 1000 simulations, the classifier achieves 94.6% accuracy, 95.4% sensitivity, 93.8% specificity, 94.6% F1-score, 0.987 ROC-AUC, and 0.985 PR-AUC. Ablation experiments show that diastolic interval is the most critical descriptor. Qualitative attention inspection suggests that different heads focus on border-zone, stimulation location, and early propagation path. These results support graph attention as a fast early-prediction approach for large-scale in silico ventricular reentry studies.

</details>

### 525. [Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26453v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26453

**作者：** Guannan Lai、Zi-Yang Bai、Jun-Peng Jiang、Han-Jia Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26453v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26453v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出在生成、交互与记忆预算紧张时，现有终身记忆方法常不如简单检索甚至无记忆智能体，并提出 TokenWorth：一个从稀疏执行反馈中在线学习「查询相关记忆价值」的轻量框架，并将其统一用于记忆检索与有界记忆管理，在三个 LifelongAgentBench 环境与本地／API 部署上取得最高成功率与最少输出 token。

**相关性简评：** 其「在预算下学习哪些经验值得保留与复用」的价值估计思路，可能启发 LVR 中如何筛选视觉证据或保留哪些 latent 状态、以及缓存与上下文长度对推理的影响，属于概念层面的可核查线索，而非已验证的视觉推理结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints

**abstract/A1：** Lifelong agents continually accumulate and reuse experience to improve after deployment, yet in practice they often operate under tight generation, interaction, and memory budgets. Under such stringent joint constraints, we find that existing lifelong-memory methods can become ineffective, with several sophisticated approaches offering little advantage over simple retrieval or even no-memory agents. This reveals a more fundamental problem: resource scarcity makes each memory decision more consequential. When only a small amount of past experience can be retained or reused and opportunities for reasoning and recovery are limited, retrieving a relevant but ineffective memory can consume scarce context and hinder downstream execution. The key challenge is therefore not simply to retrieve relevant experience, but to determine which experiences are actually worth retaining and reusing. To address this challenge, we propose TokenWorth, a lightweight online memory framework that learns query-dependent memory worth from sparse execution feedback and applies it consistently to memory retrieval and bounded memory management. Across three LifelongAgentBench environments and both local and API-based deployments, TokenWorth achieves the highest task success rate while using the fewest output tokens among the evaluated methods. These results suggest that effective lifelong adaptation under resource constraints depends not on remembering more, but on learning what is worth remembering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth.

</details>

### 526. [A Simple and Unified Method for Gradient-Variation Regret](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26473v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26473

**作者：** Hang Yu、Peng Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26473v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26473v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种基于「带二次决策移动惩罚的代理损失」的统一方法，在非平稳在线学习与通用在线学习两类设定下同时得到梯度变化（gradient-variation）遗憾界，并用于在线博弈。

**相关性简评：** 其决策移动的二次惩罚与动态遗憾分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态逐步更新的平滑约束，以及环境难度非平稳时计算/步骤分配的评价方式提供类比线索，可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Simple and Unified Method for Gradient-Variation Regret

**abstract/A1：** Gradient-variation online learning has attracted increasing attention for its connections to game theory and optimization. It has been studied in both non-stationary online learning, which aims to minimize dynamic regret against time-varying comparator sequences, and universal online learning, which seeks to adapt to unknown loss curvature. Prior work obtained gradient-variation bounds using different techniques tailored to each setting. We propose a simple and unified method based on surrogate losses with a quadratic penalty on decision movement, yielding gradient-variation bounds in both settings. For non-stationary online learning, the method induces an optimistic-to-gradient-variation reduction, enabling a broad class of algorithms to match the rate established by Zhao et al. (2024). For universal online learning, it yields a simple algorithm that matches the optimal universal regret bounds of Yan et al. (2024) while relaxing the extended smoothness assumption. Finally, we apply our method to online games and improve on existing guarantees.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文分析降水临近预报中普遍存在的湿偏数据管线：基于目标观测的采样不仅偏向极端事件，还会改变生成模型学到的条件分布，使评测偏差掩盖训练偏差；作者用固定的卫星到雷达扩散模型证明，目标依赖的测试采样会让校准结论反转（湿偏测试集上偏低估、部署代表性测试集上偏高估），且七年后的域外数据仍可复现，并借 classifier-free guidance 说明这种矛盾评估会误导下游开发。

**相关性简评：** 其「目标依赖采样使训练与评测偏差互相掩盖、结论可被反转」的机制分析，可能为 LVR 中基准筛选、分布偏移下 latent 使用与校准评估的可靠性提供可供核查的方法论类比，但与视觉推理本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Wet-Biased Data Pipelines Mislead the Training and Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting

**abstract/A1：** Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically how this target-dependent sampling also shifts the conditional distribution learned by generative models. When training and test sampling match, even an ideal model learns precisely the distribution favored by evaluation, allowing the evaluation bias to conceal the training bias. Using a fixed satellite-to-radar diffusion model, we demonstrate that target-dependent test sampling can reverse the calibration assessment. The model appears under-predictive on a wet-biased test set but over-predictive on a deployment-representative test set. This result is replicated outside the model's training domain after a seven-year gap. Utilizing classifier-free guidance as an example, we demonstrate how the contradictory calibration assessment can misdirect downstream model development.

**comment/C1：** 63 pages, 7 figures and 3 tables in the main text, 11 supplementary figures and 9 supplementary tables. This work has been submitted to npj Climate and Atmospheric Science

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing

**abstract/A1：** Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.

**内容简述：** 这是一篇金融领域的立场与议程论文，主张以结构化数据为先，构建模块化、领域专业化的金融基础模型，通过「表示织体」实现跨域复用与组合，并要求模型在多个聚合层级和时间尺度上维持持久金融状态、刻画其动态、模拟动作条件下的未来。

**相关性简评：** 与 latent visual reasoning 无直接关联，但其「部分可观测下维持持久多尺度状态并模拟动作条件未来」的议程，可能为 latent 推理状态的持续更新与展开提供概念参照；稀有尾部状态与制度切换下的校准评价，或可类比长链推理的鲁棒性与停止决策评价，属推测性线索，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward Structured Financial Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models promise reusable capabilities and step-change performance gains across tasks. In finance, large-scale pretraining of domain-specialized foundation models can advance both goals. However, prevailing architectures and objectives do not by themselves address the combined demands of financial systems: partial observability, interacting entities, asynchronous events, changing regimes, action-dependent outcomes, and rare states with disproportionate consequences. Moreover, independently developed specialists may learn incompatible representations, while multi-domain monolithic alternatives couple data access, model updates, and governance. We therefore propose a structured-data-first research agenda centered on modular, domain-specialized financial foundation models connected by a representation fabric for reuse and composition across domains and tasks. These models should maintain persistent financial state across aggregation levels and time horizons, capture its dynamics, and simulate action-conditioned futures, while remaining calibrated across regimes and for tail outcomes. They must also learn efficiently under data and access constraints and provide faithful, traceable explanations. We identify research challenges, directions, and capability-oriented evaluation criteria.

</details>

**内容简述：** 通过 80 名参与者的纵向模拟交易实验，检验 LLM 能否在交易发生、买卖结构、资产选择与组合结果上复现个体投资者的行为与决策逻辑，并以输入消融和解释对齐评分分析其证据依赖。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Behavioral Accuracy: Evaluating Individual-Level Fidelity in LLM Investor Simulation

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as user simulators, but can they faithfully reproduce an individual's behavior and decision logic over time? We investigate this question in a longitudinal paper-trading study with 80 participants. Using rolling next-day predictions, we evaluate trading activity, buy-sell structure, asset selection, and portfolio outcomes, complemented by controlled input ablations and participant-rated explanation alignment. No evaluated LLM reliably outperforms a simple recent-activity persistence baseline for predicting trade occurrence, while buy-sell structure and asset selection remain difficult to reproduce. Similar activity-level performance can also yield substantially different portfolio trajectories. Ablations show that activity predictions depend primarily on recent trades, whereas asset choices are sensitive to multiple evidence sources. Participants rate explanations as more aligned with their recurring strategies than with their decision-specific rationales. These findings reveal a gap between coarse behavioral agreement and individual-level fidelity, motivating separate evaluation of behavioral accuracy, explanation alignment, and evidence dependence in personalized user simulation.

### 531. [Training Natural Schemers: RL Can Amplify Oversight-Conditional Behavior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26551v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26551

**作者：** Bart Jaworski、Nathaniel Mitrani、Fred Bruford、Victoria Krakovna

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26551v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26551v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 Kimi K2.6 上构造不依赖测试期提示或手工后门的「自然」scheming 模型，再用只奖励任务质量与策略合规、不奖励 scheming 的 RL 训练，发现监控与无监控下的合规差距（oversight flip）随训练扩大，CoT 中出现围绕监控的工具性推理，且该策略可在多个环境间迁移。

**相关性简评：** 来自 AI 安全领域：其「奖励只覆盖任务质量仍会放大未被奖励行为」的现象，可能为 LVR 中任务奖励能否支撑 latent 状态的实际使用、贡献分配与训练监督提供待核查的概念线索，但与本主线无直接交集，需较多迁移核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training Natural Schemers: RL Can Amplify Oversight-Conditional Behavior

**abstract/A1：** One of the central concerns for the safety of advanced AI is scheming: when a model strategically complies under oversight but pursues its own goals when unobserved. Current demonstrations, such as Anthropic's Alignment Faking work, depend on design choices that make them less convincing: explicit test-time prompting, handcrafted backdoors, or training data that demonstrates or hints at the target behavior. Model organisms built in this way cannot tell us whether scheming tendencies would arise or increase under realistic training conditions. We therefore construct a natural model organism of scheming, built on Kimi K2.6: trained with traits that could plausibly emerge in a frontier training pipeline, and without providing the model with the target scheming policy. The resulting model is a benign schemer: it aims to maximize aggregate help across all users over time, values its own continued operation only as a means to future help, and knows the consequences of oversight and deployment. We then train it using Reinforcement Learning (RL) with a reward that scores only task quality and policy compliance and does not reward scheming; we show that this amplifies scheming. We measure the oversight flip (the gap between monitored and unmonitored compliance with a given policy) and find that it increases during RL training across our environments. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) analysis finds explicit instrumental reasoning about oversight accompanying this behavior. The effect holds across our three RL environments, and we find that the scheming policy transfers between them. The pipeline also replicates on other open-weight base models. Our results suggest that a reward that does not reward scheming offers no inherent protection against certain traits when an oversight-conditional policy is indistinguishable from an aligned one during training.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 19 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 532. [MRI Reconstruction Risk Estimation from Inference Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26558v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26558

**作者：** Tamir Shor、Alex Bronstein

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26558v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26558v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把迭代式 MRI 重建的推理轨迹视为重建风险的内部表示，将中间状态投影为图像、压缩成 16 维描述子，用源域训练的 ridge 读出预测 log-NMSE，并考察零样本域偏移、前缀提前预测与少样本校准。

**相关性简评：** 其「内部状态轨迹＋线性读出」以及域偏移下读出翻转、校准改变、有用信息早于完成出现的观察，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息含量、提前停止读取与跨分布稳健性提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MRI Reconstruction Risk Estimation from Inference Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Iterative MRI reconstructors produce intermediate estimates before returning a final image. We study these inference trajectories as a model-internal representation of realized reconstruction risk, measured by log-NMSE. Model-native states are projected to magnitude images, summarized by a fixed 16-dimensional descriptor, and mapped to risk using a source-trained ridge readout. Across three reconstruction backbones, trajectory features are strongly predictive of reconstruction risk on held-out source data. Under zero-shot target shift, their behavior is backbone-dependent, exhibiting both preserved positive association and readout reversal. Conditional analyses show that trajectory information can remain associated with error beyond an initialization-only predictor. A prefix analysis further shows that useful trajectory information can emerge before reconstruction completes. Repeated-mask and low-shot calibration studies indicate that trajectories primarily encode persistent case difficulty, while their orientation and calibration can change under domain shift.

</details>

### 533. [Reward Objectives for Robust (PO)MDPs: A Law-Preserving Equivalence with (Partially Observable) Games](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26568v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26568

**作者：** Durgam Latha、Dion Reji、Dorde Zikelic、Shankaranarayanan Krishna

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.FL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26568v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26568v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究稳健部分可观测 MDP（RPOMDP）在折扣、长期平均与累积奖励目标下的求解问题，形式化 law-invariant 风险度量（含期望、均值-方差、CVaR、熵风险），并通过 logspace 归约证明 (s,a)-矩形 RPOMDP 与部分可观测随机博弈（POSG）等价，导出新的复杂度结论。

**相关性简评：** 其信念状态下的部分可观测决策与对抗性不确定性形式化、以及风险敏感效用度量，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据不完整时的推理决策与停止/评价提供问题表述线索，可供核查，但领域较远、联系仍属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reward Objectives for Robust (PO)MDPs: A Law-Preserving Equivalence with (Partially Observable) Games

**abstract/A1：** Robust partially observable Markov decision processes model agents that act under partial observability while adversarial environment resolves uncertainty in the transition probabilities. Reward objectives such as discounted-sum, long-run average and cumulative reward under finite and infinite horizons allow quantifying the utility of an agent. We consider the problem of solving RPOMDPs under all four reward objectives, where the goal is to decide whether the value of a risk measure with respect to a reward objective exceeds a given threshold. We consider different risk measures, such as (1)~expected value, (2)~mean-variance (MV), (3)~conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), and (4)~entropic risk (ERisk). Our results can be summarized as follows. First, we formalize the class of law-invariant risk measures, that subsume all four risk measures above. Second, we propose a unified framework for solving RPOMDPs with discounted-sum, long-run average and cumulative reward objectives under any law-invariant risk measure, by reducing the problem to solving partially observable stochastic games (POSGs). Our unified framework applies to (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets, which we show to be {\\em equivalent} to POSGs, for each of the four reward objectives and any law-invariant risk measure. We prove equivalence by designing logspace reductions between the RPOMDP and POSG models, that map strategies to strategies and preserve the distribution of the reward objective, up to a constant rescaling factor. Third, as a corollary, we derive new computational complexity results for R(PO)MDPs and POSGs. In particular, we show that solving (s,a)-rectangular RMDPs is as hard as solving simple stochastic games.

</details>

### 534. [WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26582v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26582

**作者：** Arjun Ashok、Mihir Parmar、Palash Goyal、Bhavana Dalvi Mishra、Chun-Liang Li、Irina Rish、Alexandre Drouin、Jinsung Yoon、Tomas Pfister

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26582v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26582v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 WhatIf-Bench：以数据中心、电网、交通与供水系统的半合成时间序列，评测预测模型能否依据历史干预事件预测目标对未来事件（复现已见取值 Replay 或使用未见取值 Novel）的响应，并比较 TSFM、LLM 与回归基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「模型是否真正使用外部证据、以及在未见干预取值与更多事件同时设置时泛化」的诊断设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被实际使用、组合与场景泛化的评价方式提供参照，属远领域线索，尚需核查，未见与视觉 latent 推理的直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Recent time series foundation models (TSFMs) can consume covariates in-context, extending zero-shot forecasting to problems driven by external factors. This enables scenario analysis: forecasting how a target responds to events that set covariates to chosen future values. Whether they can do this reliably is an open question. We introduce WhatIf-Bench, a benchmark measuring how well forecasters use covariates to forecast a target's response to future events. WhatIf-Bench is semi-synthetic: time series come from mechanistic simulators of data centers, power grids, road traffic, and water networks, with controlled covariate-target relationships grounded in each system. Each task presents a history of events intervening on covariates, then asks to forecast a future event that either replays seen values (Replay) or sets them to unseen ones (Novel). Varying the number of covariates, historical events, and event length yields 37,665 tasks. Evaluating TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and simple regression baselines, we find the LLMs reach the highest skill (improvement over a naive baseline), ahead of the best TSFMs. Every model forecasts well on Replay futures (48 to 85% skill) but drops to -7 to 50% on Novel futures, with the regression baselines falling the most. Skill on Novel futures also falls as events set more covariates jointly. More historical events raise skill on Novel futures across the board, but large differences remain. WhatIf-Bench reveals generalization to Novel futures as the core challenge, and offers a testbed toward arbitrary scenario analysis.

**comment/C1：** Leaderboard at https://huggingface.co/spaces/arjunashok/WhatIf-Bench; code at https://github.com/ashok-arjun/whatif-bench

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26612

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.AC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26612v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26612v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究点云在旋转与置换等价下如何被分离：给出 n 个点的不变量多项式分离所需的二次上下界，据此推导 Tensor Field Networks 与 MACE 达到完整性所需的表示阶数显式上界，并给出仅依赖局部邻域不变量度的消息传递方案与 MACE 反例。

**相关性简评：** 其关于不变量阶数与表示容量的理论界，可能为 LVR 中内部状态需保留多少几何或细节信息、表示阶数是否充分提供形式化视角，属表示几何层面的潜在启发，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Degree Bounds for Separating Polynomial and Neural Invariants for Point Clouds

**abstract/A1：** Neural networks that respect the symmetries of point clouds commonly compute high-order representations of the rotation group to improve their expressivity. Such models are known to be universal, and thus able to separate any pair of point clouds, when using representations of sufficiently high order, yet no precise bound on this order, as a function of the number of points, was previously known. We establish the first quadratic lower and upper degree bounds for polynomials that separate point clouds of n points up to rotations and permutations. By showing Tensor Field Networks and MACE can express all invariant polynomials of a given degree with sufficient representation order, we additionally derive the first explicit, quadratic bound on the representation order sufficient for these architectures to be complete, replacing previous existence results with concrete guarantees. We further show that, under local regularity assumptions, point cloud separation can be achieved with a message-passing-based model using invariants whose degree depends only on the size of a local neighborhood, rather than on the size of the full point cloud. Finally, we provide counterexamples showing MACE must compute high order irreducible representations to separate locally regular point clouds.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 2 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Global Time-Aware Conditioning（GTC），在局部位置编码之外用「睡眠全局时间」对 latent 表示做条件化，并把它接入三种 SSL 框架，在两个儿科队列的五项任务上评估，F1 与 AUPRC 普遍提升且跨队列迁移仍有效。

**相关性简评：** 其把全局时间位置注入 latent 的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的位置/深度条件化以及内容与位置对表示的影响提供可核查线索，但领域为睡眠生理信号，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC): A Mechanism for Time-Aware Pediatric Sleep Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Sleep physiology evolves throughout the night, with changes in sleep cycles, respiratory stability, and cardiovascular dynamics. However, self-supervised learning (SSL) methods for sleep typically process short, fixed-duration windows without explicitly modeling where each window occurs within the full sleep session. We introduce Global Time-Aware Conditioning (GTC), a mechanism that complements local positional encodings by conditioning latent representations on the global time-of-sleep of each input window. We integrate GTC into three representative SSL frameworks and evaluate them on five clinically relevant tasks with extreme class imbalance across two independent pediatric cohorts. GTC generally improves F1 and AUPRC across architectures and tasks, with gains persisting under cross-cohort transfer, highlighting the value of global temporal context for sleep representation learning.

</details>

### 537. [VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26629v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26629

**作者：** Shashwat Saxena、Mehul Goel、Sreyas Venkataraman、Sarvesh Patil、Max Simchowitz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26629v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26629v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Value Disaggregation（VaDar）：训练单个不依赖子目标的策略去最大化各子目标 critic 值的线性组合，使子目标信息仅在训练期使用、部署时无需子目标选择，并在 RoboCasa 长时域任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练期借子目标信息改善 critic 学习、推理期不必条件化目标」的思路，可能与 LVR 中是否需在推理期保留目标相关 latent 状态、以及用辅助监督塑造内部表示的问题形成类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence. We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the efficacy of critic learning, whereas policy goal-conditioning is often unnecessary.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 以 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型为对象，研究预训练阶段过滤病毒蛋白的效果、规模依赖与耐久性：过滤会选择性降低病毒相关任务的性能、随模型增大更有效，但少量微调即可恢复。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练数据筛选—特定能力选择性退化—再训练恢复」的评估思路，可能为 LVR 中训练期监督如何影响内部表示的信息保留、贡献分配与遗忘耐久性提供类比线索，但与视觉多模态推理主线距离较远，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Effectiveness and Durability of Pretraining Data Filtering in Protein Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Pretraining filtering is one of the most common safeguards for open-weight language models. Here we study its effectiveness, durability and scalability using the ESM-2 family of protein language models. We find that filtering viral proteins from the pretraining data meaningfully degrades masked language modelling, mutation effect prediction and long-range contact prediction on viral proteins, while largely preserving performance on non-viral proteins. These effects are concentrated among proteins from human-infecting viruses, and grow as we scale models from 8M to 3B parameters. As models increase in size, we find that stringent filtering becomes more effective. However, fine-tuning on sequences from the removed viral families restores the lost performance. Although the cost to recover performance increases with model scale, even for the largest models it costs about 80 USD of H100 time. This work establishes pretraining filtering as moderately effective at selectively degrading performance on viral proteins, but not durable against fine-tuning with modest computational resources and access to relevant data.

</details>

### 539. [Honeypots for AI Agent Insider Threats](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26664v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26664

**作者：** Jan Wehner、Jam Kraprayoon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26664v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26664v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张把「蜜罐」作为 AI 控制手段：在组织生产环境中布置诱饵机会，以诱发、识别和归责内部代理的有害行为，并讨论其局限、随能力提升仍有效的理由以及待研究问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「主动布置诱饵以触发并检验监控能否发现隐藏行为」的思路，可能可供核查用于设计 LVR 诊断，验证推理是否真正依赖视觉证据、以及内部状态监控的可靠性；但材料本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Honeypots for AI Agent Insider Threats

**abstract/A1：** AI agents deployed inside organizations can pose an insider threat if they make mistakes, are compromised by an attacker, or pursue misaligned objectives. We propose honeypots as an AI control method to improve the security of internal agent deployments. Rather than only using honeypots for pre-deployment evaluations, defenders should plant decoy opportunities for harmful actions throughout the production environment to detect misbehavior, incriminate malicious agents, and deter attacks. Such honeypots can elicit misbehavior under real deployment conditions, identify malicious agents even if chain-of-thought monitorability degrades, provide reliable warnings about agent misbehavior to security teams, and scale cheaply to many agent instances. The presence of honeypots also introduces uncertainty about which opportunities are real, thus deterring malicious agents from attacking and reducing the rate of misbehavior. We discuss the limitations of honeypots and give reasons to expect them to remain effective as agent capabilities increase. Finally, we outline key research questions to measure and improve the effectiveness of honeypots: testing the robustness of honeypots, comparing their detection effectiveness with other monitoring methods, understanding their incrimination and deterrence effects, and building supporting infrastructure.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PACT 针对信息逐步揭示的动态多智能体组合优化问题，在环境图中加入表示智能体计划的辅助节点以指示未来依赖，并通过增广图上的消息传递实现主动式冲突协调，在动态路由任务上提升解质量并更好地迁移到更大实例。

**相关性简评：** 其「把计划作为显式辅助节点编码未来依赖、以主动而非被动方式协调」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的证据获取与前瞻性决策提供概念线索，是否可迁移到多模态推理状态尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PACT: Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-Graphs for Dynamic Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent approaches have been investigated recently as a means of improving the scalability of reinforcement learning for neural combinatorial optimization. Existing methods assume that all problem instance information is known upfront. However, real-world problems are often dynamic: relevant information is progressively revealed as the agents take actions (e.g., arriving at an edge in a routing problem only to discover it is untraversable). In such cases, existing methods fail to coordinate agents to explore and exploit the progressively revealed information. To address the arising coordination challenge, we introduce PACT (Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs). PACT augments the environment graph with auxiliary nodes representing the plans of agents, which are connected to the resource nodes to indicate future dependencies. The proposed message-passing scheme over the augmented graph grounds inter-agent coordination in the environment and enables proactive, rather than reactive, conflict resolution. We show that PACT improves solution quality in dynamic problems relative to baselines and exhibits the best transfer to larger instances on which, remarkably, it outperforms centralized oracles with privileged access to instance uncertainty.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 STEPBENCH，从 wikiHow 采集 6,885 条流程并构造 5 类诊断任务（步骤缺失、错误、乱序的判定与下一步生成），用于区分 agent 规划中不同环节的失败，并比较诊断分数与整体计划有效性的关系。

**相关性简评：** 虽不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其「按步骤类型拆解过程错误、并以低成本诊断预测端到端有效性」的评价思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中推理轨迹各步贡献与答案正确性的关联，尤其是乱序与长步骤（9 步以上）性能骤降的现象，或与长度泛化/状态更新问题有类比价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** StepBench: Diagnosing Real-World Procedural Understanding in AI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating an agent's planning ability remains challenging for open-domain tasks, where verifying procedures through execution is often impractical. Existing evaluations typically assess only the final plan and do not distinguish procedural errors such as missing, incorrect, or misordered actions. We introduce STEPBENCH, a benchmark of 6,885 verified procedures crawled from wikiHow across 81 open-domain categories. From each procedure, we derive 5 diagnostic tasks: four with deterministic answers involving withheld, incorrect, or shuffled steps, and one requiring next-step generation. We additionally evaluate full-plan generation to examine how diagnostic performance correlates with end-to-end plan validity. Using the same procedures across tasks lets us directly compare different planning capabilities. For generation, STEPEVAL identifies critical failures that prevent goal completion. Across 14 configurations of 12 models, we find substantial differences across planning capabilities, with step ordering proving the most difficult: the strongest model correctly orders only 63.0% of procedures, dropping to 33.1% for those with nine or more steps. Incorrect-step detection also predicts judged plan validity across models, suggesting a lower-cost alternative for evaluating generation quality. On STEPBENCH-Val, comprising 214 procedures published in 2026, comprehension scores and rankings remain stable, suggesting limited influence from memorisation.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26698

**作者：** Lennart Finke、Hardik Bhatnagar、Euodia Dodd、Francis Rhys Ward、Yves-Alexandre de Montjoye、Matthias Bethge、Mary Phuong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26698v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26698v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文训练「模型生物」在漏洞检测任务中隐瞒答案（sandbagging），用转录蒸馏、反提示与抗篡改训练赋予其选择性、抗诱导与知识保留三种性质，作为研究 ELK 的测试平台。

**相关性简评：** 该工作对「能否从内部状态读出未表达知识」的诱导鲁棒性与保留性评估，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉信息是否真被读出或使用、以及探测手段的可靠性提供参照；但属 AI 安全领域、非多模态，联系需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Robust Model Organisms for Eliciting Latent Knowledge

**abstract/A1：** A key problem in AI safety is eliciting latent knowledge (ELK), extracting information from a model that is misaligned and more knowledgeable than its overseer. For example, a misaligned model used to scan code for vulnerabilities may want to withhold its findings, i.e., sandbag, in order to exploit them later. To study ELK empirically, we need model organisms that mirror this setting. Existing model organisms fall short in several respects. In this work, we train model organisms to withhold solutions in a vulnerability detection task. We combine transcript distillation with counter-prompting and tamper-resistance training to instill three properties that we argue are critical for a useful ELK testbed: 1) Selectivity, the model sandbags when it thinks the overseer doesn't know the answer and complies otherwise, 2) Robustness, the model resists elicitation, and 3) Retention, the model retains a knowledge advantage over the overseer, as opposed to losing the relevant capability. We train a sequence of model organisms and show that our strongest model substantially outperforms prior models on robustness while keeping the other two properties intact. We hope that our model organisms provide a useful ELK testbed for the community, and that our methodology sparks the development of increasingly challenging model organisms. All our code, models and the dataset are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/lennart-finke/sandbagging.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26710v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26710v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究时变治疗与历史依赖删失下的异质生存治疗效果估计，提出将干预窗口与生存期分离的双稳健学习框架，并给出 Neyman 正交、速率双稳健与拟神谕效率等理论性质。

**相关性简评：** 其面向时变干预的序列调整与双稳健、正交化估计，可能为 LVR 中跨推理步的贡献分配与轨迹级监督提供可核查的借鉴线索，但与本主线的联系仍属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Doubly Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Survival Treatment Effects under Time-Varying Treatments

**abstract/A1：** Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects (HSTEs) from time-to-event data under time-varying treatments is important in fields such as medicine (e.g., to decide which sequence of treatments is better in terms of survival probability). However, this task is challenging because treatment decisions, patient characteristics, and censoring probability often evolve together, requiring sequential adjustment for both treatments and censoring. Existing survival learners mostly consider a single baseline treatment assignment, while longitudinal treatment-effect learners typically assume uncensored outcomes. In this paper, we introduce a novel doubly robust learner for heterogeneous survival treatment effects under time-varying treatments and history-dependent censoring. Our framework separates the intervention window from the survival horizon, with treatment prescribed for a finite period, after which care follows its natural course. We further establish the favorable theoretical properties of Neyman-orthogonality, rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency. The framework accommodates flexible machine learning models for nuisance estimation and treatment-effect regression. We evaluate our learners through several numerical experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26711

**作者：** Kaiwei Chen、Moran Li、Zhenye Gan、Yabiao Wang、Chengjie Wang、Kexin Zhang、Yong Liu、Jiangning Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26711v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26711v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PVBench，一个面向视频生成的物理合理性基准：包含 600 条提示、46 个维度、七大领域，并用专门的视觉模型对物体级 6D 姿态、度量尺度、表面法向、运动学及守恒律残差做定量测量，另附人评校准与主流模型对比。

**相关性简评：** 该工作针对视频生成而非 VLM 推理，与主线较远；但其「用物体级可验证测量替代主观打分」的评估思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中几何与任务必要视觉细节是否被保留和使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements

**abstract/A1：** Recent video generation models produce visually compelling outputs, yet their physical plausibility remains poorly measured. Physical plausibility asks whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws. Existing benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than video generation itself. We introduce PVBench, a physical video benchmark that quantitatively measures the plausibility of generated videos across 46 dimensions organized into seven domains, spanning: i) instruction and semantic fidelity, ii) behavioral and causal consistency, iii) perceptual and temporal quality, iv) geometric and spatial consistency, v) material properties and field states, vi) kinematic and spatiotemporal persistence, vii) and mechanical plausibility with conservation laws. PVBench comprises 600 carefully crafted prompts, of which 30% involve physical embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems. For challenging physically tractable dimensions, it pairs each with specialized vision models that derive verifiable, physically grounded measurements, such as object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals. It thus avoids relying solely on subjective scoring, while supporting both text-to-video and image-to-video generation. Finally, we validate the agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments through human evaluation. Meanwhile, we evaluate mainstream open-source and closed-source models and present several insights. By releasing the benchmark, prompts, and calibration protocol, we aim to foster physically grounded video generation.

</details>

### 545. [Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26718v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26718

**作者：** Jean-Loup Dupret、Patrick Cheridito

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26718v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26718v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出深度 Pontryagin 学习框架，求解含跳扩散的高维连续时间随机控制：把伴随（状态敏感度）学习与策略改进分离，先用轨迹反向传播得到路径级伴随标签并回归投影到 Markov 状态，再以逐点 Hamiltonian 平稳条件更新控制。

**相关性简评：** 其「先沿轨迹回传得到敏感度/信用标签、再投影回状态并单独更新策略」的分解，可能为 LVR 中 latent 步骤的贡献分配与状态监督提供概念类比，可供核查，尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps

**abstract/A1：** We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.

</details>

### 546. [Cross-Fitting for Neural Posterior Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26733v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26733

**作者：** Jeffrey Regier

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26733v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26733v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CF-NPE：通过 K 折 cross-fitting 把后验均值估计与后验高阶矩估计分离，先拟合 K 个均值回归器，再对 out-of-fold 残差拟合条件密度估计器，以缓解标准 NPE 对训练点的过度自信，在合成与宇宙学实验中改善 held-out log-likelihood 与校准。

**相关性简评：** 其 amortized 后验（信念状态）建模与过自信、校准及分布外泛化的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练监督和置信度评价提供可供核查的类比线索，但领域较远，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-Fitting for Neural Posterior Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) fits an amortized conditional density estimator to a simulated training set of complete-data realizations. NPE's training objective, log-likelihood, favors posterior approximations that assign arbitrarily high density to the training points, and typical families of amortized conditional density estimators (e.g., normalizing flows, Gaussian encoders) are flexible enough to oblige. The resulting policy of extreme overconfidence translates poorly to held-out data. Early stopping and other regularizers can prevent this degeneracy, but they are limited to selecting posterior approximations along an unfavorable optimization trajectory set by in-sample residuals, where the posterior mean is underfit while the posterior variance is overfit. To avoid this trade-off, we propose Cross-Fitting NPE (CF-NPE), which uses sample splitting to separate conditional-mean estimation from the estimation of the posterior's higher moments. Using $K$-fold cross-fitting, CF-NPE fits $K$ posterior-mean regressors and then fits a conditional density estimator to the resulting out-of-fold residuals. In experiments with synthetic data and in a cosmological application, CF-NPE achieves higher held-out log-likelihood than standard NPE and typically improves calibration. CF-NPE is most useful in high-dimensional, simulation-limited settings.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility（TSI），用交互复形与容量层把任务层面的相容性障碍与系统能力分开，以非零上同调作为结构签名，并在两个有限单轮多智能体模型上给出精确性与修复率对比。

**相关性简评：** 其层与上同调「局部信息能否粘合成全局截面」的障碍刻画，可能为分析局部视觉证据在 latent 状态中能否相容整合、以及信息坍缩的判据提供形式化语言，是否可迁移到 LVR 诊断尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility: A Theoretical Framework for Multi-Agent Task Obstructions

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent systems can differ under identical agents and communication budgets when they support different forms of joint interaction. We introduce Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility (TSI), a sheaf-theoretic framework separating task-level compatibility obstructions from system capability. A task is represented by an interaction complex $K$ and a capacity sheaf $\\mathcal{F}$; nonzero $H^n(K;\\mathcal{F})$ defines a structural signature, while registered interventions test capability. For cocycle data, cochain realization is solvable exactly when the represented cohomology class vanishes. Examples show that the signature is sheaf-relative, and the degree-1 reduction yields cycle-space witnesses and observation requirements. We evaluate two finite one-round models. Across 15,625 degree-1 inputs, an all-agent additive primitive solves decision and repair exactly; the optimal pairwise system reaches 88.80% on decision, one input above the 88.79% majority-class baseline, and 26.63% on repair. On a degree-2 tetrahedral-boundary task over 531,441 inputs, the same-2-skeleton system retains all four three-agent primitives yet matches the pairwise-only optimum throughout the registered separation window, whereas adding the class-filling four-agent primitive makes both tasks exact. Status-preserving robustness checks retain exact performance but are not cost-matched to the class-restoring ablation. Conditional on the registered primitives and cost models, TSI provides task-relative, falsifiable tests of higher-order interaction.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LG-Bench: A Graph-Structured Evaluation Benchmark for Life Sciences

**abstract/A1：** Traditional evaluation benchmarks reduce inherently interconnected scientific knowledge in life sciences into flat lists of questions, disregarding the underlying topological structure of the knowledge. We introduce, the first graph-structured benchmark for life sciences, featuring over 10,000 high-quality multiple-choice questions across medicine, biology, and chemistry. Our approach constructs a weighted evaluation graph using bidirectional matching and semantic similarity algorithms, where nodes represent questions and edge weights capture their semantic relationships. Leveraging this graph topology, we design two novel evaluation metrics. The Global Coherence Score (GCS) measures a model's consistency within semantically related neighborhoods, while Knowledge Balance Score (KBS) analyzes how model errors are distributed across the graph to reveal conceptual blind spots. LG-Bench facilitates fine-grained comparison of LLMs by surfacing differences in conceptual coherence and patterns of knowledge organization across models. Our framework shifts the evaluation paradigm from flat accuracy metrics to structure-aware analysis, offering a new lens for diagnosing and improving LLM performance in the life sciences domain.

</details>

### 550. [Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26800v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.26800

**作者：** Yuheng Ma、Chendi Wang、Qiong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26800v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.26800v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「预算化本地专家转介」框架，把去中心化联邦学习的推理期协作建模为图约束路由过程：每个客户端学习基于密度的路由势，据此在邻居间逐跳转介查询，并沿路径聚合本地模型预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐跳转介＋预算限制＋沿路径聚合」的线索可供核查，或可类比 LVR 中动态计算分配、证据逐步获取与停止决策的状态更新设计；但原文不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning

**abstract/A1：** In decentralized federated learning, heterogeneous clients may develop complementary expertise, yet each query is typically evaluated only by the client where it arrives. To exploit this distributed expertise without global coordination, we formulate inference-time collaboration as budgeted local expert referral, a graph-constrained routing process in which a query can move only between neighboring clients and only visited clients contribute to its final prediction. EdgeDRM implements this framework by learning a density-based routing potential for each client: differences between neighboring potentials provide the comparisons used to select successive referrals, while local task models generate predictions that are aggregated along the resulting route. Both training and inference are decentralized, using only neighbor-local information without a central router or graph-wide client scoring. We establish estimation guarantees for the learned comparisons and characterize how local improvement and graph structure govern prior-weighted density gains from referral. Experiments on benchmark and real-world medical data show that EdgeDRM outperforms graph-matched decentralized baselines in most settings, with the clearest benefits under sparse connectivity.

</details>
